1→/**
     2→ * Standardized error types for the application
     3→ *
     4→ * These error classes help distinguish between different error categories,
     5→ * enabling better error handling, user messaging, and logging.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * Base application error with additional context
    10→ */
    11→export class AppError extends Error {
    12→  /** Whether this error should be shown to the user via toast */
    13→  public readonly showToast: boolean;
    14→  /** Additional context for logging */
    15→  public readonly context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    16→  /** Original error if this wraps another error */
    17→  public readonly cause?: Error;
    18→
    19→  constructor(
    20→    message: string,
    21→    options?: {
    22→      showToast?: boolean;
    23→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    24→      cause?: Error;
    25→    }
    26→  ) {
    27→    super(message);
    28→    this.name = 'AppError';
    29→    this.showToast = options?.showToast ?? true;
    30→    this.context = options?.context;
    31→    this.cause = options?.cause;
    32→  }
    33→}
    34→
    35→/**
    36→ * Network-related errors (fetch failures, timeouts, offline)
    37→ * These are often transient and may benefit from retry
    38→ */
    39→export class NetworkError extends AppError {
    40→  /** Whether the user appears to be offline */
    41→  public readonly isOffline: boolean;
    42→  /** Whether this was a timeout */
    43→  public readonly isTimeout: boolean;
    44→
    45→  constructor(
    46→    message: string,
    47→    options?: {
    48→      isOffline?: boolean;
    49→      isTimeout?: boolean;
    50→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    51→      cause?: Error;
    52→    }
    53→  ) {
    54→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
    55→    this.name = 'NetworkError';
    56→    this.isOffline = options?.isOffline ?? !navigator.onLine;
    57→    this.isTimeout = options?.isTimeout ?? false;
    58→  }
    59→
    60→  static fromError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, unknown>): NetworkError {
    61→    const isTimeout = error.name === 'AbortError' || error.message.includes('timeout');
    62→    const isOffline = !navigator.onLine;
    63→
    64→    let message = 'Network request failed';
    65→    if (isOffline) {
    66→      message = 'You appear to be offline. Please check your connection.';
    67→    } else if (isTimeout) {
    68→      message = 'Request timed out. Please try again.';
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    return new NetworkError(message, { isOffline, isTimeout, context, cause: error });
    72→  }
    73→}
    74→
    75→/**
    76→ * Authentication/authorization errors
    77→ * User needs to log in or doesn't have permission
    78→ */
    79→export class AuthError extends AppError {
    80→  /** Whether the user needs to log in (vs lacking permission) */
    81→  public readonly needsLogin: boolean;
    82→
    83→  constructor(
    84→    message: string,
    85→    options?: {
    86→      needsLogin?: boolean;
    87→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    88→      cause?: Error;
    89→    }
    90→  ) {
    91→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
    92→    this.name = 'AuthError';
    93→    this.needsLogin = options?.needsLogin ?? true;
    94→  }
    95→
    96→  static fromError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AuthError {
    97→    const message = error.message.toLowerCase();
    98→    const needsLogin = message.includes('unauthorized') || message.includes('not authenticated');
    99→
   100→    return new AuthError(
   101→      needsLogin ? 'Please log in to continue' : 'You don\'t have permission for this action',
   102→      { needsLogin, context, cause: error }
   103→    );
   104→  }
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Validation errors (invalid input, missing required fields)
   109→ * These are user errors that can be corrected
   110→ */
   111→export class ValidationError extends AppError {
   112→  /** The field that failed validation, if applicable */
   113→  public readonly field?: string;
   114→
   115→  constructor(
   116→    message: string,
   117→    options?: {
   118→      field?: string;
   119→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   120→      cause?: Error;
   121→    }
   122→  ) {
   123→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
   124→    this.name = 'ValidationError';
   125→    this.field = options?.field;
   126→  }
   127→}
   128→
   129→/**
   130→ * Server/API errors (5xx responses, unexpected server behavior)
   131→ * These are typically not the user's fault
   132→ */
   133→export class ServerError extends AppError {
   134→  /** HTTP status code if available */
   135→  public readonly statusCode?: number;
   136→
   137→  constructor(
   138→    message: string,
   139→    options?: {
   140→      statusCode?: number;
   141→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   142→      cause?: Error;
   143→    }
   144→  ) {
   145→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
   146→    this.name = 'ServerError';
   147→    this.statusCode = options?.statusCode;
   148→  }
   149→}
   150→
   151→/**
   152→ * Errors that should be silently logged (not shown to user)
   153→ * Use for expected failures like localStorage unavailable, optional features
   154→ */
   155→export class SilentError extends AppError {
   156→  constructor(
   157→    message: string,
   158→    options?: {
   159→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   160→      cause?: Error;
   161→    }
   162→  ) {
   163→    super(message, { showToast: false, ...options });
   164→    this.name = 'SilentError';
   165→  }
   166→}
   167→
   168→/**
   169→ * Type guard to check if an error is one of our app errors
   170→ */
   171→export function isAppError(error: unknown): error is AppError {
   172→  return error instanceof AppError;
   173→}
   174→
   175→/**
   176→ * Type guard to check if an error is a network error
   177→ */
   178→export function isNetworkError(error: unknown): error is NetworkError {
   179→  return error instanceof NetworkError;
   180→}
   181→
   182→/**
   183→ * Type guard to check if an error is an auth error
   184→ */
   185→export function isAuthError(error: unknown): error is AuthError {
   186→  return error instanceof AuthError;
   187→}
   188→
   189→/**
   190→ * Categorize an unknown error into an appropriate AppError type
   191→ */
   192→export function categorizeError(error: unknown, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AppError {
   193→  // Already an AppError
   194→  if (isAppError(error)) {
   195→    return error;
   196→  }
   197→
   198→  // Convert to Error if needed
   199→  const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
   200→  const message = err.message.toLowerCase();
   201→
   202→  // Network errors
   203→  if (
   204→    err.name === 'AbortError' ||
   205→    message.includes('network') ||
   206→    message.includes('fetch') ||
   207→    message.includes('timeout') ||
   208→    message.includes('failed to fetch') ||
   209→    !navigator.onLine
   210→  ) {
   211→    return NetworkError.fromError(err, context);
   212→  }
   213→
   214→  // Auth errors
   215→  if (
   216→    message.includes('unauthorized') ||
   217→    message.includes('forbidden') ||
   218→    message.includes('not authenticated') ||
   219→    message.includes('authentication required')
   220→  ) {
   221→    return AuthError.fromError(err, context);
   222→  }
   223→
   224→  // Validation errors
   225→  if (
   226→    message.includes('required') ||
   227→    message.includes('invalid') ||
   228→    message.includes('validation')
   229→  ) {
   230→    return new ValidationError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  // Default to generic AppError
   234→  return new AppError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   235→}
   236→

import { renderHook, act, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import React from 'react';

function createWrapper() {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false, gcTime: 0 } },
  });
  return ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>
  );
}
```

1→import { createTask, validateRequiredFields, TaskValidationError } from '../taskCreation';
     2→import type { TaskCreationResult } from '../taskCreation';
     3→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Parameters for creating an image upscale task
     7→ */
     8→interface ImageUpscaleTaskParams {
     9→  project_id: string;
    10→  image_url: string; // The source image to upscale
    11→  generation_id?: string | null; // Optional: the generation ID to update with upscaled URL
    12→  source_variant_id?: string; // Optional: track which variant was the source for lineage
    13→  scale_factor?: number; // Default to 2x upscaling
    14→  noise_scale?: number; // Default to 0.1
    15→  output_format?: string; // Default to "jpeg"
    16→  shot_id?: string; // Optional: associate with shot for navigation from TasksPane
    17→}
    18→
    19→/**
    20→ * Validates image upscale task parameters
    21→ * @param params - Parameters to validate
    22→ * @throws TaskValidationError if validation fails
    23→ */
    24→function validateImageUpscaleParams(params: ImageUpscaleTaskParams): void {
    25→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'image_url']);
    26→
    27→  if (params.image_url.trim() === '') {
    28→    throw new TaskValidationError('Image URL cannot be empty', 'image_url');
    29→  }
    30→
    31→  // Validate URL format
    32→  try {
    33→    new URL(params.image_url);
    34→  } catch {
    35→    throw new TaskValidationError('Image URL must be a valid URL', 'image_url');
    36→  }
    37→
    38→  if (params.scale_factor !== undefined && (params.scale_factor < 1 || params.scale_factor > 8)) {
    39→    throw new TaskValidationError('Scale factor must be between 1 and 8', 'scale_factor');
    40→  }
    41→}
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Builds the task params for an image-upscale task
    45→ */
    46→function buildImageUpscaleTaskParams(
    47→  params: ImageUpscaleTaskParams
    48→): Record<string, unknown> {
    49→  const taskParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
    50→    image: params.image_url,
    51→    scale_factor: params.scale_factor ?? 2,
    52→    noise_scale: params.noise_scale ?? 0.1,
    53→    output_format: params.output_format ?? "jpeg",
    54→  };
    55→
    56→  // Add generation_id to task params so the worker knows which generation to update
    57→  // Also add based_on for lineage tracking (same as inpaint and other edit tasks)
    58→  // is_primary=true makes the upscaled version the main display variant
    59→  if (params.generation_id) {
    60→    taskParams.generation_id = params.generation_id;
    61→    taskParams.based_on = params.generation_id;
    62→    taskParams.is_primary = true;
    63→  }
    64→
    65→  // Track source variant if enhancing from a specific variant
    66→  if (params.source_variant_id) {
    67→    taskParams.source_variant_id = params.source_variant_id;
    68→  }
    69→
    70→  if (params.shot_id) {
    71→    taskParams.shot_id = params.shot_id;
    72→  }
    73→
    74→  return taskParams;
    75→}
    76→
    77→/**
    78→ * Creates an image upscale task
    79→ * 
    80→ * @param params - Image upscale task parameters
    81→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
    82→ */
    83→export async function createImageUpscaleTask(params: ImageUpscaleTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
    84→
    85→  try {
    86→    // 1. Validate parameters
    87→    validateImageUpscaleParams(params);
    88→
    89→    // 2. Build task params in the image-upscale format
    90→    const taskParams = buildImageUpscaleTaskParams(params);
    91→
    92→    // 3. Create task using unified create-task function
    93→    const result = await createTask({
    94→      project_id: params.project_id,
    95→      task_type: "image-upscale",
    96→      params: taskParams,
    97→    });
    98→
    99→    return result;
   100→
   101→  } catch (error) {
   102→    handleError(error, { context: 'ImageUpscale', showToast: false });
   103→    throw error;
   104→  }
   105→}

    64→  if (params.strength !== undefined && (params.strength < 0 || params.strength > 1)) {

    76→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {

    83→      }

    88→/**
    89→ * Validates batch parameters

    91→function validateBatchParams(params: BatchZImageTurboI2ITaskParams): void {
    92→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'image_url', 'numImages']);
    93→
    94→  if (params.numImages < 1 || params.numImages > 16) {
    95→    throw new TaskValidationError('Number of images must be between 1 and 16', 'numImages');
    96→  }

   108→/**
   109→ * Builds task params in the format expected by the worker
   110→ */
   111→function buildTaskParams(params: ZImageTurboI2ITaskParams): Record<string, unknown> {
   112→  const taskParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
   113→    image_url: params.image_url,
   114→    prompt: params.prompt ?? '',
   115→    strength: params.strength ?? 0.6,
   116→    enable_prompt_expansion: params.enable_prompt_expansion ?? false,
   117→    num_images: params.num_images ?? 1,
   118→    // API-specific params
   119→    image_size: 'auto',
   120→    num_inference_steps: 8,
   121→    output_format: 'png',
   122→    enable_safety_checker: true,
   123→  };
   124→
   125→  // Add seed if provided
   126→  if (params.seed !== undefined) {
   127→    taskParams.seed = params.seed;
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  // Add LoRAs if provided (transforms to API format)
   131→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   132→    taskParams.loras = params.loras.map(lora => ({
   133→      path: lora.path,
   134→      scale: lora.scale ?? 1.0,
   135→    }));
   136→    // When using LoRAs, acceleration must be "none"
   137→    taskParams.acceleration = 'none';
   138→  } else {
   139→    // Without LoRAs, use "high" acceleration
   140→    taskParams.acceleration = 'high';
   141→  }
   142→
   143→  // Add lineage tracking
   144→  if (params.based_on) {
   145→    taskParams.based_on = params.based_on;
   146→  }
   147→
   148→  if (params.source_variant_id) {

   154→  }

   157→  if (params.shot_id) {
   158→    taskParams.shot_id = params.shot_id;
   159→  }
   160→
   161→  // Add tool type override
   162→  if (params.tool_type) {
   163→    taskParams.tool_type = params.tool_type;
   164→  }
   165→
   166→  // Make edits unpositioned by default
   167→  taskParams.add_in_position = false;
   168→
   169→  return taskParams;
   170→}
   171→
   172→/**
   173→ * Creates a single Z Image Turbo I2I task
   174→ * (internal use only - used by createBatchZImageTurboI2ITasks)
   175→ */
   176→async function createZImageTurboI2ITask(params: ZImageTurboI2ITaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   177→

   181→

   200→/**
   201→ * Creates multiple Z Image Turbo I2I tasks in parallel (batch generation)
   202→ */
   203→export async function createBatchZImageTurboI2ITasks(params: BatchZImageTurboI2ITaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
   204→
   205→  try {
   206→    // 1. Validate parameters
   207→    validateBatchParams(params);
   208→
   209→    // 2. Generate individual task parameters for each image
   210→    const taskParams = Array.from({ length: params.numImages }, (_, index) => {
   211→      // Generate a different seed for each task
   212→      const seed = params.seed ?? Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x7fffffff);
   213→
   214→      return {
   215→        project_id: params.project_id,
   216→        image_url: params.image_url,
   217→        prompt: params.prompt,
   218→        strength: params.strength,
   219→        enable_prompt_expansion: params.enable_prompt_expansion,
   220→        seed: seed + index, // Increment seed for variation
   221→        num_images: 1, // Each task creates one image
   222→        loras: params.loras,
   223→        shot_id: params.shot_id,
   224→        based_on: params.based_on,
   225→        source_variant_id: params.source_variant_id,
   226→        create_as_generation: params.create_as_generation,
   227→        tool_type: params.tool_type,
   228→      } as ZImageTurboI2ITaskParams;
   229→    });
   230→
   231→    // 3. Create all tasks in parallel
   232→    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
   233→      taskParams.map(taskParam => createZImageTurboI2ITask(taskParam))
   234→    );
   235→
   236→    return processBatchResults(results, 'createBatchZImageTurboI2ITasks');
   237→

   239→    handleError(error, { context: 'BatchZImageTurboI2I', showToast: false });
   240→    throw error;

   140→  // Build the task params in the format expected by image_edit
   141→  const taskParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
   142→    seed: params.seed ?? Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x7fffffff),
   143→    image: params.image_url,
   144→    prompt: params.prompt,
   145→    output_format: params.output_format ?? "jpeg",
   146→    qwen_edit_model: params.qwen_edit_model ?? 'qwen-edit',
   147→    enable_sync_mode: params.enable_sync_mode ?? false,
   148→    max_wait_seconds: params.max_wait_seconds ?? 300,
   149→    enable_base64_output: params.enable_base64_output ?? false,
   150→  };
   151→
   152→  // Add optional parameters if provided
   153→  if (params.negative_prompt) {
   154→    taskParams.negative_prompt = params.negative_prompt;
   155→  }
   156→
   157→  if (params.in_scene !== undefined) {
   158→    taskParams.in_scene = params.in_scene;
   159→  }
   160→
   161→  // Add resolution if needed (some edit models may use this)
   162→  if (finalResolution && finalResolution !== "custom") {
   163→    taskParams.resolution = finalResolution;
   164→  }
   165→
   166→  // Add shot_id as top-level parameter if provided
   167→  if (params.shot_id) {
   168→    taskParams.shot_id = params.shot_id;
   169→  }
   170→
   171→  // Always add add_in_position as false for magic edit tasks (unpositioned by default)
   172→  taskParams.add_in_position = false;
   173→  
   174→  // Add tool_type override if provided (for generation association)
   175→  if (params.tool_type) {
   176→    taskParams.tool_type = params.tool_type;
   177→  }
   178→
   179→  // Add loras if provided
   180→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   181→    taskParams.loras = params.loras;
   182→  }
   183→
   184→  // Add based_on if provided (for lineage tracking)
   185→  if (params.based_on) {
   186→    taskParams.based_on = params.based_on;
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  // Add source_variant_id if provided (for variant relationship tracking)
   190→  if (params.source_variant_id) {
   191→    taskParams.source_variant_id = params.source_variant_id;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Add create_as_generation if true (create new generation instead of variant)
   195→  if (params.create_as_generation) {
   196→    taskParams.create_as_generation = true;
   197→  }
   198→
   199→  // Add hires fix / inference params if provided
   200→  Object.assign(taskParams, buildHiresFixParams(params.hires_fix));
   201→
   202→  return taskParams;
   203→}
   204→
   205→/**
   206→ * Creates a single magic edit task using the unified approach
   207→ * This replaces the direct call to the magic-edit edge function
   208→ * (internal use only - used by createBatchMagicEditTasks)
   209→ *
   210→ * @param params - Magic edit task parameters
   211→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   212→ */
   213→async function createMagicEditTask(params: MagicEditTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   214→
   215→  try {
   216→    // 1. Validate parameters
   217→    validateMagicEditParams(params);
   218→
   219→    // 2. Resolve project resolution (client-side)
   220→    const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   221→      params.project_id,
   222→      params.resolution
   223→    );
   224→
   225→    // 3. Build task params in the image_edit format
   226→    const taskParams = buildMagicEditTaskParams(params, finalResolution);
   227→
   228→    // 4. Create task using unified create-task function
   229→    const result = await createTask({
   230→      project_id: params.project_id,
   231→      task_type: "qwen_image_edit",
   232→      params: taskParams,
   233→    });
   234→
   235→    return result;
   236→
   237→  } catch (error) {
   238→    handleError(error, { context: 'MagicEdit', showToast: false });
   239→    throw error;
   240→  }
   241→}
   242→
   243→/**
   244→ * Creates multiple magic edit tasks in parallel (batch generation)
   245→ * Used by MediaLightbox unified edit mode for creating multiple variations
   246→ * 
   247→ * @param params - Batch magic edit parameters
   248→ * @returns Promise resolving to array of created tasks
   249→ */
   250→export async function createBatchMagicEditTasks(params: BatchMagicEditTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
   251→
   252→  try {
   253→    // 1. Validate parameters
   254→    validateBatchMagicEditParams(params);
   255→
   256→    // 2. Resolve project resolution once for all tasks
   257→    const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   258→      params.project_id,
   259→      params.resolution
   260→    );
   261→
   262→    // 3. Generate individual task parameters for each image
   263→    const taskParams = Array.from({ length: params.numImages }, (_, index) => {
   264→      // Generate a different seed for each task to ensure variety
   265→      const seed = params.seed ?? Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x7fffffff);
   266→
   267→      return {
   268→        project_id: params.project_id,
   269→        prompt: params.prompt,
   270→        image_url: params.image_url,
   271→        negative_prompt: params.negative_prompt,
   272→        resolution: finalResolution,
   273→        seed: seed + index, // Increment seed for variation
   274→        in_scene: params.in_scene,
   275→        shot_id: params.shot_id,
   276→        output_format: params.output_format,
   277→        enable_sync_mode: params.enable_sync_mode,
   278→        max_wait_seconds: params.max_wait_seconds,
   279→        enable_base64_output: params.enable_base64_output,
   280→        tool_type: params.tool_type, // Pass through tool type override
   281→        loras: params.loras, // Pass through lora configurations
   282→        based_on: params.based_on, // Pass through source generation ID for lineage tracking
   283→        source_variant_id: params.source_variant_id, // Pass through source variant ID for relationship tracking
   284→        create_as_generation: params.create_as_generation, // Pass through create as generation flag
   285→        hires_fix: params.hires_fix, // Pass through hires fix settings
   286→        qwen_edit_model: params.qwen_edit_model, // Pass through model selection
   287→      } as MagicEditTaskParams;
   288→    });
   289→
   290→    // 4. Create all tasks in parallel
   291→    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
   292→      taskParams.map(taskParam => createMagicEditTask(taskParam))
   293→    );
   294→
   295→    return processBatchResults(results, 'createBatchMagicEditTasks');
   296→
   297→  } catch (error) {
   298→    handleError(error, { context: 'BatchMagicEdit', showToast: false });
   299→    throw error;
   300→  }
   301→}
   302→
   303→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   304→

   246→
   247→async function calculateTaskResolution(
   248→  projectIdOrOptions: string | CalculateTaskResolutionOptions,
   249→  customResolution?: string,
   250→  modelName?: string
   251→): Promise<string> {
   252→  // Handle both old and new API
   253→  const options: CalculateTaskResolutionOptions = typeof projectIdOrOptions === 'string'
   254→    ? { projectId: projectIdOrOptions, customResolution, modelName }
   255→    : projectIdOrOptions;
   256→
   257→  const { projectId, resolution_scale, resolution_mode, custom_aspect_ratio } = options;
   258→
   259→  // 1. If explicit custom resolution is provided, use it as-is (assumes it's already final)
   260→  if (options.customResolution?.trim()) {
   261→    return options.customResolution.trim();
   262→  }
   263→
   264→  // 2. Determine base resolution
   265→  let baseResolution: string;
   266→
   267→  if (resolution_mode === 'custom' && custom_aspect_ratio) {
   268→    // Use custom aspect ratio
   269→    baseResolution = ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[custom_aspect_ratio] ?? '902x508';
   270→  } else {
   271→    // Use project resolution
   272→    const { resolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(projectId);
   273→    baseResolution = resolution;

   278→  if (isImageGenerationModel) {

   280→    const [width, height] = baseResolution.split('x').map(Number);
   281→    const scaledWidth = Math.round(width * scale);
   282→    const scaledHeight = Math.round(height * scale);
   283→    const scaledResolution = `${scaledWidth}x${scaledHeight}`;

   329→    const isQwenModel = params.model_name?.startsWith('qwen-image') || params.model_name === 'z-image';
   330→    
   331→    // 4. Generate task ID for orchestrator payload (stored in params, not as DB ID)
   332→    const taskId = generateTaskId(taskType);
   333→
   334→    // 5. Create task using unified create-task function (let DB auto-generate UUID)
   335→    const taskParamsToSend = {
   336→      // Store all task data at top level - no duplication
   337→      task_id: taskId,
   338→      model: params.model_name ?? "optimised-t2i",
   339→      prompt: params.prompt,
   340→      resolution: finalResolution,
   341→      seed: params.seed ?? 11111,
   342→      negative_prompt: params.negative_prompt,
   343→      // Use provided steps value if available, otherwise use default of 12
   344→      steps: params.steps ?? 12,
   345→      // Include LoRAs if present, plus the "in this scene" LoRA if enabled
   346→      ...(() => {
   347→        const lorasMap: Record<string, number> = {};
   348→        
   349→        // Add user-selected LoRAs
   350→        if (params.loras?.length) {
   351→          params.loras.forEach(lora => {
   352→            lorasMap[lora.path] = lora.strength;
   353→          });
   354→        }
   355→        
   356→        // Add "in this scene" LoRA if enabled for Qwen models
   357→        if (isQwenModel && params.in_this_scene && params.in_this_scene_strength && params.in_this_scene_strength > 0) {
   358→          lorasMap['https://huggingface.co/peteromallet/random_junk/resolve/main/in_scene_different_object_000010500.safetensors'] = params.in_this_scene_strength;
   359→        }
   360→        
   361→        return Object.keys(lorasMap).length > 0 ? { additional_loras: lorasMap } : {};
   362→      })(),
   363→      // Include style reference for Qwen.Image - filtered by reference mode to only include relevant settings
   364→      ...(isQwenModel && params.style_reference_image && (() => {
   365→        const filteredSettings = filterReferenceSettingsByMode(params.reference_mode, {
   366→          style_reference_strength: params.style_reference_strength ?? 1.0,
   367→          subject_strength: params.subject_strength ?? 0.0,
   368→          subject_description: params.subject_description,
   369→          in_this_scene: params.in_this_scene,
   370→          in_this_scene_strength: params.in_this_scene_strength
   371→        });
   372→        
   373→        return {
   374→          style_reference_image: params.style_reference_image,
   375→          subject_reference_image: params.subject_reference_image || params.style_reference_image, // Fallback to style image
   376→          ...filteredSettings,
   377→          // Add scene_reference_strength if in_this_scene_strength was included in filtered settings
   378→          ...(filteredSettings.in_this_scene_strength !== undefined && {
   379→            scene_reference_strength: filteredSettings.in_this_scene_strength
   380→          })
   381→        };
   382→      })()),
   383→      // Include shot association
   384→      ...(params.shot_id ? { shot_id: params.shot_id } : {}),
   385→      // Make new image generations unpositioned by default
   386→      add_in_position: false,
   387→      // Two-pass hires fix settings
   388→      ...(params.hires_scale !== undefined && { hires_scale: params.hires_scale }),
   389→      ...(params.hires_steps !== undefined && { hires_steps: params.hires_steps }),
   390→      ...(params.hires_denoise !== undefined && { hires_denoise: params.hires_denoise }),
   391→      ...(params.lightning_lora_strength_phase_1 !== undefined && { lightning_lora_strength_phase_1: params.lightning_lora_strength_phase_1 }),
   392→      ...(params.lightning_lora_strength_phase_2 !== undefined && { lightning_lora_strength_phase_2: params.lightning_lora_strength_phase_2 }),
   393→      // Per-phase LoRA strengths for hires fix (overrides additional_loras if provided)
   394→      ...(params.additional_loras && Object.keys(params.additional_loras).length > 0 && {
   395→        additional_loras: params.additional_loras
   396→      }),
   397→    };
   398→    
   399→    const result = await createTask({
   400→      project_id: params.project_id,
   401→      task_type: taskType,
   402→      params: taskParamsToSend
   403→    });
   404→    
   405→    return result;
   406→
   407→  } catch (error) {
   408→    handleError(error, { context: 'ImageGeneration', showToast: false });
   409→    throw error;
   410→  }
   411→}
   412→
   413→/**
   414→ * Creates multiple image generation tasks in parallel (batch generation)
   415→ * This replaces the enqueueTasks pattern used in ImageGenerationForm
   416→ * 
   417→ * @param params - Batch image generation parameters
   418→ * @returns Promise resolving to array of created tasks
   419→ */
   420→export async function createBatchImageGenerationTasks(params: BatchImageGenerationTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
   421→
   422→  try {
   423→    // 1. Validate parameters
   424→    validateBatchImageGenerationParams(params);
   425→
   426→    // 2. Calculate final resolution once for all tasks (handles Qwen scaling automatically)
   427→    const finalResolution = await calculateTaskResolution({
   428→      projectId: params.project_id,
   429→      customResolution: params.resolution,
   430→      modelName: params.model_name,
   431→      resolution_scale: params.resolution_scale,
   432→      resolution_mode: params.resolution_mode,
   433→      custom_aspect_ratio: params.custom_aspect_ratio,
   434→    });
   435→
   436→    // 3. Generate individual task parameters for each image
   437→    const taskParams = params.prompts.flatMap((promptEntry) => {
   438→      return Array.from({ length: params.imagesPerPrompt }, () => {
   439→        // Generate a random seed for each task to ensure diverse outputs (32-bit signed integer range)
   440→        const seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x7fffffff);
   441→
   442→        return {
   443→          project_id: params.project_id,
   444→          prompt: promptEntry.fullPrompt,
   445→          resolution: finalResolution, // Pass the pre-calculated resolution
   446→          seed,
   447→          loras: params.loras,
   448→          shot_id: params.shot_id,
   449→          model_name: params.model_name,
   450→          steps: params.steps, // Pass through the steps parameter
   451→          reference_mode: params.reference_mode, // Pass reference mode for filtering
   452→          // Include style reference for Qwen.Image model - filtered by reference mode
   453→          ...(params.style_reference_image && (() => {
   454→            const filteredSettings = filterReferenceSettingsByMode(params.reference_mode, {
   455→              style_reference_strength: params.style_reference_strength,
   456→              subject_strength: params.subject_strength,
   457→              subject_description: params.subject_description,
   458→              in_this_scene: params.in_this_scene,
   459→              in_this_scene_strength: params.in_this_scene_strength
   460→            });
   461→            
   462→            return {
   463→              style_reference_image: params.style_reference_image,
   464→              subject_reference_image: params.subject_reference_image || params.style_reference_image,
   465→              ...filteredSettings
   466→            };
   467→          })()),
   468→          // Two-pass hires fix settings
   469→          ...(params.hires_scale !== undefined && { hires_scale: params.hires_scale }),
   470→          ...(params.hires_steps !== undefined && { hires_steps: params.hires_steps }),
   471→          ...(params.hires_denoise !== undefined && { hires_denoise: params.hires_denoise }),
   472→          ...(params.lightning_lora_strength_phase_1 !== undefined && { lightning_lora_strength_phase_1: params.lightning_lora_strength_phase_1 }),
   473→          ...(params.lightning_lora_strength_phase_2 !== undefined && { lightning_lora_strength_phase_2: params.lightning_lora_strength_phase_2 }),
   474→          ...(params.additional_loras && { additional_loras: params.additional_loras }),
   475→        } as ImageGenerationTaskParams;
   476→      });
   477→    });
   478→
   479→    // 4. Create all tasks in parallel (matching original behavior)
   480→    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
   481→      taskParams.map(taskParam => createImageGenerationTask(taskParam))
   482→    );
   483→
   484→    return processBatchResults(results, 'createBatchImageGenerationTasks');
   485→
   486→  } catch (error) {
   487→    handleError(error, { context: 'BatchImageGeneration', showToast: false });
   488→    throw error;
   489→  }
   490→}
   491→
   492→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   493→

   349→  // Audio to mix into the final joined video
   350→  if (params.audio_url) {
   351→    orchestratorDetails.audio_url = params.audio_url;
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  const totalJoins = Math.max(clipSequence.length - 1, 0);
   355→  if (totalJoins > 0) {
   356→    const perJoinOverrides: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
   357→    let hasOverrides = false;
   358→
   359→    for (let index = 0; index < totalJoins; index++) {
   360→      const override = params.per_join_settings?.[index];
   361→      const joinSettings: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   362→
   363→      if (override) {
   364→        if (override.prompt !== undefined) joinSettings.prompt = override.prompt;
   365→        if (override.gap_frame_count !== undefined) joinSettings.gap_frame_count = override.gap_frame_count;
   366→        if (override.context_frame_count !== undefined) joinSettings.context_frame_count = override.context_frame_count;
   367→        if (override.replace_mode !== undefined) joinSettings.replace_mode = override.replace_mode;
   368→        if (override.model !== undefined) joinSettings.model = override.model;
   369→        if (override.num_inference_steps !== undefined) joinSettings.num_inference_steps = override.num_inference_steps;
   370→        if (override.guidance_scale !== undefined) joinSettings.guidance_scale = override.guidance_scale;
   371→        if (override.seed !== undefined) joinSettings.seed = override.seed;
   372→        if (override.negative_prompt !== undefined) joinSettings.negative_prompt = override.negative_prompt;
   373→        if (override.priority !== undefined) joinSettings.priority = override.priority;
   374→        if (override.resolution !== undefined) joinSettings.resolution = override.resolution;
   375→        if (override.fps !== undefined) joinSettings.fps = override.fps;
   376→        if (override.loras && override.loras.length > 0) {
   377→          joinSettings.additional_loras = mapLorasToRecord(override.loras);
   378→        }
   379→      }
   380→
   381→      if (Object.keys(joinSettings).length > 0) {
   382→        hasOverrides = true;
   383→        perJoinOverrides.push(joinSettings);
   384→      } else {

   386→      }
   387→    }
   388→
   389→    if (hasOverrides) {

   391→    }
   392→  }
   393→
   394→  return {
   395→    orchestrator_details: orchestratorDetails,
   396→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   397→    // Only include tool_type if explicitly passed (Join Clips page passes it, ShotEditor doesn't)
   398→    ...(params.tool_type && { tool_type: params.tool_type }),
   399→  };
   400→}

   402→/**
   403→ * Creates a join clips task using the unified approach
   404→ * 
   405→ * @param params - Join clips task parameters
   406→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   407→ */
   408→export async function createJoinClipsTask(params: JoinClipsTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   409→
   410→  try {
   411→    // 1. Validate parameters
   412→    const clipSequence = validateJoinClipsParams(params);
   413→
   414→    // 2. Generate IDs for orchestrator payload
   415→    const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("join_clips_orchestrator");
   416→    const runId = params.run_id ?? generateRunId();
   417→
   418→    // 3. Build orchestrator payload
   419→    const orchestratorPayload = buildJoinClipsPayload(
   420→      params, 
   421→      clipSequence,
   422→      runId,
   423→      orchestratorTaskId
   424→    );
   425→
   426→    // 4. Create task using unified create-task function
   427→    const result = await createTask({
   428→      project_id: params.project_id,
   429→      task_type: 'join_clips_orchestrator',
   430→      params: orchestratorPayload
   431→    });
   432→
   433→    return result;
   434→
   435→  } catch (error) {
   436→    handleError(error, { context: 'JoinClips', showToast: false });
   437→    throw error;
   438→  }
   439→}

   544→
   545→/**
   546→ * Creates an individual travel segment regeneration task
   547→ * 
   548→ * This creates a standalone task (visible in TasksPane) that regenerates
   549→ * a single segment and creates a variant on the parent generation when complete.
   550→ * The task params match the exact structure of travel_segment for GPU worker compatibility.
   551→ * 
   552→ * If no parent_generation_id is provided but shot_id is, a placeholder parent
   553→ * generation will be created and linked to the shot.
   554→ * 
   555→ * @param params - Individual travel segment parameters
   556→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   557→ */
   558→export async function createIndividualTravelSegmentTask(params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   559→  try {
   560→    // 1. Validate parameters
   561→    validateIndividualTravelSegmentParams(params);
   562→
   563→    // 2. Ensure we have a parent_generation_id (create placeholder if needed)
   564→    let effectiveParentGenerationId = params.parent_generation_id;
   565→
   566→    if (!effectiveParentGenerationId && params.shot_id) {
   567→
   568→      // Create a placeholder parent generation
   569→      const newParentId = crypto.randomUUID();
   570→      // Build input images array (end_image_url is optional for trailing segments)
   571→      const placeholderInputImages = params.end_image_url
   572→        ? [params.start_image_url, params.end_image_url]
   573→        : [params.start_image_url];
   574→
   575→      const placeholderParams = {
   576→        tool_type: TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES,
   577→        created_from: 'individual_segment_first_generation',
   578→        // Include basic orchestrator_details structure so it shows in segment outputs
   579→        orchestrator_details: {
   580→          num_new_segments_to_generate: 1, // Will be updated as more segments are generated
   581→          input_image_paths_resolved: placeholderInputImages,
   582→        },
   583→      };
   584→
   585→      const { error: parentError } = await supabase
   586→        .from('generations')
   587→        .insert({
   588→          id: newParentId,
   589→          project_id: params.project_id,
   590→          type: 'video',
   591→          is_child: false,
   592→          location: null, // Placeholder - no video yet
   593→          params: placeholderParams,
   594→          created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   595→        })
   596→        .select()
   597→        .single();
   598→      
   599→      if (parentError) {
   600→        console.error("[IndividualTravelSegment] Error creating placeholder parent:", parentError);
   601→        throw new Error(`Failed to create placeholder parent generation: ${parentError.message}`);
   602→      }
   603→      
   604→      effectiveParentGenerationId = newParentId;
   605→      
   606→      // Link the parent to the shot using the RPC
   607→      const { error: linkError } = await supabase.rpc('add_generation_to_shot', {
   608→        p_shot_id: params.shot_id,
   609→        p_generation_id: newParentId,
   610→        p_with_position: false, // Don't add to timeline position
   611→      });
   612→      
   613→      if (linkError) {
   614→        handleError(linkError, { context: 'IndividualTravelSegment:linkParentToShot', showToast: false });
   615→        // Don't fail - the generation was created, just not linked
   616→      }
   617→    }
   618→    
   619→    if (!effectiveParentGenerationId) {
   620→      throw new Error("Could not determine or create parent_generation_id");
   621→    }
   622→
   623→    // 3. Look up existing child to create variant on
   624→    // Priority: pair_shot_generation_id match > child_order match
   625→    // This ensures we regenerate the correct video even if timeline was reordered
   626→    let effectiveChildGenerationId = params.child_generation_id;
   627→    
   628→    if (!effectiveChildGenerationId && effectiveParentGenerationId) {
   629→      // Strategy 1: Look for child with matching pair_shot_generation_id (most accurate)
   630→      // Query the FK column (source of truth with referential integrity)
   631→      if (params.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   632→        const { data: childByPairId, error: pairIdError } = await supabase
   633→          .from('generations')
   634→          .select('id')
   635→          .eq('parent_generation_id', effectiveParentGenerationId)
   636→          .eq('pair_shot_generation_id', params.pair_shot_generation_id)
   637→          .limit(1)
   638→          .maybeSingle();
   639→
   640→        if (pairIdError) {
   641→        } else if (childByPairId) {
   642→          effectiveChildGenerationId = childByPairId.id;
   643→        }
   644→      }
   645→
   646→      // Strategy 2: Fallback to child_order match (legacy ONLY - skip if pair_shot_generation_id was provided)
   647→      // If pair_shot_generation_id was provided but no match found, we want a NEW child for that pair,
   648→      // not a variant on some unrelated video that happens to have the same child_order
   649→      if (!effectiveChildGenerationId && params.segment_index !== undefined && !params.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   650→        const { data: childByOrder, error: orderError } = await supabase
   651→          .from('generations')
   652→          .select('id')
   653→          .eq('parent_generation_id', effectiveParentGenerationId)
   654→          .eq('child_order', params.segment_index)
   655→          .limit(1)
   656→          .maybeSingle();
   657→
   658→        if (orderError) {
   659→        } else if (childByOrder) {
   660→          effectiveChildGenerationId = childByOrder.id;
   661→        }
   662→      } else if (!effectiveChildGenerationId && params.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   663→      }
   664→    }
   665→    
   666→    // Update params with the effective IDs
   667→    const paramsWithIds = {
   668→      ...params,
   669→      parent_generation_id: effectiveParentGenerationId,
   670→      child_generation_id: effectiveChildGenerationId,
   671→    };
   672→
   673→    // 4. Resolve project resolution (use original if available)
   674→    const origResolution = params.originalParams?.parsed_resolution_wh ||
   675→                          params.originalParams?.orchestrator_details?.parsed_resolution_wh;
   676→    const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   677→      params.project_id,
   678→      origResolution
   679→    );
   680→
   681→    // 5. Build task params matching travel_segment structure
   682→    const taskParams = buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(paramsWithIds, finalResolution);
   683→
   684→    // 6. Create task using unified create-task function
   685→    const result = await createTask({
   686→      project_id: params.project_id,
   687→      task_type: 'individual_travel_segment',
   688→      params: taskParams
   689→    });
   690→
   691→    return result;
   692→
   693→  } catch (error) {
   694→    handleError(error, { context: 'IndividualTravelSegment', showToast: false });
   695→    throw error;
   696→  }
   697→}
   698→
   699→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   700→export type { TaskCreationResult } from "../taskCreation";
   701→
```

   125→ *   scope: 'shot',
   126→ *   defaults: { prompt: '', mode: 'basic' },
   127→ * });
   128→ *
   129→ * // Custom load/save mode
   130→ * const settings = useAutoSaveSettings({
   131→ *   defaults: { prompt: '', mode: 'basic' },
   132→ *   customLoadSave: {
   133→ *     entityId: generationId,
   134→ *     load: (id) => fetchFromDB(id),
   135→ *     save: (id, data) => saveToDB(id, data),
   136→ *   },
   137→ * });
   138→ *
   139→ * // Update a field (auto-saves after debounce)
   140→ * settings.updateField('prompt', 'new prompt');
   141→ *
   142→ * // Check if ready before rendering
   143→ * if (settings.status !== 'ready') return <Loading />;
   144→ * ```
   145→ */
   146→export function useAutoSaveSettings<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
   147→  options: UseAutoSaveSettingsOptions<T>
   148→): UseAutoSaveSettingsReturn<T> {
   149→  const {
   150→    toolId = '',
   151→    shotId,
   152→    projectId,
   153→    scope = 'shot',
   154→    debounceMs = 300,
   155→    defaults,
   156→    enabled = true,
   157→    onSaveSuccess,
   158→    onSaveError,
   159→    customLoadSave,
   160→  } = options;
   161→
   162→  const isCustomMode = !!customLoadSave;
   163→
   164→  // Determine the entity ID based on mode
   165→  const entityId = isCustomMode
   166→    ? customLoadSave.entityId
   167→    : (scope === 'shot' ? shotId : projectId) ?? null;
   168→  const isEntityValid = !!entityId;
   169→
   170→  // Local state - single source of truth for UI
   171→  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<T>(defaults);
   172→  const [status, setStatus] = useState<AutoSaveStatus>('idle');
   173→  const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
   174→  const [hasPersistedData, setHasPersistedData] = useState(false);
   175→
   176→  // Refs for tracking state without triggering re-renders
   177→  const loadedSettingsRef = useRef<T | null>(null);
   178→  const currentEntityIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
   179→  const isLoadingRef = useRef(false);
   180→
   181→  // Stable refs for custom callbacks to avoid effect dependency churn
   182→  const customLoadRef = useRef(customLoadSave?.load);
   183→  const customSaveRef = useRef(customLoadSave?.save);
   184→  const onFlushRef = useRef(customLoadSave?.onFlush);
   185→  customLoadRef.current = customLoadSave?.load;
   186→  customSaveRef.current = customLoadSave?.save;
   187→  onFlushRef.current = customLoadSave?.onFlush;
   188→
   189→  // Fetch settings from database (React Query mode only)
   190→  const {
   191→    settings: dbSettings,
   192→    isLoading: rqIsLoading,
   193→    update: updateSettings,
   194→    hasShotSettings,
   195→  } = useToolSettings<T>(toolId, {
   196→    shotId: scope === 'shot' ? (shotId || undefined) : undefined,
   197→    projectId: projectId || undefined,
   198→    enabled: !isCustomMode && enabled && isEntityValid,
   199→  });
   200→
   201→  // Dirty flag - has user changed anything since load?
   202→  const isDirty = useMemo(
   203→    () => (loadedSettingsRef.current ? !deepEqual(settings, loadedSettingsRef.current) : false),
   204→    [settings]
   205→  );
   206→
   207→  // Save implementation
   208→  const saveImmediate = useCallback(async (settingsToSave?: T): Promise<void> => {
   209→    if (!entityId) {
   210→      return;
   211→    }
   212→
   213→    const toSave = settingsToSave ?? settings;
   214→
   215→    // Don't save if nothing changed
   216→    if (deepEqual(toSave, loadedSettingsRef.current)) {
   217→      return;
   218→    }
   219→
   220→    setStatus('saving');
   221→
   222→    try {
   223→      if (isCustomMode) {
   224→        await customSaveRef.current!(entityId, toSave);
   225→      } else {
   226→        await updateSettings(scope, toSave);
   227→      }
   228→
   229→      // Update our "clean" reference
   230→      loadedSettingsRef.current = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(toSave));
   231→
   232→      if (isCustomMode) {
   233→        setHasPersistedData(true);
   234→      }
   235→
   236→      // NOTE: Don't clear pendingSettingsRef here - it's now handled in the timeout callback
   237→      // with edit version checking to avoid race conditions when user types fast
   238→
   239→      setStatus('ready');
   240→      setError(null);
   241→
   242→      onSaveSuccess?.();
   243→    } catch (err) {
   244→      handleError(err, { context: 'useAutoSaveSettings.save', showToast: false });
   245→      setStatus('error');
   246→      setError(err as Error);
   247→      onSaveError?.(err as Error);
   248→      throw err;
   249→    }
   250→  }, [entityId, settings, isCustomMode, updateSettings, scope, onSaveSuccess, onSaveError]);
   251→
   252→  // Ref to hold latest saveImmediate to avoid effect dependency churn
   253→  const saveImmediateRef = useRef(saveImmediate);
   254→  saveImmediateRef.current = saveImmediate;
   255→
   256→  // Helper to read the latest settings from React state (via setSettings identity trick)
   257→  const getLatestSettings = useCallback((): Promise<T> => {
   258→    return new Promise<T>((resolve) => {
   259→      setSettings(current => {
   260→        resolve(current);
   261→        return current; // Don't modify, just read
   262→      });
   263→    });
   264→  }, []);
   265→
   266→  // Debounced save sub-hook — manages scheduling, pending tracking, edit versioning, and flush effects
   267→  const debouncedSave = useDebouncedSettingsSave<T>({
   268→    entityId,
   269→    debounceMs,
   270→    status,
   271→    flushConfig: { isCustomMode, scope, toolId, projectId },
   272→    customSaveRef,
   273→    onFlushRef,
   274→    saveImmediateRef,
   275→    getLatestSettings,
   276→  });
   277→
   278→  // Update single field
   279→  const updateField = useCallback(<K extends keyof T>(key: K, value: T[K]) => {
   280→    debouncedSave.incrementEditVersion();
   281→
   282→    setSettings(prev => {
   283→      const updated = { ...prev, [key]: value };
   284→
   285→      // Always track pending settings - this protects user input from being overwritten by DB load
   286→      debouncedSave.trackPendingUpdate(updated, entityId ?? null);
   287→
   288→      // Schedule auto-save (no-ops during loading - just keeps pending tracking)
   289→      debouncedSave.scheduleSave(entityId ?? null);
   290→
   291→      return updated;
   292→    });
   293→  }, [entityId, debouncedSave]);
   294→
   295→  // Update multiple fields at once
   296→  const updateFields = useCallback((updates: Partial<T>) => {
   297→    debouncedSave.incrementEditVersion();
   298→
   299→    setSettings(prev => {
   300→      const updated = { ...prev, ...updates };
   301→
   302→      // Always track pending settings - this protects user input from being overwritten by DB load
   303→      debouncedSave.trackPendingUpdate(updated, entityId ?? null);
   304→
   305→      // Schedule auto-save (no-ops during loading - just keeps pending tracking)
   306→      debouncedSave.scheduleSave(entityId ?? null);
   307→
   308→      return updated;
   309→    });
   310→  }, [entityId, debouncedSave]);
   311→
   312→  // Revert to last saved settings
   313→  const revert = useCallback(() => {
   314→    if (loadedSettingsRef.current) {
   315→      setSettings(loadedSettingsRef.current);
   316→      debouncedSave.clearPending();
   317→    }
   318→  }, [debouncedSave]);
   319→
   320→  // Manual save - flushes debounce immediately
   321→  const save = useCallback(async () => {
   322→    debouncedSave.cancelPendingSave();
   323→    await saveImmediate();
   324→  }, [saveImmediate, debouncedSave]);
   325→
   326→  // Reset to defaults (or provided settings)
   327→  const reset = useCallback((newDefaults?: T) => {
   328→    const resetTo = newDefaults || defaults;
   329→
   330→    setSettings(resetTo);
   331→    loadedSettingsRef.current = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(resetTo));
   332→    debouncedSave.clearPending();
   333→  }, [defaults, debouncedSave]);
   334→
   335→  // Initialize from external source (e.g., "last used" settings) - custom mode only
   336→  const initializeFrom = useCallback((data: Partial<T>) => {
   337→    if (!isCustomMode) return;
   338→    // Only apply if we don't have persisted data and aren't loading
   339→    if (hasPersistedData || isLoadingRef.current) {
   340→      return;
   341→    }
   342→
   343→    setSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, ...data }));
   344→  }, [isCustomMode, hasPersistedData]);
   345→
   346→  // Handle entity changes - flush and reset
   347→  useEffect(() => {
   348→    const previousEntityId = currentEntityIdRef.current;
   349→
   350→    if (!entityId) {
   351→      // Reset state
   352→      currentEntityIdRef.current = null;
   353→      setSettings(defaults);
   354→      setStatus('idle');
   355→      setHasPersistedData(false);
   356→      loadedSettingsRef.current = null;
   357→      debouncedSave.clearPending();
   358→      return;
   359→    }
   360→
   361→    // Entity changed to a different one
   362→    if (previousEntityId && previousEntityId !== entityId) {
   363→      // Reset for new entity
   364→      setSettings(defaults);
   365→      setStatus('idle');
   366→      setHasPersistedData(false);
   367→      loadedSettingsRef.current = null;
   368→      debouncedSave.clearPending();
   369→    }
   370→
   371→    currentEntityIdRef.current = entityId;
   372→  }, [entityId, defaults, debouncedSave]);
   373→
   374→  // Load settings - custom mode (imperative async load)
   375→  useEffect(() => {
   376→    if (!isCustomMode) return;
   377→    if (!entityId || !enabled) return;
   378→    // Only start load from idle state - prevents duplicate loads
   379→    if (status !== 'idle') return;
   380→
   381→    // Don't reload if we have pending edits for this entity
   382→    if (debouncedSave.hasPendingFor(entityId)) {
   383→      setStatus('ready');
   384→      // Schedule save for pending edits
   385→      debouncedSave.cancelPendingSave();
   386→      const toSave = debouncedSave.pendingSettingsRef.current!;
   387→      debouncedSave.saveTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
   388→        try {
   389→          await saveImmediateRef.current(toSave);
   390→        } catch (err) {
   391→          handleError(err, { context: 'useAutoSaveSettings.pendingSave', showToast: false });
   392→        }
   393→      }, debounceMs);
   394→      return;
   395→    }
   396→
   397→    setStatus('loading');
   398→    isLoadingRef.current = true;
   399→
   400→    customLoadRef.current!(entityId)
   401→      .then(loaded => {
   402→        // Check if entity changed during load
   403→        if (currentEntityIdRef.current !== entityId) {
   404→          return;
   405→        }
   406→
   407→        // Check again for pending edits (user may have typed during load)
   408→        if (debouncedSave.hasPendingFor(entityId)) {
   409→          setStatus('ready');
   410→          isLoadingRef.current = false;
   411→          return;
   412→        }
   413→
   414→        if (loaded) {
   415→          const mergedState = { ...defaults, ...loaded };
   416→          const cloned = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(mergedState));
   417→
   418→          setSettings(cloned);
   419→          loadedSettingsRef.current = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cloned));
   420→          setHasPersistedData(true);
   421→        } else {
   422→          setSettings(defaults);
   423→          loadedSettingsRef.current = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaults));
   424→          setHasPersistedData(false);
   425→        }

   428→        isLoadingRef.current = false;

   438→
   439→  // Load settings - React Query mode (reactive from useToolSettings)

   449→      return;
   450→    }
   451→
   452→    // Don't overwrite if we're in the middle of saving
   453→    if (status === 'saving') {
   454→      return;
   455→    }
   456→
   457→    // Don't overwrite if user has pending edits for THIS entity (debounce hasn't fired yet)
   458→    // This prevents React Query refetches from "unwriting" user input
   459→    // IMPORTANT: We now protect pending edits even on first load - losing user's typing
   460→    // is worse than the theoretical risk of saving defaults over DB values
   461→    if (debouncedSave.hasPendingFor(entityId)) {
   462→      // Still transition to ready and schedule save for pending edits
   463→      if (status !== 'ready') {
   464→        setStatus('ready');
   465→        // Schedule save for input that happened during loading
   466→        debouncedSave.cancelPendingSave();
   467→        const toSave = debouncedSave.pendingSettingsRef.current!;
   468→        debouncedSave.saveTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
   469→          try {
   470→            await saveImmediateRef.current(toSave);
   471→          } catch (err) {
   472→            handleError(err, { context: 'useAutoSaveSettings.pendingSave', showToast: false });
   473→          }
   474→        }, debounceMs);
   475→      }
   476→      return;
   477→    }
   478→
   479→    // Apply settings from DB
   480→    // Note: dbSettings comes from useToolSettings which already merges in priority order:
   481→    // defaults -> user -> project -> shot (via deepMerge). We layer local defaults on top
   482→    // only as a fallback for fields not present in the merged settings.
   483→    const loadedSettings: T = {
   484→      ...defaults,
   485→      ...(dbSettings || {}),
   486→    };
   487→
   488→    // Deep clone to prevent React Query cache reference sharing
   489→    const clonedSettings = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(loadedSettings));
   490→
   491→    // Avoid setState loops when dbSettings identity changes but values don't.
   492→    if (loadedSettingsRef.current && deepEqual(clonedSettings, loadedSettingsRef.current)) {
   493→      if (status !== 'ready') {
   494→        setStatus('ready');
   495→      }
   496→      return;
   497→    }
   498→
   499→    // No pending edits for this entity - safe to apply DB settings
   500→
   501→    setSettings(clonedSettings);
   502→    loadedSettingsRef.current = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(clonedSettings));
   503→    setStatus('ready');
   504→    setError(null);
   505→  }, [isCustomMode, entityId, rqIsLoading, dbSettings, defaults, enabled, status, debounceMs, debouncedSave]);
   506→
   507→  // Memoize return value to prevent object recreation on every render
   508→  // NOTE: entityId uses currentEntityIdRef.current which is a ref value, so it updates
   509→  // without triggering memo recalculation. Consumers should check status === 'ready'
   510→  // alongside entityId to ensure settings are actually loaded for that entity.
   511→  return useMemo(() => ({
   512→    settings,
   513→    status,
   514→    entityId: currentEntityIdRef.current,
   515→    isDirty,
   516→    error,
   517→    hasShotSettings: isCustomMode ? hasPersistedData : hasShotSettings,
   518→    hasPersistedData: isCustomMode ? hasPersistedData : hasShotSettings,
   519→    updateField,
   520→    updateFields,
   521→    save,
   522→    saveImmediate,
   523→    revert,
   524→    reset,
   525→    initializeFrom,
   526→  }), [settings, status, isDirty, error, isCustomMode, hasPersistedData, hasShotSettings, updateField, updateFields, save, saveImmediate, revert, reset, initializeFrom]);
   527→}

   146→    show_input_images: params.show_input_images ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.show_input_images,
   147→    generation_mode: params.generation_mode ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.generation_mode,
   148→    dimension_source: params.dimension_source ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.dimension_source,
   149→    // Only include amount_of_motion if NOT in Advanced Mode
   150→    ...(params.advanced_mode ? {} : { amount_of_motion: params.amount_of_motion ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.amount_of_motion }),
   151→    advanced_mode: params.advanced_mode ?? false,
   152→    // Always set regenerate_anchors to false in Advanced Mode
   153→    ...(params.advanced_mode ? { regenerate_anchors: false } : {}),
   154→    // Include generation_name in orchestrator payload so it flows to child tasks
   155→    generation_name: params.generation_name ?? undefined,
   156→    independent_segments: params.independent_segments ?? true,
   157→    // Text before/after prompts
   158→    ...(params.text_before_prompts ? { text_before_prompts: params.text_before_prompts } : {}),
   159→    ...(params.text_after_prompts ? { text_after_prompts: params.text_after_prompts } : {}),
   160→    // Motion control mode
   161→    ...(params.motion_mode ? { motion_mode: params.motion_mode } : {}),
   162→    // HARDCODED: SVI (smooth continuations) feature has been removed from UX
   163→    // Always set to false regardless of any params passed
   164→    use_svi: false,
   165→  };
   166→
   167→  // ============================================================================
   168→  // STRUCTURE GUIDANCE - NEW UNIFIED FORMAT (videos INSIDE structure_guidance)
   169→  // ============================================================================
   170→  // The unified format nests videos inside structure_guidance:
   171→  // {
   172→  //   "structure_guidance": {
   173→  //     "target": "uni3c" | "vace",
   174→  //     "videos": [{ path, start_frame, end_frame, treatment }],
   175→  //     "strength": 1.0,
   176→  //     // Uni3C: step_window, frame_policy, zero_empty_frames
   177→  //     // VACE: preprocessing, canny_intensity, depth_contrast
   178→  //   }
   179→  // }
   180→  // NO SEPARATE structure_videos array - everything is in structure_guidance.
   181→
   182→  if (params.structure_guidance) {
   183→    // New unified format - structure_guidance contains videos inside
   184→    orchestratorPayload.structure_guidance = params.structure_guidance;
   185→  } else if (params.structure_videos && params.structure_videos.length > 0) {
   186→    // LEGACY: Separate structure_videos array - convert to unified format
   187→    // Clean the array to only include backend-relevant fields
   188→    const cleanedVideos = params.structure_videos.map(video => ({
   189→      path: video.path,
   190→      start_frame: video.start_frame ?? 0,
   191→      end_frame: video.end_frame ?? null,
   192→      treatment: video.treatment ?? DEFAULT_VIDEO_STRUCTURE_PARAMS.structure_video_treatment,
   193→    }));
   194→
   195→    // Build unified structure_guidance from the first video's settings
   196→    const firstVideo = params.structure_videos[0];
   197→    const isUni3cTarget = (firstVideo as Record<string, unknown>).structure_type === 'uni3c';
   198→
   199→    const unifiedGuidance: Record<string, unknown> = {
   200→      target: isUni3cTarget ? 'uni3c' : 'vace',
   201→      videos: cleanedVideos,
   202→      strength: (firstVideo as Record<string, unknown>).motion_strength ?? 1.0,
   203→    };
   204→
   205→    if (isUni3cTarget) {
   206→      unifiedGuidance.step_window = [
   207→        (firstVideo as Record<string, unknown>).uni3c_start_percent ?? 0,
   208→        (firstVideo as Record<string, unknown>).uni3c_end_percent ?? 1.0,
   209→      ];
   210→      unifiedGuidance.frame_policy = 'fit';
   211→      unifiedGuidance.zero_empty_frames = true;
   212→    } else {
   213→      const preprocessingMap: Record<string, string> = {
   214→        'flow': 'flow', 'canny': 'canny', 'depth': 'depth', 'raw': 'none',
   215→      };
   216→      unifiedGuidance.preprocessing = preprocessingMap[(firstVideo as Record<string, unknown>).structure_type as string ?? 'flow'] ?? 'flow';
   217→    }
   218→
   219→    orchestratorPayload.structure_guidance = unifiedGuidance;
   220→
   221→  } else if (params.structure_video_path) {
   222→    // LEGACY: Single video path - convert to unified format
   223→    const isUni3cTarget = params.structure_video_type === 'uni3c' || params.use_uni3c;
   224→
   225→    const unifiedGuidance: Record<string, unknown> = {
   226→      target: isUni3cTarget ? 'uni3c' : 'vace',
   227→      videos: [{
   228→        path: params.structure_video_path,
   229→        start_frame: 0,
   230→        end_frame: null,
   231→        treatment: params.structure_video_treatment ?? DEFAULT_VIDEO_STRUCTURE_PARAMS.structure_video_treatment,
   232→      }],
   233→      strength: params.structure_video_motion_strength ?? 1.0,
   234→    };
   235→
   236→    if (isUni3cTarget) {
   237→      unifiedGuidance.step_window = [
   238→        params.uni3c_start_percent ?? 0,
   239→        params.uni3c_end_percent ?? 0.1,
   240→      ];
   241→      unifiedGuidance.frame_policy = 'fit';
   242→      unifiedGuidance.zero_empty_frames = true;
   243→    } else {
   244→      const preprocessingMap: Record<string, string> = {
   245→        'flow': 'flow', 'canny': 'canny', 'depth': 'depth', 'raw': 'none',
   246→      };
   247→      unifiedGuidance.preprocessing = preprocessingMap[params.structure_video_type ?? 'flow'] ?? 'flow';
   248→    }
   249→
   250→    orchestratorPayload.structure_guidance = unifiedGuidance;
   251→
   252→  }
   253→
   254→  // Attach additional_loras mapping if provided (matching original logic)
   255→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   256→    const additionalLoras: Record<string, number> = params.loras.reduce<Record<string, number>>((acc, lora) => {
   257→      acc[lora.path] = lora.strength;
   258→      return acc;
   259→    }, {});
   260→    orchestratorPayload.additional_loras = additionalLoras;
   261→  }
   262→
   263→  // Add phase_config if provided (for advanced mode)
   264→  if (params.phase_config) {
   265→    orchestratorPayload.phase_config = params.phase_config;
   266→  }
   267→
   268→  // Add selected_phase_preset_id if provided (for UI state restoration)
   269→  if (params.selected_phase_preset_id) {
   270→    orchestratorPayload.selected_phase_preset_id = params.selected_phase_preset_id;
   271→  }
   272→
   273→  // CLEANUP: Remove legacy structure video params that are now replaced by unified structure_guidance
   274→  // These may have been passed in params and are no longer needed in the output
   275→  const legacyStructureParams = [
   276→    'structure_type',
   277→    'structure_videos',
   278→    'structure_video_path',
   279→    'structure_video_treatment',
   280→    'structure_video_motion_strength',
   281→    'structure_video_type',
   282→    'structure_canny_intensity',
   283→    'structure_depth_contrast',
   284→    'structure_guidance_video_url',
   285→    'structure_guidance_frame_offset',
   286→    'use_uni3c',
   287→    'uni3c_guide_video',
   288→    'uni3c_strength',
   289→    'uni3c_start_percent',
   290→    'uni3c_end_percent',
   291→    'uni3c_guidance_frame_offset',
   292→  ];
   293→  for (const param of legacyStructureParams) {
   294→    delete (orchestratorPayload as Record<string, unknown>)[param];
   295→  }
   296→
   297→  return orchestratorPayload;
   298→}

    79→async function fetchCreditLedger(limit: number = 50, offset: number = 0): Promise<CreditLedgerResponse> {

1→/**
     2→ * Gallery Page State & Orchestration (useGalleryPageState)
     3→ * =========================================================
     4→ *
     5→ * This is a PAGE-LEVEL CONTROLLER, not a data fetching hook.
     6→ * It manages filter state, pagination, and action handlers for gallery pages.
     7→ *
     8→ * ## When to Use
     9→ * - Building a tool page with the standard GenerationsPane
    10→ * - You need filter state (shot filter, starred, search) with persistence
    11→ * - You need "add to shot" or "delete" action handlers
    12→ * - You want automatic filter persistence per-shot
    13→ *
    14→ * ## When NOT to Use
    15→ * - You just need to fetch generations -> use `useProjectGenerations` directly
    16→ * - You're inside a shot editor -> use hooks from `useShotImages.ts`
    17→ * - You're building a custom gallery without standard filters
    18→ *
    19→ * ## What This Hook Provides
    20→ * - **State**: selectedShotFilter, excludePositioned, searchTerm, starredOnly, page
    21→ * - **Data**: paginatedData, totalCount, expectedItemCount (for skeletons)
    22→ * - **Handlers**: handleAddToShot, handleDeleteGeneration, handleToggleStar
    23→ * - **Loading**: isLoading, isFetching, isError
    24→ *
    25→ * ## Internal Dependencies
    26→ * - Calls `useGalleryFilterState` for filter state management
    27→ * - Calls `useProjectGenerations` for data fetching
    28→ * - Calls `useShots` for shot list and counts
    29→ *
    30→ * @module useGalleryPageState
    31→ */
    32→
    33→import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useContext } from 'react';
    34→import { useProject } from '@/shared/contexts/ProjectContext';

    39→import { LastAffectedShotContext } from '@/shared/contexts/LastAffectedShotContext';
    40→import { useCurrentShot } from '@/shared/contexts/CurrentShotContext';
    41→import { useShots } from '@/shared/contexts/ShotsContext';
    42→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/sonner';
    43→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    44→import { useGalleryFilterState } from '@/shared/hooks/gallery/useGalleryFilterState';
    45→
    46→interface UseGenerationsPageLogicOptions {
    47→  itemsPerPage?: number;
    48→  mediaType?: 'all' | 'image' | 'video';
    49→  toolType?: string;
    50→  enableDataLoading?: boolean;
    51→}
    52→
    53→/**
    54→ * @internal Use `useGalleryPageState` instead (exported alias below).
    55→ */
    56→function useGenerationsPageLogic({
    57→  itemsPerPage = 45,
    58→  mediaType = 'image',
    59→  toolType,
    60→  enableDataLoading = true
    61→}: UseGenerationsPageLogicOptions = {}) {
    62→  const { selectedProjectId } = useProject();
    63→  const { shots: shotsData } = useShots();
    64→
    65→  // Gate all data loading based on project availability and enableDataLoading flag
    66→  const shouldLoadData = enableDataLoading && !!selectedProjectId;
    67→  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
    68→
    69→  const { currentShotId } = useCurrentShot();
    70→
    71→  // Get last affected shot context early so it's available for effects below
    72→  const lastAffectedShotContext = useContext(LastAffectedShotContext);
    73→  const { lastAffectedShotId = null, setLastAffectedShotId = () => {} } = lastAffectedShotContext || {};
    74→
    75→  // ============================================================================
    76→  // FILTER STATE (extracted to useGalleryFilterState)
    77→  // ============================================================================
    78→
    79→  const filterState = useGalleryFilterState({
    80→    shouldLoadData,
    81→    onShotFilterApplied: setLastAffectedShotId,
    82→  }, mediaType, toolType);
    83→
    84→  const {
    85→    selectedShotFilter,
    86→    excludePositioned,
    87→    searchTerm,
    88→    starredOnly,
    89→    filters,
    90→    expectedItemCount,
    91→    applyQueryFallback,
    92→  } = filterState;
    93→
    94→  // Reset to page 1 when shot filter or position filter changes
    95→  useEffect(() => {
    96→    setPage(1);
    97→  }, [selectedShotFilter, excludePositioned]);
    98→
    99→  // Reset to page 1 when media type or starred filter changes
   100→  useEffect(() => {
   101→    setPage(1);
   102→  }, [mediaType, starredOnly]);
   103→
   104→  // ============================================================================
   105→  // DATA FETCHING
   106→  // ============================================================================
   107→
   108→  const generationsQuery = useProjectGenerations(
   109→    shouldLoadData ? selectedProjectId : null,
   110→    page,
   111→    itemsPerPage,
   112→    shouldLoadData,
   113→    filters
   114→  );
   115→  const generationsResponse = generationsQuery.data as GenerationsPaginatedResponse | undefined;
   116→  const isFetching = generationsQuery.isFetching;
   117→  const isError = generationsQuery.isError;
   118→  const error = generationsQuery.error;

   120→  // Track if we're showing stale/placeholder data during a filter change
   121→  const isPlaceholderData = generationsQuery.isPlaceholderData;
   122→
   123→  // Show loading state when:

   125→  // 2. Filter changed and we're showing stale placeholder data
   126→  const isLoading = generationsQuery.isLoading || (isFetching && isPlaceholderData);
   127→
   128→  // ============================================================================
   129→  // QUERY FALLBACK - delegate to filter state hook
   130→  // ============================================================================
   131→
   132→  useEffect(() => {
   133→    applyQueryFallback({
   134→      isLoading,
   135→      isFetching,
   136→      total: generationsResponse?.total,
   137→      hasResponse: generationsResponse !== undefined,
   138→    }, page);
   139→  }, [selectedShotFilter, isLoading, isFetching, generationsResponse?.total, page, applyQueryFallback, generationsResponse]);
   140→
   141→  // ============================================================================
   142→  // MUTATIONS
   143→  // ============================================================================
   144→
   145→  const addImageToShotMutation = useAddImageToShot();
   146→  const addImageToShotWithoutPositionMutation = useAddImageToShotWithoutPosition();
   147→  const positionExistingGenerationMutation = usePositionExistingGenerationInShot();
   148→  const { requestDelete, DeleteConfirmDialog, deletingId } = useDeleteGenerationWithConfirm();
   149→  const toggleStarMutation = useToggleGenerationStar();
   150→
   151→  // ============================================================================
   152→  // PAGINATION
   153→  // ============================================================================
   154→
   155→  const paginatedData = useMemo(() => {
