    13→  getInstalledRelatedApps?: () => Promise<Array<{ platform: string; url?: string; id?: string }>>;
    14→  connection?: { effectiveType?: string };
    15→}
    16→
    17→export type Platform = 'mac' | 'windows' | 'linux' | 'ios' | 'android' | 'unknown';
    18→export type Browser = 'chrome' | 'safari' | 'edge' | 'firefox' | 'samsung' | 'unknown';
    19→export type InstallMethod = 'prompt' | 'safari-dock' | 'safari-home-screen' | 'none';
    20→export type DeviceType = 'phone' | 'tablet' | 'desktop';
    21→
    22→interface PlatformInstallState {
    23→  // Platform & Browser
    24→  platform: Platform;
    25→  browser: Browser;
    26→  deviceType: DeviceType; // phone, tablet, or desktop
    27→  
    28→  // PWA state
    29→  isStandalone: boolean;  // Running as installed PWA
    30→  canInstall: boolean;    // Can show install prompt (Chrome/Edge beforeinstallprompt)
    31→  isWaitingForPrompt: boolean; // Chrome/Edge desktop - waiting for beforeinstallprompt
    32→  isAppInstalled: boolean; // PWA appears to be installed (prompt timed out or detected)
    33→  installMethod: InstallMethod;
    34→  
    35→  // CTA helpers
    36→  ctaText: string;
    37→  ctaIcon: 'download' | 'plus' | 'discord' | 'external';
    38→  showInstallCTA: boolean;
    39→  
    40→  // Install instructions for manual methods
    41→  installInstructions: string[];
    42→  
    43→  // Actions
    44→  triggerInstall: () => Promise<boolean>;
    45→}
    46→
    47→/**
    48→ * Detects platform, browser, and PWA installation capabilities.
    49→ * Provides contextual CTA text and install methods.
    50→ * 
    51→ * PWA Install Support Matrix:
    52→ * - Chrome (Mac/Win/Linux/Android): beforeinstallprompt ✓
    53→ * - Edge (Mac/Win/Linux/Android): beforeinstallprompt ✓
    54→ * - Safari macOS Sonoma+: "Add to Dock" (manual)
    55→ * - Safari iOS: "Add to Home Screen" (manual)
    56→ * - Firefox Desktop: No PWA support
    57→ * - Firefox Android: beforeinstallprompt ✓
    58→ * - Samsung Internet: beforeinstallprompt ✓
    59→ */
    60→// Helper to check standalone mode synchronously
    61→const checkIsStandalone = (): boolean => {
    62→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    63→  try {
    64→    const displayModeStandalone = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches;
    65→    const displayModeFullscreen = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: fullscreen)').matches;
    66→    const iosStandalone = (navigator as NavigatorWithExtensions).standalone === true;
    67→    return displayModeStandalone || displayModeFullscreen || iosStandalone;
    68→  } catch {
    69→    return false;
    70→  }
    71→};
    72→
    73→export function usePlatformInstall(): PlatformInstallState {
    74→  const [deferredPrompt, setDeferredPrompt] = useState<BeforeInstallPromptEvent | null>(null);
    75→  // Initialize isStandalone synchronously to prevent flash of install UI in PWA
    76→  const [isStandalone, setIsStandalone] = useState(checkIsStandalone);
    77→  const [promptTimedOut, setPromptTimedOut] = useState(false);
    78→  const [isAppInstalled, setIsAppInstalled] = useState(false);
    79→  // Track if the install prompt was already shown and dismissed/declined
    80→  const [promptConsumed, setPromptConsumed] = useState(false);
    81→  
    82→  // Detect platform
    83→  const platform = useMemo<Platform>(() => {
    84→    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return 'unknown';
    85→    
    86→    const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
    87→    const navPlatform = navigator.platform || '';
    88→
    89→    // iOS detection (iPhone, iPad, iPod)
    90→    if (/iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(ua)) return 'ios';
    91→    // iPadOS 13+ detection (reports as Mac)
    92→    if (navPlatform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1) return 'ios';
    93→    
    94→    // Android
    95→    if (/Android/i.test(ua)) return 'android';
    96→    
    97→    // Desktop platforms
    98→    if (/Mac/i.test(navPlatform) || /Macintosh/i.test(ua)) return 'mac';
    99→    if (/Win/i.test(navPlatform) || /Windows/i.test(ua)) return 'windows';
   100→    if (/Linux/i.test(navPlatform) || /Linux/i.test(ua)) return 'linux';
   101→    
   102→    return 'unknown';
   103→  }, []);
   104→  
   105→  // Detect browser
   106→  const browser = useMemo<Browser>(() => {
   107→    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return 'unknown';
   108→    
   109→    const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
   110→    
   111→    // Order matters - check more specific browsers first
   112→    
   113→    // Samsung Internet
   114→    if (/SamsungBrowser/i.test(ua)) return 'samsung';
   115→    
   116→    // Edge (Chromium-based Edge contains both "Edg" and "Chrome")
   117→    if (/Edg/i.test(ua)) return 'edge';
   118→    
   119→    // Chrome (but not Edge, not Samsung)
   120→    // Note: Chrome on iOS uses "CriOS"
   121→    if (/Chrome|CriOS/i.test(ua) && !/Edg/i.test(ua) && !/SamsungBrowser/i.test(ua)) return 'chrome';
   122→    
   123→    // Firefox
   124→    if (/Firefox|FxiOS/i.test(ua)) return 'firefox';
   125→    
   126→    // Safari (check after Chrome since Chrome on iOS also contains "Safari")
   127→    if (/Safari/i.test(ua) && !/Chrome|CriOS/i.test(ua)) return 'safari';
   128→    
   129→    return 'unknown';
   130→  }, []);
   131→  
   132→  // Detect device type (phone, tablet, desktop)
   133→  const deviceType = useMemo<DeviceType>(() => {
   134→    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return 'desktop';
   135→    
   136→    const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
   137→    const navPlatform = navigator.platform || '';
   138→
   139→    // iPad detection (explicit iPad in UA, or iPadOS 13+ which reports as Mac with touch)
   140→    if (/iPad/i.test(ua)) return 'tablet';
   141→    if (navPlatform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1) return 'tablet';
   142→    
   143→    // Android tablet detection (Android without "Mobile" usually means tablet)
   144→    if (/Android/i.test(ua) && !/Mobile/i.test(ua)) return 'tablet';
   145→    
   146→    // iPhone/iPod are phones
   147→    if (/iPhone|iPod/i.test(ua)) return 'phone';
   148→    
   149→    // Android with "Mobile" is a phone
   150→    if (/Android/i.test(ua) && /Mobile/i.test(ua)) return 'phone';
   151→    
   152→    // Desktop platforms
   153→    if (platform === 'mac' || platform === 'windows' || platform === 'linux') return 'desktop';
   154→    
   155→    return 'desktop';
   156→  }, [platform]);
   157→  
   158→  // Detect if Safari supports PWA install (Safari 17+ / macOS Sonoma+)
   159→  const safariSupportsPWA = useMemo<boolean>(() => {
   160→    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return false;
   161→    if (browser !== 'safari') return false;
   162→    if (platform !== 'mac') return false;
   163→    
   164→    // Try to detect Safari version from user agent
   165→    // Safari UA contains "Version/X.Y" where X is the major version
   166→    const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
   167→    const versionMatch = ua.match(/Version\/(\d+)/);
   168→    if (versionMatch) {
   169→      const majorVersion = parseInt(versionMatch[1], 10);
   170→      // Safari 17+ supports "Add to Dock"
   171→      return majorVersion >= 17;
   172→    }
   173→    
   174→    // If we can't detect version, assume it's supported (better UX than hiding it)
   175→    // User will see the option doesn't exist and can use Discord instead
   176→    return true;
   177→  }, [browser, platform]);
   178→  
   179→  // Listen for standalone mode changes (e.g., app installed while page is open)
   180→  useEffect(() => {
   181→    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
   182→    
   183→    const mq = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)');
   184→    const handler = () => setIsStandalone(checkIsStandalone());
   185→    
   186→    try {
   187→      mq.addEventListener('change', handler);
   188→    } catch {
   189→      // Fallback for older browsers
   190→      mq.addListener(handler);
   191→    }
   192→    
   193→    return () => {
   194→      try {
   195→        mq.removeEventListener('change', handler);
   196→      } catch {
   197→        mq.removeListener(handler);
   198→      }
   199→    };
   200→  }, []);
   201→  
   202→  // Listen for beforeinstallprompt
   203→  useEffect(() => {
   204→    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
   205→    
   206→    let timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
   207→    
   208→    const handleBeforeInstallPrompt = (e: Event) => {
   209→      // Prevent the mini-infobar from appearing on mobile
   210→      e.preventDefault();
   211→      setDeferredPrompt(e as BeforeInstallPromptEvent);
   212→      // Clear timeout since we got the prompt
   213→      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   214→      // Reset states in case they were set before this event
   215→      setPromptTimedOut(false);
   216→      setPromptConsumed(false);
   217→    };
   218→    
   219→    const handleAppInstalled = () => {
   220→      setDeferredPrompt(null);
   221→      setIsAppInstalled(true);
   222→      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   223→    };
   224→    
   225→    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handleBeforeInstallPrompt);
   226→    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', handleAppInstalled);
   227→    
   228→    // Set a timeout - if beforeinstallprompt doesn't fire within 3 seconds,
   229→    // the PWA is likely already installed or not supported
   230→    timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
   231→      setPromptTimedOut(true);
   232→      
   233→      // Try to detect if app is installed using getInstalledRelatedApps (Chrome 80+)
   234→      // This requires the manifest to list related_applications, but worth trying
   235→      const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithExtensions;
   236→      if (nav.getInstalledRelatedApps) {
   237→        nav.getInstalledRelatedApps().then((apps) => {
   238→          if (apps && apps.length > 0) {
   239→            setIsAppInstalled(true);
   240→          }
   241→        }).catch(() => {
   242→          // API not available or failed, that's fine
   243→        });
   244→      }
   245→    }, 3000);
   246→    
   247→    return () => {
   248→      window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handleBeforeInstallPrompt);
   249→      window.removeEventListener('appinstalled', handleAppInstalled);
   250→      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   251→    };
   252→  }, []);
   253→  
   254→  // Check if this is a browser that supports beforeinstallprompt on desktop
   255→  const isDesktopChromium = useMemo(() => {
   256→    return (browser === 'chrome' || browser === 'edge') && 
   257→           (platform === 'mac' || platform === 'windows' || platform === 'linux');
   258→  }, [browser, platform]);
   259→  
   260→  // Are we waiting for the beforeinstallprompt event? (Chrome/Edge desktop without prompt yet)
   261→  const isWaitingForPrompt = useMemo(() => {
   262→    if (isStandalone) return false;
   263→    if (deferredPrompt) return false; // Already have it
   264→    if (promptTimedOut) return false; // Timed out waiting
   265→    if (isAppInstalled) return false; // Already installed
   266→    if (promptConsumed) return false; // User already saw and dismissed the prompt
   267→    return isDesktopChromium;
   268→  }, [isStandalone, deferredPrompt, promptTimedOut, isAppInstalled, promptConsumed, isDesktopChromium]);
   269→  
   270→  // Determine install method
   271→  const installMethod = useMemo<InstallMethod>(() => {
   272→    if (isStandalone) return 'none';
   273→    
   274→    // If we have the prompt, use it (Chrome/Edge/Samsung/Firefox Android)
   275→    if (deferredPrompt) return 'prompt';
   276→    
   277→    // Safari on macOS Sonoma+ (Safari 17+) supports "Add to Dock"
   278→    if (platform === 'mac' && browser === 'safari' && safariSupportsPWA) return 'safari-dock';
   279→    
   280→    // Safari on iOS supports "Add to Home Screen"
   281→    if (platform === 'ios' && browser === 'safari') return 'safari-home-screen';
   282→    
   283→    // Chrome on iOS (iPhone & iPad) can install via share menu (iOS 16.4+)
   284→    if (platform === 'ios' && browser === 'chrome') return 'safari-home-screen';
   285→    
   286→    // Edge on iOS can install via share menu
   287→    if (platform === 'ios' && browser === 'edge') return 'safari-home-screen';
   288→    
   289→    // Firefox desktop doesn't support PWA
   290→    if (browser === 'firefox' && (platform === 'mac' || platform === 'windows' || platform === 'linux')) {
   291→      return 'none';
   292→    }
   293→    
   294→    // Chrome/Edge on desktop waiting for prompt - we'll show the CTA but in waiting state
   295→    if (isDesktopChromium) {
   296→      return 'none'; // Method is 'none' until prompt fires, but isWaitingForPrompt handles the UI
   297→    }
   298→    
   299→    return 'none';
   300→  }, [isStandalone, deferredPrompt, platform, browser, isDesktopChromium]);
   301→  
   302→  // Generate install instructions (used for manual methods or as fallback if user declines prompt)
   303→  // Keep minimal since visual mockups are self-explanatory
   304→  const installInstructions = useMemo<string[]>(() => {
   305→    // App appears to be installed - just show how to open it
   306→    if (isAppInstalled || (promptTimedOut && isDesktopChromium)) {
   307→      // Mobile/tablet: tell them to find it on home screen
   308→      if (deviceType === 'phone' || deviceType === 'tablet') {
   309→        return [
   310→          'Find Reigh on your home screen:'
   311→        ];
   312→      }
   313→      // Desktop: tell them to look in address bar
   314→      return [
   315→        'Look for this in your address bar:'
   316→      ];
   317→    }
   318→    
   319→    // If waiting for prompt on Chrome/Edge desktop
   320→    if (isWaitingForPrompt) {
   321→      return [
   322→        'Look for this in your address bar:'
   323→      ];
   324→    }
   325→    
   326→    switch (installMethod) {
   327→      case 'prompt':
   328→        // Fallback if user declines the browser prompt
   329→        if (platform === 'android') {
   330→          return [
   331→            'Tap "Install" when the banner appears:'
   332→          ];
   333→        }
   334→        return [
   335→          'Look for this in your address bar:'
   336→        ];
   337→      case 'safari-dock':
   338→        return [
   339→          'In Safari, go to File → Add to Dock'
   340→        ];
   341→      case 'safari-home-screen':
   342→        // iPad (tablet)
   343→        if (deviceType === 'tablet') {
   344→          if (browser === 'chrome') {
   345→            // Chrome iPad: Share icon at top-right (same as iPhone)
   346→            return [
   347→              'Tap Share icon at top-right, then "Add to Home Screen"'
   348→            ];
   349→          }
   350→          if (browser === 'edge') {
   351→            // Edge iPad: Three-dot menu, then Share
   352→            return [
   353→              'Tap ⋮ menu, then Share, then "Add to Home Screen"'
   354→            ];
   355→          }
   356→          // Safari iPad: Share button in top toolbar
   357→          return [
   358→            'Tap Share in the toolbar, then "Add to Home Screen"'
   359→          ];
   360→        }
   361→        
   362→        // iPhone - each browser has different UI
   363→        if (browser === 'chrome') {
   364→          // Chrome iPhone: Share icon at top-right
   365→          return [
   366→            'Tap Share icon at top-right, then "Add to Home Screen"'
   367→          ];
   368→        }
   369→        if (browser === 'edge') {
   370→          // Edge iPhone: Three-dot menu at bottom center
   371→          return [
   372→            'Tap ⋮ at bottom, then Share, then "Add to Home Screen"'
   373→          ];
   374→        }
   375→        // Safari iPhone: Share button at bottom
   376→        return [
   377→          'Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen"'
   378→        ];
   379→      default:
   380→        return [];
   381→    }
   382→  }, [installMethod, browser, isWaitingForPrompt, isAppInstalled, promptTimedOut, isDesktopChromium]);
   383→  
   384→  // Generate CTA text
   385→  const ctaText = useMemo<string>(() => {
   386→    if (isStandalone) return 'Sign in with Discord';
   387→    
   388→    // App appears to be installed - nudge to open it
   389→    if (isAppInstalled || (promptTimedOut && isDesktopChromium)) {
   390→      return 'Open Reigh App';
   391→    }
   392→    
   393→    // No install available (and not waiting for prompt)
   394→    if (installMethod === 'none' && !isWaitingForPrompt) return 'Sign in with Discord';
   395→    
   396→    // Platform-specific install text
   397→    switch (platform) {
   398→      case 'mac':
   399→        return 'Install for Mac';
   400→      case 'windows':
   401→        return 'Install for Windows';
   402→      case 'linux':
   403→        return 'Install for Linux';
   404→      case 'ios':
   405→        return 'Add to Home Screen';
   406→      case 'android':
   407→        return 'Install App';
   408→      default:
   409→        return 'Install App';
   410→    }
   411→  }, [isStandalone, installMethod, isWaitingForPrompt, isAppInstalled, promptTimedOut, isDesktopChromium, platform]);
   412→  
   413→  // Determine CTA icon
   414→  const ctaIcon = useMemo<'download' | 'plus' | 'discord' | 'external'>(() => {
   415→    if (isStandalone) return 'discord';
   416→    
   417→    // App appears to be installed - show external link icon
   418→    if (isAppInstalled || (promptTimedOut && isDesktopChromium)) {
   419→      return 'external';
   420→    }
   421→    
   422→    if (installMethod === 'none' && !isWaitingForPrompt) return 'discord';
   423→    if (platform === 'ios') return 'plus';
   424→    return 'download';
   425→  }, [isStandalone, installMethod, isWaitingForPrompt, isAppInstalled, promptTimedOut, isDesktopChromium, platform]);
   426→  
   427→  // Should we show install CTA vs Discord sign-in
   428→  const showInstallCTA = useMemo(() => {
   429→    if (isStandalone) return false;
   430→    // Show CTA if we have an install method, we're waiting for the prompt, or app is installed
   431→    return installMethod !== 'none' || isWaitingForPrompt || isAppInstalled || (promptTimedOut && isDesktopChromium);
   432→  }, [isStandalone, installMethod, isWaitingForPrompt, isAppInstalled, promptTimedOut, isDesktopChromium]);
   433→  
   434→  // Trigger install action
   435→  const triggerInstall = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
   436→    if (installMethod === 'prompt' && deferredPrompt) {
   437→      try {
   438→        deferredPrompt.prompt();
   439→        const { outcome } = await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
   440→        setDeferredPrompt(null);
   441→        // Mark prompt as consumed so we don't show "waiting" state after decline
   442→        setPromptConsumed(true);
   443→        return outcome === 'accepted';
   444→      } catch (error) {
   445→        handleError(error, { context: 'usePlatformInstall', showToast: false });
   446→        setPromptConsumed(true);
   447→        return false;
   448→      }
   449→    }
   450→    
   451→    // For manual methods, return false (caller should show instructions)
   452→    return false;
   453→  }, [installMethod, deferredPrompt]);
   454→  
   455→  return {
   456→    platform,
   457→    browser,
   458→    deviceType,
   459→    isStandalone,
   460→    canInstall: !!deferredPrompt,
   461→    isWaitingForPrompt,
   462→    isAppInstalled: isAppInstalled || (promptTimedOut && isDesktopChromium),
   463→    installMethod,
   464→    ctaText,
   465→    ctaIcon,
   466→    showInstallCTA,
   467→    installInstructions,
   468→    triggerInstall,
   469→  };
   470→}
   471→
   472→
   473→

1→import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Returns true when a MediaLightbox is open (non-modal, desktop/tablet).
     5→ * Reacts to the `lightbox-open` CSS class that LightboxShell toggles on <html>.
     6→ */
     7→export const useLightboxOpen = (): boolean => {
     8→  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(
     9→    () => document.documentElement.classList.contains('lightbox-open')
    10→  );
    11→
    12→  useEffect(() => {
    13→    const html = document.documentElement;
    14→    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
    15→      setIsOpen(html.classList.contains('lightbox-open'));
    16→    });
    17→    observer.observe(html, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    18→    return () => observer.disconnect();
    19→  }, []);
    20→
    21→  return isOpen;
    22→};

1→/**
     2→ * Progressive Image Loading Hook
     3→ * 
     4→ * Manages thumbnail → full resolution image loading for individual images.
     5→ * Shows thumbnail immediately, loads full image in background, then transitions smoothly.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { hasLoadedImage, markImageLoaded } from '@/shared/lib/preloading';
    10→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    11→
    12→type ImagePhase = 'idle' | 'thumb' | 'loadingFull' | 'full' | 'error';
    13→
    14→interface UseProgressiveImageOptions {
    15→  priority?: boolean; // Load immediately without intersection observer
    16→  lazy?: boolean; // Use intersection observer for lazy loading
    17→  crossfadeMs?: number; // Crossfade duration in milliseconds
    18→  prefetch?: boolean; // Prefetch full image without showing
    19→  ioRootMargin?: string; // Intersection observer root margin
    20→  enabled?: boolean; // Enable/disable progressive loading
    21→}
    22→
    23→interface UseProgressiveImageResult {
    24→  src: string;
    25→  phase: ImagePhase;
    26→  isThumbShowing: boolean;
    27→  isFullLoaded: boolean;
    28→  error: string | null;
    29→  retry: () => void;
    30→  ref: (element: HTMLElement | null) => void;
    31→}
    32→
    33→interface LoadingSession {
    34→  id: string;
    35→  abortController: AbortController;
    36→  timeouts: (NodeJS.Timeout | number)[];
    37→  isActive: boolean;
    38→}
    39→
    40→export const useProgressiveImage = (
    41→  thumbUrl?: string | null,
    42→  fullUrl?: string | null,
    43→  options: UseProgressiveImageOptions = {}
    44→): UseProgressiveImageResult => {
    45→  const {
    46→    priority = false,
    47→    lazy = true,
    48→    crossfadeMs = 180,
    49→    prefetch = false,
    50→    ioRootMargin = '200px',
    51→    enabled = true
    52→  } = options;
    53→
    54→  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<ImagePhase>('idle');
    55→  const [currentSrc, setCurrentSrc] = useState<string>('');
    56→  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    57→  const [isIntersecting, setIsIntersecting] = useState(!lazy || priority);
    58→
    59→  const activeSessionRef = useRef<LoadingSession | null>(null);
    60→  const elementRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
    61→  const observerRef = useRef<IntersectionObserver | null>(null);
    62→  const retryCountRef = useRef(0);
    63→  const phaseRef = useRef<ImagePhase>('idle'); // Ref for logging without causing re-renders
    64→
    65→  // Keep phaseRef in sync with phase state
    66→  useEffect(() => {
    67→    phaseRef.current = phase;
    68→  }, [phase]);
    69→
    70→  // Helper function to cancel active session
    71→  const cancelActiveSession = useCallback((_reason: string) => {
    72→    if (activeSessionRef.current?.isActive) {
    73→      activeSessionRef.current.abortController.abort();
    74→      activeSessionRef.current.timeouts.forEach(timeout => clearTimeout(timeout));
    75→      activeSessionRef.current.isActive = false;
    76→      activeSessionRef.current = null;
    77→    }
    78→  }, []); // No dependencies - stable function reference
    79→
    80→  // Helper function to create new session
    81→  const createSession = useCallback((): LoadingSession => {
    82→    const sessionId = `prog-img-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
    83→    const abortController = new AbortController();
    84→    const timeouts: (NodeJS.Timeout | number)[] = [];
    85→    
    86→    const session: LoadingSession = {
    87→      id: sessionId,
    88→      abortController,
    89→      timeouts,
    90→      isActive: true
    91→    };
    92→    
    93→    activeSessionRef.current = session;
    94→    return session;
    95→  }, []);
    96→
    97→  // Helper function to check if session is still active
    98→  const isSessionActive = useCallback((session: LoadingSession) => {
    99→    return activeSessionRef.current?.id === session.id && 
   100→           activeSessionRef.current?.isActive && 
   101→           !session.abortController.signal.aborted;
   102→  }, []);
   103→
   104→  // Helper function to safely update state
   105→  const safeSetState = useCallback((session: LoadingSession, updater: () => void) => {
   106→    if (isSessionActive(session)) {
   107→      updater();
   108→      return true;
   109→    }
   110→    return false;
   111→  }, [isSessionActive]);
   112→
   113→  // Helper function to load an image
   114→  const loadImage = useCallback((url: string, session: LoadingSession): Promise<HTMLImageElement> => {
   115→    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   116→      if (!isSessionActive(session)) {
   117→        reject(new Error('Session cancelled'));
   118→        return;
   119→      }
   120→
   121→      const img = new Image();
   122→      
   123→      const cleanup = () => {
   124→        img.onload = null;
   125→        img.onerror = null;
   126→        img.onabort = null;
   127→      };
   128→
   129→      img.onload = () => {
   130→        cleanup();
   131→        if (isSessionActive(session)) {
   132→          markImageLoaded(url);
   133→          resolve(img);
   134→        } else {
   135→          reject(new Error('Session cancelled during load'));
   136→        }
   137→      };
   138→
   139→      img.onerror = () => {
   140→        cleanup();
   141→        reject(new Error(`Failed to load image: ${url}`));
   142→      };
   143→
   144→      img.onabort = () => {
   145→        cleanup();
   146→        reject(new Error('Image load aborted'));
   147→      };
   148→
   149→      // Handle session abortion
   150→      session.abortController.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
   151→        cleanup();
   152→        reject(new Error('Session aborted'));
   153→      });
   154→
   155→      img.src = url;
   156→    });
   157→  }, [isSessionActive]);
   158→
   159→  // Setup intersection observer for lazy loading
   160→  useEffect(() => {
   161→    if (!lazy || priority || !enabled) {
   162→      setIsIntersecting(true);
   163→      return;
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    if (!elementRef.current) return;
   167→
   168→    observerRef.current = new IntersectionObserver(
   169→      (entries) => {
   170→        const entry = entries[0];
   171→        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
   172→          setIsIntersecting(true);
   173→          observerRef.current?.disconnect();
   174→        }
   175→      },
   176→      { rootMargin: ioRootMargin }
   177→    );
   178→
   179→    observerRef.current.observe(elementRef.current);
   180→
   181→    return () => {
   182→      observerRef.current?.disconnect();
   183→    };
   184→  }, [lazy, priority, enabled, ioRootMargin]);
   185→
   186→  // Main loading logic
   187→  useEffect(() => {
   188→    if (!enabled || !isIntersecting) {
   189→      return;
   190→    }
   191→
   192→    // Cancel any previous session
   193→    cancelActiveSession('new loading session');
   194→    
   195→    // Reset error state
   196→    setError(null);
   197→
   198→    // Determine what to do based on available URLs
   199→    const hasThumb = thumbUrl && thumbUrl !== fullUrl;
   200→    const hasFull = !!fullUrl;
   201→
   202→    if (!hasThumb && !hasFull) {
   203→      setPhase('idle');
   204→      setCurrentSrc('');
   205→      return;
   206→    }
   207→
   208→    const session = createSession();
   209→
   210→    // If no thumbnail or thumbnail equals full URL, load full directly
   211→    if (!hasThumb) {
   212→      if (hasFull) {
   213→        safeSetState(session, () => {
   214→          setPhase('loadingFull');
   215→          setCurrentSrc('');
   216→        });
   217→
   218→        loadImage(fullUrl!, session)
   219→          .then(() => {
   220→            safeSetState(session, () => {
   221→              setPhase('full');
   222→              setCurrentSrc(fullUrl!);
   223→            });
   224→          })
   225→          .catch((err) => {
   226→            // Only log non-abort errors (abort is expected during navigation)
   227→            if (err.message !== 'Session aborted') {
   228→              handleError(err, { context: 'useProgressiveImage', showToast: false });
   229→            }
   230→            safeSetState(session, () => {
   231→              setPhase('error');
   232→              setError(err.message);
   233→            });
   234→          });
   235→      }
   236→      return;
   237→    }
   238→
   239→    // Progressive loading: Load thumbnail FIRST, then full image
   240→    safeSetState(session, () => {
   241→      setPhase('thumb');
   242→      setCurrentSrc(''); // Don't show anything until thumbnail loads
   243→    });
   244→
   245→    // Step 1: Load thumbnail first
   246→    loadImage(thumbUrl!, session)
   247→      .then(() => {
   248→        if (!isSessionActive(session)) {
   249→          return;
   250→        }
   251→
   252→        // Show thumbnail once it's loaded
   253→        safeSetState(session, () => {
   254→          setCurrentSrc(thumbUrl!);
   255→        });
   256→
   257→        // If prefetch only, don't continue to full loading
   258→        if (prefetch || !hasFull) {
   259→          return;
   260→        }
   261→
   262→        // Step 2: Now start loading full image in background
   263→        const isFullCached = hasLoadedImage(fullUrl!);
   264→        
   265→        const loadFullImage = () => {
   266→          safeSetState(session, () => setPhase('loadingFull'));
   267→
   268→          loadImage(fullUrl!, session)
   269→            .then(() => {
   270→              if (!isSessionActive(session)) {
   271→                return;
   272→              }
   273→
   274→              // Smooth transition to full image
   275→              if (crossfadeMs > 0) {
   276→                const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
   277→                  safeSetState(session, () => {
   278→                    setPhase('full');
   279→                    setCurrentSrc(fullUrl!);
   280→                  });
   281→                }, crossfadeMs);
   282→                session.timeouts.push(timeout);
   283→              } else {
   284→                safeSetState(session, () => {
   285→                  setPhase('full');
   286→                  setCurrentSrc(fullUrl!);
   287→                });
   288→              }
   289→            })
   290→            .catch((err) => {
   291→              // Only log non-abort errors (abort is expected during navigation)
   292→              if (err.message !== 'Session aborted') {
   293→                handleError(err, { context: 'useProgressiveImage', showToast: false });
   294→              }
   295→              safeSetState(session, () => {
   296→                setError(err.message);
   297→                // Keep showing thumbnail on full image error
   298→              });
   299→            });
   300→        };
   301→
   302→        if (isFullCached || priority) {
   303→          // Load immediately if cached or high priority
   304→          loadFullImage();
   305→        } else {
   306→          // Small delay for non-cached images to let thumbnail render first
   307→          const timeout = setTimeout(loadFullImage, 50);
   308→          session.timeouts.push(timeout);
   309→        }
   310→      })
   311→      .catch((thumbErr) => {
   312→        // Thumbnail failed to load - fall back to loading full image directly
   313→        if (!isSessionActive(session)) {
   314→          return;
   315→        }
   316→        
   317→        if (hasFull) {
   318→          safeSetState(session, () => {
   319→            setPhase('loadingFull');
   320→            setCurrentSrc('');
   321→          });
   322→
   323→          loadImage(fullUrl!, session)
   324→            .then(() => {
   325→              safeSetState(session, () => {
   326→                setPhase('full');
   327→                setCurrentSrc(fullUrl!);
   328→              });
   329→            })
   330→            .catch((fullErr) => {
   331→              handleError(fullErr, { context: 'useProgressiveImage', showToast: false });
   332→              safeSetState(session, () => {
   333→                setPhase('error');
   334→                setError(`Both thumbnail and full image failed: ${fullErr.message}`);
   335→              });
   336→            });
   337→        } else {
   338→          handleError(new Error('Thumbnail failed and no full URL available'), { context: 'useProgressiveImage', showToast: false });
   339→          safeSetState(session, () => {
   340→            setPhase('error');
   341→            setError(`Thumbnail failed to load: ${thumbErr.message}`);
   342→          });
   343→        }
   344→      });
   345→
   346→    return () => {
   347→      if (activeSessionRef.current?.id === session.id) {
   348→        cancelActiveSession('effect cleanup');
   349→      }
   350→    };
   351→  }, [
   352→    enabled,
   353→    isIntersecting,
   354→    thumbUrl,
   355→    fullUrl,
   356→    priority,
   357→    prefetch,
   358→    crossfadeMs,
   359→    loadImage,
   360→    cancelActiveSession,
   361→    createSession,
   362→    safeSetState
   363→  ]);
   364→
   365→  // Retry function
   366→  const retry = useCallback(() => {
   367→    retryCountRef.current += 1;
   368→    setError(null);
   369→
   370→    // Trigger re-run of loading effect
   371→    cancelActiveSession('retry');
   372→
   373→    // Small delay to ensure cleanup completes
   374→    setTimeout(() => {
   375→      setIsIntersecting(true);
   376→    }, 100);
   377→  }, [cancelActiveSession]);
   378→
   379→  // Cleanup on unmount
   380→  useEffect(() => {
   381→    return () => {
   382→      cancelActiveSession('component unmount');
   383→      observerRef.current?.disconnect();
   384→    };
   385→  }, [cancelActiveSession]);
   386→
   387→  // Ref callback for intersection observer
   388→  const setRef = useCallback((element: HTMLElement | null) => {
   389→    elementRef.current = element;
   390→  }, []);
   391→
   392→  return {
   393→    src: currentSrc,
   394→    phase,
   395→    isThumbShowing: phase === 'thumb' || (phase === 'loadingFull' && currentSrc === thumbUrl),
   396→    isFullLoaded: phase === 'full',
   397→    error,
   398→    retry,
   399→    ref: setRef
   400→  };
   401→};
   402→

1→/**
     2→ * useLineageChain Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Fetches the full lineage chain for a variant by following the `source_variant_id` field in params.
     5→ * Returns an array ordered from oldest ancestor to newest (the provided variant).
     6→ *
     7→ * Note: Lineage is tracked at the variant level via params.source_variant_id,
     8→ * not at the generation level via based_on.
     9→ */
    10→
    11→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    12→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    13→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    14→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    15→
    16→interface LineageItem {
    17→  id: string;
    18→  imageUrl: string;
    19→  thumbnailUrl: string | null;
    20→  createdAt: string;
    21→  type: 'variant';
    22→  variantType: string | null;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface LineageChainResult {
    26→  chain: LineageItem[];
    27→  isLoading: boolean;
    28→  hasLineage: boolean;
    29→  error: Error | null;
    30→}
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Recursively fetch the lineage chain for a variant.
    34→ * Follows the `params.source_variant_id` field to find ancestors.
    35→ */
    36→async function fetchLineageChain(variantId: string): Promise<LineageItem[]> {
    37→  const chain: LineageItem[] = [];
    38→  const visited = new Set<string>();
    39→  let currentId: string | null = variantId;
    40→
    41→  // Follow the source_variant_id chain upward to find all ancestors
    42→  while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
    43→    visited.add(currentId);
    44→
    45→    const { data, error } = await supabase
    46→      .from('generation_variants')
    47→      .select('id, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, params, variant_type')
    48→      .eq('id', currentId)
    49→      .single();
    50→
    51→    if (error || !data) {
    52→      handleError(error || new Error('Variant not found'), { context: 'useLineageChain', showToast: false });
    53→      break;
    54→    }
    55→
    56→    // Add to beginning of chain (we're going backwards in time)
    57→    chain.unshift({
    58→      id: data.id,
    59→      imageUrl: data.location,
    60→      thumbnailUrl: data.thumbnail_url,
    61→      createdAt: data.created_at,
    62→      type: 'variant',
    63→      variantType: data.variant_type,
    64→    });
    65→
    66→    // Move to the parent variant via source_variant_id in params
    67→    const params = data.params as Record<string, unknown> | null;
    68→    currentId = params?.source_variant_id || null;
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return chain;
    72→}
    73→
    74→/**
    75→ * Hook to fetch the full lineage chain for a variant.
    76→ *
    77→ * @param variantId - The variant ID to fetch lineage for
    78→ * @returns Object with chain (oldest to newest), loading state, and whether there's lineage
    79→ */
    80→export function useLineageChain(variantId: string | null): LineageChainResult {
    81→  const { data: chain = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery({
    82→    [REDACTED](variantId!),
    83→    queryFn: () => fetchLineageChain(variantId!),
    84→    enabled: !!variantId,
    85→    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes - lineage doesn't change
    86→    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
    87→  });
    88→
    89→  return {
    90→    chain,
    91→    isLoading,
    92→    // Has lineage if chain has more than 1 item (the current variant + at least one ancestor)
    93→    hasLineage: chain.length > 1,
    94→    error: error as Error | null,
    95→  };
    96→}
    97→
    98→/**
    99→ * Count the lineage chain length for a variant.
   100→ * Returns the number of ancestors (0 if no lineage, 1+ if has ancestors).
   101→ * This fetches directly without caching - use sparingly for initial checks.
   102→ */
   103→export async function getLineageDepth(variantId: string): Promise<number> {
   104→  let depth = 0;
   105→  let currentId: string | null = variantId;
   106→  const visited = new Set<string>();
   107→
   108→  while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
   109→    visited.add(currentId);
   110→
   111→    const { data, error } = await supabase
   112→      .from('generation_variants')
   113→      .select('params')
   114→      .eq('id', currentId)
   115→      .single();
   116→
   117→    if (error || !data) {
   118→      break;
   119→    }
   120→
   121→    const params = data.params as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   122→    currentId = params?.source_variant_id || null;
   123→
   124→    if (currentId) {
   125→      depth++;
   126→    }
   127→  }
   128→
   129→  return depth;
   130→}
   131→
   132→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { useLineageChain } instead
   133→

1→/**
     2→ * Project-Wide Generation Queries
     3→ * ================================
     4→ *
     5→ * This module provides hooks for querying generations at the PROJECT level.
     6→ * Mutations live in `useGenerationMutations.ts` (re-exported here for compatibility).
     7→ *
     8→ * ## When to Use
     9→ * - Displaying a gallery of generations across the project (GenerationsPane, MediaGallery)
    10→ * - Filtering by tool type, media type, starred, search term
    11→ * - Fetching derived items (edits based on a generation)
    12→ *
    13→ * ## When NOT to Use
    14→ * - Querying images within a specific shot → use `useShotImages.ts` instead
    15→ * - Timeline-specific data (frame positions, pair prompts) → use `useShotImages.ts`
    16→ * - Page-level state management (filters, pagination) → use `useGalleryPageState.ts`
    17→ * - Mutations (create, delete, star) → import from `useGenerationMutations.ts` directly
    18→ *
    19→ * ## Key Exports
    20→ * - `useProjectGenerations(projectId, page, limit, filters)` - Paginated gallery data
    21→ * - `fetchGenerations(projectId, limit, offset, filters)` - Direct fetch function
    22→ * - `GenerationsPaginatedResponse` - Response type
    23→ *
    24→ * ## Data Source

    26→ *
    27→ * @module useProjectGenerations

    29→

    31→import { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery';
    32→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';

    39→
    40→/** Cache garbage collection time for paginated generation queries */

    43→/** Common filter options for generation queries */

    53→
    54→/**

    57→ */
    58→// TODO: type properly - PostgrestFilterBuilder generics are complex Supabase internals
    59→function applyGenerationFilters<T extends PostgrestFilterBuilder<Record<string, unknown>, Record<string, unknown>, unknown>>(
    60→  query: T,
    61→  filters: GenerationFilters | undefined
    62→): T {
    63→  if (!filters) return query;
    64→
    65→  // Tool type filter (skip when shot filter is active - shot filter takes precedence)
    66→  if (filters.toolType && !filters.shotId) {
    67→    if (filters.toolType === TOOL_IDS.IMAGE_GENERATION) {
    68→      query = query.eq('params->>tool_type', TOOL_IDS.IMAGE_GENERATION) as T;
    69→    } else {
    70→      query = query.or(`params->>tool_type.eq.${filters.toolType},params->>tool_type.eq.${filters.toolType}-reconstructed-client`) as T;
    71→    }
    72→  }
    73→
    74→  // Media type filter
    75→  if (filters.mediaType && filters.mediaType !== 'all') {
    76→    if (filters.mediaType === 'video') {
    77→      query = query.like('type', '%video%') as T;
    78→    } else if (filters.mediaType === 'image') {
    79→      query = query.not('type', 'like', '%video%') as T;
    80→    }
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  // Starred filter
    84→  if (filters.starredOnly) {
    85→    query = query.eq('starred', true) as T;
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  // Edits only filter (generations derived from another)
    89→  if (filters.editsOnly) {

    91→  }
    92→
    93→  // Search filter

    96→    query = query.ilike('params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>prompt', searchPattern) as T;
    97→  }
    98→
    99→  // Shot filter
   100→  if (filters.shotId === SHOT_FILTER.NO_SHOT) {

   102→  } else if (filters.shotId) {

   105→      query = query.or(`shot_data->${filters.shotId}.eq.null,shot_data->${filters.shotId}.eq.-1,shot_data->${filters.shotId}.cs.[null],shot_data->${filters.shotId}.cs.[-1]`) as T;
   106→    }
   107→  }

   109→  return query;

   112→/**
   113→ * Fetch edit variants from generation_variants table for a project
   114→ * Filters by tool_type in params (set by complete_task)

   116→ * NOTE: Requires the project_id column on generation_variants (added via migration)
   117→ * The column is auto-populated by a trigger from the parent generation
   118→ */
   119→async function fetchEditVariants(
   120→  projectId: string,

   123→  filters?: {

   125→    mediaType?: 'all' | 'image' | 'video';
   126→    sort?: 'newest' | 'oldest';
   127→    parentsOnly?: boolean; // Exclude child variants (those with parent_variant_id in params)
   128→  }
   129→): Promise<{
   130→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   131→  total: number;
   132→  hasMore: boolean;
   133→}> {
   134→  const toolType = filters?.toolType;
   135→  const sort = filters?.sort || 'newest';
   136→  const mediaType = filters?.mediaType || 'all';
   137→  const parentsOnly = filters?.parentsOnly ?? true;
   138→
   139→  // Build count query
   140→  let countQuery = supabase
   141→    .from('generation_variants')
   142→    .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   143→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   144→  
   145→  // Only filter by toolType if specified
   146→  if (toolType) {
   147→    countQuery = countQuery.eq('params->>tool_type', toolType);
   148→  }
   149→  
   150→  // Filter by media type - variants don't have a type column, so filter by URL extension
   151→  if (mediaType === 'video') {
   152→    countQuery = countQuery.or('location.ilike.%.mp4,location.ilike.%.webm,location.ilike.%.mov');
   153→  } else if (mediaType === 'image') {
   154→    countQuery = countQuery.not('location', 'ilike', '%.mp4').not('location', 'ilike', '%.webm').not('location', 'ilike', '%.mov');
   155→  }
   156→  
   157→  // Exclude child variants (those created from another variant)
   158→  if (parentsOnly) {
   159→    countQuery = countQuery.is('params->>parent_variant_id', null);
   160→  }
   161→
   162→  const { count, error: countError } = await countQuery;
   163→
   164→  if (countError) {
   165→    throw countError;
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  const totalCount = count || 0;
   169→
   170→  if (totalCount === 0) {
   171→    return { items: [], total: 0, hasMore: false };
   172→  }
   173→
   174→  // Data query with pagination
   175→  const ascending = sort === 'oldest';
   176→  let dataQuery = supabase
   177→    .from('generation_variants')
   178→    .select(`
   179→      id,
   180→      generation_id,
   181→      location,
   182→      thumbnail_url,
   183→      params,
   184→      variant_type,
   185→      name,
   186→      created_at
   187→    `)
   188→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   189→  
   190→  // Only filter by toolType if specified
   191→  if (toolType) {
   192→    dataQuery = dataQuery.eq('params->>tool_type', toolType);
   193→  }
   194→  
   195→  // Filter by media type in data query too
   196→  if (mediaType === 'video') {
   197→    dataQuery = dataQuery.or('location.ilike.%.mp4,location.ilike.%.webm,location.ilike.%.mov');
   198→  } else if (mediaType === 'image') {
   199→    dataQuery = dataQuery.not('location', 'ilike', '%.mp4').not('location', 'ilike', '%.webm').not('location', 'ilike', '%.mov');
   200→  }
   201→  
   202→  // Exclude child variants in data query too
   203→  if (parentsOnly) {
   204→    dataQuery = dataQuery.is('params->>parent_variant_id', null);
   205→  }
   206→  
   207→  dataQuery = dataQuery
   208→    .order('created_at', { ascending })
   209→    .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
   210→
   211→  const { data, error } = await dataQuery;
   212→
   213→  if (error) {
   214→    throw error;
   215→  }
   216→
   217→  // Transform variants using shared transformer
   218→  const items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[] = (data || []).map((variant) =>
   219→    transformVariant(variant as unknown as RawVariant, { toolType })
   220→  );
   221→
   222→  return {
   223→    items,
   224→    total: totalCount,
   225→    hasMore: offset + items.length < totalCount,
   226→  };
   227→}
   228→
   229→/**
   230→ * Fetch generations using direct Supabase call with pagination support
   231→ */
   232→export async function fetchGenerations(
   233→  projectId: string | null,
   234→  limit: number = 100,
   235→  offset: number = 0,
   236→  filters?: {
   237→    toolType?: string;
   238→    mediaType?: 'all' | 'image' | 'video';
   239→    shotId?: string;
   240→    excludePositioned?: boolean;
   241→    starredOnly?: boolean;
   242→    searchTerm?: string;
   243→    includeChildren?: boolean;
   244→    parentGenerationId?: string;
   245→    sort?: 'newest' | 'oldest';
   246→    editsOnly?: boolean; // Filter for images with based_on set (derived/edited images)
   247→    parentsOnly?: boolean; // For variants: exclude child variants (those with parent_variant_id)
   248→    variantsOnly?: boolean; // Fetch edit variants from generation_variants table
   249→  }
   250→): Promise<{
   251→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   252→  total: number;
   253→  hasMore: boolean;
   254→}> {
   255→
   256→  if (!projectId) {
   257→    return { items: [], total: 0, hasMore: false };
   258→  }
   259→
   260→  // Special path for variantsOnly - fetch from generation_variants table
   261→  if (filters?.variantsOnly) {
   262→    return fetchEditVariants(projectId, limit, offset, {
   263→      toolType: filters.toolType,
   264→      mediaType: filters.mediaType,
   265→      sort: filters.sort,
   266→      parentsOnly: filters.parentsOnly ?? true, // Default to parents only
   267→    });
   268→  }
   269→
   270→  // Build count query
   271→  let countQuery = supabase
   272→    .from('generations')
   273→    .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   274→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   275→  
   276→  // Only include generations with valid output URLs - UNLESS fetching children of a specific parent
   277→  // (children may still be processing and need to show as placeholders)
   278→  if (!filters?.parentGenerationId) {
   279→    countQuery = countQuery.not('location', 'is', null);
   280→  }
   281→
   282→  // Parent/Child filtering (count query specific)
   283→  if (filters?.parentGenerationId) {
   284→    countQuery = countQuery.eq('parent_generation_id', filters.parentGenerationId);
   285→  } else if (!filters?.includeChildren) {
   286→    countQuery = countQuery.eq('is_child', false);
   287→  }
   288→
   289→  // Apply common filters (toolType, mediaType, starred, edits, search, shot)
   290→  countQuery = applyGenerationFilters(countQuery, filters);
   291→
   292→  const { count, error: countError } = await countQuery;
   293→  if (countError) {
   294→    throw countError;
   295→  }
   296→  const totalCount = count || 0;
   297→
   298→  // 🚀 PERFORMANCE FIX: Optimize query - select only needed fields
   299→  let dataQuery = supabase
   300→    .from('generations')
   301→    .select(`
   302→      id,
   303→      location,
   304→      thumbnail_url,
   305→      type,
   306→      created_at,
   307→      updated_at,
   308→      params,
   309→      starred,
   310→      tasks,
   311→      based_on,
   312→      shot_data,
   313→      name,
   314→      is_child,
   315→      parent_generation_id,
   316→      child_order
   317→    `)
   318→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   319→
   320→  // Parent/Child filtering - apply BEFORE location filter since parentGenerationId affects whether we filter by location
   321→  // Parent/Child filtering (data query specific - has ordering)
   322→  if (filters?.parentGenerationId) {
   323→    dataQuery = dataQuery.eq('parent_generation_id', filters.parentGenerationId);
   324→    dataQuery = dataQuery.order('child_order', { ascending: true });
   325→  } else {
   326→    dataQuery = dataQuery.not('location', 'is', null);
   327→    if (!filters?.includeChildren) {
   328→      dataQuery = dataQuery.eq('is_child', false);
   329→    }
   330→  }
   331→
   332→  // Apply common filters (toolType, mediaType, starred, edits, search, shot)
   333→  dataQuery = applyGenerationFilters(dataQuery, filters);
   334→
   335→
   336→  // Determine sort order
   337→  const sort = filters?.sort || 'newest';
   338→  const ascending = sort === 'oldest';
   339→
   340→  // Execute query with standard server-side pagination
   341→  const { data, error } = await dataQuery
   342→    .order('created_at', { ascending })
   343→    .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
   344→
   345→  if (error) {
   346→    throw error;
   347→  }
   348→
   349→  if (!data) {
   350→    return { items: [], total: totalCount, hasMore: false };
   351→  }
   352→
   353→
   354→  const finalData = data || [];
   355→  const hasMore = (offset + limit) < totalCount;
   356→
   357→  // Badge data (derivedCount, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCount) is now loaded
   358→  // lazily via useVariantBadges hook to avoid blocking gallery display
   359→
   360→  // Use shared transformer instead of inline transformation logic
   361→  const items = finalData?.map((item) => {
   362→    // Transform using shared function - handles all the complex logic
   363→    return transformGeneration(item as unknown as RawGeneration, {
   364→      shotId: filters?.shotId,
   365→    });
   366→  }) || [];
   367→
   368→  return { items, total: totalCount, hasMore };
   369→}
   370→
   371→
   372→export type GenerationsPaginatedResponse = {
   373→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   374→  total: number;
   375→  hasMore: boolean;
   376→};
   377→
   378→export function useProjectGenerations(
   379→  projectId: string | null,
   380→  page: number = 1,
   381→  limit: number = 100,
   382→  enabled: boolean = true,
   383→  filters?: {
   384→    toolType?: string;
   385→    mediaType?: 'all' | 'image' | 'video';
   386→    shotId?: string;
   387→    excludePositioned?: boolean;
   388→    starredOnly?: boolean;
   389→    searchTerm?: string;
   390→    includeChildren?: boolean;
   391→    parentGenerationId?: string;
   392→    sort?: 'newest' | 'oldest';
   393→    editsOnly?: boolean; // Filter for images with based_on set (derived/edited images)
   394→    parentsOnly?: boolean; // For variants: exclude child variants (those with parent_variant_id)
   395→    variantsOnly?: boolean; // Fetch edit variants from generation_variants table
   396→  },
   397→  options?: {
   398→    disablePolling?: boolean; // Disable smart polling (useful for long-running tasks)
   399→  }
   400→) {
   401→  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
   402→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   403→  const effectiveProjectId = projectId ?? (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.__PROJECT_CONTEXT__?.selectedProjectId : null);
   404→  const [REDACTED](effectiveProjectId, page, limit, filters);
   405→
   406→
   407→  // 🎯 SMART POLLING: Use DataFreshnessManager for intelligent polling decisions
   408→  // Can be disabled for tools with long-running tasks to prevent gallery flicker
   409→  const smartPollingConfig = useSmartPollingConfig(['generations', projectId]);
   410→  const pollingConfig = options?.disablePolling
   411→    ? { refetchInterval: false, staleTime: Infinity }
   412→    : smartPollingConfig;
   413→
   414→  const result = useQuery<GenerationsPaginatedResponse, Error>({
   415→    queryKey: queryKey,
   416→    queryFn: () => fetchGenerations(effectiveProjectId, limit, offset, filters),
   417→    enabled: !!effectiveProjectId && enabled,
   418→    // Use `placeholderData` with `keepPreviousData` to prevent UI flashes on pagination/filter changes
   419→    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
   420→    // Synchronously grab initial data from the cache on mount to prevent skeletons on revisit
   421→    initialData: () => queryClient.getQueryData(queryKey),
   422→    // Cache management to prevent memory leaks as pagination grows
   423→    gcTime: GENERATIONS_GC_TIME_MS,
   424→    refetchOnWindowFocus: false, // Prevent double-fetches
   425→
   426→    // 🎯 SMART POLLING: Intelligent polling based on realtime health (or disabled)
   427→    ...pollingConfig,
   428→    refetchIntervalInBackground: !options?.disablePolling, // Only poll in background if polling is enabled
   429→    refetchOnReconnect: false, // Prevent double-fetches
   430→  });
   431→
   432→  return result;
   433→}
   434→
   435→// ===== MUTATIONS (re-exported from useGenerationMutations.ts) =====
   436→
   437→export {
   438→  useDeleteGeneration,
   439→  useDeleteVariant,
   440→  useUpdateGenerationLocation,
   441→  useCreateGeneration,
   442→  useToggleGenerationStar,
   443→} from './useGenerationMutations';

   446→
   447→/** @deprecated Import from '@/shared/hooks/useDerivedItems' instead */
   448→export { type DerivedItem, useDerivedItems } from './useDerivedItems';

1→/**
     2→ * Unified Shot Creation Hook
     3→ * 
     4→ * Single source of truth for ALL shot creation in the app.
     5→ * Handles:
     6→ * - Empty shots (name only)
     7→ * - Shots with a generation (atomic RPC)
     8→ * - Shots with files (upload + add)
     9→ * 
    10→ * Automatically handles:
    11→ * - Settings inheritance (runs in background)
    12→ * - Last affected shot tracking
    13→ * - Optimistic UI events (skeleton display)
    14→ * - Error handling with cleanup
    15→ * 
    16→ * @see CLAUDE.md - Settings/persistence → settings_system.md
    17→ */
    18→
    19→import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
    20→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    21→import { useProject } from '@/shared/contexts/ProjectContext';
    22→import { useLastAffectedShot } from '@/shared/hooks/useLastAffectedShot';
    23→import {
    24→  useCreateShot,
    25→  useCreateShotWithImage,
    26→  useHandleExternalImageDrop
    27→} from '@/shared/hooks/useShots';
    28→import { useShots } from '@/shared/contexts/ShotsContext';
    29→import { inheritSettingsForNewShot } from '@/shared/lib/shotSettingsInheritance';
    30→import { GenerationRow, Shot } from '@/types/shots';
    31→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/sonner';
    32→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    33→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    34→
    35→// ============================================================================
    36→// TYPES
    37→// ============================================================================
    38→
    39→interface ShotCreationResult {
    40→  /** The created shot's ID */
    41→  shotId: string;
    42→  /** The created shot's name */
    43→  shotName: string;

    49→
    50→interface CreateShotOptions {

    53→  
    54→  /** 
    55→   * Generation ID to add to the shot atomically.
    56→   * If provided, uses the atomic RPC for better performance.
    57→   */
    58→  generationId?: string;
    59→
    60→  /**
    61→   * Optional preview data for the generation being added (used for optimistic UI).
    62→   * When provided, we can update the shots cache immediately without waiting for a full refetch.
    63→   */
    64→  generationPreview?: {

    66→    thumbUrl?: string;
    67→    type?: string | null;

    70→

    76→

    79→  
    80→  /**

    82→   * Runs in background to avoid blocking UI.
    83→   * @default true

    85→  inheritSettings?: boolean;
    86→  
    87→  /**

    89→   * Used by GenerationsPane to default to the most recent shot.
    90→   * @default true
    91→   */
    92→  updateLastAffected?: boolean;
    93→  
    94→  /**

    96→   * @default true
    97→   */
    98→  dispatchSkeletonEvents?: boolean;
    99→  
   100→  /**
   101→   * Whether to switch sort mode to "newest" after creation.
   102→   * @default false
   103→   */

   105→  
   106→  /**

   111→  
   112→  /**

   114→   * Called after all side effects (inheritance, lastAffected) are applied.
   115→   */
   116→  onSuccess?: (result: ShotCreationResult) => void;

   118→
   119→export interface UseShotCreationReturn {
   120→  /**
   121→   * Create a new shot with optional generation or files.
   122→   * 
   123→   * @example
   124→   * // Empty shot
   125→   * await createShot({ name: 'Shot 1' });
   126→   * 
   127→   * // Shot with generation (atomic)
   128→   * await createShot({ generationId: '...' });
   129→   * 
   130→   * // Shot with files
   131→   * await createShot({ files: [...] });
   132→   */
   133→  createShot: (options?: CreateShotOptions) => Promise<ShotCreationResult | null>;
   134→  
   135→  /** Whether any shot creation is in progress */

   137→

   141→  /** Clear the last created shot state */
   142→  clearLastCreated: () => void;
   143→}
   144→
   145→// ============================================================================
   146→// HOOK IMPLEMENTATION
   147→// ============================================================================
   148→
   149→export function useShotCreation(): UseShotCreationReturn {
   150→  const { selectedProjectId } = useProject();
   151→  const { shots } = useShots();
   152→  const { setLastAffectedShotId } = useLastAffectedShot();
   153→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   154→  
   155→  // Mutations
   156→  const createShotMutation = useCreateShot();
   157→  const createShotWithImageMutation = useCreateShotWithImage();
   158→  const handleExternalImageDropMutation = useHandleExternalImageDrop();
   159→  
   160→  // State
   161→  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false);
   162→  const [lastCreatedShot, setLastCreatedShot] = useState<{ id: string; name: string } | null>(null);
   163→  
   164→  const clearLastCreated = useCallback(() => {
   165→    setLastCreatedShot(null);
   166→  }, []);
   167→  
   168→  /**
   169→   * Generate automatic shot name based on current shot count
   170→   */
   171→  const generateShotName = useCallback(() => {
   172→    const count = shots?.length ?? 0;
   173→    return `Shot ${count + 1}`;
   174→  }, [shots]);
   175→  
   176→  /**
   177→   * Apply post-creation side effects
   178→   */
   179→  const applyPostCreationEffects = useCallback((
   180→    result: ShotCreationResult,
   181→    options: CreateShotOptions
   182→  ) => {
   183→    const {
   184→      inheritSettings = true,
   185→      updateLastAffected = true,
   186→    } = options;
   187→    
   188→    // 1. Update last affected shot
   189→    if (updateLastAffected) {
   190→      setLastAffectedShotId(result.shotId);
   191→    }
   192→    
   193→    // 2. Apply settings inheritance (background, don't await)
   194→    if (inheritSettings && selectedProjectId) {
   195→      inheritSettingsForNewShot({
   196→        newShotId: result.shotId,
   197→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
   198→        shots: shots || [],
   199→      });
   200→    }
   201→    
   202→    // 3. Update last created shot state
   203→    setLastCreatedShot({ id: result.shotId, name: result.shotName });
   204→    
   205→  }, [selectedProjectId, shots, setLastAffectedShotId]);
   206→  
   207→  /**
   208→   * Dispatch optimistic skeleton event
   209→   */
   210→  const dispatchSkeletonEvent = useCallback((imageCount: number = 1) => {
   211→    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shot-pending-create', {
   212→      detail: { imageCount }
   213→    }));
   214→  }, []);
   215→  
   216→  /**
   217→   * Clear optimistic skeleton event on error
   218→   */
   219→  const clearSkeletonEvent = useCallback(() => {
   220→    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shot-pending-create-clear'));
   221→  }, []);
   222→  
   223→  /**
   224→   * Main shot creation function
   225→   */
   226→  const createShot = useCallback(async (
   227→    options: CreateShotOptions = {}
   228→  ): Promise<ShotCreationResult | null> => {
   229→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
   230→      toast.error('No project selected');
   231→      return null;
   232→    }
   233→    
   234→    const {
   235→      name,
   236→      generationId,
   237→      generationPreview,
   238→      files,
   239→      aspectRatio,
   240→      dispatchSkeletonEvents = true,
   241→      onProgress,
   242→    } = options;
   243→    
   244→    const shotName = name || generateShotName();
   245→    
   246→    // Dispatch skeleton event before starting
   247→    if (dispatchSkeletonEvents) {
   248→      const imageCount = files?.length || (generationId ? 1 : 0);
   249→      if (imageCount > 0) {
   250→        dispatchSkeletonEvent(imageCount);
   251→      }
   252→    }
   253→    
   254→    setIsCreating(true);
   255→    
   256→    try {
   257→      let result: ShotCreationResult;
   258→      
   259→      // ========================================
   260→      // PATH 1: Shot with Generation (Atomic RPC)
   261→      // ========================================
   262→      if (generationId && !files?.length) {
   263→        
   264→        const rpcResult = await createShotWithImageMutation.mutateAsync({
   265→          projectId: selectedProjectId,
   266→          shotName,
   267→          generationId,
   268→        });
   269→
   270→        // Optimistic cache update:
   271→        // The atomic RPC doesn't (currently) insert into the heavy `useListShots` cache,
   272→        // which makes the UI feel slow while it waits for a full shots refetch.
   273→        // Patch the shots cache immediately so:
   274→        // - the new shot appears right away
   275→        // - the pending skeleton transfers to the real shot card
   276→        // - selectors can resolve the new shot name immediately
   277→        if (rpcResult?.shotId) {
   278→          const newShotId = rpcResult.shotId;
   279→          const newShotName = rpcResult.shotName || shotName;
   280→          const shotGenerationId = rpcResult.shotGenerationId;
   281→
   282→          const updateShotCache = (oldShots: Shot[] = []) => {
   283→            if (oldShots.some(s => s.id === newShotId)) return oldShots;
   284→
   285→            const maxPosition = oldShots.reduce((max, s) => {

    49→        break;
    50→      case 'generations-deleted':
    51→        handleGenerationsDeleted(queryClient, event);
    52→        break;
    53→      case 'shot-generations-changed':

    55→        break;
    56→      case 'variants-changed':

    58→        break;
    59→      case 'variants-deleted':
    60→        handleVariantsDeleted(queryClient, event);
    61→        break;
    62→    }
    63→  }, [queryClient]);
    64→
    65→  useEffect(() => {
    66→    const unsubscribe = realtimeEventProcessor.onEvent(handleEvent);
    67→    return unsubscribe;
    68→  }, [handleEvent]);
    69→}

    75→function handleTasksUpdated(queryClient: QueryClient, event: TasksUpdatedEvent): void {
    76→
    77→  // Track affected queries for freshness manager
    78→  const affectedQueries: string[][] = [
    79→    queryKeys.tasks.paginatedAll,
    80→    queryKeys.tasks.statusCountsAll,
    81→  ];
    82→
    83→  // Always invalidate task list queries
    84→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
    85→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
    86→
    87→  // Invalidate individual task queries
    88→  event.tasks.forEach((task) => {
    89→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](task.id) });
    90→  });
    91→
    92→  // Check for completed tasks
    93→  const completedTasks = event.tasks.filter((t) => t.isComplete);
    94→  const failedTasks = event.tasks.filter((t) => t.isFailed);
    95→
    96→  // Handle failed/cancelled tasks
    97→  if (failedTasks.length > 0) {
    98→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({
    99→      predicate: (query) =>
   100→        query.queryKey[0] === 'pending-segment-tasks' ||
   101→        query.queryKey[0] === 'pending-generation-tasks',
   102→    });
   103→  }
   104→
   105→  // Handle completed tasks - invalidate generation data
   106→  if (completedTasks.length > 0) {
   107→    // Segment-related queries
   108→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   109→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   110→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   111→
   112→    // Derived generations
   113→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   114→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   115→
   116→    // Shot final videos (for shot list video previews)
   117→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   118→
   119→    // Project-level unified queries
   120→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   121→      predicate: (query) =>
   122→        query.queryKey[0] === 'unified-generations' && query.queryKey[1] === 'project',
   123→    });
   124→
   125→    // Track generation-related queries
   126→    affectedQueries.push(
   127→      queryKeys.segments.parentsAll,
   128→      queryKeys.segments.childrenAll,
   129→      queryKeys.unified.all,
   130→      queryKeys.generations.all
   131→    );
   132→
   133→    // Shot-specific invalidation
   134→    const completedShotIds = new Set(
   135→      completedTasks.map((t) => t.shotId).filter((id): id is string => !!id)
   136→    );
   137→
   138→    if (completedShotIds.size > 0) {
   139→      completedShotIds.forEach((shotId) => {
   140→        invalidateGenerationsSync(queryClient, shotId, {
   141→          reason: 'task-complete',
   142→          scope: 'all',
   143→        });
   144→      });
   145→    } else {
   146→      // No shot IDs found - fallback to broad invalidation
   147→      invalidateAllShotGenerations(queryClient, 'ta[REDACTED_SK]');
   148→    }
   149→  }
   150→
   151→  // Report to freshness manager
   152→  dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeEvent('tasks-updated', affectedQueries);
   153→}
   154→
   155→function handleTasksCreated(queryClient: QueryClient, _event: TasksCreatedEvent): void {
   156→
   157→  // Only invalidate task queries - new tasks haven't completed yet
   158→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   159→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });

   161→  // Report to freshness manager

   168→function handleGenerationsInserted(queryClient: QueryClient, event: GenerationsInsertedEvent): void {
   169→
   170→  // Invalidate generation queries
   171→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   172→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   173→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   174→
   175→  // Invalidate shot-generations
   176→  invalidateAllShotGenerations(queryClient, 'generations-inserted');

   178→  // Invalidate child generation queries if any have parents

   181→  );
   182→  if (parentsWithNewChildren.size > 0) {

   189→  // Report to freshness manager

   191→    queryKeys.unified.all,
   192→    queryKeys.generations.all,

   196→
   197→function handleGenerationsUpdated(queryClient: QueryClient, event: GenerationsUpdatedEvent): void {
   198→  // BUSINESS LOGIC: Determine if this is a "real" update or just a shot sync update
   199→  // Shot sync updates only change shot_id/timeline_frame/shot_data - we skip these
   200→  // because they're handled by shot_generations events and invalidating here causes flicker
   201→
   202→  const meaningfulUpdates = event.generations.filter(
   203→    (g) => g.locationChanged || g.thumbnailChanged || g.starredChanged
   204→  );
   205→
   206→  if (meaningfulUpdates.length === 0) {
   207→    return;
   208→  }
   209→
   210→  // Invalidate generation queries
   211→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   212→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   213→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   214→
   215→  // Invalidate shot-generations
   216→  invalidateAllShotGenerations(queryClient, 'generations-updated');
   217→
   218→  // Invalidate shots (for thumbnail updates)
   219→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   220→
   221→  // Report to freshness manager
   222→  dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeEvent('generations-updated', [
   223→    queryKeys.unified.all,
   224→    queryKeys.generations.all,
   225→    queryKeys.generations.detailAll,
   226→    queryKeys.shots.all,
   227→  ]);
   228→}
   229→
   230→function handleGenerationsDeleted(queryClient: QueryClient, event: GenerationsDeletedEvent): void {
   231→
   232→  // Notify preloading service to clear deleted images from tracker
   233→  const deletedIds = event.generations.map((g) => g.id).filter((id): id is string => !!id);
   234→  if (deletedIds.length > 0) {
   235→    preloadingService.onGenerationsDeleted(deletedIds);
   236→  }
   237→
   238→  // Invalidate all generation-related queries
   239→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   240→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   241→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   242→
   243→  // Invalidate shot-generations (deleted generation may have been in shots)
   244→  invalidateAllShotGenerations(queryClient, 'generations-deleted');
   245→
   246→  // Report to freshness manager
   247→  dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeEvent('generations-deleted', [
   248→    queryKeys.unified.all,
   249→    queryKeys.generations.all,
   250→    queryKeys.generations.detailAll,
   251→  ]);
   252→}
   253→
   254→function handleShotGenerationsChanged(
   255→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   256→  event: ShotGenerationsChangedEvent
   257→): void {
   258→
   259→  // BUSINESS LOGIC: For INSERT-only batches, skip broad invalidation to prevent flicker
   260→  // (optimistic updates handle these). For UPDATE/DELETE, need broader invalidation.
   261→
   262→  if (!event.allInserts) {
   263→    // Has UPDATE or DELETE - invalidate project-level queries
   264→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   265→      predicate: (query) =>
   266→        query.queryKey[0] === 'unified-generations' && query.queryKey[1] === 'project',
   267→    });
   268→  }
   269→
   270→  // Invalidate queries for each affected shot
   271→  event.affectedShotIds.forEach((shotId) => {
   272→    if (event.allInserts) {
   273→      // For INSERT-only, minimal invalidation (optimistic updates handle the rest)
   274→      invalidateGenerationsSync(queryClient, shotId, {
   275→        reason: 'shot-generation-insert',
   276→        scope: 'unified',
   277→      });
   278→      invalidateGenerationsSync(queryClient, shotId, {
   279→        reason: 'shot-generation-insert',
   280→        scope: 'counts',
   281→      });
   282→    } else {
   283→      // For UPDATE/DELETE, full invalidation
   284→      invalidateGenerationsSync(queryClient, shotId, {
   285→        reason: 'shot-generation-change',
   286→        scope: 'all',
   287→      });
   288→    }
   289→  });
   290→
   291→  // Report to freshness manager - include shot-specific queries
   292→  const affectedQueries: string[][] = [queryKeys.unified.all];
   293→  event.affectedShotIds.forEach((shotId) => {
   294→    affectedQueries.push(['unified-generations', 'shot', shotId]);
   295→  });
   296→  dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeEvent('shot-generations-changed', affectedQueries);
   297→}
   298→
   299→/**
   300→ * Shared invalidation logic for variant changes and deletions.
   301→ * Both events affect the same caches - only the event name for tracking differs.
   302→ */
   303→function invalidateVariantCaches(
   304→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   305→  affectedGenerationIds: string[],
   306→  eventName: 'variants-changed' | 'variants-deleted'
   307→): void {
   308→  // Invalidate variant queries for affected generations
   309→  affectedGenerationIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   310→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](generationId) });
   311→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](generationId) });
   312→  });
   313→
   314→  // Invalidate variant badges
   315→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   316→
   317→  // Variant changes/deletions may affect which variant is displayed
   318→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   319→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   320→  invalidateAllShotGenerations(queryClient, eventName);
   321→
   322→  // Report to freshness manager
   323→  const affectedQueries: string[][] = [
   324→    queryKeys.unified.all,
   325→    queryKeys.generations.all,
   326→    queryKeys.generations.variantBadges,
   327→  ];
   328→  affectedGenerationIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   329→    affectedQueries.push(queryKeys.generations.variants(generationId));
   330→  });
   331→  dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeEvent(eventName, affectedQueries);
   332→}
   333→
   334→function handleVariantsChanged(queryClient: QueryClient, event: VariantsChangedEvent): void {
   335→  invalidateVariantCaches(queryClient, event.affectedGenerationIds, 'variants-changed');
   336→}
   337→
   338→function handleVariantsDeleted(queryClient: QueryClient, event: VariantsDeletedEvent): void {
   339→  invalidateVariantCaches(queryClient, event.affectedGenerationIds, 'variants-deleted');
   340→}

   286→ * 
   287→ * Call at the top-level component (VideoTravelToolPage) to enable instant selector data.
   288→ * When a shot is selected, this seeds the cache so selectors immediately have data
   289→ * to display, eliminating the need for dual-source fallback logic in components.
   290→ * 
   291→ * NOTE: Primed data from ShotsContext does NOT include `metadata` (pair prompts).
   292→ * This is fine because selectors filter on `timeline_frame` and `type` which are present.
   293→ * Full metadata arrives when the useAllShotGenerations query completes (~300ms).
   294→ * 
   295→ * @param shotId - The shot ID to prime cache for
   296→ * @param contextImages - Images from ShotsContext (selectedShot.images)
   297→ */
   298→const usePrimeShotGenerationsCache = (
   299→  shotId: string | null,
   300→  contextImages: GenerationRow[] | undefined
   301→) => {
   302→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   303→  
   304→  React.useEffect(() => {
   305→    if (!shotId || !contextImages || contextImages.length === 0) return;
   306→
   307→    const existingData = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId));
   308→    if (existingData && existingData.length > 0) return;
   309→
   310→    // Prime the cache with context data
   311→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), contextImages);
   312→  }, [shotId, contextImages, queryClient]);
   313→};
   314→
   315→// ============================================================================
   316→// EXPORTED NAMES - Use these in code
   317→// ============================================================================
   318→
   319→/**
   320→ * All images in a shot (positioned + unpositioned).
   321→ * This is the preferred name - use this in new code.
   322→ * @see useAllShotGenerations for documentation
   323→ */
   324→export const useShotImages = useAllShotGenerations;
   325→
   326→/**
   327→ * Primes the shot images cache with data from context.
   328→ * This is the preferred name - use this in new code.
   329→ * @see usePrimeShotGenerationsCache for documentation
   330→ */
   331→export const usePrimeShotImagesCache = usePrimeShotGenerationsCache;
   332→
   333→// NOTE: useAllShotGenerations and usePrimeShotGenerationsCache are the implementation
   334→// functions above. We only export the preferred names (useShotImages, usePrimeShotImagesCache)
   335→// to avoid duplicate exports and confusion.
