```
    31→  created_at: string;
    32→  viewed_at: string | null;
    33→}
    34→
    35→/**
    36→ * Return type for useVariants hook
    37→ */
    38→export interface UseVariantsReturn {
    39→  variants: GenerationVariant[];
    40→  primaryVariant: GenerationVariant | null;
    41→  activeVariant: GenerationVariant | null;
    42→  isLoading: boolean;
    43→  error: Error | null;
    44→  refetch: () => void;
    45→  setActiveVariantId: (variantId: string | null) => void;
    46→  setPrimaryVariant: (variantId: string) => Promise<void>;
    47→  deleteVariant: (variantId: string) => Promise<void>;
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface UseVariantsProps {
    51→  generationId: string | null;
    52→  enabled?: boolean;
    53→}
    54→
    55→export const useVariants = ({
    56→  generationId,
    57→  enabled = true,
    58→}: UseVariantsProps): UseVariantsReturn => {
    59→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    60→  const [activeVariantId, setActiveVariantIdInternal] = useState<string | null>(null);
    61→  
    62→  // Stable callback - no deps needed since we just forward to internal setter
    63→  const setActiveVariantId = useCallback((variantId: string | null) => {
    64→    setActiveVariantIdInternal(variantId);
    65→  }, []);
    66→
    67→  // Fetch variants for this generation
    68→  const {
    69→    data: variants = [],
    70→    isLoading,
    71→    error,
    72→    refetch,
    73→  } = useQuery({
    74→    [REDACTED](generationId),
    75→    queryFn: async () => {
    76→      if (!generationId) return [];
    77→
    78→      const { data, error } = await supabase
    79→        .from('generation_variants')
    80→        .select('*')
    81→        .eq('generation_id', generationId)
    82→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    83→
    84→      if (error) {
    85→        console.error('[useVariants] Error fetching variants:', error);
    86→        throw error;
    87→      }
    88→
    89→      return (data || []) as GenerationVariant[];
    90→    },
    91→    enabled: enabled && !!generationId,
    92→    staleTime: 30000, // 30 seconds
    93→  });
    94→
    95→  // Listen for realtime variant changes and refetch when our generationId is affected
    96→  useEffect(() => {
    97→    if (!generationId || !enabled) return;
    98→
    99→    const handleVariantChange = (event: CustomEvent) => {
   100→      const affectedIds = event.detail?.affectedGenerationIds || [];
   101→      if (affectedIds.includes(generationId)) {
   102→        refetch();
   103→      }
   104→    };
   105→
   106→    window.addEventListener('realtime:variant-change-batch', handleVariantChange as EventListener);
   107→
   108→    return () => {
   109→      window.removeEventListener('realtime:variant-change-batch', handleVariantChange as EventListener);
   110→    };
   111→  }, [generationId, enabled, refetch]);
   112→
   113→  // Find the primary variant
   114→  const primaryVariant = useMemo(() => {
   115→    return variants.find((v) => v.is_primary) || null;
   116→  }, [variants]);
   117→
   118→  // Get the active variant (selected or primary, fallback to first variant)
   119→  const activeVariant = useMemo(() => {
   120→    if (activeVariantId) {
   121→      const found = variants.find((v) => v.id === activeVariantId);
   122→      if (found) {
   123→        return found;
   124→      }
   125→    }
   126→    // Fall back to primary, then first variant if no primary exists
   127→    return primaryVariant || variants[0] || null;
   128→  }, [variants, activeVariantId, primaryVariant]);
   129→
   130→  // Initialize active variant to primary (or first variant) when variants load
   131→  // NOTE: Using useEffect, not useMemo - side effects should not be in useMemo
   132→  useEffect(() => {
   133→    if (!activeVariantId && variants.length > 0) {
   134→      const variantToSelect = primaryVariant || variants[0];
   135→      if (variantToSelect) {
   136→        setActiveVariantIdInternal(variantToSelect.id);
   137→      }
   138→    }
   139→  }, [primaryVariant, variants, activeVariantId]);
   140→
   141→  // Mutation to set a variant as primary
   142→  const setPrimaryMutation = useMutation({
   143→    mutationFn: async (variantId: string) => {
   144→
   145→      // Update the variant to be primary
   146→      // The database trigger will handle unsetting the old primary
   147→      const { error } = await supabase
   148→        .from('generation_variants')
   149→        .update({ is_primary: true })
   150→        .eq('id', variantId);
   151→
   152→      if (error) {
   153→        console.error('[useVariants] Error setting primary variant:', error);
   154→        throw error;
   155→      }
   156→
   157→      return variantId;
   158→    },
   159→    onSuccess: async (variantId) => {
   160→
   161→      // Invalidate caches using centralized function
   162→      if (generationId) {
   163→        await invalidateVariantChange(queryClient, {
   164→          generationId,
   165→          reason: 'set-primary-variant',
   166→        });
   167→      }
   168→
   169→      // SINGLE-SEGMENT PROPAGATION: If this is a child of a single-segment parent,
   170→      // also create a variant on the parent so the main generation updates
   171→      try {
   172→        // Get the promoted variant's location and thumbnail
   173→        const { data: promotedVariant } = await supabase
   174→          .from('generation_variants')
   175→          .select('location, thumbnail_url, params')
   176→          .eq('id', variantId)
   177→          .single();
   178→
   179→        if (!promotedVariant || !generationId) return;
   180→
   181→        // Check if this generation is a child with a parent
   182→        const { data: generation } = await supabase
   183→          .from('generations')
   184→          .select('is_child, parent_generation_id')
   185→          .eq('id', generationId)
   186→          .single();
   187→
   188→        if (!generation?.is_child || !generation?.parent_generation_id) return;
   189→
   190→        // Count how many children the parent has
   191→        const { count: childCount } = await supabase
   192→          .from('generations')
   193→          .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   194→          .eq('parent_generation_id', generation.parent_generation_id)
   195→          .eq('is_child', true);
   196→
   197→        // Only propagate for single-segment parents
   198→        if (childCount !== 1) {
   199→          return;
   200→        }
   201→
   202→        // Create a new variant on the parent with the promoted video
   203→        // Exclude task-specific fields that shouldn't propagate to parent
   204→        const {
   205→          source_task_id: _sourceTaskId,
   206→          child_generation_id: _childGenId,
   207→          ...paramsToPropagate
   208→        } = (promotedVariant.params || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   209→
   210→        const { error: insertError } = await supabase
   211→          .from('generation_variants')
   212→          .insert({
   213→            generation_id: generation.parent_generation_id,
   214→            location: promotedVariant.location,
   215→            thumbnail_url: promotedVariant.thumbnail_url,
   216→            is_primary: true, // DB trigger will unset old primary
   217→            variant_type: 'travel_segment',
   218→            params: {
   219→              ...paramsToPropagate,
   220→              propagated_from_child: generationId,
   221→              propagated_from_variant: variantId,
   222→            },
   223→          });
   224→
   225→        if (insertError) {
   226→          handleError(insertError, { context: 'useVariants', showToast: false });
   227→        } else {
   228→          // Invalidate parent's variant cache
   229→          await invalidateVariantChange(queryClient, {
   230→            generationId: generation.parent_generation_id,
   231→            reason: 'single-segment-propagation',
   232→          });
   233→        }
   234→      } catch (err) {
   235→        console.error('[useVariants] Error in single-segment propagation:', err);
   236→        // Don't throw - this is a nice-to-have, not critical
   237→      }
   238→    },
   239→    onError: (error) => {
   240→      handleError(error, { context: 'useVariants.setPrimaryVariant', toastTitle: 'Failed to set primary variant' });
   241→    },
   242→  });
   243→
   244→  const setPrimaryVariant = useCallback(
   245→    async (variantId: string) => {
   246→      await setPrimaryMutation.mutateAsync(variantId);
   247→    },
   248→    [setPrimaryMutation]
   249→  );
   250→
   251→  // Mutation to delete a variant
   252→  const deleteVariantMutation = useMutation({
   253→    mutationFn: async (variantId: string) => {
   254→
   255→      // Check if variant is primary - don't allow deleting primary
   256→      const variant = variants.find(v => v.id === variantId);
   257→      if (variant?.is_primary) {
   258→        throw new Error('Cannot delete the primary variant');
   259→      }
   260→
   261→      const { error } = await supabase
   262→        .from('generation_variants')
   263→        .delete()
   264→        .eq('id', variantId);
   265→
   266→      if (error) {
   267→        console.error('[useVariants] Error deleting variant:', error);
   268→        throw error;
   269→      }
   270→
   271→      return variantId;
   272→    },
   273→    onSuccess: async (variantId) => {
   274→
   275→      // If deleted variant was active, switch to primary
   276→      if (activeVariantId === variantId) {
   277→        setActiveVariantId(primaryVariant?.id || null);
   278→      }
   279→
   280→      // Invalidate caches
   281→      if (generationId) {
   282→        await invalidateVariantChange(queryClient, {
   283→          generationId,
   284→          reason: 'delete-variant',
   285→        });
   286→      }
   287→    },
   288→    onError: (error) => {
   289→      handleError(error, { context: 'useVariants.deleteVariant', toastTitle: 'Failed to delete variant' });
   290→    },
   291→  });
   292→
   293→  const deleteVariant = useCallback(
   294→    async (variantId: string) => {
   295→      await deleteVariantMutation.mutateAsync(variantId);
   296→    },
   297→    [deleteVariantMutation]
   298→  );
   299→
   300→  return {
   301→    variants,
   302→    primaryVariant,
   303→    activeVariant,
   304→    isLoading,
   305→    error: error as Error | null,
   306→    refetch,
   307→    setActiveVariantId,
   308→    setPrimaryVariant,
   309→    deleteVariant,
   310→  };
   311→};
   312→
   313→
```

```
1→import { useEffect, useReducer, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { dataFreshnessManager } from '@/shared/realtime/DataFreshnessManager';
     3→
     4→/**
     5→ * Smart polling hook that integrates with DataFreshnessManager
     6→ * 
     7→ * This hook replaces the old useResurrectionPolling system with a simpler,
     8→ * more reliable approach that works with our centralized freshness management.
     9→ */
    10→
    11→interface SmartPollingConfig {
    12→  /**
    13→   * The query key this polling config applies to
    14→   */
    15→  queryKey: string[];
    16→  
    17→  /**
    18→   * Minimum polling interval when realtime is working (default: 5 minutes)
    19→   * Set to false to disable polling entirely when realtime is healthy
    20→   */
    21→  minInterval?: number | false;
    22→  
    23→  /**
    24→   * Maximum polling interval when realtime is broken (default: 5 seconds)
    25→   */
    26→  maxInterval?: number;
    27→  
    28→  /**
    29→   * How fresh data needs to be to avoid aggressive polling (default: 30 seconds)
    30→   */
    31→  freshnessThreshold?: number;
    32→  
    33→  /**
    34→   * Enable debug logging for this query
    35→   */
    36→  debug?: boolean;
    37→}
    38→
    39→interface SmartPollingResult {
    40→  /**
    41→   * React Query refetchInterval - use this in your useQuery config
    42→   */
    43→  refetchInterval: number | false;
    44→  
    45→  /**
    46→   * React Query staleTime - use this in your useQuery config
    47→   */
    48→  staleTime: number;
    49→  
    50→  /**
    51→   * Whether data is considered fresh based on realtime events
    52→   */
    53→  isDataFresh: boolean;
    54→  
    55→  /**
    56→   * Current realtime connection status
    57→   */
    58→  realtimeStatus: 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error';
    59→  
    60→  /**
    61→   * Debug information (only if debug: true)
    62→   */
    63→  debug?: {
    64→    pollingReason: string;
    65→    lastEventAge?: number;
    66→    diagnostics: ReturnType<typeof dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics> | null;
    67→  };
    68→}
    69→
    70→/**
    71→ * @internal Used by useSmartPollingConfig - not directly exported.
    72→ */
    73→function useSmartPolling(config: SmartPollingConfig): SmartPollingResult {
    74→  const {
    75→    queryKey,
    76→    minInterval = 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes default
    77→    // [MobileHeatDebug] Increased from 5s to 15s to reduce mobile CPU usage
    78→    // Desktop can handle aggressive polling, but mobile overheats with 5s intervals
    79→    maxInterval = 15000, // 15 seconds default (was 5s)
    80→    freshnessThreshold = 30000, // 30 seconds default
    81→    debug = false
    82→  } = config;
    83→
    84→  // [MobileHeatDebug] Detect mobile devices and increase polling intervals
    85→  const isMobile = /iPhone|iPad|iPod|Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
    86→
    87→  // Force re-render when freshness manager state changes
    88→  const [, forceUpdate] = useReducer(x => x + 1, 0);
    89→  const lastIntervalRef = useRef<number | false | null>(null);
    90→
    91→  // 🎯 FIX: Stabilize queryKey for dependency comparison
    92→  // Arrays are compared by reference, so ['a', 'b'] !== ['a', 'b'] on every render
    93→  // Use a ref to store current queryKey so callback always has latest without needing it in deps
    94→  const queryKeyRef = useRef(queryKey);
    95→  queryKeyRef.current = queryKey;
    96→  const queryKeyString = JSON.stringify(queryKey);
    97→
    98→  // 🎯 FIX: Throttle forceUpdate to prevent rapid re-renders
    99→  // DataFreshnessManager can emit many notifications in quick succession
   100→  const pendingUpdateRef = useRef(false);
   101→  const throttleTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   102→
   103→  useEffect(() => {
   104→    // Subscribe to freshness manager updates
   105→    const unsubscribe = dataFreshnessManager.subscribe(() => {
   106→      // 🎯 OPTIMIZATION: Only re-render if the calculated polling interval actually changes
   107→      const currentInterval = dataFreshnessManager.getPollingInterval(queryKeyRef.current);
   108→      if (lastIntervalRef.current !== currentInterval) {
   109→        // 🎯 THROTTLE: Batch rapid updates into a single re-render
   110→        if (!pendingUpdateRef.current) {
   111→          pendingUpdateRef.current = true;
   112→          // Use microtask to batch synchronous notifications
   113→          queueMicrotask(() => {
   114→            pendingUpdateRef.current = false;
   115→            forceUpdate();
   116→          });
   117→        }
   118→      }
   119→    });
   120→
   121→    return () => {
   122→      unsubscribe();
   123→      if (throttleTimeoutRef.current) {
   124→        clearTimeout(throttleTimeoutRef.current);
   125→      }
   126→    };
   127→  }, [queryKeyString, debug]);
   128→
   129→  // Get current state from freshness manager
   130→  const pollingInterval = dataFreshnessManager.getPollingInterval(queryKey);
   131→  lastIntervalRef.current = pollingInterval;
   132→  const isDataFresh = dataFreshnessManager.isDataFresh(queryKey, freshnessThreshold);
   133→  const diagnostics = debug ? dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics() : null;
   134→
   135→  // Apply our min/max constraints
   136→  let finalInterval: number | false;
   137→  let pollingReason: string;
   138→  
   139→  // [MobileHeatDebug] On mobile, multiply all intervals by 2x to reduce CPU usage
   140→  const mobileMultiplier = isMobile ? 2 : 1;
   141→  const effectiveMaxInterval = maxInterval * mobileMultiplier;
   142→  const effectiveMinInterval = minInterval === false ? false : minInterval * mobileMultiplier;
   143→
   144→  if (pollingInterval === false) {
   145→    // 🎯 NEW: Respect when freshness manager disables polling completely
   146→    if (effectiveMinInterval === false) {
   147→      finalInterval = false;
   148→      pollingReason = 'Polling DISABLED - realtime is healthy and working';
   149→    } else {
   150→      finalInterval = effectiveMinInterval;
   151→      pollingReason = isMobile 
   152→        ? 'Freshness manager disabled polling, using minInterval fallback (2x for mobile)'
   153→        : 'Freshness manager disabled polling, using minInterval fallback';
   154→    }
   155→  } else if (effectiveMinInterval !== false && pollingInterval > effectiveMinInterval && isDataFresh) {
   156→    finalInterval = effectiveMinInterval;
   157→    pollingReason = isMobile 
   158→      ? 'Data is fresh, using minInterval (2x for mobile)'
   159→      : 'Data is fresh, using minInterval';
   160→  } else if (pollingInterval < effectiveMaxInterval) {
   161→    finalInterval = effectiveMaxInterval;
   162→    pollingReason = isMobile
   163→      ? 'Clamping to maxInterval for aggressive polling (2x for mobile - 30s)'
   164→      : 'Clamping to maxInterval for aggressive polling';
   165→  } else {
   166→    finalInterval = pollingInterval * mobileMultiplier;
   167→    pollingReason = isMobile
   168→      ? 'Using freshness manager interval (2x for mobile)'
   169→      : 'Using freshness manager interval';
   170→  }
   171→
   172→  // Calculate stale time based on freshness
   173→  const staleTime = isDataFresh ? freshnessThreshold : 0;
   174→
   175→  const result: SmartPollingResult = {
   176→    refetchInterval: finalInterval,
   177→    staleTime,
   178→    isDataFresh,
   179→    realtimeStatus: diagnostics?.realtimeStatus || 'disconnected'
   180→  };
   181→
   182→  if (debug) {
   183→    const queryAge = diagnostics?.queryAges?.find(q => 
   184→      JSON.stringify(q.query) === JSON.stringify(queryKey)
   185→    );
   186→
   187→    result.debug = {
   188→      pollingReason,
   189→      lastEventAge: queryAge?.ageMs,
   190→      diagnostics
   191→    };
   192→
   193→  }
   194→  
   195→  // [MobileHeatDebug] Log aggressive polling on mobile for debugging
   196→
   197→  return result;
   198→}
   199→
   200→/**
   201→ * Simplified version for common use cases
   202→ * Just returns the config object to spread into useQuery
   203→ * 
   204→ * By default, minInterval is set to false to allow polling to be completely disabled
   205→ * when realtime is working. Pass minInterval: number if you want a fallback interval.
   206→ */
   207→export function useSmartPollingConfig(queryKey: string[], debug = false) {
   208→  // 🎯 NEW: Default to minInterval: false to allow full polling disable
   209→  const { refetchInterval, staleTime } = useSmartPolling({ 
   210→    queryKey, 
   211→    debug,
   212→    minInterval: false // Allow polling to be disabled when realtime is healthy
   213→  });
   214→  
   215→  return {
   216→    refetchInterval,
   217→    staleTime
   218→  };
   219→}
   220→
```

```
    97→
    98→      if (insertError || !newGeneration) {
    99→        throw new Error(`Failed to create generation: ${insertError?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
   100→      }
   101→
   102→      // 4. Create variant
   103→      await supabase.from('generation_variants').insert({
   104→        generation_id: newGeneration.id,
   105→        location: sourceLocation,
   106→        thumbnail_url: sourceThumbnail,
   107→        is_primary: true,
   108→        variant_type: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   109→        name: 'Original',
   110→        params: newGenerationData.params,
   111→      });
   112→
   113→      // 5. Calculate timeline position
   114→      const { data: existingFramesData } = await supabase
   115→        .from('shot_generations')
   116→        .select('timeline_frame')
   117→        .eq('shot_id', shot_id);
   118→
   119→      const existingFrames = (existingFramesData || [])
   120→        .map(shotGen => shotGen.timeline_frame)
   121→        .filter((f): f is number => f !== null);
   122→
   123→      let targetTimelineFrame: number;
   124→      if (target_timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   125→        // Explicit target provided (interceptor pre-calculates midpoint + collision avoidance)
   126→        targetTimelineFrame = target_timeline_frame;
   127→      } else if (next_timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   128→        targetTimelineFrame = Math.floor((timeline_frame + next_timeline_frame) / 2);
   129→      } else {
   130→        targetTimelineFrame = timeline_frame + 30;
   131→      }
   132→
   133→      let newTimelineFrame = Math.max(0, Math.round(targetTimelineFrame));
   134→      if (existingFrames.includes(newTimelineFrame)) {
   135→        let offset = 1;
   136→        while (offset < MAX_FRAME_COLLISION_OFFSET) {
   137→          const higher = newTimelineFrame + offset;
   138→          if (!existingFrames.includes(higher)) {
   139→            newTimelineFrame = higher;
   140→            break;
   141→          }
   142→          const lower = newTimelineFrame - offset;
   143→          if (lower >= 0 && !existingFrames.includes(lower)) {
   144→            newTimelineFrame = lower;
   145→            break;
   146→          }
   147→          offset += 1;
   148→        }
   149→      }
   150→
   151→      // 6. Add to shot
   152→      const { data: newShotGen, error: addError } = await supabase
   153→        .from('shot_generations')
   154→        .insert({
   155→          shot_id,
   156→          generation_id: newGeneration.id,
   157→          timeline_frame: newTimelineFrame,
   158→        })
   159→        .select()
   160→        .single();
   161→
   162→      if (addError || !newShotGen) {
   163→        throw new Error(`Failed to add to shot: ${addError?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
   164→      }
   165→
   166→      return {
   167→        shot_id,
   168→        original_generation_id: generation_id,
   169→        new_generation_id: newGeneration.id,
   170→        new_shot_generation_id: newShotGen.id,
   171→        timeline_frame: newTimelineFrame,
   172→        project_id,
   173→      };
   174→    },
   175→
   176→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   177→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.project_id) });
   178→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   179→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   180→      invalidateGenerationsSync(queryClient, data.shot_id, {
   181→        reason: 'duplicate-as-new-generation',
   182→        scope: 'all',
   183→      });
   184→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   185→        [REDACTED](data.original_generation_id),
   186→      });
   187→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shot_id) });
   188→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   189→        [REDACTED](data.shot_id, data.project_id),
   190→      });
   191→    },
   192→
   193→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   194→      toast.error(`Failed to duplicate image: ${error.message}`);
   195→    },
   196→  });
   197→};
```

1→import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type ButtonState = 'idle' | 'submitting' | 'success';
     4→
     5→interface SubmitButtonStateOptions {
     6→  /** Duration of "Submitting..." state in ms (default: 1000) */
     7→  submittingDuration?: number;
     8→  /** Duration of success state in ms (default: 2000) */
     9→  successDuration?: number;
    10→}
    11→
    12→interface SubmitButtonStateResult {
    13→  /** True when in "submitting" state */
    14→  isSubmitting: boolean;
    15→  /** True when in "success" state */
    16→  isSuccess: boolean;
    17→  /** Current state value */
    18→  state: ButtonState;
    19→  /** Trigger the state transition: idle → submitting → success → idle */
    20→  trigger: () => void;
    21→  /** Reset to idle immediately */
    22→  reset: () => void;
    23→}
    24→
    25→/**
    26→ * Hook for managing submit button state transitions.
    27→ * Provides a consistent UX pattern: idle → submitting → success → idle
    28→ *
    29→ * Handles cleanup on unmount and clears existing transitions on re-trigger.
    30→ *
    31→ * @example
    32→ * ```tsx
    33→ * const submitButton = useSubmitButtonState();
    34→ *
    35→ * const handleSubmit = () => {
    36→ *   submitButton.trigger();
    37→ *   // Start background work...
    38→ * };
    39→ *
    40→ * <Button
    41→ *   disabled={submitButton.isSubmitting}
    42→ *   variant={submitButton.isSuccess ? "success" : "default"}
    43→ * >
    44→ *   {submitButton.isSuccess ? "Done!" : submitButton.isSubmitting ? "Submitting..." : "Submit"}
    45→ * </Button>
    46→ * ```
    47→ */
    48→export function useSubmitButtonState(options: SubmitButtonStateOptions = {}): SubmitButtonStateResult {
    49→  const { submittingDuration = 1000, successDuration = 2000 } = options;
    50→
    51→  const [state, setState] = useState<ButtonState>('idle');
    52→  const timeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    53→
    54→  // Cleanup on unmount
    55→  useEffect(() => {
    56→    return () => {
    57→      if (timeoutRef.current) {
    58→        clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    59→      }
    60→    };
    61→  }, []);
    62→
    63→  const trigger = useCallback(() => {
    64→    // Clear any existing timeout
    65→    if (timeoutRef.current) {
    66→      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    setState('submitting');
    70→    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    71→      setState('success');
    72→      timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    73→        setState('idle');
    74→      }, successDuration);
    75→    }, submittingDuration);
    76→  }, [submittingDuration, successDuration]);
    77→
    78→  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    79→    if (timeoutRef.current) {
    80→      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    81→    }
    82→    setState('idle');
    83→  }, []);
    84→
    85→  return {
    86→    isSubmitting: state === 'submitting',
    87→    isSuccess: state === 'success',
    88→    state,
    89→    trigger,
    90→    reset,
    91→  };
    92→}
    93→

```
    10→async function cancelTask(taskId: string): Promise<void> {
    11→  // First, get the task to check if it's an orchestrator
    12→  const { data: task, error: fetchError } = await supabase
    13→    .from('tasks')
    14→    .select('*')

    16→    .single();
    17→
    18→  if (fetchError) {
    19→    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch task: ${fetchError.message}`);
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  // Check if task can be cancelled (only Queued tasks can be cancelled from UI)
    23→  if (task.status !== 'Queued' && task.status !== 'In Progress') {
    24→    throw new Error(`Task is already ${task.status}`);
    25→  }
    26→
    27→  // Cancel the main task - use .select() to verify the update happened
    28→  const { data: updatedTask, error: cancelError } = await supabase
    29→    .from('tasks')
    30→    .update({
    31→      status: 'Cancelled',
    32→      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    33→    })
    34→    .eq('id', taskId)
    35→    .select('id, status')
    36→    .single();
    37→
    38→  if (cancelError) {
    39→    throw new Error(`Failed to cancel task: ${cancelError.message}`);
    40→  }
    41→
    42→  // Verify the update actually happened
    43→  if (!updatedTask || updatedTask.status !== 'Cancelled') {
    44→    const err = new Error('Task cancellation failed - status not updated');
    45→    handleError(err, { context: 'useCancelTask', showToast: false, logData: { updatedTask } });
    46→    throw err;
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  // If it's an orchestrator task, cancel all subtasks
    50→  if (task && task.task_type?.includes('orchestrator')) {
    51→    // Find all subtasks that reference this orchestrator
    52→    const { data: subtasks, error: subtaskFetchError } = await supabase
    53→      .from('tasks')
    54→      .select('id, params')
    55→      .eq('project_id', task.project_id)
    56→      .in('status', ['Queued']);
    57→

    59→      const subtaskIds = subtasks.filter(subtask => {
    60→        const params = subtask.params as Record<string, unknown> | null;
    61→        return params?.orchestrator_task_id_ref === taskId ||
    62→               params?.orchestrator_task_id === taskId;
    63→      }).map(subtask => subtask.id);
    64→
    65→      if (subtaskIds.length > 0) {
    66→        // Cancel all subtasks
    67→        const { error: subtaskCancelError } = await supabase
    68→          .from('tasks')

    71→            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    72→          })
    73→          .in('id', subtaskIds);
```

```
1→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     2→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import { getVisibleTaskTypes, getHiddenTaskTypes } from '@/shared/lib/taskConfig';
     4→
     5→interface TaskWithCost {
     6→  id: string;
     7→  taskType: string;
     8→  status: string;
     9→  createdAt: string;
    10→  generationStartedAt?: string;
    11→  generationProcessedAt?: string;
    12→  projectId: string;
    13→  cost?: number; // from credits_ledger
    14→  duration?: number; // calculated from start/end times
    15→  projectName?: string; // from projects table
    16→}
    17→
    18→interface TaskLogResponse {
    19→  tasks: TaskWithCost[];
    20→  pagination: {
    21→    limit: number;
    22→    offset: number;
    23→    total: number;
    24→    hasMore: boolean;
    25→    totalPages: number;
    26→    currentPage: number;
    27→  };
    28→  availableFilters: {
    29→    taskTypes: string[];
    30→    projects: { id: string; name: string }[];
    31→    statuses: string[];
    32→  };
    33→}
    34→
    35→interface TaskLogFilters {
    36→  costFilter?: 'all' | 'free' | 'paid';
    37→  status?: string[];
    38→  taskTypes?: string[];
    39→  projectIds?: string[];
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function useTaskLog(
    43→  limit: number = 20, 
    44→  page: number = 1, 
    45→  filters: TaskLogFilters = {}
    46→) {
    47→  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
    48→  
    49→  return useQuery<TaskLogResponse, Error>({
    50→    queryKey: ['task-log', limit, page, filters],
    51→    placeholderData: (previousData) => previousData, // Prevents table from disappearing during filter changes
    52→    queryFn: async () => {
    53→      const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    54→      if (authError || !user) {
    55→        throw new Error('Authentication required');
    56→      }
    57→
    58→      // First get user's projects to filter tasks
    59→      const { data: projects } = await supabase
    60→        .from('projects')
    61→        .select('id, name')
    62→        .eq('user_id', user.id);
    63→
    64→      if (!projects || projects.length === 0) {
    65→        return {
    66→          tasks: [],
    67→          pagination: { 
    68→            limit, 
    69→            offset, 
    70→            total: 0, 
    71→            hasMore: false, 
    72→            totalPages: 0,
    73→            currentPage: page 
    74→          },
    75→          availableFilters: {
    76→            taskTypes: [],
    77→            projects: [],
    78→            statuses: []
    79→          }
    80→        };
    81→      }
    82→
    83→      const projectIds = projects.map(p => p.id);
    84→      const projectLookup = Object.fromEntries(projects.map(p => [p.id, p.name]));
    85→
    86→      // Get hidden task types from centralized config (same as TasksPane uses)
    87→      const hiddenTaskTypes = getHiddenTaskTypes();
    88→
    89→      // Build query with filters
    90→      // Only show visible task types (uses same centralized config as TasksPane)
    91→      let query = supabase
    92→        .from('tasks')
    93→        .select('*', { count: 'exact' })
    94→        .in('project_id', projectIds);
    95→
    96→      // Exclude hidden task types if there are any defined
    97→      if (hiddenTaskTypes.length > 0) {
    98→        query = query.not('task_type', 'in', `(${hiddenTaskTypes.join(',')})`);
    99→      }
   100→
   101→      // Apply status filter
   102→      if (filters.status && filters.status.length > 0) {
   103→        query = query.in('status', filters.status);
   104→      }
   105→
   106→      // Apply task type filter
   107→      if (filters.taskTypes && filters.taskTypes.length > 0) {
   108→        query = query.in('task_type', filters.taskTypes);
   109→      }
   110→
   111→      // Apply project filter
   112→      if (filters.projectIds && filters.projectIds.length > 0) {
   113→        query = query.in('project_id', filters.projectIds);
   114→      }
   115→
   116→      const { data: tasksData, error: tasksError, count } = await query
   117→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
   118→        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
   119→
   120→      if (tasksError) {
   121→        throw new Error(`Failed to fetch tasks: ${tasksError.message}`);
   122→      }
   123→
   124→      // Get cost information for these tasks
   125→      const taskIds = tasksData?.map(task => task.id) || [];
   126→      let costsData: { task_id: string; amount: number; created_at: string }[] = [];
   127→      
   128→      if (taskIds.length > 0) {
   129→        const { data: costs } = await supabase
   130→          .from('credits_ledger')
   131→          .select('task_id, amount, created_at')
   132→          .in('task_id', taskIds)
   133→          .eq('type', 'spend');
   134→
   135→        costsData = costs || [];
   136→      }
   137→
   138→      // Combine tasks with cost information
   139→      let tasks: TaskWithCost[] = (tasksData || []).map(task => {
   140→        const costEntry = costsData.find(cost => cost.task_id === task.id);
   141→        let duration: number | undefined;
   142→        
   143→        // Calculate duration if both timestamps exist
   144→        if (task.generation_started_at && task.generation_processed_at) {
   145→          const start = new Date(task.generation_started_at);
   146→          const end = new Date(task.generation_processed_at);
   147→          duration = Math.ceil((end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / 1000); // in seconds
   148→        }
   149→
   150→        return {
   151→          id: task.id,
   152→          taskType: task.task_type,
   153→          status: task.status,
   154→          createdAt: task.created_at,
   155→          generationStartedAt: task.generation_started_at,
   156→          generationProcessedAt: task.generation_processed_at,
   157→          projectId: task.project_id,
   158→          projectName: projectLookup[task.project_id] || 'Unknown Project',
   159→          cost: costEntry ? Math.abs(costEntry.amount) : undefined,
   160→          duration,
   161→        };
   162→      });
   163→
   164→      // Apply cost filter (client-side since it depends on joined data)
   165→      if (filters.costFilter === 'free') {
   166→        tasks = tasks.filter(task => !task.cost || task.cost === 0);
   167→      } else if (filters.costFilter === 'paid') {
   168→        tasks = tasks.filter(task => task.cost && task.cost > 0);
   169→      }
   170→
   171→      // Get available filter options
   172→      // Use visible task types from centralized config (same as TasksPane dropdown)
   173→      // Show ALL visible types, not just ones user has used (matches TasksPane behavior)
   174→      const visibleTaskTypes = getVisibleTaskTypes();
   175→      
   176→      // Query for unique statuses from user's visible tasks
   177→      let allTasksQuery = supabase
   178→        .from('tasks')
   179→        .select('task_type, status, project_id')
   180→        .in('project_id', projectIds);
   181→      
   182→      if (hiddenTaskTypes.length > 0) {
   183→        allTasksQuery = allTasksQuery.not('task_type', 'in', `(${hiddenTaskTypes.join(',')})`);
   184→      }
   185→      
   186→      const { data: allTasks } = await allTasksQuery;
   187→
   188→      const availableFilters = {
   189→        // Show all visible task types (same as TasksPane dropdown)
   190→        taskTypes: visibleTaskTypes.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)),
   191→        projects: projects,
   192→        statuses: [...new Set((allTasks || []).map(t => t.status))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
   193→      };
   194→
   195→      const total = count || 0;
   196→      const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);
   197→      const hasMore = page < totalPages;
   198→
   199→      return {
   200→        tasks,
   201→        pagination: {
   202→          limit,
   203→          offset,
   204→          total,
   205→          hasMore,
   206→          totalPages,
   207→          currentPage: page,
   208→        },
   209→        availableFilters
   210→      };
   211→    },
   212→  });
   213→}
```

```
   495→export const useUpdateShotImageOrder = () => {
   496→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

   499→    mutationFn: async ({
   500→      updates,
   501→      projectId,
   502→      shotId,

   504→      updates: { shot_id: string; generation_id: string; timeline_frame: number }[];
   505→      projectId: string;
   506→      shotId: string;
   507→    }) => {
   508→      const promises = updates.map(update =>
   509→        supabase
   510→          .from('shot_generations')
   511→          .update({ timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame })
   512→          .eq('shot_id', update.shot_id)
   513→          .eq('generation_id', update.generation_id)
   514→      );
   515→
   516→      const results = await Promise.all(promises);
   517→
   518→      const errors = results.filter(r => r.error);
   519→      if (errors.length > 0) {
   520→        throw new Error(`Reorder failed: ${errors.map(e => e.error?.message).join(', ')}`);
   521→      }

   523→      return { projectId, shotId, updates };

   532→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)

   535→      if (previousFastGens) {
   536→        const updatedGens = previousFastGens.map(gen => {
   537→          const update = updates.find(u => u.generation_id === gen.generation_id);
   538→          if (update) {
   539→            return { ...gen, timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame };
   540→          }
   541→          return gen;
   542→        });

   544→        updatedGens.sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame || 0) - (b.timeline_frame || 0));
   545→        queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), updatedGens);
   546→      }
   547→
   548→      return { previousFastGens, shotId };
   549→    },
   550→
   551→    onError: (_err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   552→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   553→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   554→      }

   563→      });
```

```
     6→
     7→/** Counts stored per shot */
     8→interface ShotCounts {
     9→  videoCount: number;
    10→  finalVideoCount: number;

    13→
    14→/**
    15→ * Project-wide video counts cache
    16→ * Fetches all shot video counts for a project in a single query
    17→ */
    18→class ProjectVideoCountsCache {
    19→  private cache = new Map<string, Map<string, ShotCounts>>(); // projectId -> shotId -> counts
    20→
    21→  getProjectCounts(projectId: string): Map<string, ShotCounts> | null {
    22→    return this.cache.get(projectId) || null;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  getShotCounts(projectId: string, shotId: string): ShotCounts | null {
    26→    const projectCounts = this.cache.get(projectId);
    27→    if (!projectCounts) return null;
    28→    return projectCounts.get(shotId) || null;
    29→  }
    30→
    31→  setProjectCounts(projectId: string, counts: Map<string, ShotCounts>): void {
    32→    this.cache.set(projectId, counts);
    33→  }
    34→
    35→  clear(): void {
    36→    this.cache.clear();
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  deleteProject(projectId: string): void {
    40→    this.cache.delete(projectId);
    41→  }
    42→
    43→  // Get cache size for debugging
    44→  size(): number {
    45→    return this.cache.size;
    46→  }
    47→
    48→  // Get all cached project IDs for debugging
    49→  getCachedProjectIds(): string[] {
    50→    return Array.from(this.cache.keys());

    52→}
    53→
    54→// Global cache instance that persists across component remounts
    55→const globalProjectVideoCountsCache = new ProjectVideoCountsCache();
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Check if a shot's settings contain structure video configuration.
    59→ * Handles both new array format and legacy single-video format.
    60→ */
    61→function shotSettingsHaveStructureVideo(settings: Record<string, unknown> | null): boolean {
    62→  if (!settings) return false;
    63→  const svSettings = settings['travel-structure-video'] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    64→  if (!svSettings) return false;
    65→
    66→  // New array format
    67→  const videos = svSettings.structure_videos as unknown[] | undefined;
    68→  if (videos && videos.length > 0) return true;
    69→
    70→  // Legacy single-video format
    71→  const path = svSettings.structure_video_path;
    72→  if (path && path !== null) return true;
    73→
    74→  return false;
    75→}
    76→
    77→/**
    78→ * Fetch all shot video counts + structure video presence for a project
    79→ */
    80→async function fetchProjectShotDataFromDB(projectId: string): Promise<Map<string, ShotCounts>> {
    81→  // Parallel fetch: shot statistics (from view) + structure video presence (from shots table)
    82→  const [statsResult, shotsResult] = await Promise.all([
    83→    supabase
    84→      .from('shot_statistics')
    85→      .select('shot_id, video_count, final_video_count')
    86→      .eq('project_id', projectId),
    87→    supabase
    88→      .from('shots')
    89→      .select('id, settings')
    90→      .eq('project_id', projectId),
    91→  ]);
    92→
    93→  if (statsResult.error) {
    94→    console.error('[ProjectVideoCountsCache] Error fetching shot statistics:', statsResult.error);
    95→    throw statsResult.error;
    96→  }
    97→
    98→  // Build structure video presence set
    99→  const structureVideoShots = new Set<string>();
   100→  if (!shotsResult.error && shotsResult.data) {
   101→    for (const shot of shotsResult.data) {
   102→      if (shotSettingsHaveStructureVideo(shot.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null)) {
   103→        structureVideoShots.add(shot.id);
   104→      }
   105→    }
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  const counts = new Map<string, ShotCounts>();
   109→  statsResult.data?.forEach(row => {
   110→    counts.set(row.shot_id, {
   111→      videoCount: row.video_count || 0,
   112→      finalVideoCount: row.final_video_count || 0,
   113→      hasStructureVideo: structureVideoShots.has(row.shot_id),
   114→    });
   115→  });
   116→
   117→  // Include shots that have structure videos but no statistics entry
   118→  for (const shotId of structureVideoShots) {
   119→    if (!counts.has(shotId)) {
   120→      counts.set(shotId, {
   121→        videoCount: 0,
   122→        finalVideoCount: 0,
   123→        hasStructureVideo: true,
   124→      });
   125→    }
   126→  }
   127→
   128→  return counts;
   129→}
```

```typescript
import { renderHook, act, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';

}
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * useVariantBadges Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Lazy-loads variant badge data (derivedCount, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCount)
     5→ * for a set of generation IDs. This allows galleries to show images immediately while
     6→ * badge data loads in the background.
     7→ *
     8→ * Also provides optimistic update support - when a variant is viewed, the badge
     9→ * is immediately hidden without waiting for a refetch.
    10→ *
    11→ * Usage:
    12→ *   const { getBadgeData, markGenerationViewed } = useVariantBadges(generationIds);
    13→ *   const badge = getBadgeData(generationId); // { derivedCount, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCount }
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    17→import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
    18→import { calculateDerivedCounts, DerivedCountsResult } from '@/shared/lib/generationTransformers';
    19→
    20→interface VariantBadgeData {
    21→  derivedCount: number;
    22→  hasUnviewedVariants: boolean;
    23→  unviewedVariantCount: number;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface UseVariantBadgesResult {
    27→  /** Get badge data for a specific generation */
    28→  getBadgeData: (generationId: string) => VariantBadgeData;
    29→  /** Mark a generation as having been viewed (optimistically removes NEW badge) */
    30→  markGenerationViewed: (generationId: string) => void;
    31→  /** Whether badge data is still loading */
    32→  isLoading: boolean;
    33→}
    34→
    35→/**
    36→ * Hook for lazy-loading variant badge data
    37→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to fetch badge data for
    38→ * @param enabled - Whether to fetch (default true)
    39→ */
    40→export function useVariantBadges(
    41→  generationIds: string[],
    42→  enabled: boolean = true
    43→): UseVariantBadgesResult {
    44→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    45→
    46→  // Track generations that have been optimistically marked as viewed
    47→  // This persists across refetches until the component unmounts
    48→  const [viewedGenerations, setViewedGenerations] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    49→
    50→  // Stable query key based on sorted IDs
    51→  const queryKey = useMemo(() => {
    52→    const sortedIds = [...generationIds].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    53→    return ['variant-badges', sortedIds.join(',')];
    54→  }, [generationIds]);
    55→
    56→  const { data, isLoading, isFetching } = useQuery({
    57→    queryKey,
    58→    queryFn: async (): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> => {
    59→      if (generationIds.length === 0) {
    60→        return { derivedCounts: {}, hasUnviewedVariants: {}, unviewedVariantCounts: {} };
    61→      }
    62→      return calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
    63→    },
    64→    enabled: enabled && generationIds.length > 0,
    65→    staleTime: 30000, // Cache for 30 seconds
    66→    gcTime: 60000, // Keep in cache for 1 minute
    67→  });
    68→
    69→  // Consider loading if: query is loading, query is fetching, or data hasn't loaded yet
    70→  const isEffectivelyLoading = isLoading || isFetching || !data;
    71→
    72→  const getBadgeData = useCallback((generationId: string): VariantBadgeData => {
    73→    const derivedCount = data?.derivedCounts[generationId] || 0;
    74→
    75→    // If this generation was optimistically marked as viewed, don't show NEW
    76→    const wasViewedOptimistically = viewedGenerations.has(generationId);
    77→    const hasUnviewedVariants = wasViewedOptimistically
    78→      ? false
    79→      : (data?.hasUnviewedVariants[generationId] || false);
    80→    const unviewedVariantCount = wasViewedOptimistically
    81→      ? 0
    82→      : (data?.unviewedVariantCounts[generationId] || 0);
    83→
    84→    return {
    85→      derivedCount,
    86→      hasUnviewedVariants,
    87→      unviewedVariantCount,
    88→    };
    89→  }, [data, viewedGenerations]);
    90→
    91→  const markGenerationViewed = useCallback((generationId: string) => {
    92→    // Optimistically mark as viewed
    93→    setViewedGenerations(prev => new Set([...prev, generationId]));
    94→
    95→    // Also update the query cache directly for immediate effect across components
    96→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, (oldData: DerivedCountsResult | undefined) => {
    97→      if (!oldData) return oldData;
    98→      return {
    99→        ...oldData,
   100→        hasUnviewedVariants: {
   101→          ...oldData.hasUnviewedVariants,
   102→          [generationId]: false,
   103→        },
   104→        unviewedVariantCounts: {
   105→          ...oldData.unviewedVariantCounts,
   106→          [generationId]: 0,
   107→        },
   108→      };
   109→    });
   110→  }, [queryClient, queryKey]);
   111→
   112→  return {
   113→    getBadgeData,
   114→    markGenerationViewed,
   115→    isLoading: isEffectivelyLoading,
   116→  };
   117→}
   118→
```

```
     5→/**

     8→ * - undefined: base key (useListShots default)
     9→ * - 0: unlimited images (ShotsContext)
    10→ * - 2: sidebar preview
    11→ * - 5: compact view
    12→ *
    13→ * @internal Used only within cacheUtils.ts
    14→ */
    15→const SHOTS_CACHE_VARIANTS = [undefined, 0, 2, 5] as const;
    16→
    17→/**
    18→ * Get all cache key variants for a project's shots.
    19→ * Use this to ensure all cache entries are updated consistently.
    20→ *
    21→ * @internal Used only within cacheUtils.ts
    22→ */
    23→function getShotsCacheKeys(projectId: string): readonly (string | number | undefined)[][] {
    24→  return SHOTS_CACHE_VARIANTS.map(variant =>
    25→    variant === undefined
    26→      ? [...queryKeys.shots.all, projectId] as const
    27→      : queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, variant)
    28→  );
    29→}
    30→
    31→/**
    32→ * Update all shots cache variants for a project.
    33→ * Ensures consistent state across all cache entries.
    34→ *
    35→ * @param onlyExisting - If true, only update caches that already exist.
    36→ *                       If false (default), will create cache entries if needed.
    37→ */
    38→export function updateAllShotsCaches(
    39→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    40→  projectId: string,
    41→  updater: (old: Shot[] | undefined) => Shot[],
    42→  onlyExisting: boolean = false
    43→): void {
    44→  getShotsCacheKeys(projectId).forEach(key => {
    45→    if (onlyExisting) {
    46→      const existing = queryClient.getQueryData<Shot[]>(key);
    47→      if (existing !== undefined) {
    48→        queryClient.setQueryData(key, updater(existing));
    49→      }
    50→    } else {
    51→      // Pass updater function directly - React Query will call it with undefined if no cache
    52→      queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>(key, (old) => updater(old));
    53→    }
    54→  });
    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Rollback all shots cache variants to a previous state.
    59→ * Used in onError handlers for optimistic updates.
    60→ */
    61→export function rollbackShotsCaches(
    62→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    63→  projectId: string,
    64→  previous: Shot[] | undefined
    65→): void {
    66→  if (!previous) return;
    67→  getShotsCacheKeys(projectId).forEach(key => {
    68→    queryClient.setQueryData(key, previous);
    69→  });
    70→}
    71→
    72→/**
    73→ * Cancel all in-flight shots queries for a project.
    74→ * Call this at the start of onMutate for optimistic updates.
    75→ */
    76→export async function cancelShotsQueries(
    77→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    78→  projectId: string
    79→): Promise<void> {
    80→  await Promise.all(
    81→    getShotsCacheKeys(projectId).map(key =>
    82→      queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: key })
    83→    )
    84→  );
    85→}
    86→
    87→/**
    88→ * Find the first non-empty shots cache for a project.
    89→ * Searches through all cache variants and returns the first one with data.
    90→ */
    91→export function findShotsCache(
    92→  queryClient: QueryClient,

    94→): Shot[] | undefined {
```

```
     5→interface UseVideoFrameExtractionOptions {
     6→  /** Video metadata (required for extraction) */

    31→/**
    32→ * Hook that extracts frames from a video URL as thumbnail images.
    33→ *
    34→ * Creates its own internal video element for extraction, separate from
    35→ * any video elements used for playback/preview.
    36→ *
    37→ * @example
    38→ * const { frames, isExtracting, isReady } = useVideoFrameExtraction(videoUrl, {
    39→ *   metadata: effectiveMetadata,
    40→ *   treatment: 'adjust',
    41→ *   sourceRange: { start: 0, end: 100 },
    42→ *   outputFrameCount: 90,
    43→ *   skip: isDragging,

    45→ */
    46→export function useVideoFrameExtraction(
    47→  videoUrl: string,
    48→  options: UseVideoFrameExtractionOptions
    49→): UseVideoFrameExtractionReturn {
    50→  const {
    51→    metadata,
    52→    treatment,
    53→    sourceRange,
    54→    outputFrameCount,
    55→    maxFrames = 80,
    56→    skip = false,
    57→    quality = 0.6,
    58→  } = options;
    59→
    60→  const [frames, setFrames] = useState<string[]>([]);
    61→  const [isExtracting, setIsExtracting] = useState(false);
    62→  const [isReady, setIsReady] = useState(false);
    63→
    64→  const sourceFrameCount = Math.max(0, sourceRange.end - sourceRange.start);
    65→
    66→  useEffect(() => {
    67→    // Skip if disabled or no metadata
    68→    if (skip) return;
    69→    if (!metadata) return;
    70→
    71→    // Cancellation flag — set by cleanup when deps change or unmount.
    72→    // The async extraction checks this after every await to bail out early,
    73→    // preventing stale extractions from fighting over the video element.
    74→    let cancelled = false;

    77→    // extractions (from rapid dep changes) don't clobber each other's seeks.
    78→    const video = document.createElement('video');
    79→    video.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    80→    video.muted = true;
    81→    video.playsInline = true;
    82→    video.preload = 'auto';

    90→      if (video.readyState < 2) {
    91→        await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    92→          const handleCanPlay = () => {
    93→            video.removeEventListener('canplay', handleCanPlay);
    94→            resolve();
    95→          };
    96→          video.addEventListener('canplay', handleCanPlay);
    97→          setTimeout(() => {
    98→            video.removeEventListener('canplay', handleCanPlay);
    99→            resolve();
   100→          }, 3000);
   101→        });
   102→        if (cancelled) return;
   103→      }
   104→
   105→      // Validate video actually loaded (has dimensions)
   106→      if (video.videoWidth === 0 || video.videoHeight === 0) {
   107→        console.error('[useVideoFrameExtraction] Video did not load properly - dimensions are 0');
   108→        if (!cancelled) setIsExtracting(false);
   109→        return;
   110→      }
   111→
   112→      try {
   113→        // Calculate number of frames to extract
   114→        const numThumbnails = treatment === 'adjust'

   124→        }

   137→          if (!cancelled) setIsExtracting(false);

   139→        }

   142→
   143→        const extractedFrames: string[] = [];
   144→        const FLUSH_INTERVAL = 8;
   145→
   146→        // Extract frames
   147→        for (let i = 0; i < numFrames; i++) {
   148→          if (cancelled) return;
   149→
   150→          let frameIndex: number;
   151→
   152→          if (numFrames === 1) {
   153→            frameIndex = sourceRange.start;
   154→          } else if (treatment === 'adjust') {
   155→            // Sample evenly across source range
   156→            frameIndex = sourceRange.start + Math.floor((i / (numFrames - 1)) * (sourceFrameCount - 1));
   157→          } else {
   158→            // Clip mode: 1:1 mapping
   159→            const sourcePosition = (i / (numFrames - 1)) * (sourceFrameCount - 1);
   160→            frameIndex = sourceRange.start + Math.floor(sourcePosition);
   161→          }
   162→
   163→          // Clamp to valid range
   164→          frameIndex = Math.max(sourceRange.start, Math.min(frameIndex, sourceRange.end - 1));
   165→
   166→          if (!isFinite(frameIndex) || frameIndex < 0) {
   167→            console.error('[useVideoFrameExtraction] Invalid frameIndex:', frameIndex);
   168→            throw new Error(`Invalid frame index: ${frameIndex}`);
   169→          }
   170→
   171→          const timeInSeconds = frameIndex / metadata.frame_rate;
   172→          if (!isFinite(timeInSeconds) || timeInSeconds < 0) {
   173→            throw new Error(`Invalid time value: ${timeInSeconds}`);
   174→          }
   175→
   176→          // Seek to frame
   177→          video.currentTime = timeInSeconds;
   178→
   179→          // Wait for seek
   180→          await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   181→            const handleSeeked = () => {
   182→              video.removeEventListener('seeked', handleSeeked);
   183→              resolve();
   184→            };
   185→            video.addEventListener('seeked', handleSeeked);
   186→            setTimeout(() => {
   187→              video.removeEventListener('seeked', handleSeeked);
   188→              resolve();
   189→            }, 1000);
   190→          });
   191→
   192→          if (cancelled) return;
   193→
   194→          // Draw and capture frame
   195→          ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0);
   196→          const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
   197→          extractedFrames.push(dataUrl);
   198→
   199→          // Log first frame details to verify data URL validity
   200→
   201→          // Flush frames progressively: after first frame, then every FLUSH_INTERVAL
   202→          if (i === 0 || (i + 1) % FLUSH_INTERVAL === 0) {
   203→            setFrames([...extractedFrames]);
   204→            setIsReady(true);
   205→          }
   206→        }
   207→
   208→        // Final flush with all frames
   209→        if (!cancelled && extractedFrames.length > 0) {
   210→          setFrames(extractedFrames);
   211→          setIsReady(true);
   212→        }
   213→        if (!cancelled) setIsExtracting(false);
   214→      } catch (error) {
   215→        handleError(error, { context: 'useVideoFrameExtraction', showToast: false });
   216→        if (!cancelled) setIsExtracting(false);
   217→      }
   218→    };
   219→
   220→    if (video.readyState >= 2) {
   221→      extractFrames();
   222→    } else {
   223→      const handleLoadedMetadata = () => {
   224→        video.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', handleLoadedMetadata);
   225→        if (!cancelled) extractFrames();
   226→      };
   227→
   228→      const handleVideoError = (_e: Event) => {
   229→        handleError(new Error('Video load error'), { context: 'useVideoFrameExtraction:videoLoad', showToast: false });
   230→        if (!cancelled) {
   231→          setIsReady(false);
   232→          setIsExtracting(false);
   233→        }
   234→      };
   235→
   236→      video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', handleLoadedMetadata);
   237→      video.addEventListener('error', handleVideoError);
   238→    }
   239→
   240→    return () => {
   241→      cancelled = true;
   242→      // Stop the video element to free resources
   243→      video.src = '';
   244→    };
   245→  }, [videoUrl, metadata, treatment, sourceRange.start, sourceRange.end, outputFrameCount, sourceFrameCount, maxFrames, skip, quality]);
   246→
   247→  return { frames, isExtracting, isReady };
   248→}
   249→
```
