    15→import { getGenerationId } from '@/shared/lib/mediaTypeHelpers';
    16→
    17→// Slot type - either a real child or a placeholder for a processing segment
    18→export type SegmentSlot =
    19→  | { type: 'child'; child: GenerationRow; index: number; pairShotGenerationId?: string }
    20→  | { type: 'placeholder'; index: number; expectedFrames?: number; expectedPrompt?: string; startImage?: string; endImage?: string; pairShotGenerationId?: string };
    21→
    22→export interface ExpectedSegmentData {
    23→  count: number;
    24→  frames: number[];
    25→  prompts: string[];
    26→  inputImages: string[];
    27→  inputImageGenIds: string[];
    28→  pairShotGenIds: string[];
    29→}
    30→
    31→export interface UseSegmentOutputsReturn {
    32→  // Multiple parent generations (different "runs")
    33→  parentGenerations: GenerationRow[];
    34→  selectedParentId: string | null;
    35→  setSelectedParentId: (id: string | null) => void;
    36→
    37→  // Currently selected parent's data
    38→  selectedParent: GenerationRow | null;
    39→  hasFinalOutput: boolean; // parent.location exists
    40→
    41→  // Segment slots for current parent
    42→  segmentSlots: SegmentSlot[];
    43→  segments: GenerationRow[]; // Actual segment children (not placeholders)
    44→  segmentProgress: { completed: number; total: number };
    45→  expectedSegmentData: ExpectedSegmentData | null;
    46→
    47→  // Loading states
    48→  isLoading: boolean;
    49→  isRefetching: boolean;
    50→
    51→  // Actions
    52→  refetch: () => void;
    53→}
    54→
    55→/**
    56→ * Extract expected segment data from parent's orchestrator_details
    57→ */
    58→function extractExpectedSegmentData(parentParams: Record<string, unknown> | null): ExpectedSegmentData | null {
    59→  if (!parentParams) return null;
    60→
    61→  const orchestratorDetails = parentParams.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    62→  if (!orchestratorDetails) return null;
    63→
    64→  const segmentCount = (orchestratorDetails.num_new_segments_to_generate as number)
    65→    || (orchestratorDetails.segment_frames_expanded as unknown[] | undefined)?.length
    66→    || 0;
    67→
    68→  if (segmentCount === 0) return null;
    69→
    70→  return {
    71→    count: segmentCount,
    72→    frames: (orchestratorDetails.segment_frames_expanded as number[]) || [],
    73→    prompts: (orchestratorDetails.enhanced_prompts_expanded as string[]) || (orchestratorDetails.base_prompts_expanded as string[]) || [],
    74→    inputImages: (orchestratorDetails.input_image_paths_resolved as string[]) || [],
    75→    // Include IDs for tethering videos to shot_generations
    76→    inputImageGenIds: (orchestratorDetails.input_image_generation_ids as string[]) || [],
    77→    pairShotGenIds: (orchestratorDetails.pair_shot_generation_ids as string[]) || [],
    78→  };
    79→}
    80→
    81→/**
    82→ * Extract pair identifiers from a generation (checks column first, then params)
    83→ * @param generation - The generation row (may have pair_shot_generation_id column)
    84→ * @param params - The params JSONB (legacy storage location)
    85→ */
    86→function getPairIdentifiers(
    87→  generation: { pair_shot_generation_id?: string | null } | null,
    88→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null
    89→): { pairShotGenId?: string; startGenId?: string } {
    90→  // Check the FK column first (new format with referential integrity)
    91→  const columnValue = generation?.pair_shot_generation_id;
    92→  if (columnValue) {
    93→    const individualParams = params?.individual_segment_params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    94→    return {
    95→      pairShotGenId: columnValue,
    96→      startGenId: (individualParams?.start_image_generation_id || params?.start_image_generation_id) as string | undefined,
    97→    };
    98→  }
    99→
   100→  // Fallback to params JSONB (legacy format)
   101→  if (!params) return {};
   102→  const individualParams = (params.individual_segment_params || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   103→  return {
   104→    pairShotGenId: (individualParams.pair_shot_generation_id || params.pair_shot_generation_id) as string | undefined,
   105→    startGenId: (individualParams.start_image_generation_id || params.start_image_generation_id) as string | undefined,
   106→  };
   107→}
   108→
   109→/**
   110→ * Check if a generation is a travel segment (has segment_index in params)
   111→ * vs a join output (no segment_index)
   112→ */
   113→function isSegment(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): boolean {
   114→  return typeof params?.segment_index === 'number';
   115→}
   116→
   117→/**
   118→ * Transform raw generation data to GenerationRow format
   119→ */
   120→interface RawGenerationDbRow {
   121→  id: string;
   122→  location?: string | null;
   123→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   124→  type?: string | null;
   125→  created_at?: string;
   126→  updated_at?: string | null;
   127→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   128→  parent_generation_id?: string | null;
   129→  child_order?: number | null;
   130→  starred?: boolean;
   131→  pair_shot_generation_id?: string | null;
   132→  primary_variant_id?: string | null;
   133→}
   134→
   135→function transformToGenerationRow(gen: RawGenerationDbRow): GenerationRow {
   136→  return {
   137→    id: gen.id,
   138→    location: gen.location || '',
   139→    imageUrl: gen.location || '',
   140→    thumbUrl: gen.thumbnail_url || gen.location || '',
   141→    type: gen.type || 'video',
   142→    created_at: gen.updated_at || gen.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
   143→    createdAt: gen.updated_at || gen.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
   144→    params: gen.params as GenerationRow['params'],
   145→    parent_generation_id: gen.parent_generation_id,
   146→    child_order: gen.child_order,
   147→    starred: gen.starred,
   148→    // Include pair_shot_generation_id column (for FK-based slot matching)
   149→    pair_shot_generation_id: gen.pair_shot_generation_id,
   150→  };
   151→}
   152→
   153→export function useSegmentOutputsForShot(
   154→  shotId: string | null,
   155→  projectId: string | null,
   156→  /** Local shot_generation positions for instant updates during drag */
   157→  localShotGenPositions?: Map<string, number>,
   158→  /** Optional controlled selected parent ID (lifted state from parent) */
   159→  controlledSelectedParentId?: string | null,
   160→  /** Optional callback when selected parent changes (for controlled mode) */
   161→  onSelectedParentChange?: (id: string | null) => void,
   162→  /** Optional preloaded generations for readOnly mode (bypasses database queries) */
   163→  preloadedGenerations?: GenerationRow[],
   164→  /** Optional trailing segment shot_generation_id (allows videos at end position to show) */
   165→  trailingShotGenId?: string
   166→): UseSegmentOutputsReturn {
   167→  // [TrailingDebug] Log when trailingShotGenId is passed
   168→
   169→  // Debug: Log when local positions are passed
   170→
   171→  // Track selected parent generation - use controlled value if provided, otherwise internal state
   172→  const [internalSelectedParentId, setInternalSelectedParentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
   173→
   174→  // Determine if we're in controlled mode
   175→  const isControlled = controlledSelectedParentId !== undefined;
   176→  const selectedParentId = isControlled ? controlledSelectedParentId : internalSelectedParentId;
   177→  const setSelectedParentId = useCallback((id: string | null) => {
   178→    if (isControlled && onSelectedParentChange) {
   179→      onSelectedParentChange(id);
   180→    } else {
   181→      setInternalSelectedParentId(id);
   182→    }
   183→  }, [isControlled, onSelectedParentChange]);
   184→
   185→  // Derive parent generations from preloaded data if available
   186→  // Parent generations are videos that:
   187→  // 1. type = 'video'
   188→  // 2. parent_generation_id IS NULL (not a child itself)
   189→  // 3. Has orchestrator_details OR has children pointing to it
   190→  const preloadedParentGenerations = useMemo(() => {
   191→    if (!preloadedGenerations) return undefined;
   192→
   193→    // First, find all generation IDs that are referenced as parents
   194→    const parentIds = new Set<string>();
   195→    preloadedGenerations.forEach(gen => {
   196→      const parentId = gen.parent_generation_id;
   197→      if (parentId) parentIds.add(parentId);
   198→    });
   199→
   200→    const parents = preloadedGenerations.filter(gen => {
   201→      const isVideo = gen.type?.includes('video');
   202→      // Check if this is NOT a child (no parent_generation_id)
   203→      const isNotChild = !gen.parent_generation_id;
   204→      // Has orchestrator_details OR is referenced as a parent by other generations
   205→      const hasOrchestratorDetails = !!(gen.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.orchestrator_details;
   206→      // Use generation_id for parent lookup (shot_generations.generation_id -> generations.id)
   207→      const genId = getGenerationId(gen);
   208→      const hasChildren = parentIds.has(genId);
   209→
   210→      return isVideo && isNotChild && (hasOrchestratorDetails || hasChildren);
   211→    });
   212→
   213→    // Sort by created_at descending (most recent first) to match actual page behavior
   214→    // This ensures auto-select picks the most recent parent
   215→    parents.sort((a, b) => {
   216→      const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || a.createdAt || 0).getTime();
   217→      const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || b.createdAt || 0).getTime();
   218→      return dateB - dateA; // Descending - most recent first
   219→    });
   220→
   221→    return parents;
   222→  }, [preloadedGenerations]);
   223→
   224→  // Fetch parent generations using the shot_final_videos view (single query, all filtering server-side)
   225→  // Skip query when preloaded data is available
   226→  const {
   227→    data: parentGenerationsData,
   228→    isLoading: isLoadingParents,
   229→    isFetching: isFetchingParents,
   230→    refetch: refetchParents,
   231→  } = useQuery({
   232→    [REDACTED](shotId!, projectId),
   233→    queryFn: async () => {
   234→      if (!shotId || !projectId) return [];
   235→
   236→      // Single query using the shot_final_videos view
   237→      // This replaces 3 queries + client-side filtering with 1 indexed query
   238→      const { data, error } = await supabase
   239→        .from('shot_final_videos')
   240→        .select('*')
   241→        .eq('shot_id', shotId)
   242→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
   243→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
   244→
   245→      if (error) {
   246→        console.error('[useSegmentOutputsForShot] Error fetching parent generations:', error);
   247→        throw error;
   248→      }
   249→
   250→      return (data || []).map(transformToGenerationRow);
   251→    },
   252→    enabled: !!shotId && !!projectId && !preloadedGenerations,
   253→    staleTime: 30000, // 30 seconds
   254→  });
   255→
   256→  // Use preloaded data if available, otherwise use query data
   257→  const parentGenerations = (preloadedParentGenerations ?? parentGenerationsData) || [];
   258→
   259→  // Auto-select the first (most recent) parent if none selected
   260→  // IMPORTANT: Only auto-select when:
   261→  // 1. The query is enabled (shotId exists) - prevents controlled components with disabled queries from clearing selection
   262→  // 2. NOT in controlled mode - parent component manages selection
   263→  // 3. There are parent generations to select from
   264→  useEffect(() => {
   265→    // Don't auto-select if query is disabled (we're just using controlled state passthrough)
   266→    if (!shotId) return;
   267→
   268→    // Don't auto-select if in controlled mode - parent component manages selection
   269→    if (isControlled) return;
   270→
   271→    if (parentGenerations.length > 0 && !selectedParentId) {
   272→      setSelectedParentId(parentGenerations[0].id);
   273→    } else if (parentGenerations.length > 0 && selectedParentId) {
   274→      // Validate that current selection exists in the list
   275→      const selectionExists = parentGenerations.some(p => p.id === selectedParentId);
   276→      if (!selectionExists) {
   277→        setSelectedParentId(parentGenerations[0].id);
   278→      }
   279→    }
   280→    // Note: We don't set to null when parentGenerations is empty - keep last selection
   281→  }, [parentGenerations, selectedParentId, shotId, isControlled, setSelectedParentId]);
   282→
   283→  // Get the selected parent
   284→  const selectedParent = useMemo(() => {
   285→    if (!selectedParentId) return null;
   286→    return parentGenerations.find(p => p.id === selectedParentId) || null;
   287→  }, [parentGenerations, selectedParentId]);
   288→
   289→  // Derive children from preloaded data if available
   290→  // Children are generations with parent_generation_id pointing to the selected parent
   291→  const preloadedChildren = useMemo(() => {
   292→    if (!preloadedGenerations || !selectedParentId) return undefined;
   293→
   294→    // The selected parent might be a shot_generations.id or a generations.id
   295→    // We need to find the generation_id for the selected parent
   296→    const selectedParent = parentGenerations.find(p => p.id === selectedParentId || p.generation_id === selectedParentId);
   297→    const parentGenId = selectedParent?.generation_id || selectedParentId;
   298→
   299→    const children = preloadedGenerations.filter(gen => {
   300→      // Check if this generation's parent_generation_id matches the selected parent
   301→      const parentId = gen.parent_generation_id;
   302→      return parentId === parentGenId || parentId === selectedParentId;
   303→    });
   304→
   305→    return children;
   306→  }, [preloadedGenerations, selectedParentId, parentGenerations]);
   307→
   308→  // Smart polling for segment children - allows new segments to appear after task completion
   309→  const [REDACTED](selectedParentId!);
   310→  const childrenPollingConfig = useSmartPollingConfig(childrenQueryKey);
   311→
   312→  // Fetch children for selected parent - skip if preloaded data available
   313→  const {
   314→    data: childGenerationsData,
   315→    isLoading: isLoadingChildren,
   316→    isFetching: isFetchingChildren,
   317→    refetch: refetchChildren,
   318→  } = useQuery({
   319→    [REDACTED],
   320→    queryFn: async () => {
   321→      if (!selectedParentId) return [];
   322→
   323→      // [TrailingDebug] Also check if there are ANY videos with matching pair_shot_generation_id
   324→      // This helps diagnose if videos exist but under a different parent
   325→      const { data, error } = await supabase
   326→        .from('generations')
   327→        .select('*')
   328→        .eq('parent_generation_id', selectedParentId)
   329→        .order('child_order', { ascending: true })
   330→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
   331→
   332→      if (error) {
   333→        console.error('[useSegmentOutputsForShot] Error fetching children:', error);
   334→        throw error;
   335→      }
   336→
   337→      return (data || []).map(transformToGenerationRow);
   338→    },
   339→    enabled: !!selectedParentId && !preloadedGenerations,
   340→    // Smart polling config - polls when realtime is unhealthy, otherwise relies on invalidation
   341→    ...childrenPollingConfig,
   342→    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
   343→  });
   344→
   345→  // Use preloaded children if available
   346→  const childGenerations = (preloadedChildren ?? childGenerationsData) || [];
   347→
   348→  // Filter to only segments (not join outputs)
   349→  const segments = useMemo(() => {
   350→    const filtered = childGenerations.filter(child => isSegment(child.params as Record<string, unknown> | null));
   351→
   352→    return filtered;
   353→  }, [childGenerations, trailingShotGenId]);
   354→
   355→  // Derive timeline data from preloaded generations if available
   356→  const preloadedTimelineData = useMemo(() => {
   357→    if (!preloadedGenerations) return undefined;
   358→    // Filter to positioned items and map to timeline format
   359→    return preloadedGenerations
   360→      .filter(gen => gen.timeline_frame !== null && gen.timeline_frame !== undefined && gen.timeline_frame >= 0)
   361→      .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0))
   362→      .map(gen => ({
   363→        id: gen.id,  // shot_generations.id
   364→        generation_id: gen.generation_id,
   365→        timeline_frame: gen.timeline_frame,
   366→      }));
   367→  }, [preloadedGenerations]);
   368→
   369→  // Fetch LIVE shot_generations to get current timeline order
   370→  // This is the source of truth for video positioning - videos move with their images
   371→  // Skip if preloaded data available
   372→  const {
   373→    data: liveTimelineData,
   374→    refetch: refetchTimeline,
   375→  } = useQuery({
   376→    [REDACTED](shotId!),
   377→    queryFn: async () => {
   378→      if (!shotId) return [];
   379→
   380→      const { data, error } = await supabase
   381→        .from('shot_generations')
   382→        .select('id, generation_id, timeline_frame')
   383→        .eq('shot_id', shotId)
   384→        .gte('timeline_frame', 0) // Only positioned images
   385→        .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
   386→
   387→      if (error) {
   388→        console.error('[PairSlot] Error fetching live timeline:', error);
   389→        throw error;
   390→      }
   391→
   392→      return data || [];
   393→    },
   394→    enabled: !!shotId && !preloadedGenerations,
   395→    staleTime: 10000, // Refresh more frequently to catch timeline changes
   396→  });
   397→
   398→  // Use preloaded timeline if available
   399→  const effectiveTimelineData = preloadedTimelineData ?? liveTimelineData;
   400→
   401→  // Build map of shot_generation.id → current position (live, not snapshot)
   402→  const liveShotGenIdToPosition = useMemo(() => {
   403→    const map = new Map<string, number>();
   404→    (effectiveTimelineData || []).forEach((sg, index) => {
   405→      map.set(sg.id, index);
   406→    });
   407→
   408→    // Log the live timeline state
   409→
   410→    return map;
   411→  }, [effectiveTimelineData]);
   412→
   413→  // Extract expected segment data from selected parent
   414→  const expectedSegmentData = useMemo(() => {
   415→    if (!selectedParent) return null;
   416→    return extractExpectedSegmentData(selectedParent.params as Record<string, unknown> | null);
   417→  }, [selectedParent]);
   418→
   419→  // Build segment slots
   420→  // Uses LOCAL positions (instant during drag) or LIVE timeline (from DB) for slot assignment
   421→  const segmentSlots = useMemo((): SegmentSlot[] => {
   422→    // Prefer local positions (instant updates) over live DB query
   423→    const useLocalPositions = localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0;
   424→    const positionMap = useLocalPositions ? localShotGenPositions : liveShotGenIdToPosition;
   425→    const baseSlotCount = useLocalPositions
   426→      ? localShotGenPositions.size - 1  // N images = N-1 pairs
   427→      : (effectiveTimelineData?.length ? effectiveTimelineData.length - 1 : 0);
   428→    // Add extra slot for trailing segment if provided
   429→    const slotCount = trailingShotGenId ? baseSlotCount + 1 : baseSlotCount;
   430→
   431→    // Use slotCount (current timeline) for positioning, not expectedCount (original generation)
   432→    if (slotCount === 0) {
   433→      // No position data, just show what we have
   434→      return segments.map((child, index) => ({
   435→        type: 'child' as const,
   436→        child,
   437→        index: child.child_order ?? index,
   438→      }));
   439→    }
   440→
   441→    // Create slots for all expected segments
   442→    const slots: SegmentSlot[] = [];
   443→    const childrenBySlot = new Map<number, GenerationRow>();
   444→    const usedSlots = new Set<number>();
   445→    const childrenWithoutValidSlot: GenerationRow[] = [];
   446→
   447→    // Priority chain for slot mapping:
   448→    // 1. pair_shot_generation_id → position (LOCAL for instant, LIVE as fallback)
   449→    // 2. child_order (fallback ONLY for videos without pair_shot_generation_id)
   450→    segments.forEach(child => {
   451→      const { pairShotGenId } = getPairIdentifiers(child, child.params as Record<string, unknown> | null);
   452→      const childOrder = child.child_order;
   453→
   454→      let derivedSlot: number | undefined;
   455→      let slotSource = 'NONE';
   456→      let pairShotGenPosition: number | undefined;
   457→
   458→      // Priority 1: pair_shot_generation_id → look up position (instant from local, or from DB)
   459→      // Videos should move with their images
   460→      if (pairShotGenId && positionMap.has(pairShotGenId)) {
   461→        pairShotGenPosition = positionMap.get(pairShotGenId)!;
   462→        // Only validate against slot count (current timeline)
   463→        // Position N means "start of pair N", but pair N only exists if there's an image at N+1
   464→        // EXCEPTION: If this is a trailing segment (pairShotGenId matches trailingShotGenId),
   465→        // allow it even at the end position
   466→        const isTrailingSegment = trailingShotGenId && pairShotGenId === trailingShotGenId;
   467→
   468→        // [TrailingDebug] Detailed logging for trailing segment matching
   469→
   470→        if (pairShotGenPosition < slotCount || isTrailingSegment) {
   471→          derivedSlot = pairShotGenPosition;
   472→          slotSource = isTrailingSegment ? 'TRAILING_SEGMENT' : (useLocalPositions ? 'LOCAL_POSITION' : 'PAIR_SHOT_GEN_ID_LIVE');
   473→        } else {
   474→          // Image is at last position - no valid pair starts there
   475→          slotSource = 'PAIR_AT_END_NO_SLOT';
   476→        }
   477→      } else if (pairShotGenId && !positionMap.has(pairShotGenId)) {
   478→        // [TrailingDebug] Log when pairShotGenId is not found in position map
   479→      }
   480→
   481→      // Priority 2: child_order fallback
   482→      // Fall back to child_order when:
   483→      // - No pairShotGenId at all, OR
   484→      // - pairShotGenId is stale (not in position map) — e.g. after image duplication
   485→      //   creates new shot_generation IDs but segments still reference the originals
   486→      // Do NOT fall back if pairShotGenId was found but at an invalid position (end)
   487→      const pairShotGenIdIsStale = !!pairShotGenId && !positionMap.has(pairShotGenId);
   488→      if (derivedSlot === undefined && (!pairShotGenId || pairShotGenIdIsStale) &&
   489→          typeof childOrder === 'number' && childOrder >= 0 && childOrder < slotCount) {
   490→        derivedSlot = childOrder;
   491→        slotSource = pairShotGenIdIsStale ? 'CHILD_ORDER_STALE_FK' : 'CHILD_ORDER';
   492→      }
   493→
   494→      // Skip videos whose pair_shot_gen is at an invalid position (e.g., last image)
   495→      // These videos can't be shown because their start image has no following image
   496→      if (slotSource === 'PAIR_AT_END_NO_SLOT') {
   497→        return; // Skip this video entirely
   498→      }
   499→
   500→      // Check if slot is valid and not already used
   501→      if (derivedSlot !== undefined && !usedSlots.has(derivedSlot)) {
   502→        childrenBySlot.set(derivedSlot, child);
   503→        usedSlots.add(derivedSlot);
   504→      } else if (derivedSlot !== undefined && usedSlots.has(derivedSlot)) {
   505→        // Slot collision! Another segment wants the same slot
   506→        childrenWithoutValidSlot.push(child);
   507→      } else {
   508→        childrenWithoutValidSlot.push(child);
   509→      }
   510→    });
   511→
   512→    // DON'T assign orphans to available slots - this was causing deleted segments
   513→    // to be replaced by other segments. Orphan segments (without valid pair_shot_generation_id)
   514→    // should NOT be displayed. They'll remain hidden until regenerated for the correct slot.
   515→
   516→    // Fill in slots using LIVE timeline data for placeholders
   517→    for (let i = 0; i < slotCount; i++) {
   518→      const child = childrenBySlot.get(i);
   519→      // Use live timeline for pair_shot_generation_id (shot_generations.id of start image)
   520→      const liveStartImage = effectiveTimelineData?.[i];
   521→      const liveEndImage = effectiveTimelineData?.[i + 1];
   522→      // Get pair_shot_generation_id: prefer live data, fall back to expected data
   523→      const pairShotGenerationId = liveStartImage?.id || expectedSegmentData?.pairShotGenIds?.[i];
   524→
   525→      if (child) {
   526→        slots.push({ type: 'child', child, index: i, pairShotGenerationId });
   527→      } else {
   528→        slots.push({
   529→          type: 'placeholder',
   530→          index: i,
   531→          expectedFrames: expectedSegmentData?.frames[i],
   532→          expectedPrompt: expectedSegmentData?.prompts[i],
   533→          startImage: liveStartImage?.generation_id || expectedSegmentData?.inputImages[i],
   534→          endImage: liveEndImage?.generation_id || expectedSegmentData?.inputImages[i + 1],
   535→          pairShotGenerationId,
   536→        });
   537→      }

    43→export function useSegmentMutations({

1→import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Smart timestamp updater hook that provides live-updating relative timestamps
     5→ * with performance optimizations for galleries and task lists.
     6→ * 
     7→ * Features:
     8→ * - Automatic updates with smart intervals (30s for recent, 60s for older)
     9→ * - Only updates when component is visible (IntersectionObserver)
    10→ * - Batched updates to prevent excessive re-renders
    11→ * - Efficient memory management with cleanup
    12→ */
    13→
    14→interface TimestampUpdateOptions {
    15→  /** Date to track */
    16→  date: Date | string | null;
    17→  /** Update interval in seconds (default: smart intervals based on age) */
    18→  updateInterval?: number;
    19→  /** Whether this timestamp is currently visible (default: true) */
    20→  isVisible?: boolean;
    21→  /** Disable automatic updates (default: false) */
    22→  disabled?: boolean;
    23→}
    24→
    25→// Global timestamp manager to coordinate updates across all components
    26→class TimestampManager {
    27→  private intervals = new Map<number, Set<() => void>>();
    28→  private timers = new Map<number, NodeJS.Timeout>();
    29→  
    30→  // Smart interval selection based on timestamp age
    31→  private getUpdateInterval(date: Date): number {
    32→    const now = Date.now();
    33→    const age = now - date.getTime();
    34→    
    35→    // Less than 5 minutes old: update every 10 seconds (more responsive for fresh content)
    36→    if (age < 5 * 60 * 1000) return 10;
    37→    
    38→    // Less than 1 hour old: update every 60 seconds  
    39→    if (age < 60 * 60 * 1000) return 60;
    40→    
    41→    // Less than 1 day old: update every 5 minutes
    42→    if (age < 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) return 300;
    43→    
    44→    // Older: update every 30 minutes
    45→    return 1800;
    46→  }
    47→  
    48→  subscribe(date: Date, callback: () => void, isVisible: boolean = true): () => void {
    49→    if (!isVisible) {
    50→      // Return no-op unsubscribe for invisible timestamps
    51→      return () => {};
    52→    }
    53→    
    54→    const interval = this.getUpdateInterval(date);
    55→    
    56→    // Get or create interval group
    57→    if (!this.intervals.has(interval)) {
    58→      this.intervals.set(interval, new Set());
    59→    }
    60→    
    61→    const callbacks = this.intervals.get(interval)!;
    62→    callbacks.add(callback);
    63→    
    64→    // Start timer if this is the first callback for this interval
    65→    if (callbacks.size === 1) {
    66→      const timer = setInterval(() => {
    67→        // Batch all callbacks for this interval
    68→        callbacks.forEach(cb => cb());
    69→      }, interval * 1000);
    70→      
    71→      this.timers.set(interval, timer);
    72→    }
    73→    
    74→    // Return unsubscribe function
    75→    return () => {
    76→      callbacks.delete(callback);
    77→      
    78→      // Clean up timer if no more callbacks
    79→      if (callbacks.size === 0) {
    80→        const timer = this.timers.get(interval);
    81→        if (timer) {
    82→          clearInterval(timer);
    83→          this.timers.delete(interval);
    84→        }
    85→        this.intervals.delete(interval);
    86→      }
    87→    };
    88→  }
    89→  
    90→  // Get current update interval for a date (for debugging)
    91→  getIntervalForDate(date: Date): number {
    92→    return this.getUpdateInterval(date);
    93→  }
    94→}
    95→
    96→// Global singleton
    97→const timestampManager = new TimestampManager();
    98→
    99→/**
   100→ * Hook that provides a timestamp that automatically updates at smart intervals
   101→ */
   102→export function useTimestampUpdater({ 
   103→  date, 
   104→  isVisible = true, 
   105→  disabled = false 
   106→}: TimestampUpdateOptions) {
   107→  const [updateTrigger, setUpdateTrigger] = useState(0);
   108→  const dateRef = useRef<Date | null>(null);
   109→  
   110→  // Parse and validate date
   111→  if (date && dateRef.current?.getTime() !== (typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date)?.getTime()) {
   112→    dateRef.current = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date;
   113→  }
   114→  
   115→  useEffect(() => {
   116→    if (!dateRef.current || disabled || !isVisible) {
   117→      return;
   118→    }
   119→    
   120→    // Subscribe to timestamp updates
   121→    const unsubscribe = timestampManager.subscribe(
   122→      dateRef.current,
   123→      () => setUpdateTrigger(prev => prev + 1),
   124→      isVisible
   125→    );
   126→    
   127→    return unsubscribe;
   128→  }, [dateRef.current?.getTime(), isVisible, disabled]);
   129→  
   130→  return {
   131→    /** Current update trigger - changes when timestamp should be recalculated */
   132→    updateTrigger,
   133→    /** The date being tracked */
   134→    date: dateRef.current,
   135→    /** Current update interval for this timestamp (for debugging) */
   136→    currentInterval: dateRef.current ? timestampManager.getIntervalForDate(dateRef.current) : null,
   137→  };
   138→}
   139→
   140→/**
   141→ * Hook for components that need to track visibility for performance
   142→ * Uses IntersectionObserver to detect when timestamps are visible
   143→ */
   144→export function useTimestampVisibility(ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>) {
   145→  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(true); // Default to visible
   146→  
   147→  useEffect(() => {
   148→    const element = ref.current;
   149→    if (!element) {
   150→      // If element not mounted yet, stay visible
   151→      return;
   152→    }
   153→    
   154→    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
   155→      // If IntersectionObserver not supported, always consider visible
   156→      setIsVisible(true);
   157→      return;
   158→    }
   159→    
   160→    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
   161→      ([entry]) => {
   162→        const newVisibility = entry.isIntersecting;
   163→        setIsVisible(newVisibility);
   164→      },
   165→      {
   166→        // Consider visible when 10% is showing
   167→        threshold: 0.1,
   168→        // Add some margin to start updating before fully visible
   169→        rootMargin: '50px'
   170→      }
   171→    );
   172→    
   173→    observer.observe(element);
   174→    
   175→    return () => {
   176→      observer.disconnect();
   177→    };
   178→  }, [ref]);
   179→  
   180→  return isVisible;
   181→}
   182→

   157→    // Default: show shot's images if it has unpositioned ones, otherwise show all
   158→    const defaultFilter = hasUnpositioned ? shotId : SHOT_FILTER.ALL;
   159→
   160→    return {
   161→      filter: defaultFilter,
   162→      isUserOverride: false,
   163→    };
   164→  }, [shotsData]);
   165→
   166→  /**
   167→   * Set the filter state for a shot.
   168→   * If isUserOverride is true, this will persist until explicitly changed again.
   169→   */
   170→  const setFilterStateForShot = useCallback((shotId: string, filter: string, isUserOverride: boolean) => {
   171→    filterStateMapRef.current.set(shotId, { filter, isUserOverride });
   172→
   173→  }, []);
   174→
   175→  // ============================================================================
   176→  // INITIALIZE FILTER STATE FROM PERSISTED SETTINGS
   177→  // When shot settings load, populate the map with user's previous choice.
   178→  // ============================================================================
   179→
   180→  useEffect(() => {
   181→    if (!currentShotId || isLoadingShotSettings) return;
   182→
   183→    // Check if we already have a user override in the map
   184→    const existingState = filterStateMapRef.current.get(currentShotId);
   185→    if (existingState?.isUserOverride) {
   186→      return;
   187→    }
   188→
   189→    // Populate map from persisted settings if user had customized
   190→    if (shotSettings?.userHasCustomized && shotSettings.selectedShotFilter) {
   191→
   192→      setFilterStateForShot(currentShotId, shotSettings.selectedShotFilter, true);
   193→      // Also restore excludePositioned preference
   194→      setExcludePositioned(shotSettings.excludePositioned ?? true);
   195→    }
   196→  }, [currentShotId, isLoadingShotSettings, shotSettings, setFilterStateForShot]);
   197→
   198→  // ============================================================================
   199→  // APPLY FILTER WHEN NAVIGATING TO A SHOT
   200→  // This is the main effect that applies the filter when currentShotId changes.
   201→  // ============================================================================
   202→
   203→  useEffect(() => {
   204→
   205→    // Don't apply defaults while per-shot settings are still loading.
   206→    if (currentShotId && isLoadingShotSettings) {
   207→      return;
   208→    }
   209→
   210→    // Only run when the shot actually changes (or on initial load)
   211→    if (hasInitializedRef.current && currentShotId === lastAppliedShotIdRef.current) {
   212→      return;
   213→    }
   214→
   215→    const previousShotId = lastAppliedShotIdRef.current;
   216→
   217→    if (!currentShotId) {
   218→      // No shot selected - check for user override, otherwise default to 'no-shot'
   219→      const noShotViewState = filterStateMapRef.current.get(NO_SHOT_VIEW_KEY);
   220→
   221→      let filterToApply: string;
   222→      if (noShotViewState?.isUserOverride) {
   223→        filterToApply = noShotViewState.filter;
   224→      } else {
   225→        filterToApply = SHOT_FILTER.NO_SHOT;
   226→      }
   227→
   228→      setSelectedShotFilter(filterToApply);
   229→      setExcludePositioned(true);
   230→      lastAppliedShotIdRef.current = currentShotId;
   231→      lastAppliedFilterRef.current = filterToApply;
   232→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   233→      return;
   234→    }
   235→
   236→    // Get the filter state for this shot
   237→    const filterState = getFilterStateForShot(currentShotId);
   238→
   239→    // IMPORTANT: When navigating between shots (shot-to-shot), preserve "all" filter
   240→    // if the previous shot was on "all" and this shot has no user override.
   241→    const isNavigatingBetweenShots = previousShotId !== null && currentShotId !== null;
   242→    const previousWasAll = lastAppliedFilterRef.current === SHOT_FILTER.ALL;
   243→
   244→    let filterToApply = filterState.filter;
   245→
   246→    if (isNavigatingBetweenShots && previousWasAll && !filterState.isUserOverride) {
   247→      filterToApply = SHOT_FILTER.ALL;
   248→    }
   249→
   250→    setSelectedShotFilter(filterToApply);
   251→    setExcludePositioned(true);
   252→
   253→    // If not a user override, store this as the default in the map
   254→    if (!filterState.isUserOverride) {
   255→      setFilterStateForShot(currentShotId, filterToApply, false);
   256→    }
   257→
   258→    // Sync the dropdown selection to the current shot
   259→    onShotFilterApplied?.(currentShotId);
   260→
   261→    // Mark as applied
   262→    lastAppliedShotIdRef.current = currentShotId;
   263→    lastAppliedFilterRef.current = filterToApply;
   264→    hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   265→
   266→  }, [
   267→    currentShotId,
   268→    isLoadingShotSettings,
   269→    getFilterStateForShot,
   270→    setFilterStateForShot,
   271→    onShotFilterApplied,
   272→  ]);
   273→
   274→  // ============================================================================
   275→  // UPDATE DEFAULTS WHEN SHOT IMAGE COUNTS CHANGE
   276→  // ============================================================================
   277→
   278→  useEffect(() => {
   279→    if (!shotsData?.length) return;
   280→
   281→    shotsData.forEach(shot => {
   282→      const lastCount = lastUnpositionedCountsRef.current.get(shot.id);
   283→      const currentCount = shot.unpositionedImageCount ?? 0;
   284→
   285→      if (lastCount !== undefined && lastCount !== currentCount) {
   286→        const existingState = filterStateMapRef.current.get(shot.id);
   287→
   288→        if (!existingState?.isUserOverride) {
   289→          const newDefault = currentCount > 0 ? shot.id : SHOT_FILTER.ALL;
   290→
   291→          setFilterStateForShot(shot.id, newDefault, false);
   292→
   293→          if (shot.id === currentShotId) {
   294→            setSelectedShotFilter(newDefault);
   295→            lastAppliedFilterRef.current = newDefault;
   296→          }
   297→        }
   298→      }
   299→
   300→      lastUnpositionedCountsRef.current.set(shot.id, currentCount);
   301→    });
   302→  }, [shotsData, currentShotId, setFilterStateForShot]);
   303→
   304→  // ============================================================================
   305→  // USER OVERRIDE HANDLERS
   306→  // ============================================================================
   307→
   308→  const handleShotFilterChange = useCallback((newShotFilter: string) => {
   309→    setSelectedShotFilter(newShotFilter);
   310→    lastAppliedFilterRef.current = newShotFilter;
   311→
   312→    if (currentShotId) {
   313→      setFilterStateForShot(currentShotId, newShotFilter, true);
   314→
   315→      const updatedSettings: GenerationsPaneSettings = {
   316→        selectedShotFilter: newShotFilter,
   317→        excludePositioned,
   318→        userHasCustomized: true,
   319→      };
   320→      updateShotSettings('shot', updatedSettings);
   321→
   322→    } else {
   323→      filterStateMapRef.current.set(NO_SHOT_VIEW_KEY, { filter: newShotFilter, isUserOverride: true });
   324→
   325→    }
   326→
   327→    if (!isSpecialFilter(newShotFilter)) {
   328→      filterStateMapRef.current.set(newShotFilter, { filter: newShotFilter, isUserOverride: true });
   329→    }
   330→  }, [currentShotId, excludePositioned, setFilterStateForShot, updateShotSettings]);
   331→
   332→  const handleExcludePositionedChange = useCallback((newExcludePositioned: boolean) => {
   333→    setExcludePositioned(newExcludePositioned);
   334→
   335→    if (currentShotId) {
   336→      const updatedSettings: GenerationsPaneSettings = {
   337→        selectedShotFilter,
   338→        excludePositioned: newExcludePositioned,
   339→        userHasCustomized: true,
   340→      };
   341→      updateShotSettings('shot', updatedSettings);
   342→    }
   343→  }, [currentShotId, selectedShotFilter, updateShotSettings]);
   344→
   345→  // Reset excludePositioned when switching to video to avoid confusion
   346→  useEffect(() => {
   347→    if (mediaType === 'video') {
   348→      setExcludePositioned(false);
   349→    }
   350→  }, [mediaType]);
   351→
   352→  // Memoize filters to prevent unnecessary re-renders and duplicate progressive loading sessions
   353→  const filters = useMemo(() => {
   354→    const computedFilters = {
   355→      mediaType,
   356→      toolType,
   357→      shotId: selectedShotFilter === SHOT_FILTER.ALL ? undefined : selectedShotFilter,
   358→      excludePositioned: !isSpecialFilter(selectedShotFilter) ? excludePositioned : undefined,
   359→      starredOnly,
   360→      searchTerm: searchTerm.trim() || undefined,
   361→    };
   362→
   363→    return computedFilters;
   364→  }, [mediaType, toolType, selectedShotFilter, excludePositioned, starredOnly, searchTerm]);
   365→
   366→  // ============================================================================
   367→  // SKELETON COUNT (expectedItemCount)
   368→  // ============================================================================
   369→
   370→  const lastKnownCountsRef = useRef<Map<string, number>>(new Map());
   371→
   372→  const expectedItemCount = useMemo(() => {
   373→    const filterKey = `${selectedShotFilter}-${excludePositioned}`;
   374→
   375→    const lastKnown = lastKnownCountsRef.current.get(filterKey);
   376→    if (lastKnown !== undefined) {
   377→      const cappedLastKnown = Math.min(lastKnown, 60);
   378→
   379→      return cappedLastKnown;
   380→    }
   381→
   382→    if (selectedShotFilter === SHOT_FILTER.ALL) {
   383→      return Math.min(allImagesCount ?? 12, 60);
   384→    }
   385→    if (selectedShotFilter === SHOT_FILTER.NO_SHOT) {
   386→      return Math.min(noShotImagesCount ?? 12, 60);
   387→    }
   388→    const shot = shotsData?.find(s => s.id === selectedShotFilter);
   389→    if (!shot) return 12;
   390→
   391→    const count = excludePositioned
   392→      ? shot.unpositionedImageCount
   393→      : shot.imageCount;
   394→
   395→    const cappedCount = Math.min(count ?? 12, 60);
   396→
   397→    return cappedCount;
   398→  }, [selectedShotFilter, shotsData, excludePositioned, allImagesCount, noShotImagesCount]);
   399→
   400→  // ============================================================================
   401→  // QUERY-BASED FALLBACK
   402→  // Called by parent hook when query data changes, to fall back to 'all'
   403→  // when a specific shot filter returns 0 results.
   404→  // ============================================================================
   405→
   406→  const lastQueryResultRef = useRef<{ filter: string; total: number } | null>(null);
   407→
   408→  /** Update the last known count when we get real data (called by parent) */
   409→  const updateLastKnownCount = useCallback((total: number) => {
   410→    const filterKey = `${selectedShotFilter}-${excludePositioned}`;
   411→    lastKnownCountsRef.current.set(filterKey, total);
   412→  }, [selectedShotFilter, excludePositioned]);
   413→
   414→  const applyQueryFallback = useCallback((data: QueryFallbackData, page: number) => {
   415→
   416→    // Update last known count when data is ready
   417→    if (!data.isLoading && data.total !== undefined) {
   418→      updateLastKnownCount(data.total);
   419→    }
   420→
   421→    // Only check when query has completed and we're filtering by a specific shot
   422→    if (data.isLoading || data.isFetching || selectedShotFilter === SHOT_FILTER.ALL || page !== 1 || !data.hasResponse) {
   423→      return;
   424→    }
   425→
   426→    const total = data.total ?? 0;
   427→    const lastResult = lastQueryResultRef.current;
   428→
   429→    // Check if this is a NEW result for this filter
   430→    if (lastResult?.filter === selectedShotFilter && lastResult?.total === total) {
   431→      return;
   432→    }
   433→
   434→    lastQueryResultRef.current = { filter: selectedShotFilter, total };
   435→
   436→    if (total === 0) {
   437→      const existingState = currentShotId
   438→        ? filterStateMapRef.current.get(currentShotId)
   439→        : filterStateMapRef.current.get(selectedShotFilter);
   440→
   441→      if (existingState?.isUserOverride) {
   442→        return;
   443→      }
   444→
   445→      if (currentShotId) {
   446→        setFilterStateForShot(currentShotId, SHOT_FILTER.ALL, false);
   447→      }
   448→
   449→      setSelectedShotFilter(SHOT_FILTER.ALL);
   450→      lastAppliedFilterRef.current = SHOT_FILTER.ALL;
   451→    }
   452→  }, [selectedShotFilter, currentShotId, setFilterStateForShot, updateLastKnownCount]);
   453→
   454→  return {
   455→    // State values
   456→    selectedShotFilter,
   457→    excludePositioned,
   458→    searchTerm,
   459→    starredOnly,
   460→
   461→    // State setters
   462→    setSelectedShotFilter: handleShotFilterChange,
   463→    setExcludePositioned: handleExcludePositionedChange,
   464→    setSearchTerm,
   465→    setStarredOnly,
   466→
   467→    // Computed
   468→    filters,
   469→
   470→    // For skeleton display
   471→    expectedItemCount,
   472→
   473→    // Query fallback
   474→    applyQueryFallback,
   475→  };
   476→}
   477→

     9→export function safeAreaCalc(base: string, inset: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'): string {
    10→  const envVar = `safe-area-inset-${inset}`;

1→/**
     2→ * useGenerationInvalidation.ts
     3→ * 
     4→ * Centralized hook for invalidating generation-related React Query caches.
     5→ * 
     6→ * Why this exists:
     7→ * - 19 different places were calling invalidateQueries with different combinations
     8→ * - Inconsistent patterns led to stale data or excessive invalidation
     9→ * - No visibility into what triggered invalidations
    10→ * 
    11→ * Usage:
    12→ *   const invalidateGenerations = useInvalidateGenerations();
    13→ *   invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'delete-image' });
    14→ * 
    15→ * For variant changes (no shotId needed):
    16→ *   invalidateVariantChange(queryClient, { generationId, reason: 'set-primary' });
    17→ * 
    18→ * Scopes:
    19→ * - 'all': All generation-related queries (default)
    20→ * - 'images': Just image data (all-shot-generations, segment-live-timeline)
    21→ * - 'metadata': Just metadata (shot-generations-meta)
    22→ * - 'counts': Just counts (unpositioned-count)
    23→ *
    24→ * Note: Uses queryKeys registry from @/shared/lib/queryKeys for all key references.
    25→ */
    26→
    27→import { useQueryClient, QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    28→import { useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
    29→import { queryKeys } from '../../lib/queryKeys';
    30→
    31→export type InvalidationScope =
    32→  | 'all'           // All generation-related queries for a shot
    33→  | 'images'        // Just image data (all-shot-generations)
    34→  | 'metadata'      // Just metadata (shot-generations-meta)
    35→  | 'counts';       // Just counts (unpositioned-count)
    36→
    37→export interface InvalidationOptions {
    38→  /** Which queries to invalidate. Default: 'all' */
    39→  scope?: InvalidationScope;
    40→  /** Debug reason for logging. Required for traceability. */
    41→  reason: string;
    42→  /** Delay invalidation by this many ms (for batching rapid changes) */
    43→  delayMs?: number;
    44→  /** Also invalidate the 'shots' query for the project (e.g., for thumbnail updates) */
    45→  includeShots?: boolean;
    46→  /** Project ID - required if includeShots is true */
    47→  projectId?: string;
    48→  /** Also invalidate unified-generations at project level */
    49→  includeProjectUnified?: boolean;
    50→}
    51→
    52→/**
    53→ * Options for variant-specific invalidation.
    54→ * Use when a variant is created/updated/set-as-primary.
    55→ */
    56→export interface VariantInvalidationOptions {
    57→  /** Debug reason for logging. Required for traceability. */
    58→  reason: string;
    59→  /** Generation ID that the variant belongs to */
    60→  generationId: string;
    61→  /** Optional: specific shot ID to prioritize (will refetch immediately before global invalidation) */
    62→  shotId?: string;
    63→  /** Optional: project ID for project-scoped unified-generations invalidation */
    64→  projectId?: string;
    65→  /** Delay before invalidation (e.g., 100ms for DB trigger to complete) */
    66→  delayMs?: number;
    67→}
    68→
    69→/**
    70→ * Internal helper that performs the actual invalidation.
    71→ * Extracted so it can be used with or without React hooks.
    72→ */
    73→function performInvalidation(
    74→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    75→  shotId: string,
    76→  options: InvalidationOptions
    77→): void {
    78→  const { 
    79→    scope = 'all', 
    80→    includeShots = false,
    81→    projectId,
    82→    includeProjectUnified = false
    83→  } = options;
    84→  
    85→  // Debug logging via centralized config
    86→  
    87→  // Invalidate based on scope
    88→  if (scope === 'all' || scope === 'images') {

   115→/**
   116→ * Hook that returns a stable invalidation function.
   117→ * Use this in React components/hooks.
   118→ */
   119→export function useInvalidateGenerations() {
   120→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   121→  const timeoutRefs = useRef<Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>>(new Map());
   122→  
   123→  return useCallback((shotId: string, options: InvalidationOptions) => {
   124→    const { delayMs } = options;
   125→    
   126→    // If there's already a pending invalidation for this shotId, clear it
   127→    const existingTimeout = timeoutRefs.current.get(shotId);
   128→    if (existingTimeout) {
   129→      clearTimeout(existingTimeout);
   130→      timeoutRefs.current.delete(shotId);
   131→    }
   132→    
   133→    if (delayMs && delayMs > 0) {
   134→      // Delayed invalidation (useful for batching rapid changes)
   135→      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
   136→        performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   137→        timeoutRefs.current.delete(shotId);
   138→      }, delayMs);
   139→      timeoutRefs.current.set(shotId, timeout);
   140→    } else {
   141→      // Immediate invalidation
   142→      performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   143→    }
   144→  }, [queryClient]);
   145→}

   147→/**

   149→ * Requires passing in the queryClient.

   151→export function invalidateGenerationsSync(
   152→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   153→  shotId: string,
   154→  options: InvalidationOptions
   155→): void {
   156→  if (options.delayMs && options.delayMs > 0) {
   157→    setTimeout(() => {
   158→      performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   159→    }, options.delayMs);
   160→  } else {
   161→    performInvalidation(queryClient, shotId, options);
   162→  }
   163→}

   170→export function invalidateAllShotGenerations(

   175→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({

   177→  });

   181→/**

   183→ * 
   184→ * This handles the variant → generation → shot cascade:
   185→ * - A variant belongs to a generation

   191→ * @param options - Invalidation options including generationId and reason
   192→ */
   193→export async function invalidateVariantChange(
   194→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   195→  options: VariantInvalidationOptions
   196→): Promise<void> {
   197→  const { generationId, shotId, projectId, delayMs } = options;
   198→  
   199→  // Apply delay if specified (e.g., for DB trigger to complete)
   200→  if (delayMs && delayMs > 0) {
   201→    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs));
   202→  }
   203→  
   204→  // 1. Invalidate variant-specific queries
   205→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](generationId) });
   206→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](generationId) });
   207→  // Also invalidate variant-badges so the "X new" badges update
   208→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   209→
   210→  // 2. If we know the shot, refetch it immediately for faster UI update
   211→  if (shotId) {
   212→    await queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  // 3. Invalidate all shot-generations (generation might be in multiple shots)
   216→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   217→    predicate: (query) => query.queryKey[0] === queryKeys.generations.byShotAll[0]
   218→  });
   219→  // NOTE: ['shot-generations'] removed - it was never queried, only invalidated
   220→
   221→  // 4. Invalidate generation galleries - cover ALL key patterns for compatibility
   222→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   223→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   224→  // Derived items (variants/generations "based on this")
   225→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   226→
   227→  // 5. If projectId provided, also invalidate project-scoped queries
   228→  if (projectId) {
   229→    // Partial key match for project-scoped unified generations
   230→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  // 6. Invalidate segment output queries (for timeline segment strip)
   234→  // This ensures variant changes are reflected in the segment strip
   235→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   236→    predicate: (query) => query.queryKey[0] === queryKeys.segments.childrenAll[0]
   237→  });
   238→
   239→  // 7. Invalidate source image change detection (for video warning indicators)
   240→  // This ensures warnings appear immediately when source images change
   241→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   242→    predicate: (query) => query.queryKey[0] === queryKeys.segments.sourceSlotAll[0]
   243→  });

1→/**
     2→ * useShotInvalidation.ts
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralized hook for invalidating shot-related React Query caches.
     5→ *
     6→ * Scopes:
     7→ * - 'list': Just the shots list for a project
     8→ * - 'detail': A specific shot's detail data
     9→ * - 'all': List + all related generation caches
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import { useQueryClient, QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    13→import { useCallback } from 'react';
    14→import { queryKeys } from '../../lib/queryKeys';
    15→
    16→export type ShotInvalidationScope = 'list' | 'detail' | 'all';
    17→
    18→export interface ShotInvalidationOptions {
    19→  /** Which queries to invalidate */
    20→  scope?: ShotInvalidationScope;
    21→  /** Debug reason for logging. Required for traceability. */
    22→  reason: string;
    23→  /** Shot ID - required for 'detail' and 'all' scopes */
    24→  shotId?: string;
    25→  /** Project ID - required for 'list' and 'all' scopes */
    26→  projectId?: string;
    27→}
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Internal helper that performs the actual invalidation.
    31→ */
    32→function performShotInvalidation(
    33→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    34→  options: ShotInvalidationOptions
    35→): void {
    36→  const { scope = 'all', shotId, projectId } = options;
    37→
    38→  if ((scope === 'list' || scope === 'all') && projectId) {
    39→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });
    40→  }
    41→
    42→  if ((scope === 'detail' || scope === 'all') && shotId) {
    43→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
    44→    // Also invalidate generation caches for this shot
    45→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
    46→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
    47→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
    48→  }
    49→}
    50→
    51→/**
    52→ * Hook that returns a stable shot invalidation function.
    53→ * Use this in React components/hooks.
    54→ *
    55→ * @internal Not exported - currently unused. If needed in the future,
    56→ * add export back and update the barrel file.
    57→ */
    58→function useInvalidateShots() {
    59→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    60→
    61→  return useCallback((options: ShotInvalidationOptions) => {
    62→    performShotInvalidation(queryClient, options);
    63→  }, [queryClient]);
    64→}
    65→
    66→// Keep for potential future use - referenced in barrel file docs
    67→void useInvalidateShots;
    68→
    69→/**
    70→ * Non-hook version for use outside React components.
    71→ * Requires passing in the queryClient.
    72→ *
    73→ * @internal Not exported - currently unused. If needed in the future,
    74→ * add export back and update the barrel file.
    75→ */
    76→function invalidateShotsSync(
    77→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    78→  options: ShotInvalidationOptions
    79→): void {
    80→  performShotInvalidation(queryClient, options);
    81→}
    82→
    83→// Keep for potential future use
    84→void invalidateShotsSync;

1→/**
     2→ * useSettingsInvalidation.ts
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralized hook for invalidating settings-related React Query caches.
     5→ *
     6→ * Scopes:
     7→ * - 'tool': Tool settings for a specific tool/project
     8→ * - 'segment': Segment settings
     9→ * - 'user': User-level settings
    10→ * - 'pair': Pair metadata (segment editor)
    11→ */
    12→
    13→import { useQueryClient, QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    14→import { useCallback } from 'react';
    15→import { queryKeys } from '../../lib/queryKeys';
    16→
    17→export type SettingsInvalidationScope = 'tool' | 'segment' | 'user' | 'pair' | 'all';
    18→
    19→export interface SettingsInvalidationOptions {
    20→  /** Which settings to invalidate */
    21→  scope: SettingsInvalidationScope;
    22→  /** Debug reason for logging. Required for traceability. */
    23→  reason: string;
    24→  /** Tool ID - required for 'tool' scope */
    25→  toolId?: string;
    26→  /** Project ID - required for 'tool' scope */
    27→  projectId?: string;
    28→  /** Shot ID - optional for tool scope */
    29→  shotId?: string;
    30→  /** Pair ID - required for 'pair' scope */
    31→  pairId?: string;
    32→}
    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Internal helper that performs the actual invalidation.
    36→ */
    37→function performSettingsInvalidation(
    38→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    39→  options: SettingsInvalidationOptions
    40→): void {
    41→  const { scope, toolId, projectId, shotId, pairId } = options;
    42→
    43→  if ((scope === 'tool' || scope === 'all') && toolId && projectId) {
    44→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({
    45→      [REDACTED](toolId, projectId, shotId),
    46→    });
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  if ((scope === 'pair' || scope === 'all') && pairId) {
    50→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({
    51→      [REDACTED](pairId),
    52→    });
    53→  }
    54→
    55→  if (scope === 'user' || scope === 'all') {
    56→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
    57→  }
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Hook that returns a stable settings invalidation function.
    62→ * Use this in React components/hooks.
    63→ *
    64→ * @internal Not exported - currently unused. If needed in the future,
    65→ * add export back and update the barrel file.
    66→ */
    67→function useInvalidateSettings() {
    68→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    69→
    70→  return useCallback((options: SettingsInvalidationOptions) => {
    71→    performSettingsInvalidation(queryClient, options);
    72→  }, [queryClient]);
    73→}
    74→
    75→// Keep for potential future use
    76→void useInvalidateSettings;
    77→
    78→/**
    79→ * Non-hook version for use outside React components.

    81→ *
    82→ * @internal Not exported - currently unused. If needed in the future,
    83→ * add export back and update the barrel file.
    84→ */
    85→function invalidateSettingsSync(

    88→): void {
    89→  performSettingsInvalidation(queryClient, options);
    90→}

    92→// Keep for potential future use
    93→void invalidateSettingsSync;

1→/**
     2→ * useTaskInvalidation.ts
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralized hook for invalidating task-related React Query caches.
     5→ *
     6→ * Scopes:
     7→ * - 'list': Task list for a project
     8→ * - 'detail': Specific task
     9→ * - 'counts': Just status counts (lightweight)
    10→ * - 'all': Everything task-related
    11→ */
    12→
    13→import { useQueryClient, QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    14→import { useCallback } from 'react';
    15→import { queryKeys } from '../../lib/queryKeys';
    16→import { invalidateGenerationsSync } from './useGenerationInvalidation';
    17→
    18→export type TaskInvalidationScope = 'list' | 'detail' | 'counts' | 'all';
    19→
    20→export interface TaskInvalidationOptions {
    21→  /** Which queries to invalidate */
    22→  scope?: TaskInvalidationScope;
    23→  /** Debug reason for logging. Required for traceability. */
    24→  reason: string;
    25→  /** Task ID - required for 'detail' scope */
    26→  taskId?: string;
    27→  /** Project ID - required for 'list', 'counts', and 'all' scopes */
    28→  projectId?: string;
    29→  /** Also invalidate generation caches (for task completion) */
    30→  includeGenerations?: boolean;
    31→  /** Shot ID - required if includeGenerations is true */
    32→  shotId?: string;
    33→}
    34→
    35→/**
    36→ * Internal helper that performs the actual invalidation.
    37→ */
    38→function performTaskInvalidation(
    39→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    40→  options: TaskInvalidationOptions
    41→): void {
    42→  const { scope = 'all', reason, taskId, projectId, includeGenerations, shotId } = options;
    43→
    44→  if ((scope === 'list' || scope === 'all') && projectId) {
    45→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });
    46→  }
    47→
    48→  if ((scope === 'detail' || scope === 'all') && taskId) {
    49→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](taskId) });
    50→  }
    51→
    52→  if ((scope === 'counts' || scope === 'all') && projectId) {
    53→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  // Task completion often means new generations
    57→  if (includeGenerations && shotId) {
    58→    invalidateGenerationsSync(queryClient, shotId, {
    59→      reason: `${reason} (task completion)`,
    60→      scope: 'all',
    61→    });
    62→  }
    63→}
    64→
    65→/**
    66→ * Hook that returns a stable task invalidation function.
    67→ * Use this in React components/hooks.
    68→ *
    69→ * @internal Not exported - currently unused. If needed in the future,
    70→ * add export back and update the barrel file.
    71→ */
    72→function useInvalidateTasks() {
    73→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    74→
    75→  return useCallback((options: TaskInvalidationOptions) => {
    76→    performTaskInvalidation(queryClient, options);
    77→  }, [queryClient]);
    78→}
    79→
    80→// Keep for potential future use
    81→void useInvalidateTasks;
    82→
    83→/**
    84→ * Non-hook version for use outside React components.
    85→ * Requires passing in the queryClient.
    86→ *
    87→ * @internal Not exported - currently unused. If needed in the future,
    88→ * add export back and update the barrel file.
    89→ */
    90→function invalidateTasksSync(
    91→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    92→  options: TaskInvalidationOptions
    93→): void {
    94→  performTaskInvalidation(queryClient, options);
    95→}
    96→
    97→// Keep for potential future use
    98→void invalidateTasksSync;
    99→

1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)
     7→ * - Position calculation for drag-and-drop operations
     8→ *
     9→ * No React hooks or side effects - all functions are stateless.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/useTimelineCore';
    13→import { calculateAverageSpacing, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING } from '@/shared/utils/timelinePositionCalculator';
    14→import { MAX_FRAME_GAP } from '@/shared/lib/timelineNormalization';
    15→
    16→// ============================================================================
    17→// Types
    18→// ============================================================================
    19→
    20→interface FrameUpdate {
    21→  id: string;
    22→  newFrame: number;
    23→  reason: string;
    24→}
    25→
    26→// ============================================================================
    27→// Normalization
    28→// ============================================================================
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    32→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    33→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    34→ */
    35→function normalizePositions(
    36→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    37→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    38→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    39→
    40→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    41→
    42→  // Sort by frame position
    43→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    44→
    45→  let currentFrame = 0;
    46→
    47→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    48→    const item = sorted[i];
    49→
    50→    if (i === 0) {
    51→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    52→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    53→      }
    54→      currentFrame = 0;
    55→    } else {
    56→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    57→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    58→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    59→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    60→
    61→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    62→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    63→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    64→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    65→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    66→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    67→        });
    68→      }
    69→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    70→    }
    71→  }
    72→
    73→  return normalizedUpdates;
    74→}
    75→
    76→// ============================================================================
    77→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→
    80→/**
    81→ * Find a ShotGeneration by id or generation_id
    82→ */
    83→export function findGeneration(
    84→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    85→  key?: string | null
    86→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    87→  if (!key) return undefined;
    88→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key || sg.generation_id === key);
    89→}
    90→
    91→interface DistributionContext {
    92→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];
    93→  draggedItemIds: string[];
    94→  newStartIndex: number;
    95→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    96→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    97→}
    98→
    99→/**
   100→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   101→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).
   102→ */
   103→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   104→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   105→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];
   106→
   107→  const pushUpdate = (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => {
   108→    const normalizedFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame));
   109→    accumulateUpdates.push({ id, newFrame: normalizedFrame, reason });
   110→  };
   111→
   112→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   113→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   114→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   115→
   116→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   117→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   118→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   119→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   120→    );
   121→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   122→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   123→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   124→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   125→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   126→
   127→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   128→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   129→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   130→    });
   131→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {
   132→    // At end - extend timeline using average spacing of existing items
   133→    const existingFrames = allItems
   134→      .filter(item => item.timeline_frame != null)
   135→      .map(item => item.timeline_frame!);
   136→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   137→
   138→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   139→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   140→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   141→    });
   142→  } else if (successor && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   143→    // At start - distribute between 0 and successor
   144→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame;
   145→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   146→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   147→
   148→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   149→      const newFrame = interval * (i + 1);
   150→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed from start (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   151→    });
   152→  } else {
   153→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   154→
   155→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   156→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   157→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   158→    });
   159→  }
   160→
   161→  return accumulateUpdates;
   162→}
   163→
   164→/**
   165→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   166→ */
   167→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   168→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   169→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   170→  newEndIndex: number,
   171→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   172→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   173→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   174→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   175→) {
   176→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   177→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   178→
   179→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   180→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   181→
   182→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   183→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   184→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   185→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   186→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   188→  } else {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   190→  }
   191→
   192→  // Update displaced item
   193→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   194→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   195→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   196→  }
   197→
   198→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   199→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   200→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   201→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   202→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   203→
   204→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   205→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   206→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   207→    }
   208→  }
   209→}
   210→
   211→// ============================================================================
   212→// Update deduplication
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→
   215→/**
   216→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   217→ */
   218→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   219→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   220→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   221→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   222→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   223→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   224→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   225→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   226→    }
   227→  });
   228→  return uniqueUpdates;
   229→}
   230→
   231→/**
   232→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   233→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   234→ */
   235→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   236→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   237→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   238→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   239→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   240→
   241→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   242→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   243→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   244→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   245→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   246→  }
   247→
   248→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   249→
   250→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   251→
   252→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   253→
   254→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   255→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   256→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   257→    if (existing) {
   258→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });
   259→    } else {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, payload);
   261→    }
   262→  }
   263→
   264→  return uniqueUpdates;
   265→}
   266→

1→/**
     2→ * Variant type constants for generation_variants.variant_type.
     3→ *
     4→ * Variant types describe the nature/source of a variant:
     5→ * - original: Direct upload or primary generation output
     6→ * - upscaled: Result of upscaling
     7→ * - edit/inpaint/magic_edit/annotated_edit: Image editing operations
     8→ * - trimmed: Video trim operation
     9→ * - travel_segment/travel_stitch: Video travel outputs
    10→ * - join_clips_segment/clip_join: Join clips outputs
    11→ * - repositioned: Result of reposition operation
    12→ * - regenerated: Result of regeneration with variations
    13→ * - child_promoted: Variant promoted to generation
    14→ *
    15→ * NOTE: variant_type is orthogonal to tool_type - variant_type describes
    16→ * what kind of processing was done, while tool_type describes which tool
    17→ * created the generation.
    18→ */
    19→
    20→export const VARIANT_TYPE = {
    21→  // Base types
    22→  ORIGINAL: 'original',
    23→  UPSCALED: 'upscaled',
    24→
    25→  // Image editing types
    26→  EDIT: 'edit',
    27→  INPAINT: 'inpaint',
    28→  MAGIC_EDIT: 'magic_edit',
    29→  ANNOTATED_EDIT: 'annotated_edit',
    30→
    31→  // Video editing types
    32→  TRIMMED: 'trimmed',
    33→  REPOSITIONED: 'repositioned',
    34→
    35→  // Travel between images outputs
    36→  TRAVEL_SEGMENT: 'travel_segment',
    37→  TRAVEL_STITCH: 'travel_stitch',
    38→  INDIVIDUAL_SEGMENT: 'individual_segment',
    39→
    40→  // Join clips outputs
    41→  JOIN_CLIPS_SEGMENT: 'join_clips_segment',
    42→  CLIP_JOIN: 'clip_join',
    43→
    44→  // Other
    45→  REGENERATED: 'regenerated',
    46→  CHILD_PROMOTED: 'child_promoted',
    47→} as const;
    48→
    49→type VariantType = typeof VARIANT_TYPE[keyof typeof VARIANT_TYPE];
