     8→import type { TaskCreationResult } from "@/shared/lib/taskCreation";
     9→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    10→
    11→/**
    12→ * Interface for character animate (Wan2.2-Animate) task parameters
    13→ */
    14→export interface CharacterAnimateTaskParams {
    15→  project_id: string;
    16→  character_image_url: string;
    17→  motion_video_url: string;
    18→  prompt?: string;
    19→  mode: 'replace' | 'animate';
    20→  resolution: '480p' | '720p';
    21→  seed?: number;
    22→  random_seed?: boolean;
    23→}
    24→
    25→/**
    26→ * Default values for character animate task settings
    27→ */
    28→const DEFAULT_CHARACTER_ANIMATE_VALUES = {
    29→  mode: 'animate' as const,
    30→  resolution: '480p' as const,
    31→  prompt: 'natural expression; preserve outfit details',
    32→  seed: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000),
    33→  random_seed: true,
    34→};
    35→
    36→/**
    37→ * Validates character animate task parameters
    38→ * 
    39→ * @param params - Parameters to validate
    40→ * @throws TaskValidationError if validation fails
    41→ */
    42→function validateCharacterAnimateParams(params: CharacterAnimateTaskParams): void {
    43→  validateRequiredFields(params, [
    44→    'project_id',
    45→    'character_image_url',
    46→    'motion_video_url',
    47→    'mode',
    48→    'resolution'
    49→  ]);
    50→
    51→  // Additional validations
    52→  if (!params.character_image_url) {
    53→    throw new TaskValidationError("character_image_url is required", 'character_image_url');
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  if (!params.motion_video_url) {
    57→    throw new TaskValidationError("motion_video_url is required", 'motion_video_url');
    58→  }
    59→
    60→  if (!['replace', 'animate'].includes(params.mode)) {
    61→    throw new TaskValidationError("mode must be 'replace' or 'animate'", 'mode');
    62→  }
    63→
    64→  if (!['480p', '720p'].includes(params.resolution)) {
    65→    throw new TaskValidationError("resolution must be '480p' or '720p'", 'resolution');
    66→  }
    67→}
    68→
    69→/**
    70→ * Builds the orchestrator payload for character animation
    71→ * 
    72→ * @param params - Raw character animate parameters
    73→ * @param taskId - Generated task ID
    74→ * @param runId - Generated run ID
    75→ * @returns Processed orchestrator payload
    76→ */
    77→function buildCharacterAnimatePayload(
    78→  params: CharacterAnimateTaskParams, 
    79→  taskId: string,
    80→  runId: string
    81→): Record<string, unknown> {
    82→  // Handle random seed generation
    83→  const finalSeed = params.random_seed 
    84→    ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000) 
    85→    : (params.seed ?? DEFAULT_CHARACTER_ANIMATE_VALUES.seed);
    86→  
    87→  // Build orchestrator payload
    88→  const orchestratorPayload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    89→    orchestrator_task_id: taskId,
    90→    run_id: runId,
    91→    character_image_url: params.character_image_url,
    92→    motion_video_url: params.motion_video_url,
    93→    prompt: params.prompt ?? DEFAULT_CHARACTER_ANIMATE_VALUES.prompt,
    94→    mode: params.mode ?? DEFAULT_CHARACTER_ANIMATE_VALUES.mode,
    95→    resolution: params.resolution ?? DEFAULT_CHARACTER_ANIMATE_VALUES.resolution,
    96→    seed: finalSeed,
    97→  };
    98→
    99→  return orchestratorPayload;
   100→}
   101→
   102→/**
   103→ * Creates a character animate task using the unified approach
   104→ * 
   105→ * @param params - Character animate task parameters
   106→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   107→ */
   108→export async function createCharacterAnimateTask(params: CharacterAnimateTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   109→
   110→  try {
   111→    // 1. Validate parameters
   112→    validateCharacterAnimateParams(params);
   113→
   114→    // 2. Generate IDs for orchestrator payload
   115→    const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("character_animate");
   116→    const runId = generateRunId();
   117→
   118→    // 3. Build orchestrator payload
   119→    const orchestratorPayload = buildCharacterAnimatePayload(
   120→      params, 
   121→      orchestratorTaskId, 
   122→      runId
   123→    );
   124→
   125→    // 4. Create task using unified create-task function
   126→    // For API-based tasks, put params at top level for direct processing
   127→    const result = await createTask({
   128→      project_id: params.project_id,
   129→      task_type: 'animate_character',
   130→      params: orchestratorPayload
   131→    });
   132→
   133→    return result;
   134→
   135→  } catch (error) {
   136→    handleError(error, { context: 'CharacterAnimate', showToast: false });
   137→    throw error;
   138→  }
   139→}
   140→
   141→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   142→

1→/**
     2→ * useTimelineCore - Core hook for timeline position management
     3→ *
     4→ * This is the single source of truth for timeline positions and operations.
     5→ * It consolidates functionality from:
     6→ * - useEnhancedShotPositions (position operations)
     7→ * - useTimelinePositionUtils (batch operations, normalization)

     9→ *
    10→ * Architecture:
    11→ * - Data: Uses useShotImages for the canonical data source
    12→ * - Derived: Provides filtered/sorted positioned items via useMemo
    13→ * - Operations: Uses atomic RPCs (delete_and_normalize, unposition_and_normalize, reorder_normalized)
    14→ * - Pair Data: Includes pair prompt access with migration from old format
    15→ */

    17→import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
    18→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

    31→// Types

    88→  /** @deprecated Use segmentOverrides.motionMode and segmentOverrides.amountOfMotion instead */
    89→  pair_motion_settings?: { motionMode?: 'basic' | 'advanced'; amountOfMotion?: number };
    90→}

    92→interface TimelineCoreResult {
    93→  // Data
    94→  generations: GenerationRow[] | undefined;
    95→  positionedItems: GenerationRow[];
    96→  unpositionedItems: GenerationRow[];

   129→// ============================================================================
   130→// Hook Implementation
   131→// ============================================================================
   132→
   133→export function useTimelineCore(shotId: string | null): TimelineCoreResult {
   134→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   135→  const invalidateGenerations = useInvalidateGenerations();
   136→
   137→  // ============================================================================
   138→  // Data Layer - Single source of truth
   139→  // ============================================================================
   140→
   141→  const {
   142→    data: generations,
   143→    isLoading,
   144→    error,
   145→    refetch,
   146→  } = useShotImages(shotId);
   147→
   148→  // Derived: Positioned items (on timeline, non-video, valid location)
   149→  const positionedItems = useMemo(() => {
   150→    if (!generations) return [];
   151→
   152→    return generations
   153→      .filter((g) => {
   154→        const location = g.imageUrl || g.location;
   155→        const hasValidLocation = location && location !== '/placeholder.svg';
   156→        return (
   157→          g.timeline_frame != null &&
   158→          g.timeline_frame >= 0 &&
   159→          !isVideoGeneration(g) &&
   160→          hasValidLocation
   161→        );
   162→      })
   163→      .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0));
   164→  }, [generations]);
   165→
   166→  // Derived: Unpositioned items (not on timeline, non-video, valid location)
   167→  const unpositionedItems = useMemo(() => {
   168→    if (!generations) return [];
   169→
   170→    return generations.filter((g) => {
   171→      const location = g.imageUrl || g.location;
   172→      const hasValidLocation = location && location !== '/placeholder.svg';
   173→      return g.timeline_frame == null && !isVideoGeneration(g) && hasValidLocation;
   174→    });
   175→  }, [generations]);
   176→
   177→  // ============================================================================
   178→  // Position Operations
   179→  // ============================================================================
   180→
   181→  // Update single position (for drag preview - no normalization)
   182→  const updatePosition = useCallback(
   183→    async (shotGenerationId: string, newFrame: number) => {
   184→      if (!shotId) return;
   185→
   186→      try {
   187→        const { error } = await supabase
   188→          .from('shot_generations')
   189→          .update({
   190→            timeline_frame: newFrame,
   191→            metadata: { user_positioned: true },
   192→          })
   193→          .eq('id', shotGenerationId);
   194→
   195→        if (error) throw error;
   196→
   197→        // Invalidate to refresh data
   198→        invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'position-update', scope: 'images' });
   199→      } catch (err) {
   200→        handleError(err, { context: 'useTimelineCore.updatePosition', toastTitle: 'Failed to update position' });
   201→        throw err;
   202→      }
   203→    },
   204→    [shotId, invalidateGenerations]
   205→  );
   206→
   207→  // Commit multiple position updates with normalization
   208→  const commitPositions = useCallback(
   209→    async (updates: Array<{ shotGenerationId: string; newFrame: number }>) => {
   210→      if (!shotId || updates.length === 0) return;
   211→
   212→      try {
   213→        // Use batch_update_timeline_frames RPC for atomic update
   214→        const rpcUpdates = updates.map((u) => ({
   215→          shot_generation_id: u.shotGenerationId,
   216→          timeline_frame: u.newFrame,
   217→          metadata: { user_positioned: true },
   218→        }));
   219→
   220→        const { error } = await supabase.rpc('batch_update_timeline_frames', {
   221→          p_updates: rpcUpdates,
   222→        });
   223→
   224→        if (error) throw error;
   225→
   226→        // Invalidate to refresh data
   227→        invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'positions-commit', scope: 'all' });
   228→      } catch (err) {
   229→        handleError(err, { context: 'useTimelineCore.commitPositions', toastTitle: 'Failed to update positions' });
   230→        throw err;
   231→      }
   232→    },
   233→    [shotId, invalidateGenerations]
   234→  );
   235→
   236→  // Reorder items with normalized positioning (0, 50, 100, ...)

1→/**
     2→ * Shot filter constants for gallery/generations filtering.
     3→ *
     4→ * The shot filter can be:
     5→ * - 'all': Show items from all shots
     6→ * - 'no-shot': Show items not assigned to any shot
     7→ * - A shot UUID: Show items from a specific shot
     8→ */
     9→
    10→export const SHOT_FILTER = {
    11→  /** Show items from all shots */
    12→  ALL: 'all',
    13→  /** Show items not assigned to any shot */
    14→  NO_SHOT: 'no-shot',
    15→} as const;
    16→
    17→type SpecialShotFilter = typeof SHOT_FILTER[keyof typeof SHOT_FILTER];
    18→type ShotFilterValue = SpecialShotFilter | string; // string for shot UUIDs
    19→
    20→/**
    21→ * Type guard to check if a filter value is a special filter (all/no-shot) vs a shot UUID.
    22→ */
    23→export function isSpecialFilter(filter: string): filter is SpecialShotFilter {
    24→  return filter === SHOT_FILTER.ALL || filter === SHOT_FILTER.NO_SHOT;
    25→}
    26→
    27→

     6→interface UseTrainingDataUploadProps {

    20→export function useTrainingDataUpload({

    30→  /** Get the duration (in seconds) of a video file via a temporary <video> element. */
    31→  const getVideoDuration = (file: File): Promise<number> => {
    32→    return new Promise((resolve) => {

    34→      video.preload = 'metadata';
    35→      video.onloadedmetadata = () => {
    36→        resolve(video.duration);
    37→        URL.revokeObjectURL(video.src);

    40→        console.warn('Could not get video duration for:', file.name);

    47→
    48→  /** Upload a single video file to storage + DB. Returns the new video's ID. */
    49→  const uploadVideoFile = async (file: File, userId: string): Promise<string> => {

    52→    const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop();

   176→            break;
   177→
   178→          case 'manual':
   179→            // Don't create any segments - user will do it manually
   180→            break;
   181→        }
   182→      }
   183→
   184→      // Refresh videos to ensure they're properly loaded
   185→      await Promise.all([fetchVideos(), fetchSegments()]);
   186→
   187→      // Give a small delay to ensure DB has fully processed
   188→      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
   189→
   190→      // Refresh one more time to ensure URLs are generated
   191→      await fetchVideos();
   192→    } catch (error) {
   193→      console.error('Error uploading videos:', error);
   194→      throw error;
   195→    } finally {
   196→      setIsUploading(false);
   197→    }
   198→  };
   199→
   200→  return {
   201→    isUploading,
   202→    uploadVideo,
   203→    uploadVideosWithSplitModes,
   204→  };
   205→}
   206→

1→import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import type { TrainingDataVideo } from './types';
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Manages signed URL caching for training data videos.
     7→ * Videos are stored in a private bucket, so we need signed URLs.
     8→ * URLs are loaded asynchronously in batches and cached in state.
     9→ */
    10→export function useVideoUrlCache(videos: TrainingDataVideo[]) {
    11→  const [videoUrls, setVideoUrls] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
    12→  const [invalidVideos, setInvalidVideos] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    13→
    14→  // Preload video URLs when videos change
    15→  useEffect(() => {
    16→    const loadVideoUrls = async () => {
    17→      // Only process videos that don't have URLs yet
    18→      const videosNeedingUrls = videos.filter(video => !videoUrls[video.id]);
    19→
    20→      if (videosNeedingUrls.length === 0) return;
    21→
    22→      const newUrls: Record<string, string> = {};
    23→
    24→      // Process videos in batches to avoid overwhelming the API
    25→      const batchSize = 10;
    26→      for (let i = 0; i < videosNeedingUrls.length; i += batchSize) {
    27→        const batch = videosNeedingUrls.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    28→
    29→        const urlPromises = batch.map(async (video) => {
    30→          const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
    31→            .from('training-data')
    32→            .createSignedUrl(video.storageLocation, 3600); // 1 hour expiry
    33→
    34→          if (!error && data?.signedUrl) {
    35→            newUrls[video.id] = data.signedUrl;
    36→          }
    37→        });
    38→
    39→        await Promise.all(urlPromises);
    40→
    41→        if (Object.keys(newUrls).length > 0) {
    42→          setVideoUrls(prev => ({
    43→            ...prev,
    44→            ...newUrls
    45→          }));
    46→        }
    47→      }
    48→    };
    49→
    50→    if (videos.length > 0) {
    51→      loadVideoUrls();
    52→    }
    53→  }, [videos]); // Don't include videoUrls to avoid circular dependency
    54→
    55→  const getVideoUrl = useCallback((video: TrainingDataVideo): string => {
    56→    if (invalidVideos.has(video.id)) {
    57→      return '';
    58→    }
    59→    return videoUrls[video.id] || '';
    60→  }, [videoUrls, invalidVideos]);
    61→
    62→  const markVideoAsInvalid = useCallback((videoId: string) => {
    63→    setInvalidVideos(prev => new Set([...prev, videoId]));
    64→  }, []);
    65→
    66→  const clearUrlCache = useCallback((videoId: string) => {
    67→    setVideoUrls(prev => {
    68→      const newUrls = { ...prev };
    69→      delete newUrls[videoId];
    70→      return newUrls;
    71→    });
    72→  }, []);
    73→
    74→  return {
    75→    getVideoUrl,
    76→    markVideoAsInvalid,
    77→    clearUrlCache,
    78→  };
    79→}
    80→

1→/**
     2→ * Pure business logic for clip management in the Join Clips tool.
     3→ *
     4→ * This service layer extracts non-React logic from useClipManager so the hook
     5→ * remains a thin reactive wrapper.  Every function here is side-effect-free
     6→ * with respect to React state (callers pass data in, get data out).
     7→ *

     9→ * preloading live in clipInitService.ts (same directory).
    10→ */

    13→import { uploadVideoToStorage } from '@/shared/lib/videoUploader';

    15→import { extractVideoPosterFrame, extractVideoFinalFrame } from '@/shared/utils/videoPosterExtractor';

    22→  getCachedClipsCount,

    24→  preloadPosterImages,
    25→  consumePendingJoinClips,
    26→  applyPendingClipActions,
    27→  buildInitialClipsFromSettings,
    28→  padClipsWithEmptySlots,
    29→  createEmptyClip,
    30→} from './clipInitService';
    31→
    32→export type { PendingClipAction } from './clipInitService';
    33→
    34→// Import createEmptyClip locally for use within this module
    35→import { createEmptyClip } from './clipInitService';
    36→
    37→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    38→// Persistence serialization
    39→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    40→
    41→export function buildClipsToSave(
    42→  clips: VideoClip[],
    43→): Array<{ url: string; posterUrl?: string; finalFrameUrl?: string; durationSeconds?: number }> {
    44→  return clips
    45→    .filter(clip => clip.url)
    46→    .map(clip => ({
    47→      url: clip.url,
    48→      posterUrl: clip.posterUrl,
    49→      finalFrameUrl: clip.finalFrameUrl,
    50→      durationSeconds: clip.durationSeconds,
    51→    }));
    52→}
    53→
    54→export function buildPromptsToSave(
    55→  clips: VideoClip[],
    56→  transitionPrompts: TransitionPrompt[],
    57→): Array<{ clipIndex: number; prompt: string }> {
    58→  return transitionPrompts
    59→    .map(tp => {
    60→      const clipIndex = clips.findIndex(c => c.id === tp.id);
    61→      if (clipIndex > 0 && tp.prompt) {
    62→        return { clipIndex, prompt: tp.prompt };
    63→      }
    64→      return null;
    65→    })
    66→    .filter((p): p is { clipIndex: number; prompt: string } => p !== null);
    67→}
    68→
    69→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    70→// Lazy-load metadata for clips missing duration
    71→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    72→
    73→export function getClipsNeedingDuration(clips: VideoClip[]): VideoClip[] {
    74→  return clips.filter(
    75→    clip => clip.url && clip.durationSeconds === undefined && !clip.metadataLoading,
    76→  );
    77→}
    78→
    79→export async function loadClipDuration(
    80→  clip: VideoClip,
    81→): Promise<{ id: string; durationSeconds: number }> {
    82→  try {
    83→    const metadata = await extractVideoMetadataFromUrl(clip.url);
    84→    return { id: clip.id, durationSeconds: metadata.duration_seconds };
    85→  } catch (error) {
    86→    handleError(error, {
    87→      context: 'JoinClipsPage',
    88→      showToast: false,
    89→      logData: { clipId: clip.id },
    90→    });
    91→    return { id: clip.id, durationSeconds: 0 };
    92→  }
    93→}
    94→
    95→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    96→// Ensure minimum clips / auto-add / trim trailing empties
    97→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    98→
    99→interface ClipNormalizationResult {
   100→  clips: VideoClip[];
   101→  removedClipIds: string[];
   102→}
   103→
   104→/**
   105→ * Normalize the clips array:
   106→ * - Ensure minimum 2 clips
   107→ * - Auto-add empty slot when all slots are filled
   108→ * - Remove extra trailing empties (keep exactly 1 trailing empty)
   109→ *
   110→ * Returns null if no changes are needed.
   111→ */
   112→export function normalizeClipSlots(clips: VideoClip[]): ClipNormalizationResult | null {
   113→  if (clips.length === 0) return null;
   114→
   115→  // Ensure minimum of 2
   116→  if (clips.length < 2) {
   117→    const clipsToAdd = 2 - clips.length;
   118→    const newClips = Array.from({ length: clipsToAdd }, () => createEmptyClip());
   119→    return { clips: [...clips, ...newClips], removedClipIds: [] };
   120→  }
   121→
   122→  // Auto-add empty slot when all filled
   123→  if (clips.every(clip => clip.url)) {
   124→    return {
   125→      clips: [...clips, createEmptyClip()],
   126→      removedClipIds: [],
   127→    };
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  // Find last non-empty clip
   131→  let lastNonEmptyIndex = -1;
   132→  for (let i = clips.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   133→    if (clips[i].url) {
   134→      lastNonEmptyIndex = i;
   135→      break;
   136→    }
   137→  }
   138→
   139→  const trailingEmptyCount = clips.length - lastNonEmptyIndex - 1;
   140→
   141→  if (trailingEmptyCount > 1) {
   142→    const targetLength = Math.max(2, lastNonEmptyIndex + 2);
   143→    if (clips.length !== targetLength) {
   144→      const removedClipIds = clips.slice(targetLength).map(c => c.id);
   145→      return { clips: clips.slice(0, targetLength), removedClipIds };
   146→    }
   147→  }
   148→
   149→  return null;
   150→}
   151→
   152→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   153→// Video duration extraction (from File)
   154→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   155→
   156→/** Create a throwaway <video> to read duration from a File (revokes the object URL). */
   157→function getVideoDurationFromFile(file: File): Promise<number> {
   158→  return new Promise<number>(resolve => {
   159→    const videoElement = document.createElement('video');
   160→    videoElement.preload = 'metadata';
   161→    videoElement.onloadedmetadata = () => {
   162→      resolve(videoElement.duration);
   163→      URL.revokeObjectURL(videoElement.src);
   164→    };
   165→    videoElement.onerror = () => {
   166→      resolve(0);
   167→      URL.revokeObjectURL(videoElement.src);
   168→    };
   169→    videoElement.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
   170→  });
   171→}
   172→
   173→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   174→// Video file upload
   175→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   176→
   177→interface UploadVideoResult {
   178→  videoUrl: string;
   179→  posterUrl: string;
   180→  finalFrameUrl: string;
   181→  durationSeconds: number;
   182→}
   183→
   184→export async function uploadClipVideo(
   185→  file: File,
   186→  projectId: string,
   187→  clipId: string,
   188→): Promise<UploadVideoResult> {
   189→  const [posterBlob, finalFrameBlob, durationSeconds] = await Promise.all([
   190→    extractVideoPosterFrame(file),
   191→    extractVideoFinalFrame(file),
   192→    getVideoDurationFromFile(file),
   193→  ]);
   194→
   195→  const [videoUrl, posterUrl, finalFrameUrl] = await Promise.all([
   196→    uploadVideoToStorage(file, projectId, clipId, {
   197→      maxRetries: 3,
   198→      timeoutMs: 300000,
   199→    }),
   200→    uploadBlobToStorage(posterBlob, 'poster.jpg', 'image/jpeg', {
   201→      maxRetries: 2,
   202→      timeoutMs: 30000,
   203→    }),
   204→    uploadBlobToStorage(finalFrameBlob, 'final-frame.jpg', 'image/jpeg', {
   205→      maxRetries: 2,
   206→      timeoutMs: 30000,
   207→    }),
   208→  ]);
   209→
   210→  return { videoUrl, posterUrl, finalFrameUrl, durationSeconds };
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   214→// Drag-end reorder
   215→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   216→
   217→interface ReorderResult {
   218→  clips: VideoClip[];
   219→  transitionPrompts: TransitionPrompt[];
   220→}
   221→
   222→export function reorderClipsAndPrompts(
   223→  clips: VideoClip[],
   224→  transitionPrompts: TransitionPrompt[],
   225→  activeId: string | number,
   226→  overId: string | number,
   227→): ReorderResult {
   228→  const oldIndex = clips.findIndex(clip => clip.id === activeId);
   229→  const newIndex = clips.findIndex(clip => clip.id === overId);
   230→
   231→  if (oldIndex === -1 || newIndex === -1) {
   232→    return { clips, transitionPrompts };
   233→  }
   234→
   235→  const newClips = arrayMove(clips, oldIndex, newIndex);
   236→
   237→  const newPrompts = transitionPrompts.map(prompt => {
   238→    const oldClipIndex = clips.findIndex(c => c.id === prompt.id);
   239→    if (oldClipIndex !== -1 && oldClipIndex > 0) {
   240→      const newClipIndex = newClips.findIndex(c => c.id === clips[oldClipIndex].id);
   241→      if (newClipIndex > 0) {
   242→        return { ...prompt, id: newClips[newClipIndex].id };
   243→      }
   244→    }
   245→    return prompt;
   246→  });
   247→
   248→  return { clips: newClips, transitionPrompts: newPrompts };
   249→}
   250→
   251→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   252→// Clip state update helpers
   253→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   254→
   255→/** Update a single clip in the array by ID. */
   256→export function updateClipInArray(
   257→  clips: VideoClip[],
   258→  clipId: string,
   259→  updates: Partial<VideoClip>,
   260→): VideoClip[] {
   261→  return clips.map(clip => (clip.id === clipId ? { ...clip, ...updates } : clip));
   262→}

   270→    finalFrameUrl: undefined,
   271→    file: undefined,
   272→    loaded: false,
   273→    playing: false,
   274→  };
   275→}

     4→ * This is the single source of truth for all edit settings types.
     5→ * Other files (ImageEditContext, inpainting/types, etc.) should import from here.
     6→ *

1→/**
     2→ * Join Clips Validation Utilities
     3→ *
     4→ * Calculates frame requirements and provides info for constraining
     5→ * UI sliders to prevent invalid settings.
     6→ *
     7→ * CONSTRAINT (to avoid double-blending artifacts in REPLACE mode):
     8→ *   min_clip_frames ≥ gap_frame_count + 2 × context_frame_count
     9→ *
    10→ * Examples:
    11→ * | gap_frame_count | context_frame_count | min_clip_frames |
    12→ * |-----------------|---------------------|-----------------|
    13→ * | 23              | 15                  | 53              |
    14→ * | 23              | 11                  | 45              |
    15→ * | 15              | 15                  | 45              |
    16→ * | 53              | 8                   | 69              |
    17→ */
    18→
    19→export interface ClipFrameInfo {
    20→  index: number;
    21→  name: string;
    22→  frameCount: number;
    23→  durationSeconds?: number;
    24→  source: 'metadata' | 'estimated' | 'unknown';
    25→}
    26→
    27→export interface ValidationResult {
    28→  valid: boolean;
    29→  shortestClipFrames: number;
    30→  maxSafeGap: number;
    31→  maxSafeContext: number;
    32→  /** Minimum frames required per clip based on current settings */
    33→  minClipFramesRequired: number;
    34→}
    35→
    36→/**
    37→ * Calculate minimum clip frames required based on the constraint:
    38→ *   min_clip_frames ≥ gap_frame_count + 2 × context_frame_count
    39→ *
    40→ * This applies to REPLACE mode to avoid double-blending artifacts.
    41→ * In INSERT mode, the constraint is simpler (just context frames).
    42→ */
    43→function calculateMinClipFramesRequired(
    44→  contextFrames: number,
    45→  gapFrames: number,
    46→  replaceMode: boolean
    47→): number {
    48→  if (!replaceMode) {
    49→    // INSERT mode - only need context frames from each clip
    50→    return contextFrames;
    51→  }
    52→  // REPLACE mode - need gap + 2*context to avoid double-blending
    53→  return gapFrames + 2 * contextFrames;
    54→}
    55→
    56→/**
    57→ * Get the minimum frames required from a clip based on its position
    58→ *
    59→ * In REPLACE mode:
    60→ * - First clip: needs contextFrames + ceil(gapFrames/2) from the END
    61→ * - Last clip: needs contextFrames + floor(gapFrames/2) from the START
    62→ * - Middle clips: need frames from BOTH ends for two transitions
    63→ *
    64→ * In INSERT mode:
    65→ * - Only need contextFrames (no frames are removed from source clips)
    66→ */
    67→function getMinFramesRequired(
    68→  contextFrames: number,
    69→  gapFrames: number,
    70→  replaceMode: boolean,
    71→  position: 'first' | 'middle' | 'last'
    72→): { fromStart: number; fromEnd: number; total: number } {
    73→  if (!replaceMode) {
    74→    // INSERT mode - only need context frames, clips aren't shortened
    75→    const needed = contextFrames;
    76→    switch (position) {
    77→      case 'first':
    78→        return { fromStart: 0, fromEnd: needed, total: needed };
    79→      case 'last':
    80→        return { fromStart: needed, fromEnd: 0, total: needed };
    81→      case 'middle':
    82→        return { fromStart: needed, fromEnd: needed, total: needed * 2 };
    83→    }
    84→  }
    85→
    86→  // REPLACE mode - use the new constraint formula
    87→  // Each clip needs at least: gap + 2*context total frames
    88→  const minRequired = calculateMinClipFramesRequired(contextFrames, gapFrames, replaceMode);
    89→
    90→  // For position-specific breakdown (used for visualization):
    91→  const gapFromFirst = Math.ceil(gapFrames / 2);
    92→  const gapFromSecond = Math.floor(gapFrames / 2);
    93→
    94→  switch (position) {
    95→    case 'first':
    96→      const firstEnd = contextFrames + gapFromFirst;
    97→      return { fromStart: 0, fromEnd: firstEnd, total: minRequired };
    98→    case 'last':
    99→      const lastStart = contextFrames + gapFromSecond;
   100→      return { fromStart: lastStart, fromEnd: 0, total: minRequired };
   101→    case 'middle':
   102→      const midStart = contextFrames + gapFromSecond;
   103→      const midEnd = contextFrames + gapFromFirst;
   104→      // Middle clips need frames for TWO transitions
   105→      return { fromStart: midStart, fromEnd: midEnd, total: minRequired * 2 };
   106→  }
   107→}
   108→
   109→/**
   110→ * Get clip position based on index and total count
   111→ */
   112→function getClipPosition(index: number, totalClips: number): 'first' | 'middle' | 'last' {
   113→  if (index === 0) return 'first';
   114→  if (index === totalClips - 1) return 'last';
   115→  return 'middle';
   116→}
   117→
   118→/**
   119→ * Calculate effective frame count based on duration and target FPS
   120→ */
   121→export function calculateEffectiveFrameCount(
   122→  durationSeconds: number,
   123→  useInputVideoFps: boolean,
   124→  inputVideoFps?: number
   125→): number {
   126→  // If using input video FPS, use that (or estimate 24fps for typical videos)
   127→  // Otherwise, default to 16fps which is what the backend uses
   128→  const targetFps = useInputVideoFps ? (inputVideoFps || 24) : 16;
   129→  return Math.floor(durationSeconds * targetFps);
   130→}
   131→
   132→/**
   133→ * Validate clips and calculate constraints for UI sliders.
   134→ * Returns shortestClipFrames which is used to limit slider max values.
   135→ *
   136→ * CONSTRAINT (REPLACE mode): min_clip_frames ≥ gap + 2 × context
   137→ * - max_gap = shortest_clip - 2 × context
   138→ * - max_context = (shortest_clip - gap) / 2
   139→ */
   140→export function validateClipsForJoin(
   141→  clipFrameInfos: ClipFrameInfo[],
   142→  contextFrameCount: number,
   143→  gapFrameCount: number,
   144→  replaceMode: boolean
   145→): ValidationResult {
   146→  const totalClips = clipFrameInfos.length;
   147→
   148→  if (totalClips < 2) {
   149→    return {
   150→      valid: false,
   151→      shortestClipFrames: 0,
   152→      maxSafeGap: 0,
   153→      maxSafeContext: 0,
   154→      minClipFramesRequired: 0,
   155→    };
   156→  }
   157→
   158→  // Find shortest clip
   159→  const shortestClipFrames = Math.min(...clipFrameInfos.map(c => c.frameCount));
   160→
   161→  // Calculate minimum frames required based on current settings
   162→  const minClipFramesRequired = calculateMinClipFramesRequired(
   163→    contextFrameCount,
   164→    gapFrameCount,
   165→    replaceMode
   166→  );
   167→
   168→  // Calculate max safe settings based on shortest clip
   169→  let maxSafeGap = 0;
   170→  let maxSafeContext = 0;
   171→
   172→  if (shortestClipFrames > 0) {
   173→    if (replaceMode) {
   174→      // CONSTRAINT: shortest_clip ≥ gap + 2*context
   175→      // Rearranged: max_gap = shortest_clip - 2*context
   176→      maxSafeGap = Math.max(1, shortestClipFrames - 2 * contextFrameCount);
   177→      // Quantize to valid 4N+1 value
   178→      maxSafeGap = Math.max(1, Math.floor((maxSafeGap - 1) / 4) * 4 + 1);
   179→
   180→      // max_context = (shortest_clip - gap) / 2
   181→      maxSafeContext = Math.max(4, Math.floor((shortestClipFrames - gapFrameCount) / 2));
   182→    } else {
   183→      // INSERT mode - gap doesn't affect clip length requirements
   184→      maxSafeGap = 81;
   185→      maxSafeContext = shortestClipFrames;
   186→    }
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  // Check if current settings are valid
   190→  const valid = clipFrameInfos.every((clip) => {
   191→    const position = getClipPosition(clip.index, totalClips);
   192→    const required = getMinFramesRequired(contextFrameCount, gapFrameCount, replaceMode, position);
   193→    return clip.frameCount >= required.total;
   194→  });
   195→
   196→  return {
   197→    valid,
   198→    shortestClipFrames,
   199→    maxSafeGap,
   200→    maxSafeContext,
   201→    minClipFramesRequired,
   202→  };
   203→}
   204→
   205→
   206→
   207→
   208→
   209→
   210→
   211→
   212→

1→/**
     2→ * Clip initialization and pending-clip consumption for the Join Clips tool.
     3→ *
     4→ * Extracted from clipManagerService to isolate:
     5→ * - localStorage cache helpers (skeleton sizing)
     6→ * - Poster preloading
     7→ * - Video duration extraction from URLs
     8→ * - Pending join clips (lightbox "Add to Join" localStorage polling)
     9→ * - Building initial clips from persisted settings
    10→ * - Padding clips with empty slots
    11→ */
    12→
    13→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';

    15→import type { VideoClip, TransitionPrompt } from '../types';

    17→
    18→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    19→// Empty clip factory (canonical location — re-exported by clipManagerService)
    20→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    21→
    22→export function createEmptyClip(): VideoClip {
    23→  return { id: generateUUID(), url: '', loaded: false, playing: false };
    24→}
    25→
    26→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    27→// localStorage cache helpers (skeleton sizing)
    28→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    29→
    30→function getLocalStorageKey(projectId: string): string {
    31→  return `join-clips-count-${projectId}`;
    32→}
    33→
    34→export function getCachedClipsCount(projectId: string | null): number {
    35→  if (!projectId) return 0;
    36→  try {
    37→    const cached = localStorage.getItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId));
    38→    return cached ? parseInt(cached, 10) : 0;
    39→  } catch {
    40→    return 0;
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→
    44→export function setCachedClipsCount(projectId: string | null, count: number): void {
    45→  if (!projectId) return;
    46→  try {
    47→    if (count > 0) {
    48→      localStorage.setItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId), count.toString());
    49→    } else {
    50→      localStorage.removeItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId));
    51→    }
    52→  } catch {
    53→    // Ignore localStorage errors
    54→  }
    55→}
    56→
    57→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    58→// Poster preloading
    59→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    60→
    61→/**
    62→ * Warm the browser image cache for the given poster URLs.
    63→ * Returns a promise that resolves when all images have loaded (or errored).
    64→ */
    65→export function preloadPosterImages(
    66→  posterUrls: string[],
    67→  alreadyPreloaded: Set<string>,
    68→): Promise<void[]> {
    69→  const promises = posterUrls
    70→    .filter(url => url && !alreadyPreloaded.has(url))
    71→    .map(
    72→      url =>
    73→        new Promise<void>(resolve => {
    74→          const img = new Image();
    75→          img.onload = () => {
    76→            alreadyPreloaded.add(url);
    77→            resolve();
    78→          };
    79→          img.onerror = () => resolve();
    80→          img.src = url;
    81→        }),
    82→    );
    83→  return Promise.all(promises);
    84→}
    85→
    86→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    87→// Video duration extraction
    88→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    89→
    90→/** Create a throwaway <video> to read duration from a URL. */
    91→function getVideoDurationFromUrl(videoUrl: string): Promise<number> {
    92→  return new Promise<number>(resolve => {
    93→    const videoElement = document.createElement('video');
    94→    videoElement.preload = 'metadata';
    95→    videoElement.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(videoElement.duration);
    96→    videoElement.onerror = () => resolve(0);
    97→    videoElement.src = videoUrl;
    98→  });
    99→}
   100→
   101→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   102→// Pending join clips (lightbox "Add to Join" localStorage polling)
   103→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   104→
   105→interface PendingJoinClipEntry {
   106→  videoUrl: string;
   107→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
   108→  generationId: string;
   109→  timestamp: number;
   110→}
   111→
   112→const [REDACTED];
   113→const PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
   114→
   115→/**
   116→ * Reads and consumes pending join clips from localStorage.
   117→ * Returns an array of new/updated clip data to merge into state.
   118→ *
   119→ * Each result item is either:
   120→ * - `{ type: 'fill', clip }` -- fill the first empty slot
   121→ * - `{ type: 'append', clip }` -- append as a new clip
   122→ */
   123→export interface PendingClipAction {
   124→  type: 'fill' | 'append';
   125→  clip: VideoClip;
   126→}
   127→
   128→export async function consumePendingJoinClips(): Promise<PendingClipAction[]> {
   129→  try {
   130→    const pendingData = localStorage.getItem(PENDING_CLIPS_KEY);
   131→    if (!pendingData) return [];
   132→
   133→    const pendingClips: PendingJoinClipEntry[] = JSON.parse(pendingData);
   134→    const now = Date.now();
   135→    const recentClips = pendingClips.filter(
   136→      clip => now - clip.timestamp < PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS,
   137→    );
   138→
   139→    if (recentClips.length === 0) {
   140→      localStorage.removeItem(PENDING_CLIPS_KEY);
   141→      return [];
   142→    }
   143→
   144→    const actions: PendingClipAction[] = [];
   145→    // Track how many empty slots we've "used" so far across iterations
   146→    let filledCount = 0;
   147→
   148→    for (const { videoUrl, thumbnailUrl, generationId } of recentClips) {
   149→      if (!videoUrl) continue;
   150→
   151→      const durationSeconds = await getVideoDurationFromUrl(videoUrl);
   152→
   153→      const clip: VideoClip = {
   154→        id: generateUUID(),
   155→        url: videoUrl,
   156→        posterUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   157→        durationSeconds,
   158→        loaded: false,
   159→        playing: false,
   160→        generationId,
   161→      };
   162→
   163→      // We'll mark as 'fill' and let the caller decide ordering
   164→      // (the hook applies fills to first empty slot, then appends)
   165→      actions.push({ type: filledCount === 0 ? 'fill' : 'append', clip });
   166→      filledCount++;
   167→    }
   168→
   169→    localStorage.removeItem(PENDING_CLIPS_KEY);
   170→    return actions;
   171→  } catch (error) {
   172→    handleError(error, { context: 'JoinClipsPage', showToast: false });
   173→    return [];
   174→  }
   175→}
   176→
   177→/**
   178→ * Apply pending clip actions to an existing clips array.
   179→ * Reproduces the exact same merge logic from the original hook:
   180→ * each action fills the first available empty slot, or appends.
   181→ */
   182→export function applyPendingClipActions(
   183→  prevClips: VideoClip[],
   184→  actions: PendingClipAction[],
   185→): VideoClip[] {
   186→  let clips = [...prevClips];
   187→  // Track which indices have been filled by previous actions in this batch
   188→  const filledIndices = new Set<number>();
   189→
   190→  for (const action of actions) {
   191→    const emptyIndex = clips.findIndex(
   192→      (clip, idx) => !clip.url && !filledIndices.has(idx),
   193→    );
   194→
   195→    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
   196→      clips = clips.map((clip, idx) =>
   197→        idx === emptyIndex
   198→          ? {
   199→              ...clip,
   200→              url: action.clip.url,
   201→              posterUrl: action.clip.posterUrl,
   202→              durationSeconds: action.clip.durationSeconds,
   203→              loaded: false,
   204→              playing: false,
   205→              generationId: action.clip.generationId,
   206→            }
   207→          : clip,
   208→      );
   209→      filledIndices.add(emptyIndex);
   210→    } else {
   211→      clips = [...clips, action.clip];
   212→    }
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  return clips;
   216→}
   217→
   218→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   219→// Build initial clips from persisted settings
   220→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   221→
   222→interface InitialClipsResult {
   223→  clips: VideoClip[];
   224→  transitionPrompts: TransitionPrompt[];
   225→  posterUrlsToPreload: string[];
   226→}
   227→
   228→export function buildInitialClipsFromSettings(
   229→  settings: JoinClipsSettings,
   230→): InitialClipsResult {
   231→  const initialClips: VideoClip[] = [];
   232→  const posterUrlsToPreload: string[] = [];
   233→  let transitionPrompts: TransitionPrompt[] = [];
   234→
   235→  // Try loading from new multi-clip format
   236→  if (settings.clips && settings.clips.length > 0) {
   237→    settings.clips.forEach(clip => {
   238→      if (clip.url) {
   239→        initialClips.push({
   240→          id: generateUUID(),
   241→          url: clip.url,
   242→          posterUrl: clip.posterUrl,
   243→          finalFrameUrl: clip.finalFrameUrl,
   244→          durationSeconds: clip.durationSeconds,
   245→          loaded: false,
   246→          playing: false,
   247→        });
   248→        if (clip.posterUrl) posterUrlsToPreload.push(clip.posterUrl);
   249→      }
   250→    });
   251→
   252→    // Load transition prompts
   253→    if (settings.transitionPrompts && settings.transitionPrompts.length > 0) {
   254→      transitionPrompts = settings.transitionPrompts
   255→        .map(tp => ({
   256→          id: initialClips[tp.clipIndex]?.id || '',
   257→          prompt: tp.prompt,
   258→        }))
   259→        .filter(p => p.id);
   260→    }
   261→  }
   262→  // Fallback to legacy two-video format
   263→  else if (settings.startingVideoUrl || settings.endingVideoUrl) {
   264→    if (settings.startingVideoUrl) {
   265→      initialClips.push({
   266→        id: generateUUID(),
   267→        url: settings.startingVideoUrl,
   268→        posterUrl: settings.startingVideoPosterUrl,
   269→        loaded: false,
   270→        playing: false,
   271→      });
   272→      if (settings.startingVideoPosterUrl) {
   273→        posterUrlsToPreload.push(settings.startingVideoPosterUrl);
   274→      }
   275→    }
   276→
   277→    if (settings.endingVideoUrl) {
   278→      initialClips.push({
   279→        id: generateUUID(),
   280→        url: settings.endingVideoUrl,
   281→        posterUrl: settings.endingVideoPosterUrl,
   282→        loaded: false,
   283→        playing: false,
   284→      });
   285→      if (settings.endingVideoPosterUrl) {
   286→        posterUrlsToPreload.push(settings.endingVideoPosterUrl);
   287→      }
   288→    }
   289→
   290→    // Initialize transition prompts from legacy format
   291→    // The `prompt` field existed in an older settings schema and may still
   292→    // be present in persisted data even though it's not in the current type.
   293→    const legacyPrompt = (settings as JoinClipsSettings & { prompt?: string }).prompt;
   294→    if (initialClips.length >= 2 && legacyPrompt) {
   295→      transitionPrompts = [
   296→        {
   297→          id: initialClips[1].id,
   298→          prompt: legacyPrompt,
   299→        },
   300→      ];
   301→    }
   302→  }
   303→
   304→  return { clips: initialClips, transitionPrompts, posterUrlsToPreload };
   305→}
   306→
   307→/**
   308→ * Pad initialClips to have at least 2 slots plus one trailing empty slot.
   309→ * This matches the original hook behavior exactly.
   310→ */
   311→export function padClipsWithEmptySlots(initialClips: VideoClip[]): VideoClip[] {
   312→  if (initialClips.length === 0) {
   313→    return [createEmptyClip(), createEmptyClip()];
   314→  }
   315→
   316→  if (initialClips.length < 2) {
   317→    const clipsToAdd = 2 - initialClips.length;
   318→    const emptyClips = Array.from({ length: clipsToAdd }, () => createEmptyClip());
   319→    return [...initialClips, ...emptyClips];
   320→  }
   321→
   322→  // >= 2 clips: add one trailing empty slot
   323→  return [...initialClips, createEmptyClip()];
   324→}

expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('transitions to submitting on trigger', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSubmitButtonState());\n\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.trigger();\n    });\n\n    expect(result.current.state).toBe('submitting');\n    expect(result.current.isSubmitting).toBe(true);\n    expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('transitions to success after submitting duration', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSubmitButtonState());\n\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.trigger();\n    });\n\n    act(() => {\n      vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000); // Default submittingDuration\n    });\n\n    expect(result.current.state).toBe('success');\n act(() => {\n      vi.advanceTimersByTime(2000); // success -> idle\n    });\n\n    expect(result.current.state).toBe('idle');\n    expect(result.current.isSubmitting).toBe(false);\n    expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('respects custom durations', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() =>\n      useSubmitButtonState({ submittingDuration: 500, expect(result.current.state).toBe('submitting');\n\n    // Success at 500ms\n    act(() => {\n      vi.advanceTimersByTime(1);\n    });\n    expect(result.current.state).toBe('success');\n\n    // tasks', () => {\n      render(\n        <IncomingTasksProvider>\n          <IncomingTasksConsumer />\n        </IncomingTasksProvider>\n      );\n\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('taskCount')).toHaveTextContent('0');\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('hasIncoming')).toHaveTextContent('false');\n    });\n\n    it('can add incoming tasks', () => {\n      render(\n        <IncomingTasksProvider>\n          <IncomingTasksConsumer />\n        </IncomingTasksProvider>\n      );\n\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('addTask').click();\n      });\n\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('taskCount')).toHaveTextContent('1');\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('hasIncoming')).toHaveTextContent('true');\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('tasks')).toHaveTextContent('Test prompt');\n    });\n\n    it('prepends new tasks (most recent first)', () => {\n      render(\n        <IncomingTasksProvider>\n          <IncomingTasksConsumer />\n        </IncomingTasksProvider>\n      );\n\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('addTask').click();\n      });\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('addSecondTask').click();\n      });\n\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('taskCount')).toHaveTextContent('2');\n      // Second task should be first in the array\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('tasks')).toHaveTextContent('[\"Travel video\",\"Test prompt\"]');\n    });\n\n    it('can remove incoming tasks', () => {\n      let taskId: string | null = null;\n\n      function RemoveConsumer() {\n        const { incomingTasks, addIncomingTask, removeIncomingTask } = useIncomingTasks();\n        return (\n          <div>\n            <span data-testid=\"taskCount\">{incomingTasks.length}</span>\n            <button\n              data-testid=\"add\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                taskId = addIncomingTask({\n                  taskType: 'test',\n                  label: 'Test',\n                });\n              }}\n            >\n              Add\n            </button>\n            <button\n              data-testid=\"remove\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                if (taskId) removeIncomingTask(taskId);\n              }}\n            >\n              Remove\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        );\n      }\n\n      render(\n        <IncomingTasksProvider>\n          <RemoveConsumer />\n        </IncomingTasksProvider>\n      );\n\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('add').click();\n      });\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('taskCount')).toHaveTextContent('1');\n\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('remove').click();\n      });\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('taskCount')).toHaveTextContent('0');\n    });\n\n    it('completeIncomingTask removes the task and updates baselines', () => {\n      let firstTaskId: string | null = null;\n\n      function CompleteConsumer() {\n        const { incomingTasks, addIncomingTask, completeIncomingTask } = useIncomingTasks();\n        return (\n          <div>\n            <span data-testid=\"taskCount\">{incomingTasks.length}</span>\n            <span data-testid=\"baselines\">\n              {JSON.stringify(incomingTasks.map(t => t.baselineCount))}\n            </span>\n            <button\n              data-testid=\"addFirst\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                firstTaskId = addIncomingTask({\n                  taskType: 'test',\n                  label: 'First',\n                  baselineCount: 5,\n                });\n              }}\n            >\n              Add First\n            </button>\n            <button\n              data-testid=\"addSecond\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                addIncomingTask({\n                  taskType: 'test',\n                  label: 'Second',\n                  baselineCount: 5,\n                });\n              }}\n            >\n              Add Second\n            </button>\n            <button\n              data-testid=\"complete\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                if (firstTaskId) completeIncomingTask(firstTaskId, 10);\n              }}\n            >\n              Complete\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        );\n      }\n\n      render(\n        <IncomingTasksProvider>\n          <CompleteConsumer />\n        </IncomingTasksProvider>\n      );\n\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('addFirst').click();\n      });\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('addSecond').click();\n      });\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('taskCount')).toHaveTextContent('2');\n\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('complete').click();\n      });\n\n      // First task removed, second task baseline updated\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('taskCount')).toHaveTextContent('1');\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('baselines')).toHaveTextContent('[10]');\n    });\n\n    it('addIncomingTask returns a unique ID', () => {\n      const ids: string[] = [];\n\n      function IdConsumer() {\n        const { addIncomingTask } = useIncomingTasks();\n        return (\n          <button\n            data-testid=\"add\"\n            onClick={() => {\n              ids.push(\n                addIncomingTask({ taskType: 'test', label: 'Task' })\n              );\n            }}\n          >\n            Add\n          </button>\n        );\n      }\n\n      render(\n        <IncomingTasksProvider>\n          <IdConsumer />\n        </IncomingTasksProvider>\n      );\n\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('add').click();\n      });\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('add').click();\n      });\n\n      expect(ids).toHaveLength(2);\n      expect(ids[0]).not.toBe(ids[1]);\n      expect(ids[0]).toMatch(/^incoming-/);\n    });\n  });\n});\n"
}

  "content": "import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';\nimport { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';\nimport { useFileDragTracking, preventDefaultDragOver, createSingleFileDropHandler } from '../useFileDragTracking';\n\nvi.mock('@/shared/components/ui/sonner', () => ({\n  toast: { error: vi.fn() },\n}));\n\nfunction makeDragEvent(types: string[]): React.DragEvent {\n  return {\n    preventDefault: vi.fn(),\n    stopPropagation: vi.fn(),\n    dataTransfer: {\n      types,\n      files: [],\n    },\n  } as unknown as React.DragEvent;\n}\n\ndescribe('useFileDragTracking', () => {\n  it('starts with isDraggingOver false and no matchedType', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFileDragTracking());\n    expect(result.current.isDraggingOver).toBe(false);\n    expect(result.current.matchedType).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('sets isDraggingOver on drag enter with matching type', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFileDragTracking(['Files']));\n    const event = makeDragEvent(['Files']);\n\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.handleDragEnter(event);\n    });\n\n    expect(result.current.isDraggingOver).toBe(true);\n    expect(result.current.matchedType).toBe('Files');\n    expect(event.preventDefault).toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(event.stopPropagation).toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('does not set isDraggingOver for non-matching types', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFileDragTracking(['Files']));\n    const event = makeDragEvent(['text/plain']);\n\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.handleDragEnter(event);\n    });\n\n    expect(result.current.isDraggingOver).toBe(false);\n    expect(result.current.matchedType).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('handles nested drag enter/leave with counter', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFileDragTracking());\n\n    const enterEvent = makeDragEvent(['Files']);\n    const leaveEvent = makeDragEvent([]);\n\n    // Enter parent\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.handleDragEnter(enterEvent);\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isDraggingOver).toBe(true);\n\n    // Enter child (nested)\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.handleDragEnter(enterEvent);\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isDraggingOver).toBe(true);\n\n    // Leave child\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.handleDragLeave(leaveEvent);\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isDraggingOver).toBe(true); // Still dragging, counter > 0\n\n    // Leave parent\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.handleDragLeave(leaveEvent);\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isDraggingOver).toBe(false); // Counter reached 0\n  });\n\n  it('resetDrag clears all state', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFileDragTracking());\n    const event = makeDragEvent(['Files']);\n\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.handleDragEnter(event);\n      result.current.handleDragEnter(event);\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isDraggingOver).toBe(true);\n\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.resetDrag();\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isDraggingOver).toBe(false);\n    expect(result.current.matchedType).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('supports custom accepted types', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useFileDragTracking(['text/plain', 'text/html']));\n\n    const event = makeDragEvent(['text/plain']);\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.handleDragEnter(event);\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isDraggingOver).toBe(true);\n    expect(result.current.matchedType).toBe('text/plain');\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('preventDefaultDragOver', () => {\n  it('prevents default and stops propagation', () => {\n    const event = makeDragEvent([]);\n    preventDefaultDragOver(event);\n    expect(event.preventDefault).toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(event.stopPropagation).toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('createSingleFileDropHandler', () => {\n  it('calls upload for valid file type', async () => {\n    const resetDrag = vi.fn();\n    const upload = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ url: 'test.jpg' });\n    const onResult = vi.fn();\n    const execute = vi.fn().mockImplementation(async (fn) => fn());\n\n    const handler = createSingleFileDropHandler({\n      mimePrefix: 'image/',\n      mimeErrorMessage: 'Please drop an image file',\n      resetDrag,\n      getProjectId: () => 'project-1',\n      upload,\n      onResult,\n      context: 'test',\n      toastTitle: 'Upload failed',\n      uploadOperation: { execute },\n    });\n\n    const file = new File(['data'], 'photo.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });\n    const event = {\n      preventDefault: vi.fn(),\n      stopPropagation: vi.fn(),\n      dataTransfer: { files: [file] },\n    } as unknown as React.DragEvent;\n\n    await handler(event);\n\n    expect(resetDrag).toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(execute).toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('shows error toast for wrong file type', async () => {\n    const { toast } = await import('@/shared/components/ui/sonner');\n    const resetDrag = vi.fn();\n\n    const handler = createSingleFileDropHandler({\n      mimePrefix: 'image/',\n      mimeErrorMessage: 'Please drop an image file',\n      resetDrag,\n      getProjectId: () => 'project-1',\n      upload: vi.fn(),\n      onResult: vi.fn(),\n      context: 'test',\n      toastTitle: 'Upload failed',\n      uploadOperation: { execute: vi.fn() },\n    });\n\n    const file = new File(['data'], 'doc.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' });\n    const event = {\n      preventDefault: vi.fn(),\n      stopPropagation: vi.fn(),\n      dataTransfer: { files: [file] },\n    } as unknown as React.DragEvent;\n\n    await handler(event);\n    expect(toast.error).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Please drop an image file');\n  });\n});\n"
}

expect(mockCreateTask).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);\n    // processBatchResults is called, returns the first task_id\n    expect(mockProcessBatchResults).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();\n   "content": "import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest';\nimport { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';\nimport { useLightboxOpen } from '../useLightboxOpen';\n\ndescribe('useLightboxOpen', () => {\n  afterEach(() => {\n    document.documentElement.classList.remove('lightbox-open');\n  });\n\n  it('returns false when lightbox-open class is absent', () => {\n    document.documentElement.classList.remove('lightbox-open');\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useLightboxOpen());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('returns true when lightbox-open class is present on init', () => {\n    document.documentElement.classList.add('lightbox-open');\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useLightboxOpen());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('reacts when lightbox-open class is added', async () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useLightboxOpen());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n\n    await act(async () => {\n      document.documentElement.classList.add('lightbox-open');\n      // MutationObserver fires asynchronously\n      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));\n    });\n    expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('reacts when lightbox-open class is removed', async () => {\n    document.documentElement.classList.add('lightbox-open');\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useLightboxOpen());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n\n    await act(async () => {\n      document.documentElement.classList.remove('lightbox-open');\n      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));\n    });\n    expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('disconnects observer on unmount', () => {\n    const disconnectSpy = vi.fn();\n    const originalMutationObserver = global.MutationObserver;\n\n    global.MutationObserver = vi.fn().mockImplementation(() => ({\n      observe: vi.fn(),\n      disconnect: disconnectSpy,\n    })) as unknown as typeof MutationObserver;\n\n    const { unmount } = renderHook(() => useLightboxOpen());\n    unmount();\n\n    expect(disconnectSpy).toHaveBeenCalled();\n    global.MutationObserver = originalMutationObserver;\n  });\n});\n"
}

  "content": "import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';\nimport { debugConfig } from '../debugConfig';\n\ndescribe('debugConfig', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    // Reset to a known state before each test\n    debugConfig.disableAll();\n  });\n\n  describe('isEnabled / enable / disable', () => {\n    it('returns false for disabled categories', () => {\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('reactProfiler')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('dragDebug')).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('enables a specific category', () => {\n      debugConfig.enable('dragDebug');\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('dragDebug')).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('disables a specific category', () => {\n      debugConfig.enable('dragDebug');\n      debugConfig.disable('dragDebug');\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('dragDebug')).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('enable does not affect other categories', () => {\n      debugConfig.enable('videoDebug');\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('videoDebug')).toBe(true);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('dragDebug')).toBe(false);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('enableAll / disableAll', () => {\n    it('enableAll turns on all categories', () => {\n      debugConfig.enableAll();\n\n      const config = debugConfig.getConfig();\n      for (const key of Object.keys(config)) {\n        expect(config[key as keyof typeof config]).toBe(true);\n      }\n    });\n\n    it('disableAll turns off all categories', () => {\n      debugConfig.enableAll();\n      debugConfig.disableAll();\n\n      const config = debugConfig.getConfig();\n      for (const key of Object.keys(config)) {\n        expect(config[key as keyof typeof config]).toBe(false);\n      }\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('setQuietMode', () => {\n    it('disables noisy categories', () => {\n      debugConfig.enableAll();\n      debugConfig.setQuietMode();\n\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('reactProfiler')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('renderLogging')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('progressiveImage')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('imageLoading')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('shotImageDebug')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('autoplayDebugger')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('dragDebug')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('skeletonDebug')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('videoDebug')).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('preserves categories not listed in quiet mode (e.g. realtimeDebug)', () => {\n      debugConfig.enableAll();\n      debugConfig.setQuietMode();\n\n      // realtimeDebug and reconnectionDebug are NOT overridden in setQuietMode\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('realtimeDebug')).toBe(true);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('reconnectionDebug')).toBe(true);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('devMode')).toBe(true);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('setDevelopmentMode', () => {\n    it('enables development-useful categories', () => {\n      debugConfig.disableAll();\n      debugConfig.setDevelopmentMode();\n\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('renderLogging')).toBe(true);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('imageLoading')).toBe(true);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('shotImageDebug')).toBe(true);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('tasksPaneDebug')).toBe(true);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('dragDebug')).toBe(true);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('skeletonDebug')).toBe(true);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('videoDebug')).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('keeps noisy categories disabled in dev mode', () => {\n      debugConfig.disableAll();\n      debugConfig.setDevelopmentMode();\n\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('reactProfiler')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('progressiveImage')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('autoplayDebugger')).toBe(false);\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('galleryPollingDebug')).toBe(false);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('getConfig', () => {\n    it('returns a copy of the current config', () => {\n      debugConfig.enable('videoDebug');\n      const config = debugConfig.getConfig();\n\n      expect(config.videoDebug).toBe(true);\n\n      // Mutating the returned object should not affect internal state\n      config.videoDebug = false;\n      expect(debugConfig.isEnabled('videoDebug')).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('returns all known keys', () => {\n      const config = debugConfig.getConfig();\n      const expectedKeys = [\n        'reactProfiler',\n        'renderLogging',\n        'progressiveImage',\n        'imageLoading',\n        'shotImageDebug',\n        'autoplayDebugger',\n        'tasksPaneDebug',\n        'galleryPollingDebug',\n        'dragDebug',\n        'skeletonDebug',\n        'videoDebug',\n        'realtimeDebug',\n        'reconnectionDebug',\n        'devMode',\n      ];\n\n      for (const key of expectedKeys) {\n        expect(config).toHaveProperty(key);\n      }\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('status', () => {\n    it('logs config state to console without throwing', () => {\n      // Just verify it doesn't throw\n      expect(() => debugConfig.status()).not.toThrow();\n    });\n  defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false, gcTime: 0 } },\n    });\n  });\n\n  // Helper to create a minimal shot\n  const createShot = (id: string, position = 0): Shot =>\n    ({\n      id,\n      name: `Shot ${id}`,\n      position,\n      project_id: projectId,\n      images: [],\n    } as unknown as Shot);\n\n  // Helper to create a minimal generation row\n  const createGenerationRow = (id: string, frame: number | null = 0): GenerationRow =>\n    ({\n      id,\n      generation_id: `gen-${id}`,\n      timeline_frame: frame,\n      location: 'https://example.com/image.png',\n    } as unknown as GenerationRow);\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // updateAllShotsCaches\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  describe('updateAllShotsCaches', () => {\n    it('creates cache entries for all variants when they do not exist', () => {\n      const shots = [createShot('shot-1'), createShot('shot-2')];\n      updateAllShotsCaches(queryClient, projectId, () => shots);\n\n      // Check the base key variant\n      const baseData = queryClient.getQueryData<Shot[]>([...queryKeys.shots.all, projectId]);\n      expect(baseData).toEqual(shots);\n\n      // Check specific variant (maxImages=0)\n      const variant0 = queryClient.getQueryData<Shot[]>(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0));\n      expect(variant0).toEqual(shots);\n    });\n\n    it('updates existing cache entries', () => {\n      const initialShots = [createShot('shot-1')];\n      // Pre-populate one cache variant\n      queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0), initialShots);\n\n      const updatedShots = [createShot('shot-1'), createShot('shot-2')];\n      updateAllShotsCaches(queryClient, projectId, () => updatedShots);\n\n      const result = queryClient.getQueryData<Shot[]>(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0));\n      expect(result).toEqual(updatedShots);\n    });\n\n    it('respects onlyExisting flag', () => {\n      // Only populate one variant\n      const initialShots = [createShot('shot-1')];\n      queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0), initialShots);\n\n      const updatedShots = [createShot('shot-1'), createShot('shot-2')];\n      updateAllShotsCaches(queryClient, projectId, () => updatedShots, true);\n\n      // The populated variant should be updated\n      const populatedResult = queryClient.getQueryData<Shot[]>(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0));\n      expect(populatedResult).toEqual(updatedShots);\n\n      // Unpopulated variants should remain undefined\n      const unpopulatedResult = queryClient.getQueryData<Shot[]>(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 2));\n      expect(unpopulatedResult).toBeUndefined();\n    });\n\n    it('passes old data to updater function', () => {\n      const return [...(old || []), createShot('shot-2')];\n      });\n\n      const result = queryClient.getQueryData<Shot[]>(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0));\n      expect(result).toHaveLength(2);\n      expect(result![0].id).toBe('shot-1');\n      expect(result![1].id).toBe('shot-2');\n    });\n  });\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // rollbackShotsCaches\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  describe('rollbackShotsCaches', () => {\n    it('restores all cache variants to previous state', () => {\n      const previousShots = [createShot('shot-1')];\n      const currentShots = [createShot('shot-1'), createShot('shot-2')];\n\n      // Set current state\n      updateAllShotsCaches(queryClient, projectId, () => currentShots);\n\n      // Rollback\n      rollbackShotsCaches(queryClient, projectId, previousShots);\n\n      const result = queryClient.getQueryData<Shot[]>(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0));\n      expect(result).toEqual(previousShots);\n    });\n\n    it('does nothing when previous is undefined', () => {\n      const ============================================================================\n  // findShotsCache\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  describe('findShotsCache', () => {\n    it('returns the first non-empty cache', () => {\n      const shots = [createShot('shot-1')];\n      // Only populate one variant\n      queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 2), shots);\n\n      const result = findShotsCache(queryClient, projectId);\n      expect(result).toEqual(shots);\n    });\n\n    it('returns undefined when no cache has data', () => {\n      const result = findShotsCache(queryClient, projectId);\n      expect(result).toBeUndefined();\n    });\n\n    it('skips empty arrays', () => {\n const result = findShotsCache(queryClient, projectId);\n      expect(result).toEqual(shots);\n    });\n  });\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // cancelShotsQueries\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  describe('cancelShotsQueries', () => {\n    it('does not throw', async () => {\n      await expect(cancelShotsQueries(queryClient, projectId)).resolves.not.toThrow();\n    });\n  });\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // rollbackShotGenerationsCache\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  describe('rollbackShotGenerationsCache', () => {\n    const shotId = 'shot-1';\n\n    it('restores shot-generations cache to previous state', () => {\n      const previous = [createGenerationRow('sg-1', 0), createGenerationRow('sg-2', 50)];\n      const current = [createGenerationRow('sg-1', 0)]; // missing sg-2\n\n      queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), current);\n      rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, shotId, expect(result).toEqual(current);\n    });\n  });\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // cancelShotGenerationsQuery\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  describe('cancelShotGenerationsQuery', () => {\n    it('does not throw', async () => {\n      await '../AIInputModeContext';\n\n// Test consumer component\nfunction AIInputConsumer() {\n  const { mode, setMode, isLoading } = useAIInputMode();\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <span data-testid=\"mode\">{mode}</span>\n      <span data-testid=\"isLoading\">{String(isLoading)}</span>\n      <button data-testid=\"setText\" onClick={() => setMode('text')}>\n        Text\n      </button>\n      <button data-testid=\"setVoice\" onClick={() => setMode('voice')}>\n        Voice\n      </button>\n      <button data-testid=\"setNone\" onClick={() => setMode('none')}>\n        None\n      </button>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\ndescribe('AIInputModeContext', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    vi.clearAllMocks();\n  });\n\n  describe('useAIInputMode hook', () => {\n    it('returns default values when used outside provider (graceful fallback)', () => {\n      function FallbackConsumer() {\n        const { mode, isLoading } = useAIInputMode();\n        return (\n          <div>\n            <span data-testid=\"mode\">{mode}</span>\n            <span data-testid=\"isLoading\">{String(isLoading)}</span>\n          </div>\n        );\n      }\n\n      render(<FallbackConsumer />);\n\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('mode')).toHaveTextContent('voice');\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('isLoading')).toHaveTextContent('false');\n    });\n\n    it('graceful fallback setMode is         Set\n          </button>\n        );\n      }\n\n      render(<FallbackConsumer />);\n\n      // Should not throw\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('setMode').click();\n      });\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('AIInputModeProvider', () => {\n    it('renders children', () => {\n      render(\n        <AIInputModeProvider>\n          <div data-testid=\"child\">Hello</div>\n        </AIInputModeProvider>\n      );\n\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('child')).toHaveTextContent('Hello');\n    });\n\n    it('provides mode from user settings', () => {\n      render(\n        <AIInputModeProvider>\n          <AIInputConsumer />\n        </AIInputModeProvider>\n      );\n\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('mode')).toHaveTextContent('voice');\n      expect(screen.getByTestId('isLoading')).toHaveTextContent('false');\n    });\n\n    it('calls update when setMode is invoked', () => {\n      render(\n        <AIInputModeProvider>\n          <AIInputConsumer />\n        </AIInputModeProvider>\n      );\n\n      act(() => {\n        screen.getByTestId('setText').click();\n      });\n\n      expect(mockUpdate).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ mode: 'text' });\n    });\n  });\n});\n"
