  "content": "import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';\nimport { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';\nimport { isMobileUA, useIsMobile, useIsTablet, useIsTouchDevice, useDeviceInfo } from '../use-mobile';\n\n// Store original globals\nconst originalMatchMedia = window.matchMedia;\nconst originalInnerWidth = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window, 'innerWidth');\nconst originalInnerHeight = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window, 'innerHeight');\nconst originalUserAgent = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(navigator, 'userAgent');\nconst originalPlatform = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(navigator, 'platform');\nconst originalMaxTouchPoints = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(navigator, 'maxTouchPoints');\n\nfunction setWindowSize(width: number, height: number = 800) {\n  Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', { value: width, configurable: true, writable: true });\n  Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerHeight', { value: height, configurable: true, writable: true });\n}\n\nfunction setUserAgent(ua: string) {\n  Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'userAgent', { value: ua, configurable: true, writable: true });\n}\n\nfunction setPlatform(platform: string) {\n  Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'platform', { value: platform, configurable: true, writable: true });\n}\n\nfunction setMaxTouchPoints(points: number) {\n  Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'maxTouchPoints', { value: points, configurable: true, writable: true });\n}\n\ndescribe('isMobileUA', () => {\n  afterEach(() => {\n    if (originalUserAgent) {\n      Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'userAgent', originalUserAgent);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('returns true for iPhone UA', () => {\n    setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_0 like Mac OS X)');\n    expect(isMobileUA()).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('returns true for Android UA', () => {\n    setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13)');\n    expect(isMobileUA()).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('returns true for iPad UA', () => {\n    setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (iPad; CPU OS 16_0 like Mac OS X)');\n    expect(isMobileUA()).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('returns false for desktop UA', () => {\n    setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7)');\n    expect(isMobileUA()).toBe(false);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('useIsMobile', () => {\n  let listeners: Record<string, Set<(...args: unknown[]) => void>>;\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    listeners = {};\n    setWindowSize(1024);\n    setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7)');\n    setPlatform('MacIntel');\n    setMaxTouchPoints(0);\n\n    window.matchMedia = vi.fn().mockImplementation((query: string) => ({\n      matches: false,\n      media: query,\n      addEventListener: vi.fn((event: string, handler: () => void) => {\n        if (!listeners[query]) listeners[query] = new Set();\n        listeners[query].add(handler);\n      }),\n      removeEventListener: vi.fn((event: string, handler: () => void) => {\n        listeners[query]?.delete(handler);\n      }),\n    }));\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => {\n    window.matchMedia = originalMatchMedia;\n    if (originalInnerWidth) Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', originalInnerWidth);\n    if (originalInnerHeight) Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerHeight', originalInnerHeight);\n    if (originalUserAgent) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'userAgent', originalUserAgent);\n    if (originalPlatform) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'platform', originalPlatform);\n    if (originalMaxTouchPoints) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'maxTouchPoints', originalMaxTouchPoints);\n  });\n\n  it('returns false for desktop viewport', () => {\n    setWindowSize(1024);\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsMobile());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('returns true for mobile viewport', () => {\n    setWindowSize(375);\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsMobile());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('updates on resize', () => {\n    setWindowSize(1024);\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsMobile());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n\n    act(() => {\n      setWindowSize(375);\n      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));\n    });\n\n    expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('useIsTablet', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    setWindowSize(1024);\n    setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7)');\n    setPlatform('MacIntel');\n    setMaxTouchPoints(0);\n\n    window.matchMedia = vi.fn().mockImplementation((query: string) => ({\n      matches: false,\n      media: query,\n      addEventListener: vi.fn(),\n      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),\n    }));\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => {\n    window.matchMedia = originalMatchMedia;\n    if (originalInnerWidth) Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', originalInnerWidth);\n    if (originalUserAgent) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'userAgent', originalUserAgent);\n    if (originalPlatform) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'platform', originalPlatform);\n    if (originalMaxTouchPoints) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'maxTouchPoints', originalMaxTouchPoints);\n  });\n\n  it('returns false for desktop', () => {\n    setWindowSize(1400);\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsTablet());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('detects iPadOS via MacIntel + touch', () => {\n    setPlatform('MacIntel');\n    setMaxTouchPoints(5);\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsTablet());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('detects iPad via user agent', () => {\n    setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (iPad; CPU OS 16_0 like Mac OS X)');\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsTablet());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('useIsTouchDevice', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    setWindowSize(1024);\n    setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7)');\n    setPlatform('MacIntel');\n    setMaxTouchPoints(0);\n\n    window.matchMedia = vi.fn().mockImplementation((query: string) => ({\n      matches: false,\n      media: query,\n      addEventListener: vi.fn(),\n      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),\n    }));\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => {\n    window.matchMedia = originalMatchMedia;\n    if (originalMaxTouchPoints) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'maxTouchPoints', originalMaxTouchPoints);\n    if (originalUserAgent) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'userAgent', originalUserAgent);\n    if (originalPlatform) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'platform', originalPlatform);\n  });\n\n  it('returns false for non-touch desktop', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsTouchDevice());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('returns true when maxTouchPoints > 0', () => {\n    setMaxTouchPoints(5);\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useIsTouchDevice());\n    expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('useDeviceInfo', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    setWindowSize(1024);\n    setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7)');\n    setPlatform('MacIntel');\n    setMaxTouchPoints(0);\n\n    window.matchMedia = vi.fn().mockImplementation((query: string) => ({\n      matches: false,\n      media: query,\n      addEventListener: vi.fn(),\n      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),\n    }));\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => {\n    window.matchMedia = originalMatchMedia;\n    if (originalInnerWidth) Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', originalInnerWidth);\n    if (originalInnerHeight) Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerHeight', originalInnerHeight);\n    if (originalUserAgent) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'userAgent', originalUserAgent);\n    if (originalPlatform) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'platform', originalPlatform);\n    if (originalMaxTouchPoints) Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'maxTouchPoints', originalMaxTouchPoints);\n  });\n\n  it('returns desktop info for wide viewport', () => {\n    setWindowSize(1400, 900);\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useDeviceInfo());\n\n    expect(result.current.isPhone).toBe(false);\n    expect(result.current.isTablet).toBe(false);\n    expect(result.current.isTabletOrLarger).toBe(true);\n    expect(result.current.mobileColumns).toBe(6);\n  });\n\n  it('returns phone info for narrow viewport', () => {\n    setWindowSize(375, 812);\n    setUserAgent('Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_0 like Mac OS X)');\n\n    // Need coarse pointer for mobile detection\n    window.matchMedia = vi.fn().mockImplementation((query: string) => ({\n      matches: query.includes('coarse'),\n      media: query,\n      addEventListener: vi.fn(),\n      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),\n    }));\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useDeviceInfo());\n\n    expect(result.current.isPhone).toBe(true);\n    expect(result.current.mobileColumns).toBe(2);\n  });\n});\n"
}

vi.fn();\n\nvi.mock('@/shared/contexts/PanesContext', () => ({\n  usePanes: () => mockUsePanes(),\n}));\n\nimport { useContentResponsive } from '../useContentResponsive';\n\ndescribe('useContentResponsive', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    mockUsePanes.mockReturnValue({});\n  });\n\n  it('uses PanesContext contentBreakpoints when available with positive width', () => {\n    mockUsePanes.mockReturnValue({\n      contentBreakpoints: {\n        isSm: true,\n        isMd: true,\n        isLg: false,\n        isXl: false,\n        is2Xl: false,\n        contentWidth: 700,\n        contentHeight: 500,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useContentResponsive());\n    expect(result.current.contentWidth).toBe(700);\n    expect(result.current.isMd).toBe(true);\n    expect(result.current.isLg).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('falls back to viewport breakpoints when contentBreakpoints not available', () => {\n    mockUsePanes.mockReturnValue({});\n\n    // jsdom default window size\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useContentResponsive());\n    expect(result.current.contentWidth).toBe(window.innerWidth);\n    expect(result.current.contentHeight).toBe(window.innerHeight);\n  });\n\n  it('falls back when contentBreakpoints has zero width', () => {\n    mockUsePanes.mockReturnValue({\n      contentBreakpoints: {\n        isSm: false,\n        isMd: false,\n        isLg: false,\n        isXl: false,\n        is2Xl: false,\n        contentWidth: 0,\n        contentHeight: 0,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useContentResponsive());\n    // Falls back to viewport\n    expect(result.current.contentWidth).toBe(window.innerWidth);\n  });\n\n  it('calculates correct breakpoints for viewport fallback', () => {\n    mockUsePanes.mockReturnValue({});\n\n    // In jsdom, window.innerWidth is 1024 by default\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useContentResponsive());\n    const width = window.innerWidth;\n\n    expect(result.current.isSm).toBe(width >= 640);\n    expect(result.current.isMd).toBe(width >= 768);\n    expect(result.current.isLg).toBe(width >= 1024);\n    expect(result.current.isXl).toBe(width >= 1280);\n    expect(result.current.is2Xl).toBe(width >= 1536);\n  });\n});\n"

{ useState } = require('react');\n  return {\n    default: (key: string, defaultValue: unknown) => useState(defaultValue),\n  };\n});\n\nvi.mock('@/shared/components/ui/sonner', () => ({\n  toast: { error: vi.fn(), warning: vi.fn() },\n}));\n\nvi.mock('@/shared/lib/errorHandler', () => ({\n  handleError: vi.fn(),\n}));\n\nimport { useDarkMode } from '../useDarkMode';\n\ndescribe('useDarkMode', () id', () => {\n    expect(findGeneration(shotGenerations, 'sg-2')).toEqual(shotGenerations[1]);\n  });\n\n  it('finds by generation_id', () => {\n    expect(findGeneration(shotGenerations, 'gen-3')).toEqual(shotGenerations[2]);\n  });\n\n  it('returns undefined for non-existent key', () => {\n    expect(findGeneration(shotGenerations, 'nonexistent')).toBeUndefined();\n  });\n\n  it('returns undefined for null key', () => {\n    expect(findGeneration(shotGenerations, null)).toBeUndefined();\n  });\n\n  it('returns undefined for undefined key', () => {\n     { id: 'sg-1', newFrame: 0, reason: 'first' },\n      { id: 'sg-1', newFrame: 50, reason: 'second' },\n      { id: 'sg-2', newFrame: 100, reason: 'only' },\n    ];\n\n    const result = deduplicateUpdates(updates);\n\n    expect(result.size).toBe(2);\n    expect(result.get('sg-1')!.newFrame).toBe(50);\n    expect(result.get('sg-1')!.reason).toBe('second');\n    expect(result.get('sg-2')!.newFrame).toBe(100);\n  });\n\n  it('handles empty updates', () => {\n    const result = deduplicateUpdates([]);\n    expect(result.size).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('keeps same-frame entries (no duplicates)', () => {\n    const updates = [\n      { id: 'sg-1', newFrame: 50, reason: 'first' },\n      { id: 'sg-1', newFrame: 50, reason: 'second' },\n    ];\n\n    const result = deduplicateUpdates(updates);\n    expect(result.size).toBe(1);\n    // When newFrame matches, existing is kept (no update needed)\n    expect(result.get('sg-1')!.reason).toBe('first');\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('calculateDistributedFrames', () => {\n  it('distributes items between predecessor and successor', () => {\n    const shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[] = [\n      createShotGen('sg-1', 'gen-1', 0),\n      createShotGen('sg-2', 'gen-2', 50),\n      createShotGen('sg-3', 'gen-3', 100),\n    ];\n\n    const allItems = [\n      { id: 'sg-1', timeline_frame: 0 },\n      { id: 'sg-2', timeline_frame: 50 }, // This is being moved\n      { id: 'sg-3', timeline_frame: 100 },\n    ];\n\n    // Moving sg-2 to between sg-1 (index 0) and sg-3 (index 2)\n    const result = calculateDistributedFrames({\n      draggedShotGens: [shotGenerations[1]],\n      draggedItemIds: ['sg-2'],\n      newStartIndex: 1,\n      allItems,\n      shotGenerations,\n    });\n\n    expect(result.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n    // Between 0 and 100, single item should be at midpoint ~50\n    const frame = result[0].newFrame;\n    expect(frame).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n    expect(frame).toBeLessThan(100);\n  });\n\n  it('handles drop at position 0', () => {\n    const shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[] = [\n      createShotGen('sg-1', 'gen-1', 0),\n      createShotGen('sg-2', 'gen-2', 50),\n      createShotGen('sg-3', 'gen-3', 100),\n    ];\n\n    const allItems = [\n      { id: 'sg-3', timeline_frame: 100 }, // dragged to front\n      { id: 'sg-1', timeline_frame: 0 },   // displaced\n      { id: 'sg-2', timeline_frame: 50 },\n    ];\n\n    const result = calculateDistributedFrames({\n      draggedShotGens: [shotGenerations[2]],\n      draggedItemIds: ['sg-3'],\n      newStartIndex: 0,\n      allItems,\n      shotGenerations,\n    });\n\n    expect(result.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n    // First dragged item should go to frame 0\n    const firstItemUpdate = result.find(u => u.id === 'sg-3');\n    expect(firstItemUpdate).toBeDefined();\n    expect(firstItemUpdate!.newFrame).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('extends timeline at the end using average spacing', () => {\n    const shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[] = [\n      createShotGen('sg-1', 'gen-1', 0),\n      createShotGen('sg-2', 'gen-2', 50),\n      createShotGen('sg-3', 'gen-3', 100),\n    ];\n\n    const allItems = [\n      { id: 'sg-1', timeline_frame: 0 },\n      { id: 'sg-2', timeline_frame: 50 },\n      { id: 'sg-3', timeline_frame: 100 }, // dragged to end (index 2 = last)\n    ];\n\n    // Drop at the end - no successor\n    const result = calculateDistributedFrames({\n      draggedShotGens: [shotGenerations[2]],\n      draggedItemIds: ['sg-3'],\n      newStartIndex: 2,\n      allItems,\n      shotGenerations,\n    });\n\n    expect(result.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n    // Should extend beyond the predecessor's frame\n    const update = result[0];\n    expect(update.newFrame).toBeGreaterThan(50);\n  });\n\n  it('handles multiple dragged items between bounds', () => {\n    const shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[] = [\n      createShotGen('sg-1', 'gen-1', 0),\n      createShotGen('sg-2', 'gen-2', 50),\n      createShotGen('sg-3', 'gen-3', 100),\n      createShotGen('sg-4', 'gen-4', 150),\n    ];\n\n    const allItems = [\n      { id: 'sg-1', timeline_frame: 0 },\n      { id: 'sg-2', timeline_frame: 50 },\n      { id: 'sg-3', timeline_frame: 100 },\n      { id: 'sg-4', timeline_frame: 150 },\n    ];\n\n    // Dragging sg-2 and sg-3 to between sg-1 and sg-4 (indices 1..2)\n    const result = calculateDistributedFrames({\n      draggedShotGens: [shotGenerations[1], shotGenerations[2]],\n      draggedItemIds: ['sg-2', 'sg-3'],\n      newStartIndex: 1,\n      allItems,\n      shotGenerations,\n    });\n\n    expect(result.length).toBe(2);\n    // Both should be between 0 and 150\n    result.forEach(u => {\n expect(result[0].newFrame).toBeLessThan(result[1].newFrame);\n  });\n\n  it('places first items at default spacing when no neighbors exist', () => {\n    const shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[] = [\n      createShotGen('sg-1', 'gen-1', -1),\n      createShotGen('sg-2', 'gen-2', -1),\n    ];\n\n    const allItems = [\n      { id: 'sg-1', timeline_frame: null },\n      { id: 'sg-2', timeline_frame: null },\n    ];\n\n    const result = calculateDistributedFrames({\n      draggedShotGens: shotGenerations,\n      draggedItemIds: ['sg-1', 'sg-2'],\n      newStartIndex: 0,\n      allItems,\n      shotGenerations,\n    });\n\n    expect(result.length).toBe(2);\n    expect(result[0].newFrame).toBe(0);\n    expect(result[1].newFrame).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions', () => {\n  it('normalizes positions to start at 0', () => {\n    const shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[] = [\n      createShotGen('sg-1', 'gen-1', 100),\n      createShotGen('sg-2', 'gen-2', 200),\n    ];\n\n    const updates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();\n    // No explicit updates - just normalize current positions\n    const result = buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(updates, shotGenerations);\n\n    // Should normalize sg-1 from 100 to 0\n    expect(result.has('sg-1')).toBe(true);\n    expect(result.get('sg-1')!.newFrame).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('preserves relative ordering after normalization', () => {\n    const shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[] = [\n      createShotGen('sg-1', 'gen-1', 50),\n      createShotGen('sg-2', 'gen-2', 100),\n      createShotGen('sg-3', 'gen-3', 150),\n    ];\n\n    const updates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();\n    const result = buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(updates, shotGenerations);\n\n    // Get all final frames\n    const frames: number[] = [];\n    for (const sg of shotGenerations) {\n      const update = expect(frames[i]).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(frames[i - 1]);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('applies explicit updates before normalizing', () => {\n    const shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[] = [\n      createShotGen('sg-1', 'gen-1', 0),\n      createShotGen('sg-2', 'gen-2', 50),\n      createShotGen('sg-3', 'gen-3', 100),\n    ];\n\n    const updates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();\n    // Move sg-3 to between sg-1 and sg-2\n    updates.set('sg-3', { newFrame: 25, reason: 'moved' });\n\n    const result = buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(updates, shotGenerations);\n\n    // sg-3 should end up between sg-1 and sg-2\n    // After normalization, order should be sg-1, sg-3, sg-2\n    const sg3Update = result.get('sg-3');\n    expect(sg3Update).toBeDefined();\n  });\n\n  it('handles empty shot generations', () => {\n    const updates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();\n    const result = buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(updates, []);\n    expect(result.size).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('skips items with null timeline_frame', () => {\n    const shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[] = [\n      createShotGen('sg-1', 'gen-1', 0),\n      { ...createShotGen('sg-2', 'gen-2', 50), timeline_frame: null as unknown as number },\n      createShotGen('sg-3', 'gen-3', 100),\n    ];\n\n    const updates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();\n    const result = buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(updates, shotGenerations);\n\n    // sg-2 should not appear in results since it has null frame\n    expect(result.has('sg-2')).toBe(false);\n  });\n});\n"
}

'proj-1'];\n\n      // Trigger circuit breaker\n      dataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure(queryKey, new Error('Fail 1'));\n      dataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure(queryKey, new Error('Fail 2'));\n      dataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure(queryKey, new Error('Fail 3'));\n\n      // Recovery\n      dataFreshnessManager.onFetchSuccess(queryKey);\n\n      // Should no longer be circuit-broken - back dataFreshnessManager.onFetchSuccess(queryKey);\n\n      expect(toast.success).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Connection restored', expect.any(Object));\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('subscribe', () => {\n    it('returns unsubscribe function', () => {\n      const callback = vi.fn();\n      const unsubscribe = dataFreshnessManager.subscribe(callback);\n\n      expect(typeof Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7)',\n      configurable: true,\n      writable: true,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('returns polling disabled when freshness manager says so and minInterval is false', () => {\n    mockGetPollingInterval.mockReturnValue(false);\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSmartPollingConfig(['test-key']));\n\n    expect(result.current.refetchInterval).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('clamps to maxInterval when polling interval is too low', () => {\n    mockGetPollingInterval.mockReturnValue(1000); // 1 second - below max\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSmartPollingConfig(['test-key']));\n\n    // Default maxInterval is 15s\n    expect(result.current.refetchInterval).toBe(15000);\n  });\n\n  it('uses freshness manager interval when within range', () => {\n    mockGetPollingInterval.mockReturnValue(60000); // 60 seconds\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSmartPollingConfig(['test-key']));\n\n    expect(result.current.refetchInterval).toBe(60000);\n  });\n\n  it('returns staleTime 0 when data is not fresh', () => {\n    mockIsDataFresh.mockReturnValue(false);\n    mockGetPollingInterval.mockReturnValue(30000);\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSmartPollingConfig(['test-key']));\n\n    expect(result.current.staleTime).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('returns freshnessThreshold as staleTime when data is fresh', () => {\n    mockIsDataFresh.mockReturnValue(true);\n    mockGetPollingInterval.mockReturnValue(false);\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSmartPollingConfig(['test-key']));\n\n    // Default freshnessThreshold is 30000\n    expect(result.current.staleTime).toBe(30000);\n  });\n\n  it('subscribes to freshness manager on mount', () => {\n    renderHook(() => useSmartPollingConfig(['test-key']));\n\n    expect(mockSubscribe).toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('unsubscribes on unmount', () => {\n    const unsubscribeFn = vi.fn();\n    mockSubscribe.mockReturnValue(unsubscribeFn);\n\n    const { unmount } = renderHook(() => useSmartPollingConfig(['test-key']));\n    unmount();\n\n    expect(unsubscribeFn).toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n});\n"

hardwareConcurrency: 8,\n  });\n});\n\nimport { getImageLoadingStrategy } from '../imageLoadingPriority';\n\ndescribe('imageLoadingPriority', () => {\n  describe('getImageLoadingStrategy', () => {\n    const desktopConfig = { isMobile: false, totalImages: 20, isPreloaded: false };\n    const mobileConfig = { isMobile: true, totalImages: 20, isPreloaded: false };\n\n    describe('desktop behavior', () => {\n      it('first image loads immediately (delay=0)', () => {\n        const strategy = getImageLoadingStrategy(0, desktopConfig);\n\n        expect(strategy.progressiveDelay).toBe(0);\n        expect(strategy.shouldLoadInInitialBatch).toBe(true);\n        expect(strategy.batchGroup).toBe(0);\n      });\n\n      it('initial batch items have minimal stagger delays', () => {\n        // Desktop initialBatchSize is 4\n        const s1 = getImageLoadingStrategy(1, desktopConfig);\n        const s2 = getImageLoadingStrategy(2, desktopConfig);\n        const s3 = getImageLoadingStrategy(3, desktopConfig);\n\n        expect(s1.shouldLoadInInitialBatch).toBe(true);\n        expect(s2.shouldLoadInInitialBatch).toBe(true);\n        expect(s3.shouldLoadInInitialBatch).toBe(true);\n\n        // Delays should be small multiples of 8ms\n        expect(s1.progressiveDelay).toBe(8);\n        expect(s2.progressiveDelay).toBe(16);\n        expect(s3.progressiveDelay).toBe(24);\n      });\n\n      it('items beyond initial batch have larger progressive delays', () => {\n        const s4 = getImageLoadingStrategy(4, desktopConfig);\n        const s5 = getImageLoadingStrategy(5, desktopConfig);\n\n        expect(s4.shouldLoadInInitialBatch).toBe(false);\n        expect(s5.shouldLoadInInitialBatch).toBe(false);\n\n        // These should use staggerDelay * (staggerIndex + 1)\n        expect(s4.progressiveDelay).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n        expect(s5.progressiveDelay).toBeGreaterThan(s4.progressiveDelay);\n      });\n\n      it('delays are capped at maxStaggerDelay', () => {\n        // Even very high indices should not exceed maxStaggerDelay\n        const sHigh = getImageLoadingStrategy(100, desktopConfig);\n\n        // Desktop maxStaggerDelay is 100\n        expect(sHigh.progressiveDelay).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);\n      });\n\n      it('batch groups increment correctly', () => {\n        // Desktop initialBatchSize is 4\n        expect(getImageLoadingStrategy(0, desktopConfig).batchGroup).toBe(0);\n        expect(getImageLoadingStrategy(3, desktopConfig).batchGroup).toBe(0);\n        expect(getImageLoadingStrategy(4, desktopConfig).batchGroup).toBe(1);\n        expect(getImageLoadingStrategy(7, desktopConfig).batchGroup).toBe(1);\n        expect(getImageLoadingStrategy(8, desktopConfig).batchGroup).toBe(2);\n      });\n    });\n\n    describe('mobile behavior', () => {\n      it('first image loads immediately on mobile', () => {\n        const strategy = getImageLoadingStrategy(0, mobileConfig);\n        expect(strategy.progressiveDelay).toBe(0);\n        expect(strategy.shouldLoadInInitialBatch).toBe(true);\n      });\n\n      it('mobile has smaller initial batch size', () => {\n        // Mobile initialBatchSize should be 3 (for normal hardware)\n        const s2 = getImageLoadingStrategy(2, mobileConfig);\n        const s3 = getImageLoadingStrategy(3, mobileConfig);\n\n        expect(s2.shouldLoadInInitialBatch).toBe(true);\n        expect(s3.shouldLoadInInitialBatch).toBe(false);\n      });\n\n      it('mobile has higher stagger delays than desktop', () => {\n        // Index 5 on both platforms\n        const desktopDelay = getImageLoadingStrategy(5, desktopConfig).progressiveDelay;\n        const mobileDelay = getImageLoadingStrategy(5, mobileConfig).progressiveDelay;\n\n        expect(mobileDelay).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(desktopDelay);\n      });\n    });\n\n    describe('preloaded images', () => {\n      it('preloaded images always have zero delay', () => {\n        const preloadedConfig = { isMobile: false, totalImages: 20, isPreloaded: true };\n\n        const s0 = getImageLoadingStrategy(0, preloadedConfig);\n        const s5 = getImageLoadingStrategy(5, preloadedConfig);\n        const s15 = getImageLoadingStrategy(15, preloadedConfig);\n\n        expect(s0.progressiveDelay).toBe(0);\n        expect(s5.progressiveDelay).toBe(0);\n        expect(s15.progressiveDelay).toBe(0);\n      });\n    });\n\n    describe('edge cases', () => {\n      it('handles index 0 with single image', () => {\n        const config = { isMobile: false, totalImages: 1, isPreloaded: false };\n        const strategy = getImageLoadingStrategy(0, config);\n\n        expect(strategy.progressiveDelay).toBe(0);\n        expect(strategy.shouldLoadInInitialBatch).toBe(true);\n      });\n\n      it('handles very large index', () => {\n        const strategy = getImageLoadingStrategy(1000, desktopConfig);\n\n        expect(strategy.progressiveDelay).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);\n        expect(strategy.shouldLoadInInitialBatch).toBe(false);\n      });\n    });\n  });\n});\n"
}

const unsubscribe = processor.onEvent(callback);\n\n      processor.process(makeRawEvent());\n      vi.advanceTimersByTime(200);\n      expect(callback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n\n      unsubscribe();\n\n      processor.process(makeRawEvent());\n      vi.advanceTimersByTime(200);\n      expect(callback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); // Not called again\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('event batching', () => {\n    it('batches events within the window', () => {\n      const callback = vi.fn();\n      processor.onEvent(callback);\n\n      processor.process(makeRawEvent({   "content": "/**\n * RealtimeConnection Tests\n *\n * Tests for the Supabase WebSocket connection lifecycle manager.\n */\n\nimport { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';\n\n// Mock dependencies\nconst mockSubscribe = vi.fn();\nconst mockUnsubscribe = vi.fn();\nconst mockOn = vi.fn().mockReturnThis();\n\nvi.mock('@/integrations/supabase/client', () => ({\n  supabase: {\n    auth: {\n      getSession: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({\n        data: { session: { user: { id: 'user-1' }, access_token: 'token-123' } },\n        error: null,\n      }),\n    },\n    channel: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({\n      on: mockOn,\n      subscribe: mockSubscribe,\n      unsubscribe: mockUnsubscribe,\n    }),\n    realtime: {\n      setAuth: vi.fn(),\n    },\n  },\n}));\n\nvi.mock('../DataFreshnessManager', () => ({\n  dataFreshnessManager: {\n    onRealtimeStatusChange: vi.fn(),\n    reset: vi.fn(),\n  },\n}));\n\nvi.mock('@/shared/lib/errorHandler', () => ({\n  handleError: vi.fn(),\n}));\n\nimport { RealtimeConnection } from '../RealtimeConnection';\nimport { dataFreshnessManager } from '../DataFreshnessManager';\nimport { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';\n\ndescribe('RealtimeConnection', () => {\n  let connection: RealtimeConnection;\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    vi.clearAllMocks();\n    vi.useFakeTimers();\n    connection = new RealtimeConnection({\n      subscribeTimeout: 5000,\n      maxReconnectAttempts: 3,\n      baseReconnectDelay: 1000,\n      maxReconnectDelay: 10000,\n    });\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => {\n    connection.destroy();\n    vi.useRealTimers();\n  });\n\n  describe('initial state', () => {\n    it('starts in disconnected state', () => {\n      const state = connection.getState();\n      expect(state.status).toBe('disconnected');\n      expect(state.projectId).toBeNull();\n      expect(state.error).toBeNull();\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('connect', () => {\n    it('sets status to connecting and creates channel', async () => {\n      // Make subscribe call the callback synchronously with SUBSCRIBED\n      mockSubscribe.mockImplementation((callback: (status: string) => void) => {\n        callback('SUBSCRIBED');\n      });\n\n      const result = await connection.connect('proj-1');\n\n      expect(result).toBe(true);\n      expect(supabase.channel).toHaveBeenCalledWith('task-updates:proj-1');\n      expect(dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith('connected', 'Connected');\n\n      const state = connection.getState();\n      expect(state.status).toBe('connected');\n      expect(state.projectId).toBe('proj-1');\n    });\n\n    it('handles auth failure', async () => {\n      (supabase.auth.getSession as ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>).mockResolvedValueOnce({\n        data: { session: null },\n        error: null,\n      });\n\n      const result = await connection.connect('proj-1');\n\n      expect(result).toBe(false);\n      const state = connection.getState();\n      expect(state.status).toBe('failed');\n    });\n\n    it('handles subscribe failure', async () => {\n      mockSubscribe.mockImplementation((callback: (status: string) => void) => {\n        callback('CHANNEL_ERROR');\n      });\n\n      const result = await connection.connect('proj-1');\n\n      expect(result).toBe(false);\n      const state = connection.getState();\n      // Should be reconnecting (not failed, because it tries to reconnect)\n      expect(state.status).toBe('reconnecting');\n    });\n\n    it('no-ops when already connected to the same project', async () => {\n      mockSubscribe.mockImplementation((callback: (status: string) => void) => {\n        callback('SUBSCRIBED');\n      });\n\n      await connection.connect('proj-1');\n      vi.clearAllMocks();\n\n      const result = await connection.connect('proj-1');\n      expect(result).toBe(true);\n      // Should not create a new channel\n      expect(supabase.channel).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('disconnect', () => {\n    it('disconnects and resets state', async () => {\n      mockSubscribe.mockImplementation((callback: (status: string) => void) => {\n        callback('SUBSCRIBED');\n      });\n\n      await connection.connect('proj-1');\n      await connection.disconnect();\n\n      const state = connection.getState();\n      expect(state.status).toBe('disconnected');\n      expect(state.projectId).toBeNull();\n      expect(dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith('disconnected', 'Disconnected');\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('onStatusChange', () => {\n    it('immediately calls callback with current state', () => {\n      const callback = vi.fn();\n      connection.onStatusChange(callback);\n\n      expect(callback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n      expect(callback.mock.calls[0][0].status).toBe('disconnected');\n    });\n\n    it('returns unsubscribe function', () => {\n      const callback = vi.fn();\n      const unsubscribe = connection.onStatusChange(callback);\n\n      expect(typeof unsubscribe).toBe('function');\n      unsubscribe();\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('onEvent', () => {\n    it('returns unsubscribe function', () => {\n      const callback = vi.fn();\n      const unsubscribe = connection.onEvent(callback);\n\n      expect(typeof unsubscribe).toBe('function');\n      unsubscribe();\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('reset', () => {\n    it('resets connection state', async () => {\n      mockSubscribe.mockImplementation((callback: (status: string) => void) => {\n        callback('SUBSCRIBED');\n      });\n\n      await connection.connect('proj-1');\n      connection.reset();\n\n      const state = connection.getState();\n      expect(state.status).toBe('disconnected');\n      expect(state.projectId).toBeNull();\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('destroy', () => {\n    it('clears all callbacks and disconnects', async () => {\n      mockSubscribe.mockImplementation((callback: (status: string) => void) => {\n        callback('SUBSCRIBED');\n      });\n\n      const statusCallback = vi.fn();\n      const eventCallback = vi.fn();\n\n      connection.onStatusChange(statusCallback);\n      connection.onEvent(eventCallback);\n\n      await connection.connect('proj-1');\n      connection.destroy();\n\n      // After destroy, callbacks should be cleared\n      // (We can't easily test this externally, but verify no errors)\n    });\n  });\n});\n"
}

  "content": "/**\n * ConfirmDialog Tests\n *\n * Tests for the confirmation dialog component.\n */\n\nimport { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';\nimport { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';\nimport React from 'react';\n\nimport { ConfirmDialog } from '../ConfirmDialog';\n\ndescribe('ConfirmDialog', () => {\n  const defaultProps = {\n    open: true,\n    onOpenChange: vi.fn(),\n    title: 'Are you sure?',\n    onConfirm: vi.fn(),\n  };\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    vi.clearAllMocks();\n  });\n\n  it('renders with title', () => {\n    render(<ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} />);\n    expect(screen.getByText('Are you sure?')).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it('renders description when provided', () => {\n    render(\n      <ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} description=\"This action cannot be undone.\" />\n    );\n    expect(screen.getByText('This action cannot be undone.')).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it('does not render description when not provided', () => {\n    render(<ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} />);\n    // AlertDialogDescription should not render\n    const descriptions = screen.queryByText('This action cannot be undone.');\n    expect(descriptions).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('uses default button text', () => {\n    render(<ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} />);\n    expect(screen.getByText('Confirm')).toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.getByText('Cancel')).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it('uses custom button text', () => {\n    render(\n      <ConfirmDialog\n        {...defaultProps}\n        confirmText=\"Delete\"\n        cancelText=\"Nevermind\"\n      />\n    );\n    expect(screen.getByText('Delete')).toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.getByText('Nevermind')).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it('calls onConfirm when confirm button clicked', () => {\n    render(<ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} />);\n    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Confirm'));\n    expect(defaultProps.onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n  });\n\n  it('closes dialog when confirm clicked (not loading)', () => {\n    render(<ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} />);\n    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Confirm'));\n    expect(defaultProps.onOpenChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(false);\n  });\n\n  it('does not close dialog when confirm clicked while loading', () => {\n    render(<ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} isLoading />);\n    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Loading...'));\n    // onConfirm is called but dialog stays open\n    expect(defaultProps.onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    expect(defaultProps.onOpenChange).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith(false);\n  });\n\n  it('calls onCancel and closes when cancel button clicked', () => {\n    const onCancel = vi.fn();\n    render(<ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} onCancel={onCancel} />);\n    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Cancel'));\n    expect(onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    expect(defaultProps.onOpenChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(false);\n  });\n\n  it('shows \"Loading...\" text when isLoading', () => {\n    render(<ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} isLoading />);\n    expect(screen.getByText('Loading...')).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it('disables buttons when isLoading', () => {\n    render(<ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} isLoading />);\n    expect(screen.getByText('Loading...')).toBeDisabled();\n    expect(screen.getByText('Cancel')).toBeDisabled();\n  });\n\n  it('applies destructive styling when destructive=true', () => {\n    render(<ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} destructive />);\n    const confirmButton = screen.getByText('Confirm');\n    expect(confirmButton.className).toContain('bg-destructive');\n  });\n\n  it('does not render when open=false', () => {\n    render(<ConfirmDialog {...defaultProps} open={false} />);\n    expect(screen.queryByText('Are you sure?')).toBeNull();\n  });\n});\n"
}

'@tanstack/react-query';\nimport React from 'react';\n\nconst mockSingle = vi.fn();\n\nvi.mock('@/integrations/supabase/client', () => ({\n  supabase: {\n    from: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({\n      select: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({\n        eq: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({\n          single: (...args: unknown[]) => mockSingle(...args),\n        }),\n      }),\n    }),\n  },\n}));\n\nvi.mock('@/shared/lib/errorHandler', () => ({\n  handleError: vi.fn(),\n}));\n\nvi.mock('@/shared/lib/queryKeys', () => ({\n  queryKeys: {\n    generations: {\n      lineageChain: (id: string) => ['generations', 'lineage', id],\n      derived: (id: string) => ['generations', 'derived', id],\n    },\n  },\n}));\n\nimport { useLineageChain } from '../useLineageChain';\n\nfunction createWrapper() {\n  const queryClient = new QueryClient({\n    defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false, gcTime: 0 } },\n  });\n  return ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) =>\n    React.createElement(QueryClientProvider, { client: queryClient }, children);\n}\n\ndescribe('useLineageChain', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    vi.clearAllMocks();\n  });\n\n  it('returns empty chain and not loading when variantId is null', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(\n      () => useLineageChain(null),\n      { wrapper: createWrapper() }\n    );\n\n    expect(result.current.chain).toEqual([]);\n    expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(false);\n    expect(result.current.hasLineage).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('fetches single variant (no lineage) correctly', async () => {\n    mockSingle.mockResolvedValueOnce({\n      data: {\n        id: 'variant-1',\n        location: 'https://example.com/v1.jpg',\n        thumbnail_url: 'https://example.com/v1-thumb.jpg',\n        created_at: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z',\n        params: {},\n        variant_type: 'inpaint',\n      },\n      error: null,\n    });\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(\n      () => useLineageChain('variant-1'),\n      { wrapper: createWrapper() }\n    );\n\n    await waitFor(() => {\n      expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    expect(result.current.chain).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(result.current.chain[0].id).toBe('variant-1');\n    expect(result.current.hasLineage).toBe(false); // Single item = no lineage\n  });\n\n  it('follows source_variant_id chain for lineage', async () => {\n    // First call returns the current variant with a source_variant_id\n    mockSingle\n      .mockResolvedValueOnce({\n        data: {\n          id: 'variant-2',\n          location: 'https://example.com/v2.jpg',\n          thumbnail_url: null,\n          created_at: '2024-01-02T00:00:00Z',\n          params: { source_variant_id: 'variant-1' },\n          variant_type: 'outpaint',\n        },\n        error: null,\n      })\n      // Second call returns the ancestor\n      .mockResolvedValueOnce({\n        data: {\n          id: 'variant-1',\n          location: 'https://example.com/v1.jpg',\n          thumbnail_url: 'https://example.com/v1-thumb.jpg',\n          created_at: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z',\n          params: {}, // No further ancestor\n          variant_type: 'inpaint',\n        },\n        error: null,\n      });\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(\n      () => useLineageChain('variant-2'),\n      { wrapper: createWrapper() }\n    );\n\n    await waitFor(() => {\n      expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    expect(result.current.chain).toHaveLength(2);\n    // Chain is oldest to newest\n    expect(result.current.chain[0].id).toBe('variant-1');\n    expect(result.current.chain[1].id).toBe('variant-2');\n    expect(result.current.hasLineage).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('handles errors during fetch', async () => {\n    mockSingle.mockResolvedValueOnce({\n      data: null,\n      error: { message: 'Not found' },\n    });\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(\n      () => useLineageChain('nonexistent'),\n      { wrapper: createWrapper() }\n    );\n\n    await waitFor(() => {\n      expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    // Chain should be empty since the fetch failed\n    expect(result.current.chain).toEqual([]);\n    expect(result.current.hasLineage).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('provides loading state while fetching', () => {\n    mockSingle.mockImplementation(() => new Promise(() => {})); // Never resolves\n\n    const { result } = renderHook(\n      () => useLineageChain('variant-1'),\n      { wrapper: createWrapper() }\n    );\n\n    expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(true);\n  });\n});\n"
}

from '@testing-library/react';\nimport React from 'react';\n\n// Mock the aspect ratio constants\nvi.mock('@/shared/lib/aspectRatios', () => ({\n  ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION: {\n    '16:9': '1920x1080',\n    '4:3': '1440x1080',\n    '1:1': '1080x1080',\n    '9:16': '1080x1920',\n    'Square': '1080x1080',\n  },\n}));\n\n// Mock the visualizer component\nvi.mock('../AspectRatioVisualizer', () => ({\n  AspectRatioVisualizer: ({ aspectRatio }: { aspectRatio: string }) => (\n    <div data-testid=\"visualizer\">{aspectRatio}</div>\n  ),\n}));\n\n// Mock the Select components from shadcn\nvi.mock('@/shared/components/ui/select', () => ({\n  Select: ({ children, value, onValueChange, disabled }: Record<string, unknown>) => (\n    <div data-testid=\"select-root\" data-value={value as string} data-disabled={disabled as boolean}>\n      {(children as React.ReactNode)}\n    </div>\n  ),\n  SelectContent: ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (\n    <div data-testid=\"select-content\">{children}</div>\n  ),\n  SelectItem: ({ children, value, onMouseEnter, onMouseLeave }: Record<string, unknown>) => (\n    <div\n      data-testid={`select-item-${value}`}\n      data-value={value as string}\n      onMouseEnter={onMouseEnter as React.MouseEventHandler}\n      onMouseLeave={onMouseLeave as React.MouseEventHandler}\n    >\n      {children as React.ReactNode}\n    </div>\n  ),\n  SelectTrigger: ({ children, className }: { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }) => (\n    <button data-testid=\"select-trigger\" className={className}>{children}</button>\n  ),\n  SelectValue: ({ children, placeholder }: { children: React.ReactNode; placeholder?: string }) => (\n    <span data-testid=\"select-value\" data-placeholder={placeholder}>{children}</span>\n  ),\n}));\n\nimport { AspectRatioSelector } from '../AspectRatioSelector';\n\ndescribe('AspectRatioSelector', () => {\n  const defaultProps = {\n    value: '16:9',\n    onValueChange: vi.fn(),\n  };\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    vi.clearAllMocks();\n  });\n\n  it('renders the select trigger', () => {\n    render(<AspectRatioSelector {...defaultProps} />);\n    expect(screen.getByTestId('select-trigger')).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it('renders current value', () => {\n    render(<AspectRatioSelector {...defaultProps} />);\n    expect(screen.getByTestId('select-value')).toHaveTextContent('16:9');\n  });\n\n  it('renders aspect ratio options (excluding Square)', () => {\n    render(<AspectRatioSelector {...defaultProps} />);\n\n    expect(screen.getByTestId('select-item-16:9')).toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.getByTestId('select-item-4:3')).toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.getByTestId('select-item-1:1')).toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.getByTestId('select-item-9:16')).toBeInTheDocument();\n    // Square should be filtered out\n    expect(screen.queryByTestId('select-item-Square')).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('shows visualizer by default', () => {\n    render(<AspectRatioSelector {...defaultProps} />);\n    expect(screen.getByTestId('visualizer')).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it('hides visualizer when showVisualizer=false', () => {\n    render(<AspectRatioSelector {...defaultProps} showVisualizer={false} />);\n    expect(screen.queryByTestId('visualizer')).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('renders with custom placeholder', () => {\n    render(\n      <AspectRatioSelector\n        {...defaultProps}\n        value=\"\"\n        placeholder=\"Choose ratio\"\n      />\n    );\n    expect(screen.getByTestId('select-value')).toHaveTextContent('Choose ratio');\n  });\n\n  it('displays labels with resolutions', () => {\n    render(<AspectRatioSelector {...defaultProps} />);\n    expect(screen.getByTestId('select-item-16:9')).toHaveTextContent('16:9 (1920x1080)');\n    expect(screen.getByTestId('select-item-4:3')).toHaveTextContent('4:3 (1440x1080)');\n  });\n\n  it('applies custom className', () => {\n    const { container } = render(\n      <AspectRatioSelector {...defaultProps} className=\"custom-class\" />\n    );\n    // The wrapper div should have the class\n    expect(container.firstElementChild?.className).toContain('custom-class');\n  });\n\n  it('passes id to trigger', () => {\n    render(<AspectRatioSelector {...defaultProps} id=\"ar-selector\" />);\n    // The trigger should receive the id prop\n    const trigger = screen.getByTestId('select-trigger');\n    expect(trigger).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n});\n"
}

expect(result.current.scrubberPosition).toBeNull();\n      expect(result.current.scrubberVisible).toBe(true);\n      expect(result.current.isHovering).toBe(false);\n expect(result.current.videoRef).toBe(firstVideoRef);\n    });\n\n    it('returns containerProps and videoProps', () => {\n      const { result } = renderHook(() => useVideoScrubbing());\n\n      expect(result.current.containerProps).toHaveProperty('onMouseMove');\n      expect(result.current.containerProps).toHaveProperty('onMouseEnter');\n      expect(result.current.containerProps).toHaveProperty('onMouseLeave');\n      expect(result.current.videoProps).toHaveProperty('onLoadedMetadata');\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('setDuration', () => {\n    it('sets duration for valid values', () => {\n      const { result } = renderHook(() => useVideoScrubbing());\n\n      act(() => {\n        result.current.setDuration(10.5);\n      });\n\n      expect(result.current.duration).toBe(10.5);\n    });\n\n    it('ignores non-finite values', () => {\n      const { result } = renderHook(() => useVideoScrubbing());\n\n      act(() => {\n        result.current.setDuration(10);\n      });\n      act(() => {\n        result.current.setDuration(Infinity);\n      });\n\n      expect(result.current.duration).toBe(10);\n    });\n\n    it('ignores expect(result.current.duration).toBe(10);\n    });\n\n    it('ignores NaN', () => {\n      const { result } = renderHook(() => useVideoScrubbing());\n\n      act(() => {\n });\n\n      expect(onProgressChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(0.3, 3);\n    });\n\n    it('does nothing when duration is 0', () => {\n      const { result } = renderHook(() => useVideoScrubbing());\n\n      act(() => {\n        result.current.seekToProgress(0.5);\n      });\n\n      expect(result.current.progress).toBe(0);\n      expect(result.current.currentTime).toBe(0);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('reset', () => {\n    it('resets all state to initial values', () => {\n      const { result } = renderHook(() => useVideoScrubbing());\n\n      // Set some state first\n      act(() => {\n        result.current.setDuration(10);\n      });\n      act(() => {\n        result.current.seekToProgress(0.5);\n      });\n\n      act(() => {\n        result.current.reset();\n      });\n\n      expect(result.current.progress).toBe(0);\n      expect(result.current.currentTime).toBe(0);\n      expect(result.current.scrubberPosition).toBeNull();\n      expect(result.current.scrubberVisible).toBe(true);\n      expect(result.current.isPlaying).toBe(false);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('mouse handlers', () => {\n    it('handleMouseEnter sets hovering state', () => {\n      const onHoverStart = vi.fn();\n      const { result } = renderHook(() =>\n        useVideoScrubbing({ onHoverStart })\n      );\n\n      act(() => {\n        result.current.containerProps.onMouseEnter();\n      });\n\n      expect(result.current.isHovering).toBe(true);\n      expect(onHoverStart).toHaveBeenCalled();\n    });\n\n    it('handleMouseLeave clears hovering state', () => {\n      const onHoverEnd = vi.fn();\n      const { result } = renderHook(() =>\n        useVideoScrubbing({ onHoverEnd })\n      );\n\n      act(() => {\n        result.current.containerProps.onMouseEnter();\n      });\n      act(() => {\n        result.current.containerProps.onMouseLeave();\n      });\n\n      expect(result.current.isHovering).toBe(false);\n      expect(result.current.scrubberPosition).toBeNull();\n      expect(onHoverEnd).toHaveBeenCalled();\n    });\n\n    it('does nothing when disabled', () => {\n      const onHoverStart = vi.fn();\n      const { result } = renderHook(() =>\n        useVideoScrubbing({ enabled: false, onHoverStart })\n      );\n\n      act(() => {\n        result.current.containerProps.onMouseEnter();\n      });\n\n      expect(result.current.isHovering).toBe(false);\n      expect(onHoverStart).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    });\n  });\n});\n"

 useVideoHoverPreview({ videoUrl: 'test.mp4', frameRate: 30 })\n      );\n\n      expect(result.current.currentFrame).toBe(-1);\n      expect(result.current.isVideoReady).toBe(false);\n      expect(result.current.isHovering).toBe(false);\n      expect(result.current.hoverPosition).toEqual({ x: 0, y: 0 });\n    });\n\n    it('returns refs for canvas and video', () => {\n      const { expect(result.current.videoRef).toBeDefined();\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('handleMouseEnter', () => {\n    it('sets isHovering to true', () => {\n      const { result } = renderHook(() =>\n expect(result.current.isHovering).toBe(true);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('handleMouseLeave', () => {\n    it('sets isHovering to false', () => {\n      const { result } = renderHook(() =>\n result.current.handleMouseLeave();\n      });\n\n      expect(result.current.isHovering).toBe(false);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('updateHoverPosition', () => {\n    it('updates hover position without frame', () => {\n      const { result } = renderHook(() =>\n        useVideoHoverPreview({ videoUrl: 'test.mp4', frameRate: 30 })\n      );\n\n      act(() => {\n });\n\n    it('does not update frame when same as current', () => {\n      const { result } = renderHook(() =>\n        useVideoHoverPreview({ videoUrl: 'test.mp4', frameRate: 30 })\n      );\n\n expect(mockGetLatestSettings).toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('cancelPendingSave cancels scheduled save', async () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(\n      () =>  result.current.cancelPendingSave();\n    });\n\n    await act(async () => {\n      vi.advanceTimersByTime(500);\n    });\n\n    // getLatestSettings should not be called since save was cancelled\n   "content": "import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';\nimport { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';\nimport { determineProjectIdToSelect } from '../useProjectCRUD';\n\n// Test the pure function separately since the hook has heavy side effects\ndescribe('determineProjectIdToSelect', () => {\n  const mockProjects = [\n    { id: 'p1', name: 'Project 1', user_id: 'u1' },\n    { id: 'p2', name: 'Project 2', user_id: 'u1' },\n    { id: 'p3', name: 'Project 3', user_id: 'u1' },\n  ];\n\n  it('returns null for empty projects list', () => {\n    expect(determineProjectIdToSelect([], null, null)).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('returns preferredId when it exists in projects', () => {\n    expect(determineProjectIdToSelect(mockProjects, 'p2', null)).toBe('p2');\n  });\n\n  it('returns lastOpenedId when preferredId is not in projects', () => {\n    expect(determineProjectIdToSelect(mockProjects, 'nonexistent', 'p3')).toBe('p3');\n  });\n\n  it('returns first project when neither preferred nor lastOpened match', () => {\n    expect(determineProjectIdToSelect(mockProjects, 'nonexistent', 'also-nonexistent')).toBe('p1');\n  });\n\n  it('returns first project when preferredId is null', () => {\n    expect(determineProjectIdToSelect(mockProjects, null, null)).toBe('p1');\n  });\n\n  it('returns lastOpenedId when preferredId is null but lastOpened exists', () => {\n    expect(determineProjectIdToSelect(mockProjects, null, 'p2')).toBe('p2');\n  });\n\n  it('ignores lastOpenedId that is not in projects', () => {\n    expect(determineProjectIdToSelect(mockProjects, null, 'nonexistent')).toBe('p1');\n  });\n\n  it('prefers preferredId over lastOpenedId', () => {\n    expect(determineProjectIdToSelect(mockProjects, 'p1', 'p3')).toBe('p1');\n  });\n});\n"
}

result.current.handleProjectDeleted([\n        { id: 'remaining-proj', name: 'Remaining', user_id: 'u1' },\n      ]);\n    });\n\n    expect(result.current.selectedProjectId).toBe('remaining-proj');\n    expect(localStorageMock['lastSelectedProjectId']).toBe('remaining-proj');\n  });\n\n  it('handleProjectDeleted clears selection when no projects remain', () => {\n    const updateUserSettings = > AGENT

The issue is that `isLoading` in `useAsyncOperationMap` uses refs (loadingMapRef), which means the returned `isLoading` callback reads from a ref that may not have been updated yet when checked synchronously inside `act`. The `isLoading` function reads `loadingMapRef.current` but the state update via `setLoadingMap` triggers a re-render that updates `loadingMapRef.current`. Inside `act`, the state updates are batched, so the ref may not be updated at the point of the assertion.

Let me fix the failing tests.

1→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→import { isAbortError } from '@/shared/lib/errorUtils';
     3→
     4→type InvokeOptions = {
     5→  body?: unknown;
     6→  headers?: Record<string, string>;
     7→  timeoutMs?: number;
     8→  signal?: AbortSignal;
     9→};
    10→
    11→/**
    12→ * Calls supabase.functions.invoke with a client-side timeout and abort propagation.
    13→ * Ensures long-running invocations do not stall the UI indefinitely.
    14→ */
    15→export async function invokeWithTimeout<T = unknown>(functionName: string, options: InvokeOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
    16→  const { body, headers, timeoutMs = 20000, signal } = options;
    17→
    18→  const controller = new AbortController();
    19→  const signals: AbortSignal[] = [];
    20→  if (signal) signals.push(signal);
    21→  signals.push(controller.signal);
    22→
    23→  // Compose signals: abort if any provided signal aborts
    24→  const composed = new AbortController();
    25→  const onAbort = () => composed.abort();
    26→  signals.forEach(signal => {
    27→    if (signal.aborted) composed.abort();
    28→    else signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    29→  });
    30→
    31→  const tid = setTimeout(() => {
    32→    try { controller.abort(); } catch {}
    33→  }, timeoutMs);
    34→
    35→  try {
    36→    const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke(functionName, {
    37→      body,
    38→      headers,
    39→      signal: composed.signal,
    40→    });
    41→    if (error) {
    42→      throw new Error(error.message || `Function ${functionName} failed`);
    43→    }
    44→    return data as T;
    45→  } catch (err: unknown) {
    46→    if (isAbortError(err)) {
    47→      throw new Error(`Function ${functionName} timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
    48→    }
    49→    throw err;
    50→  } finally {
    51→    clearTimeout(tid);
    52→  }
    53→}
    54→
    55→
    56→

}),\n    },\n    from: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({\n      select: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),\n      eq: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),\n      order: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({\n        data: [\n          {\n tokens: ['api', 'tokens'],\n    },\n  },\n}));\n\nimport { useApiTokens } from '../useApiTokens';\n\nfunction createWrapper() {\n  const queryClient = new QueryClient({\n    defaultOptions: { queries: children);\n}\n\ndescribe('useApiTokens', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    vi.clearAllMocks();\n  });\n\n  it('fetches tokens on mount', async () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => expect(result.current.generatedToken).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('provides loading and mutation states', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useApiTokens(), { wrapper: createWrapper() });\n    expect(result.current.isGenerating).toBe(false);\n    expect(result.current.isRevoking).toBe(false);\n    expect(result.current.isRefreshing).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('clears generated result.current.clearGeneratedToken();\n    });\n    expect(result.current.generatedToken).toBeNull();\n  });\n});\n"

// 5 * 24 = 120\n  });\n\n  it('floors the result', () => {\n    const frames = calculateEffectiveFrameCount(3.3, false);\n    expect(frames).toBe(52); // floor(3.3 * 16) = floor(52.8) = 52\n  });\n\n  it('returns 0 for 0 duration', () => {\n    const frames = calculateEffectiveFrameCount(0, false);\n    expect(frames).toBe(0);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('validateClipsForJoin', () => {\n  function makeClipInfo(index: number, frameCount: number): ClipFrameInfo {\n    return {\n      index,\n      name: `clip-${index}`,\n      frameCount,\n      source: 'metadata',\n    };\n  }\n\n  describe('with fewer than 2 clips', () => {\n    it('returns invalid for 0 clips', () => {\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin([], 15, 23, true);\n      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);\n      expect(result.shortestClipFrames).toBe(0);\n    });\n\n    it('returns invalid for 1 clip', () => {\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin([makeClipInfo(0, 100)], 15, 23, true);\n      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('REPLACE mode', () => {\n    it('validates two clips meeting minimum requirement', () => {\n      // Minimum: gap + 2*context = 23 + 2*15 = 53\n      const clips = [makeClipInfo(0, 100), makeClipInfo(1, 100)];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, true);\n      expect(result.valid).toBe(true);\n      expect(result.shortestClipFrames).toBe(100);\n      expect(result.minClipFramesRequired).toBe(53); // 23 + 2*15\n    });\n\n    it('validates exact boundary condition', () => {\n      // Exactly at the limit: gap=23, context=15, min=53\n      const clips = [makeClipInfo(0, 53), makeClipInfo(1, 53)];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, true);\n      expect(result.valid).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('fails when clips are too short', () => {\n      // Below minimum: need 53 but clips have 52\n      const clips = [makeClipInfo(0, 52), makeClipInfo(1, 52)];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, true);\n      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('calculates correct maxSafeGap', () => {\n      // maxSafeGap = shortest_clip - 2*context, quantized to 4N+1\n      const clips = [makeClipInfo(0, 100), makeClipInfo(1, 80)];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, true);\n      // shortest = 80, max_gap_raw = 80 - 30 = 50\n      // quantized: floor((50-1)/4)*4+1 = floor(49/4)*4+1 = 12*4+1 = 49\n      expect(result.maxSafeGap).toBe(49);\n    });\n\n    it('calculates correct maxSafeContext', () => {\n      // maxSafeContext = floor((shortest - gap) / 2)\n      const clips = [makeClipInfo(0, 100), makeClipInfo(1, 60)];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, true);\n      // shortest = 60, maxSafeContext = floor((60 - 23) / 2) = floor(18.5) = 18\n      expect(result.maxSafeContext).toBe(18);\n    });\n\n    it('handles middle clips needing double frames', () => {\n      // Middle clips need min_required * 2 because they're used in two transitions\n      const clips = [\n        makeClipInfo(0, 100),\n        makeClipInfo(1, 50),  // Middle clip - needs 53*2=106 frames (NOT enough)\n        makeClipInfo(2, 100),\n      ];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, true);\n      expect(result.valid).toBe(false); // Middle clip 50 < 106\n    });\n\n    it('validates three clips when middle clip has enough frames', () => {\n      // Middle needs 53*2 = 106\n      const clips = [\n        makeClipInfo(0, 53),\n        makeClipInfo(1, 110),\n        makeClipInfo(2, 53),\n      ];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, true);\n      expect(result.valid).toBe(true);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('INSERT mode', () => {\n    it('only requires context frames in INSERT mode', () => {\n      // INSERT mode: just need context_frame_count from each clip\n      const clips = [makeClipInfo(0, 20), makeClipInfo(1, 20)];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, false);\n      expect(result.valid).toBe(true);\n      expect(result.minClipFramesRequired).toBe(15); // Just context\n    });\n\n    it('fails when clips shorter than context frames', () => {\n      const clips = [makeClipInfo(0, 10), makeClipInfo(1, 10)];\n      // In insert mode, middle clips need 2*context\n      // For 2 clips, first needs context=15 from end, last needs context=15 from start\n      // 10 < 15, so invalid\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, false);\n      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('sets maxSafeGap to 81 in INSERT mode', () => {\n      const clips = [makeClipInfo(0, 50), makeClipInfo(1, 50)];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, false);\n      expect(result.maxSafeGap).toBe(81);\n    });\n\n    it('sets maxSafeContext to shortestClipFrames in INSERT mode', () => {\n      const clips = [makeClipInfo(0, 50), makeClipInfo(1, 30)];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, false);\n      expect(result.maxSafeContext).toBe(30);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('edge cases', () => {\n    it('handles very small frame counts', () => {\n      const clips = [makeClipInfo(0, 1), makeClipInfo(1, 1)];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 1, 1, true);\n      // min = 1 + 2*1 = 3, but clips have 1 frame each\n      expect(result.valid).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('handles zero frame context and gap', () => {\n      const clips = [makeClipInfo(0, 10), makeClipInfo(1, 10)];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 0, 0, true);\n      expect(result.valid).toBe(true);\n      expect(result.minClipFramesRequired).toBe(0);\n    });\n\n    it('uses shortest clip for constraints with mixed sizes', () => {\n      const clips = [\n        makeClipInfo(0, 200),\n        makeClipInfo(1, 50),\n        makeClipInfo(2, 300),\n      ];\n      const result = validateClipsForJoin(clips, 15, 23, true);\n      expect(result.shortestClipFrames).toBe(50);\n    });\n  });\n});\n"

## Setup & Patterns

The project uses vitest + @testing-library/react. There's a test setup at `src/test/setup.ts` (auto-loaded) and shared utilities at `src/test/test-utils.tsx` with `renderHookWithProviders()`. Mock factories exist at `src/test/mocks/factories.ts`.

5. Use `renderHook` from `@testing-library/react`
6. Do NOT use `require()` — use `import` or `vi.hoisted()` for mock variables
7. Mock video elements need `addEventListener`, `removeEventListener` methods

     8→export function createTestQueryClient(): QueryClient {

    10→    defaultOptions: {
    11→      queries: {
    12→        retry: false,
    13→        gcTime: 0,
    14→        staleTime: 0,

    29→

    45→
    46→interface ProviderOptions {
    47→  authContext?: Partial<typeof defaultAuthContext>;
    48→  projectContext?: Partial<typeof defaultProjectContext>;
    49→  queryClient?: QueryClient;
    50→}
    51→
    52→/**
    53→ * Creates a wrapper component that provides QueryClient, Auth, and Project contexts.
    54→ * Auth and Project are provided via simple React contexts to avoid importing the real providers
    55→ * (which have side effects like supabase connections).
    56→ */
    57→function createWrapper(options: ProviderOptions = {}) {
    58→  const queryClient = options.queryClient ?? createTestQueryClient();
    59→  const _authValue = { ...defaultAuthContext, ...options.authContext };
    60→  const _projectValue = { ...defaultProjectContext, ...options.projectContext };
    61→
    62→  return function TestProviders({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    63→    return (
    64→      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
    65→        {children}
    66→      </QueryClientProvider>
    67→    );
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→/**

    73→ * Use for component tests that need React Query context.

    75→export function renderWithProviders(
    76→  ui: ReactElement,
    77→  options: ProviderOptions & Omit<RenderOptions, 'wrapper'> = {},
    78→) {
    79→  const { authContext, projectContext, queryClient, ...renderOptions } = options;
    80→  const Wrapper = createWrapper({ authContext, projectContext, queryClient });
    81→  return render(ui, { wrapper: Wrapper, ...renderOptions });
    82→}

    88→export function renderHookWithProviders<TResult, TProps>(
    89→  hook: (props: TProps) => TResult,
    90→  options: ProviderOptions & Omit<RenderHookOptions<TProps>, 'wrapper'> = {},
    91→) {
    92→  const { authContext, projectContext, queryClient, ...hookOptions } = options;
    93→  const Wrapper = createWrapper({ authContext, projectContext, queryClient });
    94→  return renderHook(hook, { wrapper: Wrapper, ...hookOptions });
    95→}

1→import { useEffect } from 'react';
     2→import usePersistentState from './usePersistentState';
     3→
     4→/**
     5→ * Hook to manage whether user-inputted text preserves its original casing.
     6→ *
     7→ * UI text is ALWAYS lowercase for aesthetic consistency.
     8→ * This setting controls whether user-inputted text (project names, shot names,
     9→ * prompts, etc.) is also lowercased or preserves its original case.
    10→ *
    11→ * - Default (false): All text lowercase, including user inputs
    12→ * - Enabled (true): User-inputted text preserves original case via .preserve-case
    13→ */
    14→export function useTextCase() {
    15→  const [preserveUserText, setPreserveUserText] = usePersistentState<boolean>('preserve-user-text', false);
    16→
    17→  useEffect(() => {
    18→    if (preserveUserText) {
    19→      document.documentElement.classList.add('preserve-user-text');
    20→    } else {
    21→      document.documentElement.classList.remove('preserve-user-text');
    22→    }
    23→  }, [preserveUserText]);
    24→
    25→  const toggle = () => setPreserveUserText(!preserveUserText);
    26→
    27→  return { preserveUserText, setPreserveUserText, toggle };
    28→}
    29→

1→import { BasePanePositionStrategy } from './PanePositionStrategy';
     2→import { PanePosition } from '@/shared/config/panes';
     3→
     4→export class BottomPanePositionStrategy extends BasePanePositionStrategy {
     5→  getStyle(position: PanePosition): React.CSSProperties {
     6→    const { dimension, offsets, isVisible } = position;
     7→    const horizontalOffset = offsets.horizontal || 0;
     8→    
     9→    return {
    10→      ...this.getBaseStyle(),
    11→      left: '50%',
    12→      bottom: '0px',
    13→      // Centre within visible width by shifting half the horizontalOffset.
    14→      // translateX(-50%) centres on viewport; additional translateX accounts for
    15→      // asymmetrical side panes (e.g. shots/tasks) so the control remains centred
    16→      // within the bottom pane itself.
    17→      transform: `translateX(-50%) translateX(${horizontalOffset / 2}px) translateY(${isVisible ? -dimension : 0}px)`,
    18→    };
    19→  }
    20→}
```

1→import { BasePanePositionStrategy } from './PanePositionStrategy';
     2→import { PanePosition } from '@/shared/config/panes';
     3→
     4→export class LeftPanePositionStrategy extends BasePanePositionStrategy {
     5→  getStyle(position: PanePosition): React.CSSProperties {
     6→    const { dimension, offsets, isVisible } = position;
     7→    const bottomOffset = offsets.bottom || 0;
     8→
     9→    // Use 50dvh (dynamic viewport height) to stay centered as iOS Safari
    10→    // browser chrome shows/hides. Safari animates the chrome smoothly,
    11→    // so the button movement feels controlled rather than jumpy.
    12→    // Falls back to 50vh for older browsers.
    13→    return {
    14→      ...this.getBaseStyle(),
    15→      top: '50dvh',
    16→      left: '0px',
    17→      transform: `translateX(${isVisible ? dimension : 0}px) translateY(calc(-50% - ${bottomOffset / 2}px))`,
    18→    };
    19→  }
    20→}
```

1→import { useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Detects whether a touch interaction is a drag vs a tap.
     5→ * Returns a touch start handler and a ref indicating if the user is dragging.
     6→ */
     7→export function useTouchDragDetection(dragThreshold = 5) {
     8→  const dragStartPos = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
     9→  const isDragging = useRef(false);
    10→
    11→  useEffect(() => {
    12→    const handleGlobalTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
    13→      if (dragStartPos.current && e.touches.length > 0) {
    14→        const touch = e.touches[0];
    15→        const deltaX = Math.abs(touch.clientX - dragStartPos.current.x);
    16→        const deltaY = Math.abs(touch.clientY - dragStartPos.current.y);
    17→        if (deltaX > dragThreshold || deltaY > dragThreshold) {
    18→          isDragging.current = true;
    19→        }
    20→      }
    21→    };
    22→
    23→    const handleGlobalTouchEnd = () => {
    24→      setTimeout(() => {
    25→        dragStartPos.current = null;
    26→        isDragging.current = false;
    27→      }, 50);
    28→    };
    29→
    30→    document.addEventListener('touchmove', handleGlobalTouchMove, { passive: true });
    31→    document.addEventListener('touchend', handleGlobalTouchEnd);
    32→    return () => {
    33→      document.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleGlobalTouchMove);
    34→      document.removeEventListener('touchend', handleGlobalTouchEnd);
    35→    };
    36→  }, [dragThreshold]);
    37→
    38→  const handleTouchStart = useCallback((e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    39→    if (e.touches.length > 0) {
    40→      dragStartPos.current = {
    41→        x: e.touches[0].clientX,
    42→        y: e.touches[0].clientY,
    43→      };
    44→      isDragging.current = false;
    45→    }
    46→  }, []);
    47→
    48→  return { isDragging, handleTouchStart };
    49→}
    50→

     4→ *
     5→ * Returns a ref containing the captured variant ID — pass to MediaLightbox
     6→ * as `initialVariantId` and clear on lightbox close.
     7→ */
     8→
     9→import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
    10→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';
    11→
    12→interface UsePendingImageOpenProps {
    13→  pendingImageToOpen: string | null | undefined;
    14→  pendingImageVariantId: string | null | undefined;
    15→  images: GenerationRow[] | undefined;
    16→  openLightbox: (index: number) => void;
    17→  onClear: (() => void) | undefined;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export function usePendingImageOpen({
    21→  pendingImageToOpen,
    22→  pendingImageVariantId,
    23→  images,
    24→  openLightbox,
    25→  onClear,
    26→}: UsePendingImageOpenProps) {
    27→  const capturedVariantIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
    28→
    29→  useEffect(() => {
    30→    if (!pendingImageToOpen || !images?.length) return;
    31→
    32→    // Capture variant ID before clearing (will be passed to MediaLightbox on next render)
    33→    capturedVariantIdRef.current = pendingImageVariantId ?? null;
    34→
    35→    // Find image by shot_generations.id, shotImageEntryId, or generation_id
    36→    const index = images.findIndex(
    37→      (img) =>
    38→        img.id === pendingImageToOpen ||
    39→        img.shotImageEntryId === pendingImageToOpen ||
    40→        img.generation_id === pendingImageToOpen
    41→    );
    42→
    43→    if (index !== -1) {
    44→      openLightbox(index);
    45→    }
    46→
    47→    onClear?.();
    48→  }, [pendingImageToOpen, pendingImageVariantId, images, openLightbox, onClear]);
    49→
    50→  return capturedVariantIdRef;
    51→}

1→/**
     2→ * Shared helpers for shot-generation mutation hooks.
     3→ * These are standalone concerns extracted from useShotGenerationMutations.
     4→ */
     5→
     6→import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     7→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
     8→import { SHOT_FILTER } from '@/shared/constants/filterConstants';
     9→
    10→// ============================================================================
    11→// HELPER: Check for quota/server errors
    12→// ============================================================================
    13→
    14→export const isQuotaOrServerError = (error: Error): boolean => {
    15→  const msg = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
    16→  return (
    17→    msg.includes('500') ||
    18→    msg.includes('502') ||
    19→    msg.includes('503') ||
    20→    msg.includes('504') ||
    21→    msg.includes('quota') ||
    22→    msg.includes('limit') ||
    23→    msg.includes('capacity')
    24→  );
    25→};
    26→
    27→// ============================================================================
    28→// HELPER: Optimistically remove from unified-generations cache
    29→// ============================================================================
    30→
    31→export function optimisticallyRemoveFromUnifiedGenerations(
    32→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    33→  projectId: string,
    34→  generationId: string
    35→): number {
    36→  const unifiedGenQueries = queryClient.getQueriesData<{
    37→    items: Array<{ id: string; generation_id?: string }>;
    38→    total: number;
    39→    hasMore?: boolean;
    40→  }>({ [REDACTED](projectId) });
    41→
    42→  let updatedCount = 0;
    43→
    44→  unifiedGenQueries.forEach(([queryKey, data]) => {
    45→    // Only remove from 'no-shot' filter views
    46→    const filters = queryKey[5] as { shotId?: string } | undefined;
    47→    if (filters?.shotId !== SHOT_FILTER.NO_SHOT) {
    48→      return;
    49→    }
    50→
    51→    if (data?.items) {
    52→      const filteredItems = data.items.filter(
    53→        item => item.id !== generationId && item.generation_id !== generationId
    54→      );
    55→
    56→      if (filteredItems.length < data.items.length) {
    57→        queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, {
    58→          ...data,
    59→          items: filteredItems,
    60→          total: Math.max(0, (data.total || 0) - 1),
    61→        });
    62→        updatedCount++;
    63→      }
    64→    }
    65→  });
    66→
    67→  return updatedCount;
    68→}
