1→import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { useDeleteGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/useGenerationMutations';
     3→import { ConfirmDialog } from '@/shared/components/ConfirmDialog';
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Wraps useDeleteGeneration with a confirmation dialog.
     7→ *
     8→ * Returns `requestDelete(id)` which opens the dialog, and a
     9→ * `DeleteConfirmDialog` component that must be rendered by the caller.
    10→ *
    11→ * Works in both hooks and components:
    12→ * - Hooks: return `requestDelete` and `DeleteConfirmDialog` to the consuming component
    13→ * - Components: call `requestDelete` and render `<DeleteConfirmDialog />` directly
    14→ *
    15→ * @example
    16→ * ```tsx
    17→ * const { requestDelete, DeleteConfirmDialog, isPending } = useDeleteGenerationWithConfirm();
    18→ *
    19→ * return (
    20→ *   <>
    21→ *     <button onClick={() => requestDelete(id)}>Delete</button>
    22→ *     <DeleteConfirmDialog />
    23→ *   </>
    24→ * );
    25→ * ```
    26→ */
    27→export function useDeleteGenerationWithConfirm() {
    28→  const deleteGenerationMutation = useDeleteGeneration();
    29→  const [pendingDeleteId, setPendingDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    30→
    31→  const requestDelete = useCallback((id: string) => {
    32→    setPendingDeleteId(id);
    33→  }, []);
    34→
    35→  const handleConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    36→    if (pendingDeleteId) {
    37→      deleteGenerationMutation.mutate(pendingDeleteId);
    38→      setPendingDeleteId(null);
    39→    }
    40→  }, [pendingDeleteId, deleteGenerationMutation]);
    41→
    42→  const handleOpenChange = useCallback((open: boolean) => {
    43→    if (!open) {
    44→      setPendingDeleteId(null);
    45→    }
    46→  }, []);
    47→
    48→  /** Render this in your component tree to show the confirmation dialog */
    49→  const DeleteConfirmDialog = useCallback(() => (
    50→    <ConfirmDialog
    51→      open={pendingDeleteId !== null}
    52→      onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
    53→      title="Delete Generation"
    54→      description="Are you sure you want to delete this generation? This action cannot be undone."
    55→      confirmText="Delete"
    56→      destructive
    57→      onConfirm={handleConfirm}
    58→    />
    59→  ), [pendingDeleteId, handleOpenChange, handleConfirm]);
    60→
    61→  return {
    62→    /** Opens the confirmation dialog for the given generation ID */
    63→    requestDelete,
    64→    /** Render this component in your JSX tree: `<DeleteConfirmDialog />` */
    65→    DeleteConfirmDialog,
    66→    /** Whether a delete is currently in progress */
    67→    isPending: deleteGenerationMutation.isPending,
    68→    /** The ID currently being deleted (or null) */
    69→    deletingId: deleteGenerationMutation.isPending ? (deleteGenerationMutation.variables as string) : null,
    70→  };
    71→}

```
1→/**
```

```
     3→ *
     4→ * Toggles the starred state of a generation variant with optimistic update.
     5→ *
     6→ * Usage:
     7→ *   const { toggleStar } = useToggleVariantStar();
     8→ *   toggleStar({ variantId, generationId, starred: true });
     9→ */
    10→
    11→import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    12→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    13→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    14→import type { GenerationVariant } from '@/shared/hooks/useVariants';
    15→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    16→
    17→interface ToggleStarParams {
    18→  variantId: string;
    19→  generationId: string;
    20→  starred: boolean;
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function useToggleVariantStar() {
    24→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    25→
    26→  const mutation = useMutation({
    27→    mutationFn: async ({ variantId, starred }: ToggleStarParams) => {
    28→      const { error } = await supabase
    29→        .from('generation_variants')
    30→        .update({ starred })
    31→        .eq('id', variantId);
    32→
    33→      if (error) {
    34→        handleError(error, { context: 'useToggleVariantStar', showToast: false });
    35→        throw error;
    36→      }
    37→
    38→      return { variantId, starred };
    39→    },
    40→    onMutate: async ({ variantId, generationId, starred }) => {
    41→      const [REDACTED](generationId);
    42→
    43→      // Cancel outgoing refetches
    44→      await queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey });
    45→
    46→      // Snapshot previous value
    47→      const previousVariants = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationVariant[]>(queryKey);
    48→
    49→      // Optimistic update
    50→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationVariant[]>(queryKey, (old) => {
    51→        if (!old) return old;
    52→        return old.map((v) =>
    53→          v.id === variantId ? { ...v, starred } : v
    54→        );
    55→      });
    56→
    57→      return { previousVariants, queryKey };
    58→    },
    59→    onError: (_error, _vars, context) => {
    60→      // Rollback on error
    61→      if (context?.previousVariants) {
    62→        queryClient.setQueryData(context.queryKey, context.previousVariants);
    63→      }
    64→      handleError(new Error('Failed to toggle star'), { context: 'useToggleVariantStar', showToast: false });
    65→    },
    66→    onSettled: (_data, _error, { generationId }) => {
    67→      // Refetch to ensure consistency

    69→        [REDACTED](generationId),
    70→      });
    71→    },
    72→  });
    73→
    74→  return {
    75→    toggleStar: mutation.mutate,
    76→    isToggling: mutation.isPending,
    77→  };
    78→}
```

```
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralized hook for invalidating shot-related React Query caches.
     5→ *
     6→ * Scopes:
     7→ * - 'list': Just the shots list for a project
     8→ * - 'detail': A specific shot's detail data
     9→ * - 'all': List + all related generation caches

    15→

    18→export interface ShotInvalidationOptions {
    19→  /** Which queries to invalidate */
    20→  scope?: ShotInvalidationScope;
    21→  /** Debug reason for logging. Required for traceability. */
    22→  reason: string;
    23→  /** Shot ID - required for 'detail' and 'all' scopes */

    31→ */
    32→function performShotInvalidation(

    44→    // Also invalidate generation caches for this shot
    45→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
    46→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
    47→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
```

```
     2→import { useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
     3→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     4→import { Resource } from './useResources';

     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * Fetch a single resource by ID

    22→      return null;
    23→    }
    24→    console.error('[SpecificResources] Error fetching resource:', id, error);
    25→    throw error;
    26→  }
    27→  
    28→  return data as Resource;
    29→};
    30→
    31→/**
    32→ * Optimized hook to fetch only specific resources by their IDs
    33→ * Each resource is cached individually so removing one resource from the list
    34→ * doesn't cause other resources to be refetched.
    35→ */
    36→export const useSpecificResources = (resourceIds: string[]) => {
    37→  // Deduplicate IDs and filter out empty strings
    38→  const uniqueIds = useMemo(() => 
    39→    [...new Set(resourceIds)].filter(Boolean),
    40→    [resourceIds]
    41→  );
    42→  
    43→  // Use individual queries per resource for normalized caching
    44→  const queries = useQueries({
    45→    queries: uniqueIds.map(id => ({
    46→      [REDACTED](id),
    47→      queryFn: () => fetchResourceById(id),
    48→      // Keep data fresh but cache for a while
    49→      staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
    50→      gcTime: 30 * 60 * 1000,
    51→    })),
    52→  });
    53→  
    54→  // Combine results
    55→  const result = useMemo(() => {
    56→    // Only report loading if we have NO data yet
    57→    // Once we have some data, new fetches happen in the background without blocking UI
    58→    const data = queries
    59→      .map(q => q.data)
    60→      .filter((r): r is Resource => r !== null && r !== undefined);
    61→    const isLoading = data.length === 0 && queries.some(q => q.isLoading);
    62→
    63→    return { data, isLoading };
    64→  }, [queries]);
    65→
    66→  return result;
    67→};
    68→
    69→/**
    70→ * Hook to invalidate cache for a specific resource
    71→ * Call this when a resource is deleted to clean up its cache entry
    72→ *
    73→ * @internal Currently unused - kept for potential future use
    74→ */
    75→const useInvalidateResource = () => {
    76→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    77→
    78→  return useCallback((resourceId: string) => {
    79→    queryClient.removeQueries({ [REDACTED](resourceId) });
    80→  }, [queryClient]);
    81→};
    82→
    83→// Keep for potential future use
    84→void useInvalidateResource;
    85→
    86→
```

```
1→import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→
     3→interface ClickRippleState {
     4→  isActive: boolean;
     5→  position: { x: number; y: number };
     6→}
     7→
     8→interface UseClickRippleOptions {
     9→  duration?: number;
    10→  targetSelector?: string;
    11→}
    12→
    13→export const useClickRipple = (options: UseClickRippleOptions = {}) => {
    14→  const { duration = 700, targetSelector } = options;
    15→  const [rippleState, setRippleState] = useState<ClickRippleState>({
    16→    isActive: false,
    17→    position: { x: 0, y: 0 }
    18→  });
    19→
    20→  const triggerRipple = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent | React.MouseEvent) => {
    21→    e.stopPropagation();
    22→    
    23→    // Find the target element for positioning calculation
    24→    let targetElement: HTMLElement;
    25→    if (targetSelector) {
    26→      targetElement = e.currentTarget.querySelector(targetSelector) as HTMLElement;
    27→    } else {
    28→      targetElement = e.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
    29→    }
    30→    
    31→    if (targetElement) {
    32→      const rect = targetElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    33→      // Calculate pixel offset from center
    34→      const centerX = rect.width / 2;
    35→      const centerY = rect.height / 2;
    36→      const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    37→      const clickY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    38→      const offsetX = clickX - centerX;
    39→      const offsetY = clickY - centerY;
    40→      
    41→      // Set position first, then trigger animation in next frame
    42→      setRippleState({
    43→        isActive: false, // Keep inactive initially
    44→        position: { x: offsetX, y: offsetY }
    45→      });
    46→      
    47→      // Use requestAnimationFrame to ensure position is set before animation starts
    48→      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    49→        setRippleState(prev => ({
    50→          ...prev,
    51→          isActive: true // Now trigger the animation
    52→        }));
    53→        
    54→        // Reset after animation duration
    55→        setTimeout(() => {
    56→          setRippleState(prev => ({ ...prev, isActive: false }));
    57→        }, duration);
    58→      });
    59→    }
    60→  }, [duration, targetSelector]);
    61→
    62→  const triggerRippleAtCenter = useCallback(() => {
    63→    setRippleState({
    64→      isActive: true,
    65→      position: { x: 0, y: 0 } // Center position
    66→    });
    67→    
    68→    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    69→      setTimeout(() => {
    70→        setRippleState(prev => ({ ...prev, isActive: false }));
    71→      }, duration);
    72→    });
    73→  }, [duration]);
    74→
    75→  // CSS custom properties for the ripple position
    76→  const rippleStyles = {
    77→    '--ripple-x': `${rippleState.position.x}px`,
    78→    '--ripple-y': `${rippleState.position.y}px`
    79→  } as React.CSSProperties;
    80→
    81→  return {
    82→    rippleState,
    83→    triggerRipple,
    84→    triggerRippleAtCenter,
    85→    rippleStyles,
    86→    isRippleActive: rippleState.isActive
    87→  };
    88→};
    89→
```

```
1→import { useEffect } from 'react';
     2→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import { generateUUID } from '@/shared/lib/taskCreation';
     4→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     5→
     6→function getOrCreateSessionId(): string {
     7→  try {
     8→    let sessionId = localStorage.getItem('sessionId');
     9→    if (!sessionId) {
    10→      sessionId = generateUUID();
    11→      localStorage.setItem('sessionId', sessionId);
    12→    }
    13→    return sessionId;
    14→  } catch {
    15→    return '';
    16→  }
    17→}
    18→
    19→async function generateFingerprint(): Promise<string> {
    20→  try {
    21→    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    22→    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    23→    if (ctx) {
    24→      ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    25→      ctx.font = '14px Arial';
    26→      ctx.fillText('Browser fingerprint', 2, 2);
    27→    }
    28→
    29→    const glCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    30→    const gl = (glCanvas.getContext('webgl') || glCanvas.getContext('experimental-webgl')) as WebGLRenderingContext | null;
    31→    let webglInfo = '';
    32→    if (gl) {
    33→      const debugInfo = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');
    34→      const vendor = debugInfo ? gl.getParameter(debugInfo.UNMASKED_VENDOR_WEBGL) : '';
    35→      const renderer = debugInfo ? gl.getParameter(debugInfo.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL) : '';
    36→      webglInfo = `${vendor}_${renderer}`;
    37→    }
    38→
    39→    const fingerprintObject = {
    40→      userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
    41→      language: navigator.language,
    42→      platform: navigator.platform,
    43→      screen: `${screen.width}x${screen.height}x${screen.colorDepth}`,
    44→      timezone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone,
    45→      canvas: canvas.toDataURL(),
    46→      webgl: webglInfo,
    47→    };
    48→
    49→    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    50→    const data = encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(fingerprintObject));
    51→    const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
    52→    const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
    53→    return hashArray.map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    54→  } catch {
    55→    return '';
    56→  }
    57→}
    58→
    59→export function useReferralTracking(): void {
    60→  useEffect(() => {
    61→    const run = async () => {
    62→      try {
    63→        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    64→        const referrerCode = urlParams.get('from');
    65→        const sessionId = getOrCreateSessionId();
    66→        const fingerprint = await generateFingerprint();
    67→
    68→        if (!referrerCode) return;
    69→
    70→        try {
    71→          localStorage.setItem('referralCode', referrerCode);
    72→          localStorage.setItem('referralTimestamp', Date.now().toString());
    73→          if (fingerprint) localStorage.setItem('referralFingerprint', fingerprint);
    74→        } catch {}
    75→
    76→        const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('track_referral_visit', {
    77→          p_referrer_username: referrerCode,
    78→          p_visitor_fingerprint: fingerprint || null,
    79→          p_session_id: sessionId || null,
    80→          p_visitor_ip: null,
    81→        });
    82→
    83→        if (!error && data && typeof data === 'string') {
    84→          try { localStorage.setItem('referralSessionId', data); } catch {}
    85→        }
    86→      } catch (err) {
    87→        handleError(err, { context: 'useReferralTracking', showToast: false });
    88→      }
    89→    };
    90→
    91→    run();
    92→  }, []);
    93→}
    94→
    95→
    96→
```

```
     6→export const determineVideoPhase = (
     7→  shouldLoad: boolean,
     8→  videoPosterLoaded: boolean,
     9→  _videoMetadataLoaded: boolean,
    10→  thumbnailLoaded: boolean,

    12→): { phase: string; readyToShow: boolean } => {

    23→  } else if (shouldLoad && !videoPosterLoaded && hasThumbnail && thumbnailLoaded) {
    24→    phase = 'VIDEO_LOADING_WITH_THUMBNAIL';
    25→  } else if (videoPosterLoaded) {
    26→    phase = 'VIDEO_READY';
    27→    readyToShow = true;
    28→  }
    29→  
    30→  return { phase, readyToShow };
    31→};
    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Create loading summary for debugging
    35→ */
    36→export const createLoadingSummary = (hasThumbnail: boolean, thumbnailLoaded: boolean, videoPosterLoaded: boolean, shouldLoad: boolean): string => {
    37→  return hasThumbnail 
    38→    ? `Thumbnail: ${thumbnailLoaded ? '✅' : '⏳'} | Video: ${videoPosterLoaded ? '✅' : '⏳'}`
    39→    : `Video: ${videoPosterLoaded ? '✅' : shouldLoad ? '⏳' : '⏸️'}`;
    40→};
    41→
    42→/**
    43→ * Sort video outputs by creation date
    44→ * @internal - only used within this file
    45→ */
    46→const sortVideoOutputsByDate = (videoOutputs: GenerationRow[]): GenerationRow[] => {
    47→  return [...videoOutputs]
    48→    .map(v => ({ v, time: new Date(v.createdAt || (v as { created_at?: string | null }).created_at || 0).getTime() }))
    49→    .sort((a, b) => b.time - a.time)
    50→    .map(({ v }) => v);
    51→};
    52→
    53→// Keeping for potential future use but not exporting
    54→void sortVideoOutputsByDate;
    55→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Image Preloading Configuration
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure function to detect device capabilities and return appropriate config.
     5→ * No side effects, no state - just returns a config object.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import type { PreloadConfig } from './types';
     9→
    10→/**
    11→ * Detect device capabilities and return appropriate preload configuration.
    12→ */
    13→export function getPreloadConfig(): PreloadConfig {
    14→  // Check if we're on mobile
    15→  const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth <= 768;
    16→
    17→  // Check connection speed (if available)
    18→  const connection =
    19→    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'connection' in navigator
    20→      ? (navigator as { connection?: { effectiveType?: string } }).connection
    21→      : null;
    22→  const hasSlowConnection =
    23→    connection && ['2g', 'slow-2g'].includes(connection.effectiveType || '');
    24→
    25→  // Check memory (if available)
    26→  const hasLowMemory =
    27→    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
    28→    'deviceMemory' in navigator &&
    29→    (navigator as { deviceMemory?: number }).deviceMemory !== undefined &&
    30→    ((navigator as { deviceMemory: number }).deviceMemory <= 4);
    31→
    32→  // Slow connection: minimal preloading
    33→  if (hasSlowConnection) {
    34→    return {
    35→      maxConcurrent: 1,
    36→      debounceMs: 300,
    37→      maxImagesPerPage: 3,
    38→      preloadThumbnailsOnly: true,
    39→    };
    40→  }
    41→
    42→  // Mobile or low memory: conservative preloading
    43→  if (isMobile || hasLowMemory) {
    44→    return {
    45→      maxConcurrent: 2,
    46→      debounceMs: 200,
    47→      maxImagesPerPage: 6,
    48→      preloadThumbnailsOnly: true,
    49→    };
    50→  }
    51→
    52→  // Desktop: more aggressive preloading
    53→  return {
    54→    maxConcurrent: 3,
    55→    debounceMs: 150,
    56→    maxImagesPerPage: 10,
    57→    preloadThumbnailsOnly: false,
    58→  };
    59→}
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Image Preloader
     3→ *
     4→ * Core preloading logic - takes images and loads them via the queue.
     5→ * Marks images as loaded when they complete.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import type { PreloadableImage, PreloadConfig } from './types';
     9→import { PreloadQueue } from './queue';
    10→import { setImageLoadStatus, hasLoadedImage, markImageLoaded } from './tracker';
    11→import { getDisplayUrl } from '@/shared/lib/utils';
    12→
    13→/**
    14→ * Preload a batch of images using the provided queue.
    15→ * Marks images as loaded in the tracker when they complete.
    16→ *
    17→ * @param images - Images to preload
    18→ * @param queue - The preload queue to use
    19→ * @param config - Preload configuration
    20→ * @param priority - Base priority for these images (higher = load first)
    21→ */
    22→export async function preloadImages(
    23→  images: PreloadableImage[],
    24→  queue: PreloadQueue,
    25→  config: PreloadConfig,
    26→  priority = 0
    27→): Promise<void> {
    28→  // Limit to max images per page
    29→  const limitedImages = images.slice(0, config.maxImagesPerPage);
    30→
    31→  // Filter out already-loaded images
    32→  const toPreload = limitedImages.filter((img) => !hasLoadedImage(img as { id: string }));
    33→
    34→  if (toPreload.length === 0) {
    35→    return;
    36→  }
    37→
    38→  // Create promises for each image
    39→  const promises = toPreload.map(async (img, idx) => {
    40→    const url = getImageUrl(img, config.preloadThumbnailsOnly);
    41→
    42→    if (!url) {
    43→      return;
    44→    }
    45→
    46→    // Skip invalid URLs (e.g., join-clips outputs with non-existent thumbnails)
    47→    if (url.includes('_joined_frame.jpg')) {
    48→      return;
    49→    }
    50→
    51→    try {
    52→      // Slightly decrease priority for later images in the batch
    53→      const element = await queue.add(url, priority - idx);
    54→
    55→      // Track by ID if available
    56→      if (img.id) {
    57→        setImageLoadStatus(img as { id: string }, true);
    58→      }
    59→
    60→      // Track by URL with element ref (for browser cache persistence)
    61→      markImageLoaded(url, { element });
    62→    } catch {
    63→      // Preloading is best-effort - don't throw on failure
    64→    }
    65→  });
    66→
    67→  // Wait for all to settle (don't fail if some images fail)
    68→  await Promise.allSettled(promises);
    69→}
    70→
    71→/**
    72→ * Get the URL to preload for an image (thumbnail or full based on config)
    73→ */
    74→function getImageUrl(img: PreloadableImage, thumbnailOnly: boolean): string | null {
    75→  const rawUrl = thumbnailOnly ? img.thumbUrl || img.url : img.url;
    76→
    77→  if (!rawUrl) {
    78→    return null;
    79→  }
    80→
    81→  return getDisplayUrl(rawUrl);
    82→}
    83→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * useTaskInvalidation.ts
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralized hook for invalidating task-related React Query caches.
     5→ *
     6→ * Scopes:
     7→ * - 'list': Task list for a project
     8→ * - 'detail': Specific task
     9→ * - 'counts': Just status counts (lightweight)
    10→ * - 'all': Everything task-related
    11→ */
    12→
    13→import { useQueryClient, QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    14→import { useCallback } from 'react';
    15→import { queryKeys } from '../../lib/queryKeys';
    16→import { invalidateGenerationsSync } from './useGenerationInvalidation';
    17→
    18→export type TaskInvalidationScope = 'list' | 'detail' | 'counts' | 'all';
    19→
    20→export interface TaskInvalidationOptions {
    21→  /** Which queries to invalidate */
    22→  scope?: TaskInvalidationScope;
    23→  /** Debug reason for logging. Required for traceability. */
    24→  reason: string;
    25→  /** Task ID - required for 'detail' scope */
    26→  taskId?: string;
    27→  /** Project ID - required for 'list', 'counts', and 'all' scopes */
    28→  projectId?: string;
    29→  /** Also invalidate generation caches (for task completion) */
    30→  includeGenerations?: boolean;
    31→  /** Shot ID - required if includeGenerations is true */
    32→  shotId?: string;
    33→}
    34→
    35→/**
    36→ * Internal helper that performs the actual invalidation.
    37→ */
    38→function performTaskInvalidation(
    39→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    40→  options: TaskInvalidationOptions
    41→): void {
    42→  const { scope = 'all', reason, taskId, projectId, includeGenerations, shotId } = options;
    43→
    44→  if ((scope === 'list' || scope === 'all') && projectId) {
    45→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });
    46→  }
    47→
    48→  if ((scope === 'detail' || scope === 'all') && taskId) {
    49→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](taskId) });
    50→  }
    51→
    52→  if ((scope === 'counts' || scope === 'all') && projectId) {
    53→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  // Task completion often means new generations
    57→  if (includeGenerations && shotId) {
    58→    invalidateGenerationsSync(queryClient, shotId, {
    59→      reason: `${reason} (task completion)`,
    60→      scope: 'all',
    61→    });
    62→  }
    63→}
    64→
    65→/**
    66→ * Hook that returns a stable task invalidation function.
    67→ * Use this in React components/hooks.
    68→ *
    69→ * @internal Not exported - currently unused. If needed in the future,
    70→ * add export back and update the barrel file.
    71→ */
    72→function useInvalidateTasks() {
    73→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    74→
    75→  return useCallback((options: TaskInvalidationOptions) => {
    76→    performTaskInvalidation(queryClient, options);
    77→  }, [queryClient]);
    78→}
    79→
    80→// Keep for potential future use
    81→void useInvalidateTasks;
    82→
    83→/**
    84→ * Non-hook version for use outside React components.
    85→ * Requires passing in the queryClient.
    86→ *
    87→ * @internal Not exported - currently unused. If needed in the future,
    88→ * add export back and update the barrel file.
    89→ */
    90→function invalidateTasksSync(
    91→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    92→  options: TaskInvalidationOptions
    93→): void {
    94→  performTaskInvalidation(queryClient, options);
    95→}
    96→
    97→// Keep for potential future use
    98→void invalidateTasksSync;
    99→
```

```
1→// Snapshot utilities for realtime state inspection
     2→
     3→/** Shape of the Supabase realtime client as accessed at runtime for debugging */
     4→interface RealtimeDebugClient {
     5→  socket?: WebSocket | null;
     6→  conn?: { transport?: WebSocket | null; connectionState?: string };
     7→  channels?: Record<string, { state?: string; joinRef?: string; ref?: string }>;
     8→  isConnected?: () => boolean;
     9→}
    10→
    11→/** Shape of tracked WebSocket instances stored on window */
    12→interface TrackedWSInstance {
    13→  wsId?: number;
    14→  url?: string;
    15→  websocketRef?: WebSocket | null;
    16→}
    17→
    18→interface RealtimeSnapshot {
    19→  isConnected?: boolean;
    20→  socket: { readyState: number; url: string; protocol: string } | null;
    21→  conn: { transport: { readyState: number; url: string } | null; connectionState?: string } | null;
    22→  channelCount: number;
    23→  channelDetails: Array<{ topic: string; state?: string; joinRef?: string; ref?: string; bindings: never[] }>;
    24→  effectiveSocket: { readyState: number; url: string } | null;
    25→  timestamp: number;
    26→}
    27→
    28→interface RealtimeSnapshotError {
    29→  error: string;
    30→  message?: string;
    31→}
    32→
    33→// Helper: locate the effective Supabase WebSocket regardless of where it is stored
    34→function getEffectiveRealtimeSocket(): WebSocket | null {
    35→  try {
    36→    const rt = (window as Record<string, unknown>).supabase as { realtime?: RealtimeDebugClient } | undefined;
    37→    const realtime = rt?.realtime;
    38→    if (!realtime) return null;
    39→    const direct = realtime.socket;
    40→    if (direct && typeof direct.readyState === 'number') return direct;
    41→    const transport = realtime.conn?.transport;
    42→    if (transport && typeof transport.readyState === 'number') return transport;
    43→    const instances = ((window as Record<string, unknown>).__SUPABASE_WEBSOCKET_INSTANCES__ || []) as TrackedWSInstance[];
    44→    for (const inst of instances) {
    45→      const ref = inst?.websocketRef;
    46→      const url = inst?.url || ref?.url || '';
    47→      if (ref && typeof ref.readyState === 'number' && typeof url === 'string' && url.includes('supabase.co/realtime')) {
    48→        // Prefer an OPEN socket if available
    49→        if (ref.readyState === 1) return ref;
    50→      }
    51→    }
    52→    // Fallback: return any tracked supabase ws if present
    53→    const anyInst = instances.find((i) => ((i?.url || i?.websocketRef?.url || '') as string).includes('supabase.co/realtime'));
    54→    return anyInst?.websocketRef || null;
    55→  } catch {
    56→    return null;
    57→  }
    58→}
    59→
    60→// Capture detailed realtime state as JSON (not "Object")
    61→export function captureRealtimeSnapshot(): RealtimeSnapshot | RealtimeSnapshotError {
    62→  try {
    63→    const supabaseObj = (window as Record<string, unknown>).supabase as { realtime?: RealtimeDebugClient } | undefined;
    64→    const rt = supabaseObj?.realtime;
    65→    if (!rt) return { error: 'NO_REALTIME_CLIENT' };
    66→
    67→    const channels = rt.channels || {};
    68→    const channelDetails = Object.keys(channels).map(topic => {
    69→      const ch = channels[topic];
    70→      return {
    71→        topic,
    72→        state: ch?.state,
    73→        joinRef: ch?.joinRef,
    74→        ref: ch?.ref,
    75→        bindings: [] as never[] // DISABLED: Was accessing bindings and causing corruption
    76→      };
    77→    });
    78→
    79→    return {
    80→      isConnected: rt.isConnected?.(),
    81→      socket: rt.socket ? {
    82→        readyState: rt.socket.readyState,
    83→        url: rt.socket.url,
    84→        protocol: rt.socket.protocol
    85→      } : null,
    86→      conn: rt.conn ? {
    87→        transport: rt.conn.transport ? {
    88→          readyState: rt.conn.transport.readyState,
    89→          url: rt.conn.transport.url
    90→        } : null,
    91→        connectionState: rt.conn.connectionState
    92→      } : null,
    93→      channelCount: Object.keys(channels).length,
    94→      channelDetails,
    95→      effectiveSocket: (() => {
    96→        const sock = getEffectiveRealtimeSocket();
    97→        return sock ? { readyState: sock.readyState, url: sock.url } : null;
    98→      })(),
    99→      timestamp: Date.now()
   100→    };
   101→  } catch (error) {
   102→    return { error: 'SNAPSHOT_FAILED', message: (error as Error)?.message };
   103→  }
   104→}
   105→
   106→
   107→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Centralized Query Key Registry
     3→ *
     4→ * ALL React Query keys should be defined here. This provides:
     5→ * - TypeScript autocomplete (catches typos at compile time)
     6→ * - Single source of truth (easy refactoring)
     7→ * - Visibility into cache structure
     8→ *
     9→ * Naming conventions:
    10→ * - Use nouns for entities: 'shots', 'generations', 'tasks'
    11→ * - Use kebab-case for multi-word: 'all-shot-generations'
    12→ * - Scope from broad to specific: ['shots', projectId] not [projectId, 'shots']
    13→ *
    14→ * Usage:
    15→ *   import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    16→ *
    17→ *   // In useQuery
    18→ *   useQuery({
    19→ *     [REDACTED](shotId),
    20→ *     queryFn: fetchGenerations,
    21→ *   })
    22→ *
    23→ *   // In invalidation
    24→ *   queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) })
    25→ */
```

```
   130→  } catch (error) {
```

```
1→import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { formatDistanceToNow, isValid } from 'date-fns';
     3→import { useTimestampUpdater } from './useTimestampUpdater';
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Simple hook that returns a live-updating formatted timestamp string
     7→ * Perfect for inline timestamps in task lists, galleries, etc.
     8→ */
     9→
    10→interface UseUpdatingTimestampOptions {
    11→  /** Date to format */
    12→  date?: string | Date | null;
    13→  /** Custom abbreviation function */
    14→  abbreviate?: (str: string) => string;
    15→  /** Disable automatic updates */
    16→  disabled?: boolean;
    17→}
    18→
    19→// Simple, direct abbreviation function
    20→const defaultAbbreviate = (str: string) => {
    21→  // Handle all variations of "1 hour" - remove "about" and use singular
    22→  if (str.includes('1 hr') || str.includes('1 hour')) {
    23→    return '1 hr ago';
    24→  }
    25→  
    26→  // Handle all variations of "1 day" - remove "about" and use singular  
    27→  if (str.includes('1 day')) {
    28→    return '1 day ago';
    29→  }
    30→  
    31→  // Handle "less than a minute ago"
    32→  if (str.includes('less than a minute')) {
    33→    return '<1 min ago';
    34→  }
    35→  
    36→  // Handle other single units
    37→  if (str.includes('1 minute')) {
    38→    return '1 min ago';
    39→  }
    40→  
    41→  if (str.includes('1 second')) {
    42→    return '1 sec ago';
    43→  }
    44→  
    45→  // Handle plurals - remove "about" prefix and abbreviate
    46→  return str
    47→    .replace(/^about /, '') // Remove "about" prefix
    48→    .replace(/minutes?/, 'mins')
    49→    .replace(/hours?/, 'hrs')
    50→    .replace(/seconds?/, 'secs')
    51→    .replace(/days?/, 'days');
    52→};
    53→
    54→/**
    55→ * Hook that returns a formatted, live-updating timestamp string
    56→ * 
    57→ * @example
    58→ * const timeAgo = useUpdatingTimestamp({ date: task.createdAt });
    59→ * return <span>Created: {timeAgo}</span>;
    60→ */
    61→export function useUpdatingTimestamp({ 
    62→  date, 
    63→  abbreviate = defaultAbbreviate,
    64→  disabled = false 
    65→}: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}) {
    66→  
    67→  const parsedDate = useMemo(() => {
    68→    if (!date) return null;
    69→    const parsed = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date;
    70→    return isValid(parsed) ? parsed : null;
    71→  }, [date]);
    72→  
    73→  // Get live update trigger
    74→  const { updateTrigger } = useTimestampUpdater({
    75→    date: parsedDate,
    76→    disabled,
    77→    isVisible: true // Explicitly set to ensure TaskPane timestamps update
    78→  });
    79→  
    80→  // Debug logging for task timestamps
    81→  React.useEffect(() => {
    82→    if (parsedDate && parsedDate.getTime() > Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) { // Only log for recent tasks
    83→    }
    84→  }, [updateTrigger, parsedDate]);
    85→  
    86→  // Format timestamp with live updates
    87→  const formattedTime = useMemo(() => {
    88→    if (!parsedDate) return 'Unknown';
    89→    
    90→    const formatted = formatDistanceToNow(parsedDate, { addSuffix: true });
    91→    const abbreviated = abbreviate(formatted);
    92→    
    93→    return abbreviated;
    94→  }, [parsedDate?.getTime(), updateTrigger, abbreviate]);
    95→  
    96→  return formattedTime;
    97→}
    98→
    99→/**
   100→ * Hook specifically for task timestamps with consistent abbreviation
   101→ */
   102→export function useTaskTimestamp(date?: string | Date | null) {
   103→  return useUpdatingTimestamp({ 
   104→    date,
   105→    abbreviate: defaultAbbreviate 
   106→  });
   107→}
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * PreloadQueue
     3→ *
     4→ * A priority queue for image preloading that limits concurrent requests
     5→ * to avoid overwhelming the browser.
     6→ *
     7→ * Features:
     8→ * - Priority-based ordering (higher priority loads first)
     9→ * - Concurrent request limiting
    10→ * - Cancellation support
    11→ * - Promise-based API
    12→ * - Returns loaded HTMLImageElement for ref storage
    13→ */
    14→
    15→interface QueueItem {
    16→  url: string;
    17→  priority: number;
    18→  resolve: (element: HTMLImageElement) => void;
    19→  reject: (err: Error) => void;
    20→  aborted: boolean;
    21→}
    22→
    23→export class PreloadQueue {
    24→  private queue: QueueItem[] = [];
    25→  private active = 0;
    26→  private maxConcurrent: number;
    27→
    28→  constructor(maxConcurrent = 3) {
    29→    this.maxConcurrent = maxConcurrent;
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  /**
    33→   * Add a URL to the preload queue.
    34→   * Returns a promise that resolves with the loaded HTMLImageElement.
    35→   *
    36→   * @param url - The image URL to preload
    37→   * @param priority - Higher numbers load first (default: 0)
    38→   */
    39→  add(url: string, priority = 0): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
    40→    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    41→      const item: QueueItem = {
    42→        url,
    43→        priority,
    44→        resolve,
    45→        reject,
    46→        aborted: false,
    47→      };
    48→
    49→      // Insert sorted by priority (higher first)
    50→      const insertIdx = this.queue.findIndex((q) => q.priority < priority);
    51→      if (insertIdx === -1) {
    52→        this.queue.push(item);
    53→      } else {
    54→        this.queue.splice(insertIdx, 0, item);
    55→      }
    56→
    57→      this.processNext();
    58→    });
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  /**
    62→   * Clear all pending items from the queue.
    63→   * Active loads will complete but their callbacks are ignored.
    64→   */
    65→  clear(): void {
    66→    this.queue.forEach((item) => {
    67→      item.aborted = true;
    68→    });
    69→    this.queue = [];
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  /**
    73→   * Get the current queue size (pending items only)
    74→   */
    75→  get size(): number {
    76→    return this.queue.length;
    77→  }
    78→
    79→  /**
    80→   * Get the number of currently active loads
    81→   */
    82→  get activeCount(): number {
    83→    return this.active;
    84→  }
    85→
    86→  private async processNext(): Promise<void> {
    87→    if (this.active >= this.maxConcurrent || this.queue.length === 0) {
    88→      return;
    89→    }
    90→
    91→    const item = this.queue.shift()!;
    92→
    93→    // Skip if already aborted
    94→    if (item.aborted) {
    95→      this.processNext();
    96→      return;
    97→    }
    98→
    99→    this.active++;
   100→
   101→    try {
   102→      const element = await this.loadImage(item.url);
   103→      if (!item.aborted) {
   104→        item.resolve(element);
   105→      }
   106→    } catch (err) {
   107→      if (!item.aborted) {
   108→        item.reject(err as Error);
   109→      }
   110→    } finally {
   111→      this.active--;
   112→      // Process next item after a microtask to avoid blocking
   113→      queueMicrotask(() => this.processNext());
   114→    }
   115→  }
   116→
   117→  private loadImage(url: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
   118→    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   119→      const img = new Image();
   120→
   121→      img.onload = () => {
   122→        img.onload = null;
   123→        img.onerror = null;
   124→        resolve(img);
   125→      };
   126→
   127→      img.onerror = () => {
   128→        img.onload = null;
   129→        img.onerror = null;
   130→        reject(new Error(`Failed to load image: ${url}`));
   131→      };
   132→
   133→      img.src = url;
   134→    });
   135→  }
   136→}
   137→
```

```
     2→import { uploadImageToStorage } from './imageUploader';
     3→import { dataURLtoFile } from './utils';
     4→import { generateClientThumbnail, uploadImageWithThumbnail } from './clientThumbnailGenerator';

     7→
     8→// Import the ReferenceImage type from the image generation form
     9→export interface ReferenceImage {
    10→  id: string;
    11→  name: string;
    12→  styleReferenceImage: string | null;
    13→  styleReferenceImageOriginal: string | null;
    14→  thumbnailUrl?: string | null;

    20→  styleBoostTerms?: string;
    21→  createdAt: string;
    22→  updatedAt: string;
    23→}
    24→
    25→/**
    26→ * Reprocesses all reference images for a project when dimensions change.
    27→ * Uses the original images as source and regenerates cropped versions.
    28→ * 
    29→ * @param references - Array of reference images to reprocess
    30→ * @param newAspectRatio - New aspect ratio string (e.g., "16:9", "1:1")
    31→ * @param onProgress - Optional callback for progress updates (current, total)
    32→ * @returns Promise with array of updated references
    33→ */
    34→export async function recropAllReferences(
    35→  references: ReferenceImage[],
    36→  newAspectRatio: string,
    37→  onProgress?: (current: number, total: number) => void
    38→): Promise<ReferenceImage[]> {
    39→  
    40→  const reprocessed: ReferenceImage[] = [];
    41→  let successCount = 0;
    42→  let skipCount = 0;
    43→  let errorCount = 0;
    44→  
    45→  for (let i = 0; i < references.length; i++) {
    46→    const ref = references[i];
    47→    
    48→    // Skip if no original image
    49→    if (!ref.styleReferenceImageOriginal) {
    50→      reprocessed.push(ref);
    51→      skipCount++;
    52→      onProgress?.(i + 1, references.length);
    53→      continue;
    54→    }
    55→    
    56→    try {
    57→      // Fetch the original image
    58→      const response = await fetch(ref.styleReferenceImageOriginal);
    59→      if (!response.ok) {
    60→        throw new Error(`Failed to fetch image: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
    61→      }
    62→      const blob = await response.blob();
    63→      
    64→      // Convert to data URL for processing
    65→      const dataURL = await new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
    66→        const reader = new FileReader();
    67→        reader.onloadend = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
    68→        reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read blob as data URL'));
    69→        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
    70→      });
    71→      
    72→      // Reprocess for new aspect ratio
    73→      const processedDataURL = await processStyleReferenceForAspectRatioString(
    74→        dataURL,
    75→        newAspectRatio
    76→      );
    77→      
    78→      if (!processedDataURL) {
    79→        throw new Error('processStyleReferenceForAspectRatioString returned null');
    80→      }
    81→      
    82→      // Upload new processed version with thumbnail
    83→      const processedFile = dataURLtoFile(
    84→        processedDataURL,
    85→        `reference-${ref.id}-${Date.now()}.png`
    86→      );
    87→      
    88→      if (!processedFile) {
    89→        throw new Error('dataURLtoFile returned null');
    90→      }
    91→      
    92→      let newProcessedUrl = '';
    93→      let newThumbnailUrl = '';
    94→      
    95→      try {
    96→        // Get current user ID for storage path
    97→        const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    98→        if (!session?.user?.id) {
    99→          throw new Error('User not authenticated');
   100→        }
   101→        const userId = session.user.id;
   102→
   103→        // Generate thumbnail for reprocessed image
   104→        const thumbnailResult = await generateClientThumbnail(processedFile, 300, 0.8);
   105→        
   106→        // Upload both main image and thumbnail
   107→        const uploadResult = await uploadImageWithThumbnail(processedFile, thumbnailResult.thumbnailBlob, userId);
   108→        newProcessedUrl = uploadResult.imageUrl;
   109→        newThumbnailUrl = uploadResult.thumbnailUrl;
   110→        
   111→      } catch (thumbnailError) {
   112→        // Fallback to original upload flow without thumbnail
   113→        newProcessedUrl = await uploadImageToStorage(processedFile);
   114→        newThumbnailUrl = newProcessedUrl; // Use main image as fallback
   115→      }
   116→      
   117→      // Update reference with new processed URL and thumbnail (keep original)
   118→      const updatedRef = {
   119→        ...ref,
   120→        styleReferenceImage: newProcessedUrl,
   121→        thumbnailUrl: newThumbnailUrl,
   122→        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
   123→      };
   124→      reprocessed.push(updatedRef);
   125→      successCount++;
   126→      
   127→      // Report progress
   128→      onProgress?.(i + 1, references.length);
   129→      
   130→    } catch (error) {
   131→      handleError(error, { context: 'RecropReferences', showToast: false });
   132→      errorCount++;
   133→      // Keep the old reference unchanged on error
   134→      reprocessed.push(ref);
   135→      // Still report progress
   136→      onProgress?.(i + 1, references.length);
   137→    }
   138→  }
   139→  
   140→  return reprocessed;
   141→}
   142→
   143→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * usePendingGenerationTasks Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Tracks tasks that are "Queued" or "In Progress" that will create
     5→ * variants or derived generations from a given source generation.
     6→ *
     7→ * Works for both images and videos - checks task params for source generation references.
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { useMemo } from 'react';
    11→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    12→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    13→import { TASK_STATUS } from '@/types/tasks';
    14→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    15→
    16→interface PendingGenerationTask {
    17→  id: string;
    18→  status: string;
    19→  task_type: string;
    20→}
    21→
    22→interface UsePendingGenerationTasksReturn {
    23→  /** Number of pending tasks that will create variants/derived from this generation */
    24→  pendingCount: number;
    25→  /** The pending tasks */
    26→  pendingTasks: PendingGenerationTask[];
    27→  /** Loading state */
    28→  isLoading: boolean;
    29→}
    30→
    31→/**
    32→ * Check if task params reference a specific generation ID as a source.
    33→ * Checks common param fields where source generation is stored.
    34→ */
    35→function taskReferencesGeneration(params: Record<string, unknown> | null, generationId: string): boolean {
    36→  if (!params || !generationId) return false;
    37→
    38→  // Direct source references
    39→  if (params.based_on === generationId) return true;
    40→  if (params.source_generation_id === generationId) return true;
    41→  if (params.generation_id === generationId) return true;
    42→  if (params.input_generation_id === generationId) return true;
    43→  if (params.parent_generation_id === generationId) return true;
    44→  // Video segment tasks use pair_shot_generation_id
    45→  if (params.pair_shot_generation_id === generationId) return true;
    46→
    47→  // Check nested in orchestrator_details
    48→  const orchDetails = params.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    49→  if (orchDetails) {
    50→    if (orchDetails.based_on === generationId) return true;
    51→    if (orchDetails.source_generation_id === generationId) return true;
    52→    if (orchDetails.parent_generation_id === generationId) return true;
    53→    // Check pair_shot_generation_ids array
    54→    if (Array.isArray(orchDetails.pair_shot_generation_ids)) {
    55→      if (orchDetails.pair_shot_generation_ids.includes(generationId)) return true;
    56→    }
    57→  }
    58→
    59→  // Check full_orchestrator_payload
    60→  const fullPayload = params.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    61→  if (fullPayload) {
    62→    if (fullPayload.based_on === generationId) return true;
    63→    if (fullPayload.source_generation_id === generationId) return true;
    64→    if (fullPayload.parent_generation_id === generationId) return true;
    65→  }
    66→
    67→  // Check individual_segment_params (used by individual_travel_segment)
    68→  const individualParams = params.individual_segment_params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    69→  if (individualParams) {
    70→    if (individualParams.pair_shot_generation_id === generationId) return true;
    71→  }
    72→
    73→  return false;
    74→}
    75→
    76→export function usePendingGenerationTasks(
    77→  generationId: string | null | undefined,
    78→  projectId: string | null | undefined
    79→): UsePendingGenerationTasksReturn {
    80→  // Query pending tasks for this project
    81→  const { data: pendingTasks, isLoading } = useQuery({
    82→    queryKey: [...queryKeys.tasks.pendingGeneration(generationId!), projectId],
    83→    queryFn: async () => {
    84→      if (!generationId || !projectId) return [];
    85→
    86→      // Query tasks that are Queued or In Progress
    87→      const { data, error } = await supabase
    88→        .from('tasks')
    89→        .select('id, status, task_type, params')
    90→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
    91→        .in('status', [TASK_STATUS.QUEUED, TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS]);
    92→
    93→      if (error) {
    94→        console.error('[usePendingGenerationTasks] Query error:', error);
    95→        return [];
    96→      }
    97→
    98→      // Filter to tasks that reference this generation
    99→      const matchingTasks: PendingGenerationTask[] = (data || [])
   100→        .filter(task => taskReferencesGeneration(task.params as Record<string, unknown> | null, generationId))
   101→        .map(task => ({
   102→          id: task.id,
   103→          status: task.status,
   104→          task_type: task.task_type,
   105→        }));
   106→
   107→      return matchingTasks;
   108→    },
   109→    enabled: !!generationId && !!projectId,
   110→    // Poll to catch status changes
   111→    refetchInterval: 5000,
   112→    // Mark as stale immediately so invalidations trigger refetch
   113→    staleTime: 0,
   114→    // Short cache time - don't keep stale data around
   115→    gcTime: 10000,
   116→    // Always refetch when window regains focus
   117→    refetchOnWindowFocus: 'always',
   118→  });
   119→
   120→  const result = useMemo(() => ({
   121→    pendingCount: pendingTasks?.length || 0,
   122→    pendingTasks: pendingTasks || [],
   123→    isLoading,
   124→  }), [pendingTasks, isLoading]);
   125→
   126→  return result;
   127→}
   128→
   129→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { usePendingGenerationTasks } instead
   130→
```

```
     6→ * be added to shots, starred, and treated as first-class gallery items.

    19→interface PromoteVariantParams {
    20→  /** ID of the variant to promote */
    21→  variantId: string;

    23→  projectId: string;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PromotedGeneration {

    35→
    36→/**
    37→ * Hook for promoting a variant to a standalone generation
    38→ */
    39→export const usePromoteVariantToGeneration = () => {
    40→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    41→
    42→  return useMutation({
    43→    mutationFn: async ({
    44→      variantId,
    45→      projectId,

    47→      // 1. Fetch the variant — its generation_id is the single source of truth for lineage
    48→      const { data: variant, error: variantError } = await supabase
    49→        .from('generation_variants')
    50→        .select('*')
    51→        .eq('id', variantId)
    52→        .single();
    53→
    54→      if (variantError || !variant) {
    55→        throw new Error(`Failed to fetch variant: ${variantError?.message || 'Not found'}`);
    56→      }
    57→
    58→      const sourceGenerationId = variant.generation_id;
    59→
    60→      // 2. Determine if this is a video or image based on the URL
    61→      const isVideo = hasVideoExtension(variant.location);
    62→      const mediaType = isVideo ? 'video' : 'image';
    63→
    64→      // 3. Create new generation record
    65→      // Strip generation_id from variant params — if it leaks into the new generation's params,
    66→      // generationTransformers spreads params into metadata, and getGenerationId() reads
    67→      // metadata.generation_id (priority 2) over media.id (priority 3), causing the lightbox
    68→      // to fetch variants for the SOURCE generation instead of the new one.
    69→      const {
    70→        generation_id: _stripGenId,
    71→        source_task_id: _stripTaskId,
    72→        ...cleanVariantParams
    73→      } = (variant.params as Record<string, unknown>) || {};
    74→
    75→      const newGenerationData = {
    76→        location: variant.location,
    77→        thumbnail_url: variant.thumbnail_url,
    78→        project_id: projectId,
    79→        type: mediaType,
    80→        based_on: sourceGenerationId,
    81→        params: {
    82→          ...cleanVariantParams,
    83→          source: 'variant_promotion',
    84→          source_variant_id: variantId,
    85→          source_generation_id: sourceGenerationId,
    86→          tool_type: cleanVariantParams.tool_type || 'promoted-variant',
    87→          promoted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    88→        },
    89→      };
    90→
    91→      const { data: newGeneration, error: insertError } = await supabase
    92→        .from('generations')
    93→        .insert(newGenerationData)
    94→        .select()
    95→        .single();
    96→
    97→      if (insertError || !newGeneration) {
    98→        throw new Error(`Failed to create generation: ${insertError?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
    99→      }
   100→
   101→      // DB trigger trg_auto_create_variant_after_generation auto-creates
   102→      // the primary variant from the generation's location/params.
   103→
   104→      return {
   105→        id: newGeneration.id,
   106→        location: newGeneration.location,
   107→        thumbnail_url: newGeneration.thumbnail_url,
   108→        type: newGeneration.type,
   109→        project_id: newGeneration.project_id,
   110→        based_on: newGeneration.based_on,
   111→        params: newGeneration.params as Record<string, unknown>,
   112→      };
   113→    },
   114→
   115→    onSuccess: (data) => {

   117→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   118→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });

   120→      // Invalidate derived generations for the source

   123→          [REDACTED](data.based_on),
   124→        });
   125→      }
   126→    },
   127→
   128→    onError: (error) => {
   129→      handleError(error, { context: 'usePromoteVariantToGeneration', toastTitle: 'Failed to create new image from variant' });
   130→    },
   131→  });
   132→};
```

```
     6→/**

     8→ * Content fields (prompts, references) are excluded; configuration settings are kept.

    10→ * INHERITANCE POLICY: Content data doesn't inherit, but configuration settings do.
    11→ */
    12→function filterSettingsForInheritance(
    13→  settings: Record<string, unknown>
    14→): Record<string, unknown> {
    15→  const settingsToInherit: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    16→
    17→  Object.entries(settings).forEach(([toolId, toolSettings]) => {
    18→    if (typeof toolSettings === 'object' && toolSettings !== null) {
    19→      const filteredToolSettings = { ...toolSettings } as Record<string, unknown>;
    20→
    21→      // Remove prompt-related keys
    22→      delete filteredToolSettings.prompt;
    23→      delete filteredToolSettings.prompts;
    24→      delete filteredToolSettings.beforeEachPromptText;
    25→      delete filteredToolSettings.afterEachPromptText;
    26→      delete filteredToolSettings.pairConfigs;
    27→
    28→      // Remove reference-related keys
    29→      delete filteredToolSettings.references;
    30→      delete filteredToolSettings.selectedReferenceId;
    31→      delete filteredToolSettings.selectedReferenceIdByShot;
    32→      delete filteredToolSettings.styleReferenceImage;
    33→      delete filteredToolSettings.styleReferenceImageOriginal;
    34→      delete filteredToolSettings.styleReferenceStrength;
    35→      delete filteredToolSettings.subjectStrength;
    36→      delete filteredToolSettings.subjectDescription;
    37→      delete filteredToolSettings.inThisScene;
    38→
    39→      // Remove prompt-editor specific AI settings
    40→      delete filteredToolSettings.generationSettings;
    41→      delete filteredToolSettings.bulkEditSettings;
    42→      delete filteredToolSettings.activeTab;
    43→
    44→      // Filter out any keys containing "prompt" or "reference" (case-insensitive)
    45→      Object.keys(filteredToolSettings).forEach(key => {
    46→        const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();
    47→        if (lowerKey.includes('prompt') || lowerKey.includes('reference')) {
    48→          delete filteredToolSettings[key];

    55→    }
    56→  });
    57→
    58→  return settingsToInherit;
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Autoplay Monitor - Tracks autoplay state changes over time
     3→ * 
     4→ * This utility periodically monitors video autoplay states to help
     5→ * identify when and why autoplay permissions change.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→let monitoringActive = false;
     9→
    10→interface VideoState {
    11→  element: HTMLVideoElement;
    12→  src: string;
    13→  paused: boolean;
    14→  currentTime: number;
    15→  readyState: number;
    16→  isGallery: boolean;
    17→  isLightbox: boolean;
    18→}
    19→
    20→let previousVideoStates: VideoState[] = [];
    21→
    22→const captureVideoStates = (): VideoState[] => {
    23→  const videos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
    24→  return Array.from(videos).map(video => ({
    25→    element: video,
    26→    src: video.src?.substring(video.src.lastIndexOf('/') + 1) || 'no-src',
    27→    paused: video.paused,
    28→    currentTime: video.currentTime,
    29→    readyState: video.readyState,
    30→    isGallery: !!video.getAttribute('data-video-id'),
    31→    isLightbox: !!video.getAttribute('data-lightbox-video')
    32→  }));
    33→};
    34→
    35→const compareVideoStates = (current: VideoState[], previous: VideoState[]): boolean => {
    36→  if (current.length !== previous.length) return true;
    37→  
    38→  return current.some((curr, index) => {
    39→    const prev = previous[index];
    40→    if (!prev) return true;
    41→    
    42→    return curr.paused !== prev.paused || 
    43→           Math.abs(curr.currentTime - prev.currentTime) > 0.1 ||
    44→           curr.readyState !== prev.readyState;
    45→  });
    46→};
    47→
    48→interface VideoStateChange {
    49→  type: string;
    50→  video?: string;
    51→  isLightbox?: boolean;
    52→  isGallery?: boolean;
    53→  from: number | string;
    54→  to: number | string;
    55→}
    56→
    57→const logVideoStateChanges = (current: VideoState[], previous: VideoState[]) => {
    58→  const changes: VideoStateChange[] = [];
    59→  
    60→  // Check for new/removed videos
    61→  if (current.length !== previous.length) {
    62→    changes.push({
    63→      type: 'count_change',
    64→      from: previous.length,
    65→      to: current.length
    66→    });
    67→  }
    68→  
    69→  // Check for state changes in existing videos
    70→  current.forEach((curr, index) => {
    71→    const prev = previous[index];
    72→    if (!prev) return;
    73→    
    74→    if (curr.paused !== prev.paused) {
    75→      changes.push({
    76→        type: 'play_state_change',
    77→        video: curr.src,
    78→        isLightbox: curr.isLightbox,
    79→        isGallery: curr.isGallery,
    80→        from: prev.paused ? 'paused' : 'playing',
    81→        to: curr.paused ? 'paused' : 'playing'
    82→      });
    83→    }
    84→    
    85→    if (curr.readyState !== prev.readyState) {
    86→      changes.push({
    87→        type: 'ready_state_change',
    88→        video: curr.src,
    89→        from: prev.readyState,
    90→        to: curr.readyState
    91→      });
    92→    }
    93→  });
    94→  
    95→};
    96→
    97→const startAutoplayMonitoring = () => {
    98→  if (monitoringActive || process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'development') return;
    99→  
   100→  monitoringActive = true;
   101→  previousVideoStates = captureVideoStates();
   102→
   103→  setInterval(() => {
   104→    const currentStates = captureVideoStates();
   105→    
   106→    if (compareVideoStates(currentStates, previousVideoStates)) {
   107→      logVideoStateChanges(currentStates, previousVideoStates);
   108→      previousVideoStates = currentStates;
   109→    }
   110→  }, 1000); // Check every second
   111→};
   112→
   113→// Auto-start monitoring in development
   114→if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   115→  // Start monitoring after a short delay to let the page load
   116→  setTimeout(() => {
   117→    startAutoplayMonitoring();
   118→  }, 2000);
   119→}
   120→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Client-side thumbnail generation utility
     3→ * Generates thumbnails from image files using Canvas API
     4→ */
     5→
     6→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     7→import { uploadImageToStorage, uploadBlobToStorage } from './imageUploader';
     8→
     9→interface ThumbnailResult {
    10→  thumbnailBlob: Blob;
    11→  thumbnailWidth: number;
    12→  thumbnailHeight: number;
    13→  originalWidth: number;
    14→  originalHeight: number;
    15→}
    16→
    17→/**
    18→ * Generate a thumbnail from an image file on the client side
    19→ * @param file - The image file to generate thumbnail from
    20→ * @param maxSize - Maximum dimension for the thumbnail (default: 300px)
    21→ * @param quality - JPEG quality (0-1, default: 0.8)
    22→ * @returns Promise<ThumbnailResult>
    23→ */
    24→export async function generateClientThumbnail(
    25→  file: File,
    26→  maxSize: number = 300,
    27→  quality: number = 0.8
    28→): Promise<ThumbnailResult> {
    29→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    30→    // Create an image element to load the file
    31→    const img = new Image();
    32→    
    33→    img.onload = () => {
    34→      try {
    35→        const originalWidth = img.width;
    36→        const originalHeight = img.height;
    37→        
    38→        // Calculate thumbnail dimensions (maintain aspect ratio)
    39→        let thumbnailWidth = originalWidth;
    40→        let thumbnailHeight = originalHeight;
    41→        
    42→        if (originalWidth > originalHeight) {
    43→          if (originalWidth > maxSize) {
    44→            thumbnailWidth = maxSize;
    45→            thumbnailHeight = (originalHeight * maxSize) / originalWidth;
    46→          }
    47→        } else {
    48→          if (originalHeight > maxSize) {
    49→            thumbnailHeight = maxSize;
    50→            thumbnailWidth = (originalWidth * maxSize) / originalHeight;
    51→          }
    52→        }
    53→        
    54→        // Ensure minimum size of 1px
    55→        thumbnailWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(thumbnailWidth));
    56→        thumbnailHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(thumbnailHeight));
    57→        
    58→        // Create canvas and resize image
    59→        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    60→        canvas.width = thumbnailWidth;
    61→        canvas.height = thumbnailHeight;
    62→        
    63→        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    64→        if (!ctx) {
    65→          throw new Error('Failed to get canvas context');
    66→        }
    67→        
    68→        // Draw and resize the image
    69→        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight);
    70→        
    71→        // Convert canvas to blob (JPEG with specified quality)
    72→        canvas.toBlob(
    73→          (blob) => {
    74→            if (!blob) {
    75→              reject(new Error('Failed to generate thumbnail blob'));
    76→              return;
    77→            }
    78→            
    79→            resolve({
    80→              thumbnailBlob: blob,
    81→              thumbnailWidth,
    82→              thumbnailHeight,
    83→              originalWidth,
    84→              originalHeight
    85→            });
    86→          },
    87→          'image/jpeg',
    88→          quality
    89→        );
    90→      } catch (error) {
    91→        reject(error);
    92→      }
    93→    };
    94→    
    95→    img.onerror = () => {
    96→      reject(new Error('Failed to load image for thumbnail generation'));
    97→    };
    98→    
    99→    // Load the image file
   100→    const reader = new FileReader();
   101→    reader.onload = (e) => {
   102→      if (e.target?.result) {
   103→        img.src = e.target.result as string;
   104→      } else {
   105→        reject(new Error('Failed to read image file'));
   106→      }
   107→    };
   108→    reader.onerror = () => {
   109→      reject(new Error('Failed to read image file'));
   110→    };
   111→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
   112→  });
   113→}
   114→
   115→interface UploadWithThumbnailOptions {
   116→  onProgress?: (progress: number) => void;
   117→  signal?: AbortSignal;
   118→}
   119→
   120→/**
   121→ * Upload both original image and thumbnail to storage
   122→ * @param originalFile - The original image file
   123→ * @param thumbnailBlob - The generated thumbnail blob
   124→ * @param userId - User ID for storage path organization (kept for backwards compat, not used)
   125→ * @param onProgressOrOptions - Progress callback or options object
   126→ * @returns Promise<{imageUrl: string, thumbnailUrl: string}>
   127→ */
   128→export async function uploadImageWithThumbnail(
   129→  originalFile: File,
   130→  thumbnailBlob: Blob,
   131→  _userId: string,
   132→  onProgressOrOptions?: ((progress: number) => void) | UploadWithThumbnailOptions
   133→): Promise<{imageUrl: string, thumbnailUrl: string}> {
   134→  // Handle both old signature and new options object
   135→  let options: UploadWithThumbnailOptions;
   136→  if (typeof onProgressOrOptions === 'function') {
   137→    options = { onProgress: onProgressOrOptions };
   138→  } else {
   139→    options = onProgressOrOptions || {};
   140→  }
   141→
   142→  const { onProgress, signal } = options;
   143→
   144→  // Upload original image using existing utility (with progress tracking)
   145→  // Original image is ~90% of the work, thumbnail is ~10%
   146→  const imageUrl = await uploadImageToStorage(originalFile, {
   147→    maxRetries: 3,
   148→    signal,
   149→    onProgress: onProgress ? (progress) => {
   150→      // Map 0-100 to 0-90 for main image
   151→      onProgress(Math.round(progress * 0.9));
   152→    } : undefined
   153→  });
   154→
   155→  // Report 90% progress before thumbnail upload
   156→  onProgress?.(90);
   157→
   158→  // Upload thumbnail using centralized uploader (with retry/timeout support)
   159→  try {
   160→    const thumbnailUrl = await uploadBlobToStorage(
   161→      thumbnailBlob,
   162→      'thumbnail.jpg',
   163→      'image/jpeg',
   164→      { maxRetries: 2, signal, timeoutMs: 30000 } // Shorter timeout for small thumbnails
   165→    );
   166→
   167→    // Report 100% progress after thumbnail upload
   168→    onProgress?.(100);
   169→
   170→    return { imageUrl, thumbnailUrl };
   171→  } catch (thumbnailError) {
   172→    handleError(thumbnailError, { context: 'ClientThumbnailGenerator', showToast: false });
   173→    // Don't fail the main upload, use main image as thumbnail fallback
   174→    onProgress?.(100);
   175→    return { imageUrl, thumbnailUrl: imageUrl };
   176→  }
   177→}
   178→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Derive input images from task params
     3→ * Strips any surrounding quotes from URLs that may have been improperly stored
     4→ */
     5→export const deriveInputImages = (task: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string[] => {
     6→  const cleanUrl = (url: string): string => {
     7→    if (typeof url !== 'string') return url;
     8→    // Remove surrounding quotes if present
     9→    return url.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
    10→  };
    11→
    12→  const params = (task?.params || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    13→  if (Array.isArray(params.input_images) && params.input_images.length > 0) {
    14→    return (params.input_images as string[]).map(cleanUrl);
    15→  }
    16→  const payload = params.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    17→  if (payload && Array.isArray(payload.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    18→    return (payload.input_image_paths_resolved as string[]).map(cleanUrl);
    19→  }
    20→  if (Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    21→    return (params.input_image_paths_resolved as string[]).map(cleanUrl);
    22→  }
    23→  return [];
    24→};
```

```
    93→        setIsSummarizing(false);
    94→      }

   101→      setIsEditing(true);

   103→      try {

   111→          },

   114→        const newText = result?.newText || params.originalPromptText;
   115→         
   116→        return { success: true, newText: newText || params.originalPromptText };
   117→      } catch (error) {

   119→        return { success: false, newText: params.originalPromptText };
   120→      } finally {
   121→        setIsEditing(false);
   122→      }
   123→    },
   124→    []
   125→  );
   126→
   127→  // Expose a version of generateSummaryForPromptInternal that uses the hook's API key.
   128→  const generateSummary = useCallback(
   129→    async (promptText: string): Promise<string | null> => {
   130→      // Directly call the internal function
   131→      return generateSummaryForPromptInternal(promptText);
   132→    },

   136→  return {

   144→  };
   145→};
```

```
1→import { useMutation, QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     2→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import { GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
     6→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     7→
     8→// ================================================================
     9→// CENTRALIZED GENERATION ↔ TASK INTEGRATION PATTERNS
    10→// ================================================================
    11→// This utility consolidates all the scattered logic for linking
    12→// generations to their associated tasks across different components.
    13→// 
    14→// Previously duplicated in:
    15→// - useGenerations.ts (getTaskIdForGeneration)
    16→// - useTaskPrefetch.ts (preloadTaskDataInBackground)
    17→// - TaskDetailsModal.tsx (getTaskIdMutation)
    18→// - TaskItem.tsx (generation-for-task lookup)
    19→// - VideoOutputsGallery.tsx (manual preloading)
    20→
    21→// ================================================================
    22→// TYPES
    23→// ================================================================
    24→
    25→interface GenerationTaskMapping {
    26→  generationId: string;
    27→  taskId: string | null;
    28→  taskData?: Task; // Full task object when available
    29→}
    30→
    31→interface TaskGenerationMapping {
    32→  taskId: string;
    33→  generationId: string | null;
    34→  generationData?: GenerationRow; // Full generation object when available
    35→}
    36→
    37→// ================================================================
    38→// CORE MAPPING FUNCTIONS
    39→// ================================================================
    40→
    41→/**
    42→ * Get task ID(s) for a generation using efficient batch lookup
    43→ */
    44→async function getTaskIdForGeneration(generationId: string): Promise<{ taskId: string | null }> {
    45→  const { data, error } = await supabase
    46→    .from('generations')
    47→    .select('tasks')
    48→    .eq('id', generationId)
    49→    .single();
    50→
    51→  if (error) {
    52→    throw new Error(`Generation not found or has no task: ${error.message}`);
    53→  }
    54→
    55→  const tasksArray = data?.tasks as string[] | null;
    56→  const taskId = Array.isArray(tasksArray) && tasksArray.length > 0 ? tasksArray[0] : null;
    57→
    58→  return { taskId };
    59→}
    60→
    61→/**
    62→ * Batch fetch task IDs for multiple generations (more efficient than individual calls)
    63→ */
    64→async function getTaskIdsForGenerations(generationIds: string[]): Promise<Map<string, string | null>> {
    65→  if (generationIds.length === 0) return new Map();
    66→
    67→  const { data, error } = await supabase
    68→    .from('generations')
    69→    .select('id, tasks')
    70→    .in('id', generationIds);
    71→
    72→  if (error) {
    73→    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch task mappings: ${error.message}`);
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const mappings = new Map<string, string | null>();
    77→  data?.forEach(mapping => {
    78→    const tasksArray = mapping.tasks as string[] | null;
    79→    const taskId = Array.isArray(tasksArray) && tasksArray.length > 0 ? tasksArray[0] : null;
    80→    mappings.set(mapping.id, taskId);
    81→  });
    82→
    83→  return mappings;
    84→}
    85→
    86→// ================================================================
    87→// REACT HOOKS
    88→// ================================================================
    89→
    90→/**
    91→ * Mutation for getting task ID (for compatibility with existing code)
    92→ */
    93→export function useGetTaskIdForGeneration() {
    94→  return useMutation({
    95→    mutationFn: getTaskIdForGeneration,
    96→    onError: (error: Error) => {
    97→      handleError(error, { context: 'GenerationTaskBridge', showToast: false });
    98→    },
    99→  });
   100→}
   101→
   102→
   103→// ================================================================
   104→// CACHE MANAGEMENT
   105→// ================================================================
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background
   109→ */
   110→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
   111→  generationIds: string[], 
   112→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   113→  options: {
   114→    batchSize?: number;
   115→    delayBetweenBatches?: number;
   116→    preloadFullTaskData?: boolean;
   117→  } = {}
   118→) {
   119→  const { 
   120→    batchSize = 5, 
   121→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
   122→    preloadFullTaskData = false 
   123→  } = options;
   124→
   125→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
   126→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
   127→    
   128→    try {
   129→      // Batch fetch task IDs
   130→      const mappings = await getTaskIdsForGenerations(batch);
   131→      
   132→      // Cache the mappings
   133→      mappings.forEach((taskId, generationId) => {
   134→        queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.tasks.generationMapping(generationId), { taskId });
   135→
   136→        // Optionally preload full task data
   137→        if (preloadFullTaskData && taskId) {
   138→          queryClient.prefetchQuery({
   139→            queryKey: [...queryKeys.tasks.all, 'single', taskId],
   140→            queryFn: async () => {
   141→              const { data, error } = await supabase
   142→                .from('tasks')
   143→                .select('*')
   144→                .eq('id', taskId)
   145→                .single();
   146→              
   147→              if (error) throw error;
   148→              return data;
   149→            },
   150→            staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
   151→          });
   152→        }
   153→      });
   154→
   155→    } catch (error) {
   156→      handleError(error, { context: 'GenerationTaskBridge', showToast: false });
   157→    }
   158→    
   159→    // Throttle between batches
   160→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   161→      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   162→    }
   163→  }
   164→}
   165→
   166→
   167→// ================================================================
   168→// UTILITY FUNCTIONS
   169→// ================================================================
   170→
   171→
   172→/**
   173→ * Enhance generations with task data from cache
   174→ */
   175→export function enhanceGenerationsWithTaskData(
   176→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   177→  queryClient: QueryClient
   178→): (GenerationRow & { taskId?: string | null; taskData?: Task | null })[] {
   179→  return generations.map(generation => {
   180→    // Try to get cached task mapping
   181→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<{ taskId: string | null }>(queryKeys.tasks.generationMapping(generation.id));
   182→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   183→
   184→    // Try to get cached task data
   185→    const taskData = taskId ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>([...queryKeys.tasks.all, 'single', taskId]) : null;
   186→    
   187→    return {
   188→      ...generation,
   189→      taskId,
   190→      taskData,
   191→    };
   192→  });
   193→}
   194→
```

```
     2→import { useCurrentShot } from '@/shared/contexts/CurrentShotContext';
     3→import { useIsMobile } from '@/shared/hooks/use-mobile';
```
