1→import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Smart timestamp updater hook that provides live-updating relative timestamps
     5→ * with performance optimizations for galleries and task lists.
     6→ * 
     7→ * Features:
     8→ * - Automatic updates with smart intervals (30s for recent, 60s for older)
     9→ * - Only updates when component is visible (IntersectionObserver)
    10→ * - Batched updates to prevent excessive re-renders
    11→ * - Efficient memory management with cleanup
    12→ */
    13→
    14→interface TimestampUpdateOptions {
    15→  /** Date to track */
    16→  date: Date | string | null;
    17→  /** Update interval in seconds (default: smart intervals based on age) */
    18→  updateInterval?: number;
    19→  /** Whether this timestamp is currently visible (default: true) */
    20→  isVisible?: boolean;
    21→  /** Disable automatic updates (default: false) */
    22→  disabled?: boolean;
    23→}
    24→
    25→// Global timestamp manager to coordinate updates across all components
    26→class TimestampManager {
    27→  private intervals = new Map<number, Set<() => void>>();
    28→  private timers = new Map<number, NodeJS.Timeout>();
    29→  
    30→  // Smart interval selection based on timestamp age
    31→  private getUpdateInterval(date: Date): number {
    32→    const now = Date.now();
    33→    const age = now - date.getTime();
    34→    
    35→    // Less than 5 minutes old: update every 10 seconds (more responsive for fresh content)
    36→    if (age < 5 * 60 * 1000) return 10;
    37→    
    38→    // Less than 1 hour old: update every 60 seconds  
    39→    if (age < 60 * 60 * 1000) return 60;
    40→    
    41→    // Less than 1 day old: update every 5 minutes
    42→    if (age < 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) return 300;
    43→    
    44→    // Older: update every 30 minutes
    45→    return 1800;
    46→  }
    47→  
    48→  subscribe(date: Date, callback: () => void, isVisible: boolean = true): () => void {
    49→    if (!isVisible) {
    50→      // Return no-op unsubscribe for invisible timestamps
    51→      return () => {};
    52→    }
    53→    
    54→    const interval = this.getUpdateInterval(date);
    55→    
    56→    // Get or create interval group
    57→    if (!this.intervals.has(interval)) {
    58→      this.intervals.set(interval, new Set());
    59→    }
    60→    
    61→    const callbacks = this.intervals.get(interval)!;
    62→    callbacks.add(callback);
    63→    
    64→    // Start timer if this is the first callback for this interval
    65→    if (callbacks.size === 1) {
    66→      const timer = setInterval(() => {
    67→        // Batch all callbacks for this interval
    68→        callbacks.forEach(cb => cb());
    69→      }, interval * 1000);
    70→      
    71→      this.timers.set(interval, timer);
    72→    }
    73→    
    74→    // Return unsubscribe function
    75→    return () => {
    76→      callbacks.delete(callback);
    77→      
    78→      // Clean up timer if no more callbacks
    79→      if (callbacks.size === 0) {
    80→        const timer = this.timers.get(interval);
    81→        if (timer) {
    82→          clearInterval(timer);
    83→          this.timers.delete(interval);
    84→        }
    85→        this.intervals.delete(interval);
    86→      }
    87→    };
    88→  }
    89→  
    90→  // Get current update interval for a date (for debugging)
    91→  getIntervalForDate(date: Date): number {
    92→    return this.getUpdateInterval(date);
    93→  }
    94→}
    95→
    96→// Global singleton
    97→const timestampManager = new TimestampManager();
    98→
    99→/**
   100→ * Hook that provides a timestamp that automatically updates at smart intervals
   101→ */
   102→export function useTimestampUpdater({ 
   103→  date, 
   104→  isVisible = true, 
   105→  disabled = false 
   106→}: TimestampUpdateOptions) {
   107→  const [updateTrigger, setUpdateTrigger] = useState(0);
   108→  const dateRef = useRef<Date | null>(null);
   109→  
   110→  // Parse and validate date
   111→  if (date && dateRef.current?.getTime() !== (typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date)?.getTime()) {
   112→    dateRef.current = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date;
   113→  }
   114→  
   115→  useEffect(() => {
   116→    if (!dateRef.current || disabled || !isVisible) {
   117→      return;
   118→    }
   119→    
   120→    // Subscribe to timestamp updates
   121→    const unsubscribe = timestampManager.subscribe(
   122→      dateRef.current,
   123→      () => setUpdateTrigger(prev => prev + 1),
   124→      isVisible
   125→    );
   126→    
   127→    return unsubscribe;
   128→  }, [dateRef.current?.getTime(), isVisible, disabled]);
   129→  
   130→  return {
   131→    /** Current update trigger - changes when timestamp should be recalculated */
   132→    updateTrigger,
   133→    /** The date being tracked */
   134→    date: dateRef.current,
   135→    /** Current update interval for this timestamp (for debugging) */
   136→    currentInterval: dateRef.current ? timestampManager.getIntervalForDate(dateRef.current) : null,
   137→  };
   138→}
   139→
   140→/**
   141→ * Hook for components that need to track visibility for performance
   142→ * Uses IntersectionObserver to detect when timestamps are visible
   143→ */
   144→export function useTimestampVisibility(ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>) {
   145→  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(true); // Default to visible
   146→  
   147→  useEffect(() => {
   148→    const element = ref.current;
   149→    if (!element) {
   150→      // If element not mounted yet, stay visible
   151→      return;
   152→    }
   153→    
   154→    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
   155→      // If IntersectionObserver not supported, always consider visible
   156→      setIsVisible(true);
   157→      return;
   158→    }
   159→    
   160→    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
   161→      ([entry]) => {
   162→        const newVisibility = entry.isIntersecting;
   163→        setIsVisible(newVisibility);
   164→      },
   165→      {
   166→        // Consider visible when 10% is showing
   167→        threshold: 0.1,
   168→        // Add some margin to start updating before fully visible
   169→        rootMargin: '50px'
   170→      }
   171→    );
   172→    
   173→    observer.observe(element);
   174→    
   175→    return () => {
   176→      observer.disconnect();
   177→    };
   178→  }, [ref]);
   179→  
   180→  return isVisible;
   181→}
   182→

    25→/**
    26→ * Extracts a thumbnail from a video at a specific time
    27→ */
    28→async function extractThumbnailFromVideo(
    29→  videoUrl: string,
    30→  timeInSeconds: number = 0.001
    31→): Promise<Blob> {
    32→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    33→    const video = document.createElement('video');
    34→    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    35→    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    36→
    37→    if (!ctx) {
    38→      reject(new Error('Failed to get canvas context'));
    39→      return;
    40→    }
    41→
    42→    video.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    43→    video.preload = 'metadata';
    44→    video.muted = true;
    45→    video.playsInline = true;
    46→
    47→    // Handle video loaded
    48→    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
    49→      // Set canvas size to video dimensions (or max 1280px width)
    50→      const maxWidth = 1280;
    51→      const scale = Math.min(1, maxWidth / video.videoWidth);
    52→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth * scale;
    53→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight * scale;
    54→
    55→      // Seek to the desired time (or start if video is shorter)
    56→      video.currentTime = Math.min(timeInSeconds, video.duration - 0.1);
    57→    });
    58→
    59→    // Handle seeked event
    60→    video.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
    61→      try {
    62→        // Draw video frame to canvas
    63→        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    64→
    65→        // Convert to blob (JPEG, 85% quality)
    66→        canvas.toBlob(
    67→          (blob) => {
    68→            video.remove();
    69→            if (blob) {
    70→              resolve(blob);
    71→            } else {
    72→              reject(new Error('Failed to create blob from canvas'));
    73→            }
    74→          },
    75→          'image/jpeg',
    76→          0.85
    77→        );
    78→      } catch (error) {
    79→        video.remove();
    80→        reject(error);
    81→      }
    82→    });
    83→
    84→    // Handle errors
    85→    video.addEventListener('error', () => {
    86→      video.remove();
    87→      reject(new Error(`Video loading failed: ${video.error?.message || 'Unknown error'}`));
    88→    });
    89→
    90→    // Start loading
    91→    video.src = getDisplayUrl(videoUrl);
    92→  });
    93→}
    94→
    95→/**
    96→ * Uploads a thumbnail blob to Supabase storage
    97→ * Note: projectId param kept for backwards compatibility but no longer used in path
    98→ */
    99→async function uploadThumbnailToStorage(
   100→  blob: Blob,
   101→  generationId: string,
   102→  _projectId: string
   103→): Promise<string> {
   104→  // Get userId for storage path
   105→  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
   106→  if (!session?.user?.id) {
   107→    throw new Error('User not authenticated');
   108→  }
   109→  const userId = session.user.id;

   113→
   114→  const { error } = await supabase.storage
   115→    .from(MEDIA_BUCKET)
   116→    .upload(filePath, blob, {
   117→      contentType: 'image/jpeg',
   118→      upsert: true, // Overwrite if exists
   119→    });
   120→
   121→  if (error) {
   122→    console.error('[ThumbnailGenerator] Upload failed:', error);
   123→    throw error;
   124→  }
   125→
   126→  // Get public URL
   127→  const { data: urlData } = supabase.storage
   128→    .from(MEDIA_BUCKET)
   129→    .getPublicUrl(filePath);
   130→
   131→  return urlData.publicUrl;
   132→}

   136→ */
   137→async function updateGenerationThumbnail(
   138→  generationId: string,

   141→
   142→  const { error } = await supabase

   149→    throw error;
   150→  }
   151→}

   153→/**

   156→export async function generateAndUploadThumbnail(

   160→): Promise<ThumbnailGenerationResult> {

    16→/**
    17→ * List all shots for a specific project with configurable image loading.
    18→ * @param projectId - The project to fetch shots for
    19→ * @param options.maxImagesPerShot - Limit images per shot (0 = unlimited, default)
    20→ */
    21→export const useListShots = (
    22→  projectId?: string | null,
    23→  options: { maxImagesPerShot?: number } = {}
    24→) => {
    25→  const { maxImagesPerShot = 0 } = options;
    26→
    27→  return useQuery({
    28→    queryKey: projectId ? queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, maxImagesPerShot) : ['shots', projectId, maxImagesPerShot],
    29→    queryFn: async () => {
    30→      if (!projectId) {
    31→        return [];
    32→      }
    33→
    34→      // Get shots ordered by position
    35→      const { data: shots, error: shotsError } = await supabase
    36→        .from('shots')
    37→        .select('*')
    38→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
    39→        .order('position', { ascending: true });
    40→
    41→      if (shotsError) {
    42→        throw shotsError;
    43→      }
    44→
    45→      if (!shots || shots.length === 0) {
    46→        return [];
    47→      }
    48→
    49→      // Fetch images for each shot in batches
    50→      const BATCH_SIZE = 10;
    51→      const imagesPerShot: { shotId: string; images: GenerationRow[] }[] = [];
    52→
    53→      for (let i = 0; i < shots.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    54→        const batch = shots.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
    55→        const batchResults = await Promise.all(
    56→          batch.map(async (shot) => {
    57→            let query = supabase
    58→              .from('shot_generations')
    59→              .select(`
    60→                id,
    61→                shot_id,
    62→                timeline_frame,

    64→                generation:generations!shot_generations_generation_id_generations_id_fk (

    78→                  )
    79→                )
    80→              `)
    81→              .eq('shot_id', shot.id)
    82→              .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true, nullsFirst: false });
    83→
    84→            if (maxImagesPerShot > 0) {
    85→              query = query.limit(maxImagesPerShot);
    86→            }
    87→

    89→
    90→            if (sgError) {

    92→              return { shotId: shot.id, images: [] };
    93→            }
    94→
    95→            const images: GenerationRow[] = (shotGenerations || [])
    96→              .map(mapShotGenerationToRow)
    97→              .filter(Boolean) as GenerationRow[];
    98→
    99→            return { shotId: shot.id, images };
   100→          })
   101→        );
   102→        imagesPerShot.push(...batchResults);
   103→      }
   104→
   105→      // Build lookup map
   106→      const imagesByShot: Record<string, GenerationRow[]> = {};
   107→      imagesPerShot.forEach(({ shotId, images }) => {
   108→        imagesByShot[shotId] = images;
   109→      });
   110→
   111→      // Attach images to shots with pre-computed stats
   112→      return shots.map(shot => {

   114→

   116→        const uniqueGenIds = new Set<string>();
   117→        const unpositionedGenIds = new Set<string>();
   118→        const positionedGenIds = new Set<string>();
   119→
   120→        images.forEach(img => {
   121→          const genId = getGenerationId(img);
   122→          uniqueGenIds.add(genId);
   123→          if (img.timeline_frame == null) {
   124→            unpositionedGenIds.add(genId);
   125→          } else {
   126→            positionedGenIds.add(genId);
   127→          }
   128→        });
   129→
   130→        const unpositionedCount = unpositionedGenIds.size;
   131→
   132→        return {
   133→          ...shot,
   134→          images,
   135→          imageCount: uniqueGenIds.size,
   136→          positionedImageCount: positionedGenIds.size,
   137→          unpositionedImageCount: unpositionedCount,
   138→          hasUnpositionedImages: unpositionedCount > 0,
   139→        };
   140→      });
   141→    },
   142→    enabled: !!projectId,
   143→    staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 5, // 5 minutes
   144→    placeholderData: (previousData) => previousData,
   145→  });
   146→};

   155→export const useProjectImageStats = (projectId?: string | null) => {

   164→        .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   165→        .eq('project_id', projectId)

   172→        .from('generations')

   175→        .not('location', 'is', null)
   176→        .or('shot_data.is.null,shot_data.eq.{}');
   177→
   178→      if (noShotErr) throw noShotErr;
   179→
   180→      return {

   182→        noShotCount: noShotCount || 0,
   183→      };
   184→    },
   185→    enabled: !!projectId,
   186→    staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 5, // 5 minutes

1→/**
     2→ * createLineageGif
     3→ *
     4→ * Creates an animated GIF from an array of image URLs.
     5→ * Runs client-side using gifenc library.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { GIFEncoder, quantize, applyPalette } from 'gifenc';
     9→
    10→interface CreateGifOptions {
    11→  /** Milliseconds between frames (default: 800) */
    12→  frameDelay?: number;
    13→  /** Output width in pixels (default: 512) */
    14→  width?: number;
    15→}
    16→
    17→export interface CreateGifProgress {
    18→  stage: 'loading' | 'encoding' | 'complete';
    19→  current: number;
    20→  total: number;
    21→  message: string;
    22→}
    23→
    24→/**
    25→ * Load an image from a blob URL and return an HTMLImageElement.
    26→ */
    27→function loadImageFromBlobUrl(blobUrl: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
    28→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    29→    const img = new Image();
    30→    img.onload = () => resolve(img);
    31→    img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load image from blob'));
    32→    img.src = blobUrl;
    33→  });
    34→}
    35→
    36→/**
    37→ * Create an animated GIF from an array of image URLs.
    38→ *
    39→ * @param imageUrls - Array of image URLs to include in the GIF
    40→ * @param options - Configuration options
    41→ * @param onProgress - Optional callback for progress updates
    42→ * @returns Promise<Blob> - The generated GIF as a Blob
    43→ */
    44→export async function createLineageGif(
    45→  imageUrls: string[],
    46→  options: CreateGifOptions = {},
    47→  onProgress?: (progress: CreateGifProgress) => void
    48→): Promise<Blob> {
    49→  const { frameDelay = 800, width = 512 } = options;
    50→
    51→  if (imageUrls.length === 0) {
    52→    throw new Error('No images provided for GIF creation');
    53→  }
    54→
    55→  onProgress?.({
    56→    stage: 'loading',
    57→    current: 0,
    58→    total: imageUrls.length,
    59→    message: 'Loading images...',
    60→  });
    61→
    62→  // Step 1: Fetch all images as blobs and create blob URLs
    63→  // This avoids CORS issues since blob URLs are same-origin
    64→  const images: HTMLImageElement[] = [];
    65→  const blobUrls: string[] = [];
    66→
    67→  for (let i = 0; i < imageUrls.length; i++) {
    68→    try {
    69→      const response = await fetch(imageUrls[i]);
    70→      if (!response.ok) {
    71→        continue;
    72→      }
    73→
    74→      const blob = await response.blob();
    75→      const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    76→      blobUrls.push(blobUrl);
    77→
    78→      const img = await loadImageFromBlobUrl(blobUrl);
    79→      images.push(img);
    80→
    81→      onProgress?.({
    82→        stage: 'loading',
    83→        current: i + 1,
    84→        total: imageUrls.length,
    85→        message: `Loading images ${i + 1}/${imageUrls.length}`,
    86→      });
    87→    } catch (err) {
    88→      // Skip failed images
    89→    }
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (images.length === 0) {
    93→    blobUrls.forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
    94→    throw new Error('No images could be loaded');
    95→  }
    96→
    97→  // Calculate height based on first image aspect ratio
    98→  const firstImage = images[0];
    99→  const aspectRatio = firstImage.width / firstImage.height;
   100→  const height = Math.round(width / aspectRatio);
   101→
   102→  // Create canvas for rendering frames
   103→  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
   104→  canvas.width = width;
   105→  canvas.height = height;
   106→  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
   107→
   108→  if (!ctx) {
   109→    blobUrls.forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
   110→    throw new Error('Could not get canvas context');
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  // Initialize GIF encoder
   114→  const gif = GIFEncoder();
   115→
   116→  onProgress?.({
   117→    stage: 'encoding',
   118→    current: 0,
   119→    total: images.length,
   120→    message: 'Encoding frames...',
   121→  });
   122→
   123→  // Process each image
   124→  for (let i = 0; i < images.length; i++) {
   125→    const img = images[i];
   126→
   127→    // Fill background with black
   128→    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
   129→    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
   130→
   131→    // Calculate scaling to fit while maintaining aspect ratio
   132→    const imgAspect = img.width / img.height;
   133→    const targetAspect = width / height;
   134→
   135→    let drawWidth: number;
   136→    let drawHeight: number;
   137→    let drawX: number;
   138→    let drawY: number;
   139→
   140→    if (imgAspect > targetAspect) {
   141→      drawWidth = width;
   142→      drawHeight = width / imgAspect;
   143→      drawX = 0;
   144→      drawY = (height - drawHeight) / 2;
   145→    } else {
   146→      drawHeight = height;
   147→      drawWidth = height * imgAspect;
   148→      drawX = (width - drawWidth) / 2;
   149→      drawY = 0;
   150→    }
   151→
   152→    // Draw image to canvas
   153→    ctx.drawImage(img, drawX, drawY, drawWidth, drawHeight);
   154→
   155→    // Get image data
   156→    const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, width, height);
   157→    const { data } = imageData;
   158→
   159→    // gifenc expects RGBA data directly from canvas
   160→    const palette = quantize(data, 256, { format: 'rgba4444' });
   161→    const indexedPixels = applyPalette(data, palette, 'rgba4444');
   162→
   163→    // Add frame with specified delay (gifenc uses centiseconds)
   164→    gif.writeFrame(indexedPixels, width, height, {
   165→      palette,
   166→      delay: frameDelay / 10,
   167→    });
   168→
   169→    onProgress?.({
   170→      stage: 'encoding',
   171→      current: i + 1,
   172→      total: images.length,
   173→      message: `Encoding frames ${i + 1}/${images.length}`,
   174→    });
   175→  }
   176→
   177→  // Clean up blob URLs
   178→  blobUrls.forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
   179→
   180→  // Finish encoding
   181→  gif.finish();
   182→
   183→  const gifBytes = gif.bytes();
   184→  const blob = new Blob([gifBytes], { type: 'image/gif' });
   185→
   186→  onProgress?.({
   187→    stage: 'complete',
   188→    current: images.length,
   189→    total: images.length,
   190→    message: 'Complete!',
   191→  });
   192→
   193→  return blob;
   194→}
   195→
   196→/**
   197→ * Download a Blob as a file.
   198→ */
   199→export function downloadBlob(blob: Blob, filename: string): void {
   200→  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
   201→  const a = document.createElement('a');
   202→  a.href = url;
   203→  a.download = filename;
   204→  document.body.appendChild(a);
   205→  a.click();
   206→  document.body.removeChild(a);
   207→  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
   208→}
   209→

1→/**
     2→ * usePendingSegmentTasks Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Tracks travel segment tasks that are "Queued" or "In Progress" for a given shot.
     5→ * Returns a function to check if a specific pair_shot_generation_id has a pending task.
     6→ * Supports optimistic updates for immediate UI feedback when generate is clicked.
     7→ */
     8→
     9→import { useMemo, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
    10→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    11→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    12→import { TASK_STATUS } from '@/types/tasks';
    13→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    14→
    15→interface PendingSegmentTask {
    16→  id: string;
    17→  status: string;
    18→  pair_shot_generation_id: string | null;
    19→}
    20→
    21→interface UsePendingSegmentTasksReturn {
    22→  /** Check if a pair_shot_generation_id has a pending task (real or optimistic) */
    23→  hasPendingTask: (pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined) => boolean;
    24→  /** Get the task status for a pair_shot_generation_id */
    25→  getTaskStatus: (pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined) => string | null;
    26→  /** Set of all pair_shot_generation_ids with pending tasks */
    27→  pendingPairIds: Set<string>;
    28→  /** Loading state */
    29→  isLoading: boolean;
    30→  /** Add an optimistic pending ID (for immediate UI feedback when generate is clicked) */
    31→  addOptimisticPending: (pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined) => void;
    32→}
    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Extract pair_shot_generation_id from task params
    36→ */
    37→function extractPairShotGenId(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
    38→  if (!params) return null;
    39→
    40→  // Direct param (individual_travel_segment)
    41→  if (params.pair_shot_generation_id) {
    42→    return params.pair_shot_generation_id as string;
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  // From orchestrator_details with segment_index (travel_segment from orchestrator)
    46→  const orchDetails = params.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    47→  if (orchDetails?.pair_shot_generation_ids && typeof params.segment_index === 'number') {
    48→    const ids = orchDetails.pair_shot_generation_ids;
    49→    if (Array.isArray(ids) && ids[params.segment_index]) {
    50→      return ids[params.segment_index] as string;
    51→    }
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  return null;
    55→}
    56→
    57→export function usePendingSegmentTasks(
    58→  shotId: string | null,
    59→  projectId: string | null
    60→): UsePendingSegmentTasksReturn {
    61→  // Track optimistic pending IDs with timestamps (for immediate UI feedback before task is detected)
    62→  // Map of pairShotGenerationId -> timestamp when added
    63→  const [optimisticPending, setOptimisticPending] = useState<Map<string, number>>(new Map());
    64→
    65→  // How long to wait for a task to appear in real pending before clearing optimistic
    66→  const OPTIMISTIC_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000; // 8 seconds (covers ~2-3 query cycles)
    67→
    68→  // Query pending segment tasks for this shot
    69→  const { data: pendingTasks, isLoading } = useQuery({
    70→    queryKey: [...queryKeys.tasks.pendingSegment(shotId!), projectId],
    71→    queryFn: async () => {
    72→      if (!shotId || !projectId) return [];
    73→
    74→      // Query tasks that are Queued or In Progress
    75→      // Filter for travel segment task types
    76→      const { data, error } = await supabase
    77→        .from('tasks')
    78→        .select('id, status, params')
    79→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
    80→        .in('status', [TASK_STATUS.QUEUED, TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS])
    81→        .in('task_type', ['travel_segment', 'individual_travel_segment']);
    82→
    83→      if (error) {
    84→        // Don't log here - React Query will retry automatically.
    85→        // Errors are only surfaced via the query's error state after retries exhausted.
    86→        throw error;
    87→      }
    88→
    89→      // Extract pair_shot_generation_id from each task
    90→      const tasks: PendingSegmentTask[] = (data || []).map(task => ({
    91→        id: task.id,
    92→        status: task.status,
    93→        pair_shot_generation_id: extractPairShotGenId(task.params as Record<string, unknown> | null),
    94→      }));
    95→
    96→      // Filter to only tasks for this shot (by checking if pair_shot_generation_id exists)
    97→      // Note: We can't directly filter by shot_id in the query since it's in params
    98→      // The pair_shot_generation_id links to a shot_generations record for this shot
    99→
   100→      return tasks;
   101→    },
   102→    enabled: !!shotId && !!projectId,
   103→    // Poll frequently to catch status changes
   104→    refetchInterval: 3000,
   105→    // Mark as stale immediately so invalidations trigger refetch
   106→    staleTime: 0,
   107→    // Short cache time - don't keep stale data around
   108→    gcTime: 10000,
   109→    // Always refetch when window regains focus
   110→    refetchOnWindowFocus: 'always',
   111→  });
   112→
   113→  // Build a map of pair_shot_generation_id -> status
   114→  const { pendingPairIds, statusMap } = useMemo(() => {
   115→    const ids = new Set<string>();
   116→    const map = new Map<string, string>();
   117→
   118→    (pendingTasks || []).forEach(task => {
   119→      if (task.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   120→        ids.add(task.pair_shot_generation_id);
   121→        map.set(task.pair_shot_generation_id, task.status);
   122→      }
   123→    });
   124→
   125→    return { pendingPairIds: ids, statusMap: map };
   126→  }, [pendingTasks]);
   127→
   128→  // Clear optimistic IDs that are either:
   129→  // 1. Confirmed (appear in real pending tasks)
   130→  // 2. Expired (older than timeout and not in real pending - task was cancelled/failed)
   131→  useEffect(() => {
   132→    if (optimisticPending.size === 0 || isLoading) return;
   133→
   134→    const now = Date.now();
   135→
   136→    setOptimisticPending(prev => {
   137→      const next = new Map<string, number>();
   138→      let changed = false;
   139→
   140→      prev.forEach((addedAt, id) => {
   141→        const isInRealPending = pendingPairIds.has(id);
   142→        const isExpired = now - addedAt > OPTIMISTIC_TIMEOUT_MS;
   143→
   144→        if (isInRealPending) {
   145→          // Confirmed by real query - clear from optimistic (real will show it)
   146→          changed = true;
   147→        } else if (isExpired) {
   148→          // Not in real pending after timeout - was cancelled or failed
   149→          changed = true;
   150→        } else {
   151→          // Keep it - still within timeout window
   152→          next.set(id, addedAt);
   153→        }
   154→      });
   155→
   156→      return changed ? next : prev;
   157→    });
   158→  }, [pendingPairIds, optimisticPending.size, isLoading, OPTIMISTIC_TIMEOUT_MS]);
   159→
   160→  // Add an optimistic pending ID for immediate UI feedback
   161→  const addOptimisticPending = useCallback((pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined) => {
   162→    if (pairShotGenerationId) {
   163→      setOptimisticPending(prev => new Map(prev).set(pairShotGenerationId, Date.now()));
   164→    }
   165→  }, []);
   166→
   167→  // Helper to check if a pair has a pending task (real or optimistic)
   168→  const hasPendingTask = useCallback((pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined): boolean => {
   169→    if (!pairShotGenerationId) return false;
   170→    return pendingPairIds.has(pairShotGenerationId) || optimisticPending.has(pairShotGenerationId);
   171→  }, [pendingPairIds, optimisticPending]);
   172→
   173→  // Helper to get task status for a pair
   174→  const getTaskStatus = useCallback((pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined): string | null => {
   175→    if (!pairShotGenerationId) return null;
   176→    return statusMap.get(pairShotGenerationId) || null;
   177→  }, [statusMap]);
   178→
   179→  return {
   180→    hasPendingTask,
   181→    getTaskStatus,
   182→    pendingPairIds,
   183→    isLoading,
   184→    addOptimisticPending,
   185→  };
   186→}
   187→
   188→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { usePendingSegmentTasks } instead
   189→

1→/**
     2→ * Utility for extracting poster images (first frame) from video files
     3→ */
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Extract the first frame of a video as a Blob
     7→ * @param videoFile The video file to extract from
     8→ * @returns Promise that resolves to a Blob of the poster image (JPEG)
     9→ */
    10→export async function extractVideoPosterFrame(videoFile: File): Promise<Blob> {
    11→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    12→    const video = document.createElement('video');
    13→    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    14→    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    15→
    16→    if (!ctx) {
    17→      reject(new Error('Failed to get canvas context'));
    18→      return;
    19→    }
    20→
    21→    video.preload = 'metadata';
    22→    video.muted = true;
    23→    video.playsInline = true;
    24→
    25→    // When metadata is loaded, we can get dimensions
    26→    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
    27→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    28→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    29→      
    30→      // Seek to a small time to avoid black frames at the start
    31→      video.currentTime = 0.1;
    32→    });
    33→
    34→    // When we've seeked to the right time, capture the frame
    35→    video.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
    36→      try {
    37→        // Draw the video frame to canvas
    38→        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    39→        
    40→        // Convert canvas to blob
    41→        canvas.toBlob(
    42→          (blob) => {
    43→            if (blob) {
    44→              resolve(blob);
    45→            } else {
    46→              reject(new Error('Failed to create blob from canvas'));
    47→            }
    48→            
    49→            // Cleanup
    50→            video.src = '';
    51→            URL.revokeObjectURL(video.src);
    52→          },
    53→          'image/jpeg',
    54→          0.85 // Quality
    55→        );
    56→      } catch (error) {
    57→        reject(error);
    58→      }
    59→    });
    60→
    61→    video.addEventListener('error', () => {
    62→      reject(new Error('Failed to load video'));
    63→    });
    64→
    65→    // Load the video
    66→    video.src = URL.createObjectURL(videoFile);
    67→  });
    68→}
    69→

    91→    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
    92→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    93→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    94→      
    95→      // Seek to near the end (0.1 seconds before) to avoid potential issues
    96→      video.currentTime = Math.max(0, video.duration - 0.1);
    97→    });
    98→
    99→    // When we've seeked to the right time, capture the frame
   100→    video.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
   101→      try {
   102→        // Draw the video frame to canvas
   103→        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   104→        
   105→        // Convert canvas to blob
   106→        canvas.toBlob(
   107→          (blob) => {
   108→            if (blob) {

   112→            }
   113→            
   114→            // Cleanup

1→/**
     2→ * Background Thumbnail Generator Hook
     3→ * 
     4→ * Automatically generates thumbnails for videos that don't have them.
     5→ * Processes videos one at a time in the background without blocking the UI.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     9→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    10→import { GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';
    11→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    12→import { generateAndUploadThumbnail } from '@/shared/utils/videoThumbnailGenerator';
    13→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    14→
    15→interface UseBackgroundThumbnailGeneratorOptions {
    16→  videos: GenerationRow[];
    17→  projectId: string | null;
    18→  enabled?: boolean;
    19→}
    20→
    21→interface GenerationStatus {
    22→  generationId: string;
    23→  status: 'pending' | 'processing' | 'success' | 'error';
    24→  error?: string;
    25→}
    26→
    27→export function useBackgroundThumbnailGenerator({
    28→  videos,
    29→  projectId,
    30→  enabled = true,
    31→}: UseBackgroundThumbnailGeneratorOptions) {
    32→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    33→  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<Record<string, GenerationStatus>>({});
    34→  const processingRef = useRef(false);
    35→  const queueRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
    36→
    37→  // Identify videos without thumbnails
    38→  useEffect(() => {
    39→
    40→    if (!enabled || !projectId) {
    41→      return;
    42→    }
    43→
    44→    const videosWithoutThumbnails = videos.filter(video => {
    45→      // Debug each video
    46→      const videoUrl = video.location || video.url;
    47→      const hasUrl = !!videoUrl;
    48→      
    49→      // Check if it's a video by looking at the URL extension or isVideo property
    50→      const urlLooksLikeVideo = videoUrl && /\.(mp4|mov|avi|webm|mkv)$/i.test(videoUrl);
    51→      const isDefinitelyVideo = video.isVideo === true || urlLooksLikeVideo;
    52→      
    53→      // A "real thumbnail" is an image file (jpg/png/webp), not another video file
    54→      const thumbIsImageFile = video.thumbUrl && /\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|gif)$/i.test(video.thumbUrl);
    55→      const thumbIsDifferentFromVideo = video.thumbUrl && video.thumbUrl !== video.location && video.thumbUrl !== video.url;
    56→      const hasRealThumbnail = thumbIsImageFile && thumbIsDifferentFromVideo;
    57→      
    58→      const currentStatus = statuses[video.id]?.status;
    59→      
    60→      // Must be a video (check isVideo property or URL extension)
    61→      if (!isDefinitelyVideo) return false;
    62→      
    63→      // Must have a video URL
    64→      if (!hasUrl) return false;
    65→      
    66→      // Must NOT have a real image thumbnail (if thumbUrl is .mp4, it's not a real thumbnail!)
    67→      if (hasRealThumbnail) return false;
    68→      
    69→      // Must not already be processed, processing, or errored (avoid retry loops)
    70→      if (currentStatus === 'processing' || currentStatus === 'success' || currentStatus === 'error') return false;
    71→      
    72→      return true;
    73→    });
    74→
    75→    if (videosWithoutThumbnails.length > 0) {
    76→
    77→      // Add to queue (avoid duplicates)
    78→      const newVideoIds = videosWithoutThumbnails
    79→        .map(v => v.id)
    80→        .filter(id => !queueRef.current.includes(id));
    81→      
    82→      if (newVideoIds.length > 0) {
    83→        queueRef.current = [...queueRef.current, ...newVideoIds];
    84→        
    85→        // Mark as pending
    86→        const newStatuses: Record<string, GenerationStatus> = {};
    87→        newVideoIds.forEach(id => {
    88→          newStatuses[id] = { generationId: id, status: 'pending' };
    89→        });
    90→        setStatuses(prev => ({ ...prev, ...newStatuses }));
    91→      }
    92→    }
    93→  }, [videos, projectId, enabled, statuses]);
    94→
    95→  // Process queue
    96→  useEffect(() => {
    97→    if (!enabled || !projectId || processingRef.current || queueRef.current.length === 0) {
    98→      return;
    99→    }
   100→
   101→    const processNextVideo = async () => {
   102→      processingRef.current = true;
   103→      
   104→      const generationId = queueRef.current[0];
   105→      const video = videos.find(v => v.id === generationId);
   106→      
   107→      if (!video) {
   108→        queueRef.current.shift();
   109→        processingRef.current = false;
   110→        return;
   111→      }
   112→
   113→      const videoUrl = video.location || video.url;
   114→      if (!videoUrl) {
   115→        queueRef.current.shift();
   116→        processingRef.current = false;
   117→        return;
   118→      }
   119→
   120→      // Update status to processing
   121→      setStatuses(prev => ({
   122→        ...prev,
   123→        [generationId]: { generationId, status: 'processing' }
   124→      }));
   125→
   126→      // Generate and upload thumbnail
   127→      const result = await generateAndUploadThumbnail(videoUrl, generationId, projectId);
   128→
   129→      if (result.success && result.thumbnailUrl) {
   130→
   131→        // Update status
   132→        setStatuses(prev => ({
   133→          ...prev,
   134→          [generationId]: { generationId, status: 'success' }
   135→        }));
   136→
   137→        // Invalidate React Query cache to refresh the UI
   138→        // This will trigger a refetch and show the new thumbnail
   139→        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   140→
   141→        // Also update the cache directly for immediate UI update
   142→        queryClient.setQueriesData(
   143→          { [REDACTED] },
   144→          (oldData: { items: Array<{ id: string; [key: string]: unknown }> } | undefined) => {
   145→            if (!oldData?.items) return oldData;
   146→
   147→            return {
   148→              ...oldData,
   149→              items: oldData.items.map((item) =>
   150→                item.id === generationId 
   151→                  ? { ...item, thumbUrl: result.thumbnailUrl }
   152→                  : item
   153→              )
   154→            };
   155→          }
   156→        );
   157→      } else {
   158→        handleError(new Error(result.error || 'Thumbnail generation failed'), { context: 'useBackgroundThumbnailGenerator', showToast: false, logData: { generationId: generationId.substring(0, 8) } });
   159→
   160→        // Update status to error
   161→        setStatuses(prev => ({
   162→          ...prev,
   163→          [generationId]: { 
   164→            generationId, 
   165→            status: 'error',
   166→            error: result.error 
   167→          }
   168→        }));
   169→      }
   170→
   171→      // Remove from queue
   172→      queueRef.current.shift();
   173→      processingRef.current = false;
   174→
   175→      // Wait a bit before processing next (to avoid overwhelming the system)
   176→      setTimeout(() => {
   177→        if (queueRef.current.length > 0) {
   178→          processNextVideo();
   179→        }
   180→      }, 2000); // 2 second delay between generations
   181→    };
   182→
   183→    processNextVideo();
   184→  }, [enabled, projectId, videos, queryClient, queueRef.current.length]);
   185→
   186→  return {
   187→    statuses,
   188→    queueLength: queueRef.current.length,
   189→    isProcessing: processingRef.current,
   190→  };
   191→}
   192→
   193→

1→import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     4→import { useInvalidateGenerations } from '@/shared/hooks/useGenerationInvalidation';
     5→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     6→
     7→interface ShotGenerationMetadata {
     8→  magicEditPrompts?: Array<{
     9→    prompt: string;
    10→    timestamp: string;
    11→    numImages?: number;
    12→    isNextSceneBoostEnabled?: boolean;
    13→    isInSceneBoostEnabled?: boolean;
    14→  }>;
    15→  lastMagicEditPrompt?: string;
    16→  lastMagicEditNumImages?: number;
    17→  lastMagicEditNextSceneBoost?: boolean;
    18→  lastMagicEditInSceneBoost?: boolean;
    19→  userPositioned?: boolean;
    20→  frameSpacing?: number;
    21→  autoInitialized?: boolean;
    22→  [key: string]: unknown; // Allow for future metadata fields
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface UseShotGenerationMetadataOptions {
    26→  shotId: string;
    27→  shotGenerationId: string;
    28→  enabled?: boolean;
    29→}
    30→
    31→export function useShotGenerationMetadata({
    32→  shotId,
    33→  shotGenerationId,
    34→  enabled = true
    35→}: UseShotGenerationMetadataOptions) {
    36→  const [metadata, setMetadata] = useState<ShotGenerationMetadata>({});
    37→  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
    38→  const [isUpdating, setIsUpdating] = useState(false);
    39→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    40→  const invalidateGenerations = useInvalidateGenerations();
    41→
    42→  // Load metadata from database
    43→  useEffect(() => {
    44→
    45→    if (!enabled || !shotGenerationId) {
    46→      setIsLoading(false);
    47→      return;
    48→    }
    49→
    50→    let cancelled = false;
    51→
    52→    const loadMetadata = async () => {
    53→      try {
    54→        
    55→        const { data, error } = await supabase
    56→          .from('shot_generations')
    57→          .select('metadata')
    58→          .eq('id', shotGenerationId)
    59→          .maybeSingle();
    60→
    61→        if (error) {
    62→          handleError(error, { context: 'useShotGenerationMetadata.load', showToast: false, logData: { shotGenerationId: shotGenerationId.substring(0, 8) } });
    63→          if (!cancelled) {
    64→            setMetadata({});
    65→            setIsLoading(false);
    66→          }
    67→          return;
    68→        }
    69→
    70→        const loadedMetadata = (data?.metadata as ShotGenerationMetadata) || {};
    71→
    72→        if (!cancelled) {
    73→          setMetadata(loadedMetadata);
    74→          setIsLoading(false);
    75→        }
    76→      } catch (err) {
    77→        handleError(err, { context: 'useShotGenerationMetadata.loadMetadata', showToast: false });
    78→        if (!cancelled) {
    79→          setMetadata({});
    80→          setIsLoading(false);
    81→        }
    82→      }
    83→    };
    84→
    85→    loadMetadata();
    86→    return () => { cancelled = true; };
    87→  }, [shotGenerationId, enabled]);
    88→
    89→  // Update metadata in database
    90→  const updateMetadata = useCallback(async (updates: Partial<ShotGenerationMetadata>) => {
    91→    
    92→    if (!shotGenerationId || isUpdating) {
    93→      return;
    94→    }
    95→
    96→    setIsUpdating(true);
    97→
    98→    try {
    99→      const newMetadata = { ...metadata, ...updates };
   100→      
   101→      const { error } = await supabase
   102→        .from('shot_generations')
   103→        .update({ metadata: newMetadata })
   104→        .eq('id', shotGenerationId);
   105→
   106→      if (error) {
   107→        handleError(error, { context: 'useShotGenerationMetadata.update', showToast: false, logData: { shotGenerationId: shotGenerationId.substring(0, 8) } });
   108→        throw error;
   109→      }
   110→
   111→      // Update local state
   112→      setMetadata(newMetadata);
   113→
   114→      // Invalidate related queries to trigger UI updates (only if shotId is available)
   115→      if (shotId) {
   116→        invalidateGenerations(shotId, {
   117→          reason: 'magic-edit-prompt-persist',
   118→          scope: 'all'
   119→        });
   120→      }
   121→
   122→    } catch (error) {
   123→      handleError(error, { context: 'useShotGenerationMetadata.updateMetadata', showToast: false });
   124→      throw error;
   125→    } finally {
   126→      setIsUpdating(false);
   127→    }
   128→  }, [shotId, shotGenerationId, metadata, isUpdating, queryClient]);
   129→
   130→  // Convenience method to add a magic edit prompt
   131→  const addMagicEditPrompt = useCallback(async (
   132→    prompt: string, 
   133→    numImages?: number,
   134→    isNextSceneBoostEnabled?: boolean,
   135→    isInSceneBoostEnabled?: boolean
   136→  ) => {
   137→
   138→    const newPromptEntry = {
   139→      prompt,
   140→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
   141→      numImages,
   142→      isNextSceneBoostEnabled,
   143→      isInSceneBoostEnabled
   144→    };
   145→
   146→    const existingPrompts = metadata.magicEditPrompts || [];
   147→    const updatedPrompts = [...existingPrompts, newPromptEntry];
   148→
   149→    // Keep only the last 10 prompts to prevent unbounded growth
   150→    const trimmedPrompts = updatedPrompts.slice(-10);
   151→
   152→    await updateMetadata({
   153→      magicEditPrompts: trimmedPrompts,
   154→      lastMagicEditPrompt: prompt,
   155→      lastMagicEditNumImages: numImages,
   156→      lastMagicEditNextSceneBoost: isNextSceneBoostEnabled,
   157→      lastMagicEditInSceneBoost: isInSceneBoostEnabled
   158→    });
   159→    
   160→  }, [metadata, updateMetadata, shotGenerationId]);
   161→
   162→  // Get the most recent magic edit prompt
   163→  const getLastMagicEditPrompt = useCallback((): string => {
   164→    const prompt = metadata.lastMagicEditPrompt || '';
   165→    return prompt;
   166→  }, [metadata, shotGenerationId]);
   167→
   168→  // Get all magic edit prompts
   169→  const getMagicEditPrompts = useCallback(() => {
   170→    return metadata.magicEditPrompts || [];
   171→  }, [metadata]);
   172→
   173→  // Get last settings
   174→  const getLastSettings = useCallback(() => {
   175→    return {
   176→      numImages: metadata.lastMagicEditNumImages || 4,
   177→      isNextSceneBoostEnabled: metadata.lastMagicEditNextSceneBoost || false,
   178→      isInSceneBoostEnabled: metadata.lastMagicEditInSceneBoost || false
   179→    };
   180→  }, [metadata]);
   181→
   182→  return {
   183→    metadata,
   184→    isLoading,
   185→    isUpdating,
   186→    updateMetadata,
   187→    addMagicEditPrompt,
   188→    getLastMagicEditPrompt,
   189→    getMagicEditPrompts,
   190→    getLastSettings
   191→  };
   192→}

    53→/**

    68→export const useQuickShotCreate = ({
    69→  generationId,

    72→  onShotChange,
    73→  onClose,

    78→  const { createShot, isCreating } = useShotCreation();

    98→    onLoadingStart?.();

   102→      const result = await createShot({

   104→        generationPreview,

   106→        name: shotName || undefined,
   107→        // Settings inheritance and lastAffectedShot are handled automatically
   108→      });

   113→      }
   114→
   115→      // Select the newly created shot in the dropdown
   116→      onShotChange?.(result.shotId);

   119→      setQuickCreateSuccess({

   127→      setTimeout(() => {

   136→      setTimeout(() => {

   144→      });
   145→    } finally {

   148→  }, [

   163→

   175→    } else {

   180→        images: [],
   181→        position: 0,
   182→      }, { isNewlyCreated: true });
   183→    }
   184→
   185→    // Clear the success state

   187→  }, [quickCreateSuccess, shots, navigateToShot, onClose, clearQuickCreateSuccess]);

   189→  return {

1→// A map of common aspect ratios to specific pixel resolutions.
     2→// This ensures that generated media conforms to a set of standard dimensions.
     3→export const ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION: { [key: string]: string } = {
     4→  '21:9': '1024x438',
     5→  '16:9': '902x508',
     6→  '4:3': '768x576',
     7→  '3:2': '768x512',
     8→  '1:1': '670x670',
     9→  '2:3': '512x768',
    10→  '3:4': '576x768',
    11→  '9:16': '508x902',
    12→  '9:21': '438x1024',
    13→  // Legacy support for 'Square' key for backwards compatibility
    14→  'Square': '670x670',
    15→};
    16→
    17→/**
    18→ * Parses a "W:H" string into a numerical ratio (W / H).
    19→ * @param ratioStr The aspect ratio string (e.g., "16:9").
    20→ * @returns The numerical ratio, or NaN if the format is invalid.
    21→ */
    22→export const parseRatio = (ratioStr: string | undefined | null): number => {
    23→  if (!ratioStr) return NaN;
    24→  if (ratioStr === 'Square') return 1;
    25→  const parts = ratioStr.split(':');
    26→  if (parts.length === 2) {
    27→    const w = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
    28→    const h = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
    29→    if (!isNaN(w) && !isNaN(h) && h !== 0) {
    30→      return w / h;
    31→    }
    32→  }
    33→  return NaN;
    34→};
    35→
    36→/**
    37→ * Finds the closest predefined aspect ratio string from ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION.
    38→ * @param targetRatio The numerical aspect ratio to match (width / height).
    39→ * @returns The closest matching aspect ratio string (e.g., "16:9").
    40→ */
    41→export function findClosestAspectRatio(targetRatio: number): string {
    42→  const ratioKeys = Object.keys(ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION);
    43→  if (ratioKeys.length === 0) {
    44→    return '1:1'; // Fallback
    45→  }
    46→
    47→  let closestRatioKey: string = ratioKeys[0];
    48→  let minDiff = Infinity;
    49→
    50→  for (const ratioStr of ratioKeys) {
    51→    const predefinedRatioValue = parseRatio(ratioStr);
    52→    if (isNaN(predefinedRatioValue)) continue;
    53→
    54→    const diff = Math.abs(targetRatio - predefinedRatioValue);
    55→    if (diff < minDiff) {
    56→      minDiff = diff;
    57→      closestRatioKey = ratioStr;
    58→    }
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  return closestRatioKey;
    62→}
    63→
    64→/**
    65→ * Gets dimensions from aspect ratio for UI display purposes.
    66→ * @param aspectRatio The aspect ratio string (e.g., "16:9")
    67→ * @param baseSize The base size for the smaller dimension (default: 128px for thumbnails)
    68→ * @returns Object with width and height for CSS styling
    69→ * @internal Not currently used externally.
    70→ */
    71→function getDisplayDimensions(aspectRatio?: string, baseSize: number = 128): { width: number; height: number } {
    72→  if (!aspectRatio) {
    73→    // Default to square if no aspect ratio
    74→    return { width: baseSize, height: baseSize };
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const ratio = parseRatio(aspectRatio);
    78→  if (isNaN(ratio)) {
    79→    // Fallback to square if parsing fails
    80→    return { width: baseSize, height: baseSize };
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  // For landscape (ratio > 1), width is larger
    84→  // For portrait (ratio < 1), height is larger
    85→  // For square (ratio = 1), both are equal
    86→  if (ratio >= 1) {
    87→    // Landscape or square
    88→    const height = baseSize;
    89→    const width = Math.round(height * ratio);
    90→    return { width, height };
    91→  } else {
    92→    // Portrait
    93→    const width = baseSize;
    94→    const height = Math.round(width / ratio);
    95→    return { width, height };
    96→  }
    97→}
    98→
    99→// Keep for potential future use
   100→void getDisplayDimensions;
   101→
   102→/**
   103→ * Get preview dimensions constrained to a max height, maintaining aspect ratio.
   104→ * Used for video scrubbing previews and similar floating popups.
   105→ * @param aspectRatioStr The aspect ratio string (e.g., "16:9"). Falls back to 16:9 if invalid.
   106→ * @param maxHeight Maximum height in pixels (default: 200)
   107→ */
   108→export function getPreviewDimensions(
   109→  aspectRatioStr: string | undefined | null,
   110→  maxHeight: number = 200
   111→): { width: number; height: number } {
   112→  const defaultDims = { width: Math.round(maxHeight * 16 / 9), height: maxHeight };
   113→  if (!aspectRatioStr) return defaultDims;
   114→  const [w, h] = aspectRatioStr.split(':').map(Number);
   115→  if (w && h) {
   116→    return { width: Math.round(maxHeight * (w / h)), height: maxHeight };
   117→  }
   118→  return defaultDims;
   119→}

     6→// Phantom key for a pending item (duplicate/drop/external add) — used in augmented
     7→// positions maps so pair regions and segment strip can update before the real item arrives
     8→export const PENDING_POSITION_KEY = '__pending__';
     9→
    10→// Minimum gap between frames (4N+1 format, starting at 5)
    11→const QUANTIZE_MIN_GAP = 5;
    12→
    13→/**
    14→ * Quantize all positions to ensure gaps between adjacent items are in 4N+1 format.
    15→ * First item remains at position 0, subsequent items are adjusted to have quantized gaps.
    16→ * The trailing endpoint is extracted before quantizing and re-added after (its gap has
    17→ * different constraints — quantization happens in the drag handler).
    18→ */
    19→export const quantizePositions = (positions: Map<string, number>): Map<string, number> => {
    20→  // Extract trailing endpoint before quantizing
    21→  const trailingValue = positions.get(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
    22→  const imagePositions = new Map(positions);
    23→  imagePositions.delete(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
    24→
    25→  const entries = [...imagePositions.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
    26→
    27→  if (entries.length === 0) {
    28→    // If only trailing existed, return it as-is
    29→    const result = new Map<string, number>();
    30→    if (trailingValue !== undefined) result.set(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY, trailingValue);
    31→    return result;
    32→  }
    33→
    34→  const result = new Map<string, number>();
    35→
    36→  // First item always at 0
    37→  result.set(entries[0][0], 0);
    38→
    39→  // Subsequent items: quantize the gap from previous
    40→  for (let i = 1; i < entries.length; i++) {
    41→    const [id, pos] = entries[i];
    42→    const prevPos = result.get(entries[i - 1][0]) ?? 0;
    43→    const originalGap = pos - entries[i - 1][1];
    44→    const quantizedGap = quantizeGap(Math.max(originalGap, QUANTIZE_MIN_GAP), QUANTIZE_MIN_GAP);
    45→    result.set(id, prevPos + quantizedGap);
    46→  }
    47→
    48→  // Re-add trailing endpoint unchanged
    49→  if (trailingValue !== undefined) {
    50→    result.set(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY, trailingValue);
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  return result;
    54→};
    55→
    56→// Calculate max gap based on context frames (81 frames default)
    57→const calculateMaxGap = (contextFrames: number = 0, baseMax: number = 81): number => {
    58→  return Math.max(1, baseMax - (contextFrames * 2));
    59→};
    60→
    61→// Minimum gap between frames (4N+1 format, starting at 5)
    62→const MIN_GAP = 5;
    63→
    64→
    65→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    66→// Shrink oversized gaps and enforce frame 0 constraint.
    67→// First item is always placed at position 0.
    68→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    69→const shrinkOversizedGaps = (
    70→  positions: Map<string, number>,
    71→  excludeId?: string,
    72→  skipQuantization: boolean = false,
    73→): Map<string, number> => {
    74→  const maxGap = calculateMaxGap();
    75→
    76→  // Preserve trailing endpoint separately (not subject to gap shrinking)
    77→  const trailingValue = positions.get(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
    78→
    79→  const entries = [...positions.entries()].filter(([id]) => id !== excludeId && id !== TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
    80→
    81→  // Ensure frame 0 is included if it exists
    82→  if (!entries.some(([_, pos]) => pos === 0)) {
    83→    const zeroId = [...positions.entries()].find(([_, pos]) => pos === 0)?.[0];
    84→    if (zeroId) entries.push([zeroId, 0]);
    85→  }
    86→
    87→  entries.sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
    88→
    89→  const result = new Map<string, number>();
    90→
    91→  // First item always at position 0 (this enforces the frame 0 constraint)
    92→  for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
    93→    const [id, originalPos] = entries[i];
    94→
    95→    if (i === 0) {
    96→      result.set(id, 0);
    97→    } else {
    98→      const prevPos = result.get(entries[i - 1][0]) ?? 0;
    99→      const prevOriginalPos = entries[i - 1][1];
   100→
   101→      const originalGap = originalPos - prevOriginalPos;
   102→      const desiredGap = Math.max(originalGap, MIN_GAP);
   103→      const quantizedDesiredGap = skipQuantization ? desiredGap : quantizeGap(desiredGap, MIN_GAP);
   104→      const constrainedGap = Math.min(quantizedDesiredGap, maxGap);
   105→      const finalGap = skipQuantization ? constrainedGap : quantizeGap(constrainedGap, MIN_GAP);
   106→
   107→      result.set(id, prevPos + finalGap);
   108→    }
   109→  }
   110→
   111→  // Re-add excluded id unchanged
   112→  if (excludeId && positions.has(excludeId)) {
   113→    result.set(excludeId, positions.get(excludeId)!);
   114→  }
   115→
   116→  // Re-add trailing endpoint unchanged
   117→  if (trailingValue !== undefined) {
   118→    result.set(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY, trailingValue);
   119→  }
   120→
   121→  return result;
   122→};
   123→
   124→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   125→// Apply fluid timeline behavior with movement limiting
   126→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   127→export const applyFluidTimeline = (
   128→  positions: Map<string, number>,
   129→  draggedId: string,
   130→  targetFrame: number,
   131→  excludeId?: string,
   132→  _fullMin: number = 0,
   133→  _fullMax: number = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
   134→  skipQuantization: boolean = false,
   135→): Map<string, number> => {
   136→  const originalPos = positions.get(draggedId) ?? 0;
   137→  const movementAmount = targetFrame - originalPos;
   138→
   139→  // Limit movement to 50 frames per drag for natural feel
   140→  const maxSingleMove = 50;
   141→  const limitedMovement = Math.max(-maxSingleMove, Math.min(maxSingleMove, movementAmount));
   142→  const limitedTargetFrame = originalPos + limitedMovement;
   143→
   144→  const result = new Map(positions);
   145→  result.set(draggedId, limitedTargetFrame);
   146→
   147→  // Apply gap constraints (this also handles frame 0 enforcement)
   148→  return shrinkOversizedGaps(result, excludeId, skipQuantization);
   149→};
   150→
   151→// Convert pixel position to frame number
   152→export const pixelToFrame = (pixelX: number, containerWidth: number, fullMin: number, fullRange: number): number => {
   153→  const fraction = pixelX / containerWidth;
   154→  return Math.round(fullMin + fraction * fullRange);
   155→};
   156→
   157→// Calculate timeline dimensions
   158→const MINIMUM_TIMELINE_MAX = 30;
   159→
   160→export const getTimelineDimensions = (
   161→  framePositions: Map<string, number>,
   162→  pendingFrames?: (number | null)[]
   163→) => {
   164→  const positions = Array.from(framePositions.values());
   165→  const validPendingFrames = (pendingFrames || []).filter((f): f is number => f !== null && f !== undefined);
   166→  const allPositions = [...positions, ...validPendingFrames];
   167→
   168→  if (allPositions.length === 0) {
   169→    return { fullMin: 0, fullMax: MINIMUM_TIMELINE_MAX, fullRange: MINIMUM_TIMELINE_MAX };
   170→  }
   171→
   172→  const staticMax = Math.max(...allPositions, 0);
   173→  const staticMin = Math.min(...allPositions, 0);
   174→  const fullMax = Math.max(staticMax, MINIMUM_TIMELINE_MAX);
   175→  const fullMin = Math.min(0, staticMin);
   176→  const fullRange = Math.max(fullMax - fullMin, 1);
   177→
   178→  return { fullMin, fullMax, fullRange };
   179→};
   180→
   181→
   182→// Get pair information from positions (excludes trailing endpoint)
   183→export const getPairInfo = (framePositions: Map<string, number>) => {
   184→  const sortedPositions = [...framePositions.entries()]
   185→    .filter(([id]) => id !== TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY)
   186→    .map(([id, pos]) => ({ id, pos }))
   187→    .sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos);
   188→
   189→  const pairs = [];
   190→  for (let i = 0; i < sortedPositions.length - 1; i++) {
   191→    const startFrame = sortedPositions[i].pos;
   192→    const endFrame = sortedPositions[i + 1].pos;
   193→    const pairFrames = endFrame - startFrame;
   194→
   195→    pairs.push({
   196→      index: i,
   197→      startFrame,
   198→      endFrame,
   199→      frames: pairFrames,
   200→      generationStart: startFrame,
   201→      contextStart: endFrame,
   202→      contextEnd: endFrame,
   203→    });
   204→  }
   205→
   206→  return pairs;
   207→};
   208→
   209→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   210→// Multi-select bundling: bundle selected items 5 frames apart
   211→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   212→const BUNDLE_GAP = 5;
   213→
   214→export const applyFluidTimelineMulti = (
   215→  positions: Map<string, number>,
   216→  selectedIds: string[],
   217→  targetFrame: number,
   218→  skipQuantization: boolean = false,
   219→): Map<string, number> => {
   220→  if (selectedIds.length === 0) return positions;
   221→  if (selectedIds.length === 1) {
   222→    return applyFluidTimeline(positions, selectedIds[0], targetFrame, undefined, 0, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, skipQuantization);
   223→  }
   224→
   225→  const result = new Map(positions);
   226→
   227→  // Sort selected items by current position to preserve relative order
   228→  const selectedWithPositions = selectedIds
   229→    .map(id => ({ id, frame: positions.get(id) ?? 0 }))
   230→    .sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   231→
   232→  // Place selected items 5 frames apart
   233→  selectedWithPositions.forEach((item, index) => {
   234→    result.set(item.id, targetFrame + (index * BUNDLE_GAP));
   235→  });
   236→
   237→  // Push out non-selected items that are within the bundle range
   238→  const bundleEnd = targetFrame + ((selectedIds.length - 1) * BUNDLE_GAP);
   239→  const nonSelectedItems = [...positions.entries()]
   240→    .filter(([id]) => !selectedIds.includes(id));
   241→
   242→  nonSelectedItems.forEach(([id, pos]) => {
   243→    if (pos >= targetFrame && pos <= bundleEnd) {
   244→      result.set(id, bundleEnd + BUNDLE_GAP);
   245→    }
   246→  });
   247→
   248→  // Apply gap constraints (handles frame 0 enforcement)
   249→  return shrinkOversizedGaps(result, undefined, skipQuantization);
   250→};
   251→
   252→/**
   253→ * Calculate placement for a new structure video on the timeline.
   254→ * Places after the last existing video, clipping the last video if needed to make space.
   255→ *
   256→ * @returns Object with start_frame, end_frame, and optional lastVideoUpdate if clipping is needed
   257→ */
   258→interface VideoPlacementResult {
   259→  start_frame: number;
   260→  end_frame: number;
   261→  lastVideoUpdate?: { index: number; newEndFrame: number };
   262→}
   263→
   264→export const calculateNewVideoPlacement = (
   265→  videoFrameCount: number,
   266→  existingVideos: Array<{ path: string; start_frame: number; end_frame: number }> | undefined,
   267→  fullMax: number
   268→): VideoPlacementResult => {
   269→  let start_frame = 0;
   270→  let end_frame = videoFrameCount;
   271→  let lastVideoUpdate: { index: number; newEndFrame: number } | undefined;
   272→
   273→  if (existingVideos && existingVideos.length > 0) {
   274→    const sorted = [...existingVideos].sort((a, b) => a.start_frame - b.start_frame);
   275→    const lastVideo = sorted[sorted.length - 1];
   276→    const lastVideoIndex = existingVideos.findIndex(
   277→      v => v.path === lastVideo.path && v.start_frame === lastVideo.start_frame
   278→    );
   279→
   280→    start_frame = lastVideo.end_frame;
   281→    end_frame = start_frame + videoFrameCount;
   282→
   283→    // If no space on timeline, clip 1/5 of the last video's range
   284→    if (start_frame >= fullMax && lastVideoIndex >= 0) {
   285→      const lastVideoRange = lastVideo.end_frame - lastVideo.start_frame;
   286→      const clipAmount = Math.max(10, Math.floor(lastVideoRange / 5));
   287→      const newLastVideoEnd = lastVideo.end_frame - clipAmount;
   288→
   289→      if (newLastVideoEnd > lastVideo.start_frame + 10) {
   290→        lastVideoUpdate = { index: lastVideoIndex, newEndFrame: newLastVideoEnd };
   291→        start_frame = newLastVideoEnd;
   292→        end_frame = start_frame + videoFrameCount;
   293→      }
   294→    }
   295→  }
   296→
   297→  return { start_frame, end_frame, lastVideoUpdate };
   298→};
   299→
   300→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   301→// Trailing video detection utilities
   302→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   303→
   304→/**
   305→ * Extract pair_shot_generation_id from a generation row.
   306→ * Checks the FK column first, then falls back to params for legacy data.
   307→ */
   308→const getPairShotGenerationId = (
   309→  generation: {
   310→    pair_shot_generation_id?: string | null;
   311→    params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   312→  }
   313→): string | null => {
   314→  // Check FK column first (new format)
   315→  if (generation.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   316→    return generation.pair_shot_generation_id;
   317→  }
   318→
   319→  // Fallback to params (legacy format)
   320→  const params = generation.params;
   321→  if (!params) return null;
   322→
   323→  const individualParams = params.individual_segment_params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   324→  return (
   325→    (individualParams?.pair_shot_generation_id as string) ||
   326→    (params.pair_shot_generation_id as string) ||
   327→    null
   328→  );
   329→};
   330→
   331→/**
   332→ * Find trailing video info from a list of video outputs.
   333→ * A trailing video is one where pair_shot_generation_id matches the last image's shot_generation_id.
   334→ *
   335→ * @param videoOutputs - Array of generation rows (video outputs)
   336→ * @param lastImageShotGenId - The shot_generation_id of the last image on the timeline
   337→ * @returns Object with hasTrailing boolean and optional videoUrl
   338→ */
   339→export const findTrailingVideoInfo = (
   340→  videoOutputs: Array<{
   341→    type?: string | null;
   342→    location?: string | null;
   343→    pair_shot_generation_id?: string | null;
   344→    params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   345→  }>,
   346→  lastImageShotGenId: string | null
   347→): { hasTrailing: boolean; videoUrl: string | null } => {
   348→  if (!videoOutputs || videoOutputs.length === 0 || !lastImageShotGenId) {
   349→    return { hasTrailing: false, videoUrl: null };
   350→  }
   351→
   352→  const trailingVideo = videoOutputs.find(gen => {
   353→    // Must be a video with a location (completed)
   354→    if (!gen.type?.includes('video') || !gen.location) return false;
   355→    // Check if pair_shot_generation_id matches the last image
   356→    const pairId = getPairShotGenerationId(gen);
   357→    return pairId === lastImageShotGenId;
   358→  });
   359→
   360→  return {
   361→    hasTrailing: !!trailingVideo,
   362→    videoUrl: trailingVideo?.location || null,
   363→  };
   364→};

   239→        initialClips.push({
   240→          id: generateUUID(),
   241→          url: clip.url,
   242→          posterUrl: clip.posterUrl,
   243→          finalFrameUrl: clip.finalFrameUrl,
   244→          durationSeconds: clip.durationSeconds,
   245→          loaded: false,
   246→          playing: false,
   247→        });
   248→        if (clip.posterUrl) posterUrlsToPreload.push(clip.posterUrl);
   249→      }
   250→    });
   251→
   252→    // Load transition prompts
   253→    if (settings.transitionPrompts && settings.transitionPrompts.length > 0) {
   254→      transitionPrompts = settings.transitionPrompts
   255→        .map(tp => ({
   256→          id: initialClips[tp.clipIndex]?.id || '',
   257→          prompt: tp.prompt,
   258→        }))
   259→        .filter(p => p.id);
   260→    }
   261→  }
   262→  // Fallback to legacy two-video format
   263→  else if (settings.startingVideoUrl || settings.endingVideoUrl) {
   264→    if (settings.startingVideoUrl) {
   265→      initialClips.push({
   266→        id: generateUUID(),
   267→        url: settings.startingVideoUrl,
   268→        posterUrl: settings.startingVideoPosterUrl,
   269→        loaded: false,
   270→        playing: false,
   271→      });
   272→      if (settings.startingVideoPosterUrl) {
   273→        posterUrlsToPreload.push(settings.startingVideoPosterUrl);
   274→      }
   275→    }
   276→
   277→    if (settings.endingVideoUrl) {
   278→      initialClips.push({
   279→        id: generateUUID(),
   280→        url: settings.endingVideoUrl,
   281→        posterUrl: settings.endingVideoPosterUrl,
   282→        loaded: false,
   283→        playing: false,
   284→      });
   285→      if (settings.endingVideoPosterUrl) {
   286→        posterUrlsToPreload.push(settings.endingVideoPosterUrl);
   287→      }
   288→    }
   289→
   290→    // Initialize transition prompts from legacy format
   291→    // The `prompt` field existed in an older settings schema and may still
   292→    // be present in persisted data even though it's not in the current type.
   293→    const legacyPrompt = (settings as JoinClipsSettings & { prompt?: string }).prompt;
   294→    if (initialClips.length >= 2 && legacyPrompt) {
   295→      transitionPrompts = [
   296→        {
   297→          id: initialClips[1].id,
   298→          prompt: legacyPrompt,
   299→        },
   300→      ];
   301→    }
   302→  }
   303→
   304→  return { clips: initialClips, transitionPrompts, posterUrlsToPreload };
   305→}
   306→
   307→/**
   308→ * Pad initialClips to have at least 2 slots plus one trailing empty slot.
   309→ * This matches the original hook behavior exactly.
   310→ */
   311→export function padClipsWithEmptySlots(initialClips: VideoClip[]): VideoClip[] {
   312→  if (initialClips.length === 0) {
   313→    return [createEmptyClip(), createEmptyClip()];
   314→  }
   315→
   316→  if (initialClips.length < 2) {
   317→    const clipsToAdd = 2 - initialClips.length;
   318→    const emptyClips = Array.from({ length: clipsToAdd }, () => createEmptyClip());
   319→    return [...initialClips, ...emptyClips];
   320→  }
   321→
   322→  // >= 2 clips: add one trailing empty slot
   323→  return [...initialClips, createEmptyClip()];
   324→}

1→/**
     2→ * Extracts a segment from a video using the browser's MediaRecorder API.
     3→ *
     4→ * The approach: creates an off-screen <video> + <canvas>, seeks to the start
     5→ * time, records canvas frames via MediaRecorder until the end time is reached,
     6→ * then resolves with the resulting Blob and its file extension.
     7→ */
     8→
     9→interface ExtractedSegment {
    10→  blob: Blob;
    11→  fileExtension: string;
    12→}
    13→
    14→export async function extractVideoSegment(
    15→  videoUrl: string,
    16→  startTime: number,
    17→  endTime: number,
    18→  videoName: string,
    19→): Promise<ExtractedSegment> {
    20→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    21→    const video = document.createElement('video');
    22→    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    23→    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    24→
    25→    video.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    26→    video.muted = true;
    27→    video.preload = 'metadata';
    28→
    29→    let mediaRecorder: MediaRecorder;
    30→    let chunks: BlobPart[] = [];
    31→    let isRecording = false;
    32→
    33→    video.onloadedmetadata = () => {
    34→      // Set canvas size to match video
    35→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth || 640;
    36→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight || 480;
    37→
    38→      // Create stream from canvas
    39→      const stream = canvas.captureStream(30); // 30 FPS
    40→
    41→      // Try to use MP4 first, fall back to WebM if needed
    42→      const { mimeType, fileExtension } = negotiateMimeType();
    43→
    44→      mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType });
    45→
    46→      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
    47→        if (event.data.size > 0) {
    48→          chunks.push(event.data);
    49→        }
    50→      };
    51→
    52→      mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
    53→        const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: mimeType });
    54→        resolve({ blob, fileExtension });
    55→      };
    56→
    57→      // Seek to start time
    58→      video.currentTime = startTime;
    59→    };
    60→
    61→    video.onseeked = () => {
    62→      if (!isRecording && Math.abs(video.currentTime - startTime) < 0.1) {
    63→        // Start recording
    64→        isRecording = true;
    65→        chunks = [];
    66→        mediaRecorder.start();
    67→
    68→        const renderFrame = () => {
    69→          if (video.currentTime >= endTime || video.ended || video.paused) {
    70→            mediaRecorder.stop();
    71→            return;
    72→          }
    73→
    74→          // Draw current frame to canvas
    75→          if (ctx && !video.paused && !video.ended) {
    76→            ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    77→          }
    78→
    79→          // Continue to next frame
    80→          requestAnimationFrame(renderFrame);
    81→        };
    82→
    83→        // Start rendering loop
    84→        video.play().then(() => {
    85→          renderFrame();
    86→        }).catch(reject);
    87→
    88→        // Stop recording when we reach end time
    89→        const checkEndTime = () => {
    90→          if (video.currentTime >= endTime) {
    91→            video.pause();
    92→            mediaRecorder.stop();
    93→          } else {
    94→            requestAnimationFrame(checkEndTime);
    95→          }
    96→        };
    97→        checkEndTime();
    98→      }
    99→    };
   100→
   101→    video.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Failed to load video: ${videoName}`));
   102→    video.onabort = () => reject(new Error(`Video loading aborted: ${videoName}`));
   103→
   104→    // Set video source and load
   105→    video.src = videoUrl;
   106→    video.load();
   107→  });
   108→}
   109→
   110→/** Negotiate the best supported recording MIME type for the browser. */
   111→function negotiateMimeType(): { mimeType: string; fileExtension: string } {
   112→  const candidates: Array<{ mimeType: string; fileExtension: string }> = [
   113→    { mimeType: 'video/mp4', fileExtension: 'mp4' },
   114→    { mimeType: 'video/webm;codecs=vp9', fileExtension: 'webm' },
   115→    { mimeType: 'video/webm;codecs=vp8', fileExtension: 'webm' },
   116→    { mimeType: 'video/webm', fileExtension: 'webm' },
   117→  ];
   118→
   119→  for (const candidate of candidates) {
   120→    if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(candidate.mimeType)) {
   121→      return candidate;
   122→    }
   123→  }
   124→
   125→  // Fallback - let the browser pick
   126→  return { mimeType: 'video/webm', fileExtension: 'webm' };
   127→}
   128→
