1→/**
     2→ * Unified Timeline Position Calculator
     3→ * 
     4→ * This utility ensures that new items added to a timeline always get unique
     5→ * timeline_frame positions, preventing collisions that can cause display issues.
     6→ * 
     7→ * Used by:
     8→ * - BatchDropZone (batch mode file/generation drops)
     9→ * - Timeline (timeline mode file/generation drops)
    10→ * - useAddImageToShot (add to shot button)
    11→ * - handleTimelineImageDrop / handleTimelineGenerationDrop
    12→ * - handleBatchImageDrop / handleBatchGenerationDrop
    13→ */
    14→
    15→/** Default/max spacing when no existing items to calculate average from */
    16→export const DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING = 50;
    17→
    18→/** Minimum spacing to use even if average is lower (prevents overly tight timelines) */
    19→const MIN_FRAME_SPACING = 10;
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Calculate the average spacing between existing frames in a timeline.
    23→ * Returns the default spacing if there aren't enough items to calculate an average.
    24→ * 
    25→ * @param existingFrames - Array of existing frame positions
    26→ * @param defaultSpacing - Fallback spacing if average can't be calculated
    27→ * @returns The average spacing, clamped between MIN_FRAME_SPACING and DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING
    28→ */
    29→export const calculateAverageSpacing = (
    30→  existingFrames: number[],
    31→  defaultSpacing: number = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING
    32→): number => {
    33→  // Need at least 2 items to calculate spacing
    34→  if (existingFrames.length < 2) {
    35→    return defaultSpacing;
    36→  }
    37→  
    38→  const sortedFrames = [...existingFrames].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    39→  const minFrame = sortedFrames[0];
    40→  const maxFrame = sortedFrames[sortedFrames.length - 1];
    41→  
    42→  // Calculate average: total span divided by number of gaps
    43→  const totalSpan = maxFrame - minFrame;
    44→  const numGaps = sortedFrames.length - 1;
    45→  const averageSpacing = Math.round(totalSpan / numGaps);
    46→  
    47→  // Clamp between min (10) and max (81) to prevent outliers from causing huge gaps
    48→  return Math.min(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, Math.max(MIN_FRAME_SPACING, averageSpacing));
    49→};
    50→
    51→/**
    52→ * Calculate a unique timeline frame that doesn't collide with existing frames.
    53→ * 
    54→ * @param targetFrame - The desired frame position
    55→ * @param existingFrames - Array of existing frame positions in the shot
    56→ * @param minGap - Minimum gap between frames (default: 1)
    57→ * @returns A unique frame position that doesn't collide with existing frames
    58→ */
    59→export const ensureUniqueFrame = (
    60→  targetFrame: number,
    61→  existingFrames: number[],
    62→  minGap: number = 1
    63→): number => {
    64→  // Normalize to integer
    65→  let frame = Math.max(0, Math.round(targetFrame));
    66→  
    67→  // If no collision, return as-is
    68→  if (!existingFrames.includes(frame)) {
    69→    return frame;
    70→  }
    71→  
    72→  // Find nearest available position using expanding search
    73→  // Try +1, -1, +2, -2, etc. until we find an available slot
    74→  let offset = 1;
    75→  const maxOffset = 1000; // Safety limit
    76→  
    77→  while (offset < maxOffset) {
    78→    // Try higher first (more natural for timeline)
    79→    const higher = frame + offset;
    80→    if (!existingFrames.includes(higher)) {
    81→      return higher;
    82→    }
    83→    
    84→    // Then try lower (but not below 0)
    85→    const lower = frame - offset;
    86→    if (lower >= 0 && !existingFrames.includes(lower)) {
    87→      return lower;
    88→    }
    89→    
    90→    offset += minGap;
    91→  }
    92→  
    93→  // Fallback: append at end (should never reach here)
    94→  const maxFrame = existingFrames.length > 0 ? Math.max(...existingFrames) : 0;
    95→  const fallback = maxFrame + DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
    96→  return fallback;
    97→};
    98→
    99→/**
   100→ * Calculate frame position for inserting at a given index, with collision detection.
   101→ * This is an enhanced version of getFramePositionForIndex that ensures uniqueness.
   102→ * Uses average spacing of existing items when appending at end.
   103→ * 
   104→ * @param index - The grid index where the item is being inserted
   105→ * @param existingFrames - Array of existing frame positions (sorted by timeline_frame)
   106→ * @param explicitSpacing - Optional explicit spacing (overrides average calculation for end insertion)
   107→ * @returns A unique frame position
   108→ */
   109→export const calculateFrameForIndex = (
   110→  index: number,
   111→  existingFrames: number[],
   112→  explicitSpacing?: number
   113→): number => {
   114→  // Sort frames to ensure correct neighbor calculation
   115→  const sortedFrames = [...existingFrames].sort((a, b) => a - b);
   116→  
   117→  let targetFrame: number;
   118→  
   119→  if (sortedFrames.length === 0) {
   120→    // Empty timeline - start at 0
   121→    targetFrame = 0;
   122→  } else if (index === 0) {
   123→    // Inserting at beginning - use half of first frame
   124→    const firstFrame = sortedFrames[0];
   125→    targetFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(firstFrame / 2));
   126→  } else if (index >= sortedFrames.length) {
   127→    // Inserting at end - use average spacing or explicit
   128→    const spacing = explicitSpacing ?? calculateAverageSpacing(sortedFrames);
   129→    const lastFrame = sortedFrames[sortedFrames.length - 1];
   130→    targetFrame = lastFrame + spacing;
   131→  } else {
   132→    // Inserting in middle - use midpoint between neighbors
   133→    const prevFrame = sortedFrames[index - 1];
   134→    const nextFrame = sortedFrames[index];
   135→    targetFrame = Math.floor((prevFrame + nextFrame) / 2);
   136→  }
   137→  
   138→  // Ensure the calculated frame is unique
   139→  return ensureUniqueFrame(targetFrame, sortedFrames);
   140→};
   141→
   142→/**
   143→ * Calculate the next available frame for appending to a timeline.
   144→ * Uses the average spacing of existing items to maintain consistent spacing.
   145→ * 
   146→ * @param existingFrames - Array of existing frame positions
   147→ * @param explicitSpacing - Optional explicit spacing (overrides average calculation)
   148→ * @returns A unique frame position at the end of the timeline
   149→ */
   150→export const calculateNextAvailableFrame = (
   151→  existingFrames: number[],
   152→  explicitSpacing?: number
   153→): number => {
   154→  if (existingFrames.length === 0) {
   155→    return 0;
   156→  }
   157→  
   158→  // Use explicit spacing if provided, otherwise calculate average
   159→  const spacing = explicitSpacing ?? calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames);
   160→  
   161→  const maxFrame = Math.max(...existingFrames);
   162→  const targetFrame = maxFrame + spacing;
   163→  
   164→  // Should always be unique since we're adding after max, but check anyway
   165→  return ensureUniqueFrame(targetFrame, existingFrames);
   166→};
   167→
   168→/**
   169→ * Extract timeline_frame values from an array of shot generations or images.
   170→ * Filters out null/undefined values and videos.
   171→ * 
   172→ * @param items - Array of items with timeline_frame property
   173→ * @returns Array of valid frame numbers
   174→ */
   175→export const extractExistingFrames = (
   176→  items: Array<{ timeline_frame?: number | null; type?: string }>
   177→): number[] => {
   178→  return items
   179→    .filter(item => {
   180→      // Filter out videos
   181→      if (item.type === 'video') return false;
   182→      // Filter out null/undefined frames
   183→      if (item.timeline_frame == null) return false;
   184→      // Filter out unpositioned items (timeline_frame === -1)
   185→      if (item.timeline_frame === -1) return false;
   186→      return true;
   187→    })
   188→    .map(item => item.timeline_frame as number);
   189→};
   190→
   191→

1→/**

     3→ *
     4→ * Handles the priority logic for displaying prompts from multiple sources.
     5→ * Uses basePromptForEnhancement to distinguish between:

     7→ * - settings.prompt that is a user edit after enhancement (SHOULD show instead of enhanced)

    12→ * 2. If enhancedPrompt exists → show AI-enhanced version with badge

    97→ *   basePromptForEnhancement,
    98→ *   defaultPrompt: shotDefaults?.prompt,
    99→ *   onSettingsChange: (value) => onChange({ prompt: value }),
   100→ *   onClearEnhancedPrompt,
   101→ * });
   102→ *
   103→ * return (
   104→ *   <>
   105→ *     {prompt.badgeType === 'enhanced' && <EnhancedBadge onClear={prompt.handleClearEnhanced} />}
   106→ *     <Textarea
   107→ *       value={prompt.displayValue}
   108→ *       onChange={(e) => prompt.handleChange(e.target.value)}
   109→ *       onClear={prompt.handleClearAll}
   110→ *     />
   111→ *   </>
   112→ * );
   113→ * ```
   114→ */
   115→export function usePromptFieldState({
   116→  settingsPrompt,
   117→  enhancedPrompt,
   118→  basePromptForEnhancement,
   119→  defaultPrompt,
   120→  onSettingsChange,
   121→  onClearEnhancedPrompt,
   122→}: UsePromptFieldStateOptions): PromptFieldState {
   123→  // Derived state
   124→  const hasEnhancedPrompt = !!enhancedPrompt?.trim();
   125→  const hasSettingsPrompt = settingsPrompt !== undefined;
   126→  const hasDefaultPrompt = defaultPrompt !== undefined;
   127→
   128→  // Check if user has edited AFTER enhancement was created
   129→  // This is true if:
   130→  // 1. settings.prompt exists
   131→  // 2. AND it's different from the base that was used for enhancement
   132→  const userHasEditedAfterEnhancement = useMemo(() => {
   133→    if (settingsPrompt === undefined) return false;
   134→    if (!hasEnhancedPrompt) return false; // No enhancement to compare against
   135→
   136→    // If we have the base that was used for enhancement, compare against it
   137→    if (basePromptForEnhancement !== undefined) {
   138→      return settingsPrompt.trim() !== basePromptForEnhancement.trim();
   139→    }
   140→
   141→    // Fallback: if no base stored (older data), compare against enhanced prompt itself
   142→    // User has edited if their prompt differs from the displayed enhanced value
   143→    return enhancedPrompt ? settingsPrompt.trim() !== enhancedPrompt.trim() : false;
   144→  }, [hasSettingsPrompt, hasEnhancedPrompt, settingsPrompt, basePromptForEnhancement, enhancedPrompt]);
   145→
   146→  // Calculate display value and badge type
   147→  const { displayValue, badgeType } = useMemo(() => {
   148→    // Priority 1: User edited after enhancement → show their edit
   149→    if (userHasEditedAfterEnhancement && settingsPrompt !== undefined) {
   150→      return { displayValue: settingsPrompt, badgeType: null as PromptBadgeType };
   151→    }
   152→
   153→    // Priority 2: Enhanced prompt exists → show it
   154→    if (enhancedPrompt?.trim()) {
   155→      return { displayValue: enhancedPrompt, badgeType: 'enhanced' as PromptBadgeType };
   156→    }
   157→
   158→    // Priority 3: settings.prompt exists (no enhancement, or same as base)
   159→    if (settingsPrompt !== undefined) {
   160→      return { displayValue: settingsPrompt, badgeType: null as PromptBadgeType };
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    // Priority 4: Fall back to shot defaults
   164→    if (defaultPrompt !== undefined) {
   165→      return { displayValue: defaultPrompt, badgeType: 'default' as PromptBadgeType };
   166→    }
   167→
   168→    // Nothing set
   169→    return { displayValue: '', badgeType: null as PromptBadgeType };
   170→  }, [
   171→    userHasEditedAfterEnhancement,
   172→    settingsPrompt,
   173→    enhancedPrompt,
   174→    defaultPrompt,
   175→    hasEnhancedPrompt,
   176→    hasSettingsPrompt,
   177→    hasDefaultPrompt,
   178→  ]);
   179→
   180→  // Handlers
   181→  const handleChange = useCallback((value: string) => {
   182→    onSettingsChange(value);
   183→  }, [onSettingsChange]);
   184→
   185→  const handleClearAll = useCallback(() => {
   186→    // Clear user edit (undefined = use defaults)
   187→    onSettingsChange(undefined);
   188→    // Also clear enhanced prompt
   189→    onClearEnhancedPrompt?.();
   190→  }, [onSettingsChange, onClearEnhancedPrompt]);
   191→
   192→  const handleClearEnhanced = useCallback(() => {
   193→    // Only clear enhanced prompt
   194→    // This reveals the base prompt (settings.prompt or shot default)
   195→    onClearEnhancedPrompt?.();
   196→  }, [onClearEnhancedPrompt]);
   197→
   198→  const handleVoiceResult = useCallback((result: { prompt?: string; transcription?: string }) => {
   199→    onSettingsChange(result.prompt || result.transcription || '');
   200→  }, [onSettingsChange]);
   201→
   202→  return {
   203→    displayValue,
   204→    badgeType,
   205→    hasEnhancedPrompt,
   206→    userHasSetPrompt: hasSettingsPrompt,
   207→    userHasEditedAfterEnhancement,
   208→    handleChange,
   209→    handleClearAll,
   210→    handleClearEnhanced,
   211→    handleVoiceResult,
   212→  };
   213→}
   214→

    12→// FRAME QUANTIZATION (4N + 1 Constraint)
    13→// ============================================================================
    14→// Wan models require frame counts in the form 4N + 1:
    15→// Valid values: 1, 5, 9, 13, 17, 21, 25, 29, 33, 37, 41, 45, 49, 53, 57, 61, 65, 69, 73, 77, 81...
    16→
    17→/**
    18→ * Check if a frame count is valid (in 4N+1 format)
    19→ * @param frames - The frame count to validate
    20→ * @returns True if the frame count is valid (4N+1)
    21→ */
    22→export function isValidFrameCount(frames: number): boolean {
    23→  return frames > 0 && (frames - 1) % 4 === 0;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/**
    27→ * Get the nearest valid frame count (4N+1) that is >= minFrames
    28→ * Rounds to the nearest valid value
    29→ * @param frames - The frame count to quantize
    30→ * @param minFrames - Minimum allowed frame count (default: 1)
    31→ * @returns The nearest valid frame count in 4N+1 format
    32→ */
    33→export function quantizeFrameCount(frames: number, minFrames: number = 1): number {
    34→  // Ensure minFrames itself is valid (4N+1)
    35→  const validMin = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((minFrames - 1) / 4) * 4 + 1);
    36→
    37→  if (frames <= validMin) return validMin;
    38→
    39→  // Calculate N for 4N+1
    40→  const quantizationFactor = Math.round((frames - 1) / 4);
    41→  const quantized = quantizationFactor * 4 + 1;
    42→
    43→  // Ensure we don't go below minimum
    44→  return Math.max(validMin, quantized);
    45→}

     3→ *
     4→ * Loads a variant's source images onto the timeline by switching primary variants.
     5→ * For each image position (start, end) where the image differs:
     6→ * - Same generation, different variant → find and set as primary
     7→ * - Same generation, match by URL → find and set as primary
     8→ * - Different generation entirely → create new variant with source URL, set as primary
     9→ */
    10→
    11→import { useCallback, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
    12→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    13→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    14→import { invalidateVariantChange } from '@/shared/hooks/useGenerationInvalidation';
    15→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    16→import type { GenerationVariant } from '@/shared/hooks/useVariants';
    17→import type { CurrentSegmentImagesData } from '@/shared/components/VariantSelector/utils';
    18→
    19→interface UseLoadVariantImagesProps {

    26→/**
    27→ * Extract the storage path from a full URL or relative path for matching.
    28→ */
    29→function extractStoragePath(url: string | undefined | null): string | null {
    30→  if (!url) return null;
    31→  const storageMatch = url.match(/\/storage\/v1\/object\/(?:public|sign)\/(.+?)(?:\?|$)/);
    32→  if (storageMatch) return storageMatch[1];
    33→  if (url.startsWith('generations/') || url.startsWith('/generations/')) {
    34→    return url.replace(/^\//, '');
    35→  }
    36→  return url;
    37→}
    38→
    39→function pathsMatch(url1: string | undefined | null, url2: string | undefined | null): boolean {
    40→  if (!url1 || !url2) return false;
    41→  if (url1 === url2) return true;
    42→  const p1 = extractStoragePath(url1);
    43→  const p2 = extractStoragePath(url2);
    44→  return !!p1 && !!p2 && p1 === p2;
    45→}
    46→
    47→export function useLoadVariantImages({ currentSegmentImages }: UseLoadVariantImagesProps) {
    48→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    49→  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
    50→
    51→  // Clean up on unmount
    52→  useEffect(() => {
    53→    return () => {
    54→      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    55→    };

    59→    // Abort any previous in-flight request
    60→    abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    61→    abortControllerRef.current = new AbortController();
    62→    const signal = abortControllerRef.current.signal;

    65→

    67→    if (!params) return;
    68→
    69→    // Extract source image data from variant params
    70→    const indivParams = (params.individual_segment_params || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    71→    const resolvedPaths = (indivParams.input_image_paths_resolved || params.input_image_paths_resolved) as string[] | undefined;
    72→
    73→    const variantStartGenId = (indivParams.start_image_generation_id || params.start_image_generation_id) as string | undefined;
    74→    const variantEndGenId = (indivParams.end_image_generation_id || params.end_image_generation_id) as string | undefined;
    75→    const variantStartVariantId = (indivParams.start_image_variant_id || params.start_image_variant_id) as string | undefined;
    76→    const variantEndVariantId = (indivParams.end_image_variant_id || params.end_image_variant_id) as string | undefined;
    77→    const variantStartUrl = resolvedPaths?.[0] || (indivParams.start_image_url || params.start_image_url) as string | undefined;
    78→    const variantEndUrl = resolvedPaths && resolvedPaths.length > 1
    79→      ? resolvedPaths[resolvedPaths.length - 1]
    80→      : (indivParams.end_image_url || params.end_image_url) as string | undefined;
    81→
    82→    // Process each image position
    83→    const positions = [
    84→      {
    85→        variantGenId: variantStartGenId,
    86→        variantVariantId: variantStartVariantId,
    87→        variantUrl: variantStartUrl,
    88→        currentGenId: currentSegmentImages.startGenerationId,
    89→        currentVariantId: currentSegmentImages.startVariantId,
    90→        currentUrl: currentSegmentImages.startUrl,
    91→      },
    92→      {
    93→        variantGenId: variantEndGenId,
    94→        variantVariantId: variantEndVariantId,
    95→        variantUrl: variantEndUrl,
    96→        currentGenId: currentSegmentImages.endGenerationId,
    97→        currentVariantId: currentSegmentImages.endVariantId,
    98→        currentUrl: currentSegmentImages.endUrl,
    99→      },
   100→    ];
   101→
   102→    for (const pos of positions) {
   103→      // Skip if no source data or no current data
   104→      if (!pos.variantGenId && !pos.variantUrl) continue;
   105→      if (!pos.currentGenId) continue;
   106→
   107→      // Check if this request was superseded before each async operation
   108→      if (signal.aborted) return;
   109→
   110→      try {
   111→        await loadSingleImage({
   112→          variantGenId: pos.variantGenId,
   113→          variantVariantId: pos.variantVariantId,
   114→          variantUrl: pos.variantUrl,
   115→          currentGenId: pos.currentGenId,
   116→          currentVariantId: pos.currentVariantId,
   117→          currentUrl: pos.currentUrl,
   118→        });
   119→
   120→        if (signal.aborted) return;
   121→
   122→        // Invalidate caches for this generation
   123→        await invalidateVariantChange(queryClient, {
   124→          generationId: pos.currentGenId,
   125→          reason: 'load-variant-images',
   126→        });
   127→
   128→        if (signal.aborted) return;
   129→      } catch (error) {
   130→        if (signal.aborted) return;
   131→        handleError(error, { context: 'LoadVariantImages', showToast: false });
   132→      }
   133→    }
   134→  }, [currentSegmentImages, queryClient]);
   135→
   136→  return { loadVariantImages };
   137→}
   138→
   139→/**
   140→ * Load a single image position: find or create the variant and make it primary.
   141→ */
   142→async function loadSingleImage(pos: {
   143→  variantGenId: string | undefined;
   144→  variantVariantId: string | undefined;
   145→  variantUrl: string | undefined;
   146→  currentGenId: string;
   147→  currentVariantId: string | undefined;
   148→  currentUrl: string | undefined;
   149→}) {
   150→  // Check if images actually differ
   151→  if (pos.variantGenId === pos.currentGenId) {
   152→    if (pos.variantVariantId && pos.currentVariantId && pos.variantVariantId === pos.currentVariantId) {
   153→      return; // Same variant, nothing to do
   154→    }
   155→    if (!pos.variantVariantId && !pos.currentVariantId) {
   156→      if (pathsMatch(pos.variantUrl, pos.currentUrl)) return;
   157→    }
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  const targetGenerationId = pos.currentGenId;
   161→
   162→  // Strategy 1: Same generation - find variant by ID
   163→  if (pos.variantGenId === pos.currentGenId && pos.variantVariantId) {
   164→    await setPrimaryById(pos.variantVariantId);
   165→    return;
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  // Strategy 2: Find variant by URL match on the current generation
   169→  if (pos.variantUrl) {
   170→    const { data: existingVariants } = await supabase
   171→      .from('generation_variants')
   172→      .select('id, location')
   173→      .eq('generation_id', targetGenerationId);
   174→
   175→    if (existingVariants) {
   176→      const match = existingVariants.find(v => pathsMatch(v.location, pos.variantUrl));
   177→      if (match) {
   178→        await setPrimaryById(match.id);
   179→        return;
   180→      }
   181→    }
   182→
   183→    // Strategy 3: Create new variant with the source URL
   184→    const { error } = await supabase
   185→      .from('generation_variants')
   186→      .insert({
   187→        generation_id: targetGenerationId,
   188→        location: pos.variantUrl,
   189→        thumbnail_url: pos.variantUrl,
   190→        is_primary: true, // DB trigger handles unsetting old primary
   191→        variant_type: 'loaded',
   192→        params: {
   193→          source_generation_id: pos.variantGenId,
   194→          loaded_from_variant: pos.variantVariantId,
   195→          source_url: pos.variantUrl,
   196→        },
   197→      })
   198→      .select('id')
   199→      .single();
   200→
   201→    if (error) {
   202→      throw new Error(`Failed to create variant: ${error.message}`);
   203→    }
   204→  }
   205→}
   206→
   207→/**
   208→ * Set a variant as primary by ID. DB trigger handles unsetting the old primary.
   209→ */
   210→async function setPrimaryById(variantId: string) {
   211→  const { error } = await supabase
   212→    .from('generation_variants')
   213→    .update({ is_primary: true })
   214→    .eq('id', variantId);
   215→
   216→  if (error) {
   217→    throw new Error(`Failed to set primary variant: ${error.message}`);
   218→  }
   219→}
   220→

1→/**
     2→ * useAdjacentPagePreloader
     3→ *
     4→ * Unified hook for preloading adjacent gallery pages.
     5→ * Handles React Query prefetching + image preloading + cache cleanup in one place.
     6→ *
     7→ * This replaces the previous scattered approach where:
     8→ * - Page components had handlePrefetchAdjacentPages callbacks
     9→ * - Those callbacks manually called queryClient.prefetchQuery + smartPreloadImages
    10→ * - ImagePreloadManager separately ran useImagePreloading + useCacheCleanup
    11→ *
    12→ * Now: Just use this hook in MediaGallery. Pages don't need to know about preloading.
    13→ */
    14→
    15→import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
    16→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    17→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    18→import { fetchGenerations } from '@/shared/hooks/useProjectGenerations';
    19→import {
    20→  preloadingService,
    21→  clearLoadedImages,
    22→  PRIORITY_VALUES,
    23→} from '@/shared/lib/preloading';
    24→
    25→interface UseAdjacentPagePreloaderProps {
    26→  /** Project ID to scope queries */
    27→  projectId: string | null;
    28→  /** Current page (1-indexed, as used by the API) */
    29→  currentPage: number;
    30→  /** Items per page */
    31→  itemsPerPage: number;
    32→  /** Filters object (will be stringified for cache key) */
    33→  filters?: Record<string, unknown>;
    34→  /** Total items (for calculating total pages) */
    35→  totalItems?: number;
    36→  /** Whether preloading is enabled */
    37→  enabled?: boolean;
    38→  /** Pause preloading (e.g., when lightbox is open) */
    39→  paused?: boolean;
    40→}
    41→
    42→interface PaginatedResponse {
    43→  items?: Array<{ id?: string; url?: string; thumbUrl?: string }>;
    44→  total?: number;
    45→}
    46→
    47→/**
    48→ * Clean up distant page queries from React Query cache.
    49→ * Keeps pages within ±keepRange of current page.
    50→ */
    51→function cleanupDistantPages(
    52→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    53→  projectId: string,
    54→  currentPage: number,
    55→  keepRange: number = 2
    56→): void {
    57→  const allQueries = queryClient.getQueryCache().getAll();
    58→
    59→  allQueries.forEach((query) => {
    60→    const key = query.queryKey as unknown[];
    61→    if (!Array.isArray(key)) return;
    62→
    63→    // Match unified format: ['unified-generations', 'project', projectId, page, ...]
    64→    if (
    65→      key[0] === 'unified-generations' &&
    66→      key[1] === 'project' &&
    67→      key[2] === projectId
    68→    ) {
    69→      const page = key[3];
    70→      if (typeof page === 'number' && Math.abs(page - currentPage) > keepRange) {
    71→        // Clear load tracker for removed pages
    72→        const data = query.state?.data as PaginatedResponse | undefined;
    73→        if (data?.items) {
    74→          clearLoadedImages(data.items.filter((item): item is { id: string } => !!item.id));
    75→        }
    76→        // Remove the query
    77→        queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: query.queryKey });
    78→      }
    79→    }
    80→  });
    81→}
    82→
    83→/**
    84→ * Unified hook for preloading adjacent gallery pages.
    85→ */
    86→export function useAdjacentPagePreloader({
    87→  projectId,
    88→  currentPage,
    89→  itemsPerPage,
    90→  filters,
    91→  totalItems,
    92→  enabled = true,
    93→  paused = false,
    94→}: UseAdjacentPagePreloaderProps): void {
    95→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    96→
    97→  // Use shared service for config
    98→  const config = preloadingService.getConfig();
    99→
   100→  // Stable filters string for dependency array (to detect when filters change)
   101→  // We stringify for the dependency array but pass the object to query keys
   102→  const filtersString = useMemo(
   103→    () => (filters ? JSON.stringify(filters) : null),
   104→    [filters]
   105→  );
   106→
   107→  // Calculate total pages
   108→  const totalPages = useMemo(() => {
   109→    if (totalItems !== undefined && totalItems > 0) {
   110→      return Math.ceil(totalItems / itemsPerPage);
   111→    }
   112→    return Infinity; // Unknown, assume there's always more
   113→  }, [totalItems, itemsPerPage]);
   114→
   115→  useEffect(() => {
   116→    // Skip if disabled, paused, or no project
   117→    if (!enabled || paused || !projectId) {
   118→      return;
   119→    }
   120→
   121→    // Clear pending preloads from previous page
   122→    preloadingService.clearQueue();
   123→
   124→    // Debounce: wait for user to settle on a page
   125→    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
   126→      const hasPrevPage = currentPage > 1;
   127→      const hasNextPage = currentPage < totalPages;
   128→
   129→      // IMPORTANT: Pass the filters object directly to query keys (not stringified)
   130→      // This must match how useProjectGenerations creates its query keys
   131→      // The filtersString is only used for the effect dependency array
   132→
   133→      // Prefetch next page (higher priority)
   134→      if (hasNextPage) {
   135→        const nextPage = currentPage + 1;
   136→        try {
   137→          await queryClient.prefetchQuery({
   138→            [REDACTED](
   139→              projectId,
   140→              nextPage,
   141→              itemsPerPage,
   142→              filters // Pass object, not string
   143→            ),
   144→            queryFn: () =>
   145→              fetchGenerations(
   146→                projectId,
   147→                itemsPerPage,
   148→                (nextPage - 1) * itemsPerPage,
   149→                filters
   150→              ),
   151→            staleTime: 30_000,
   152→          });
   153→
   154→          // Preload images from prefetched data
   155→          const cached = queryClient.getQueryData<PaginatedResponse>(
   156→            queryKeys.unified.byProject(projectId, nextPage, itemsPerPage, filters)
   157→          );
   158→          if (cached?.items) {
   159→            preloadingService.preloadImages(cached.items, PRIORITY_VALUES.high);
   160→          }
   161→        } catch (err) {
   162→          // Prefetch failures are non-critical, just log
   163→        }
   164→      }
   165→
   166→      // Prefetch previous page (lower priority)
   167→      if (hasPrevPage) {
   168→        const prevPage = currentPage - 1;
   169→        try {
   170→          await queryClient.prefetchQuery({
   171→            [REDACTED](
   172→              projectId,
   173→              prevPage,
   174→              itemsPerPage,
   175→              filters // Pass object, not string
   176→            ),
   177→            queryFn: () =>
   178→              fetchGenerations(
   179→                projectId,
   180→                itemsPerPage,
   181→                (prevPage - 1) * itemsPerPage,
   182→                filters
   183→              ),
   184→            staleTime: 30_000,
   185→          });
   186→
   187→          const cached = queryClient.getQueryData<PaginatedResponse>(
   188→            queryKeys.unified.byProject(projectId, prevPage, itemsPerPage, filters)
   189→          );
   190→          if (cached?.items) {
   191→            preloadingService.preloadImages(cached.items, PRIORITY_VALUES.normal);
   192→          }
   193→        } catch (err) {
   194→        }
   195→      }
   196→
   197→      // Clean up distant pages
   198→      cleanupDistantPages(queryClient, projectId, currentPage, 2);
   199→    }, config.debounceMs);
   200→
   201→    return () => {
   202→      clearTimeout(timer);
   203→      // Clear queue on page change to prioritize new adjacent pages
   204→      preloadingService.clearQueue();
   205→    };
   206→  }, [
   207→    enabled,
   208→    paused,
   209→    projectId,
   210→    currentPage,
   211→    itemsPerPage,
   212→    filters, // Include filters object for reference equality checks
   213→    filtersString, // Include string for content change detection
   214→    totalPages,
   215→    queryClient,
   216→    config,
   217→  ]);
   218→
   219→  // Note: We don't clear queue on unmount because other components may be using it
   220→  // The service handles cleanup on project change
   221→}

1→/**
     2→ * useServerForm - Generic "form over server state" pattern.
     3→ *
     4→ * This is NOT a settings hook. It provides local editing state on top of any
     5→ * server data source (React Query, custom fetch, etc.). Use it for editing
     6→ * arbitrary server records, not for tool/UI settings persistence.
     7→ *
     8→ * For persisting tool settings, use `useAutoSaveSettings` instead.
     9→ *
    10→ * Features:
    11→ * - Local state management with dirty tracking
    12→ * - Optional auto-save with configurable debounce
    13→ * - Unmount flush (best-effort save of unsaved changes)
    14→ * - Context switching (reset on key change)
    15→ *
    16→ * @see docs/structure_detail/settings_system.md for the settings hook decision tree
    17→ *
    18→ * @example
    19→ * ```tsx
    20→ * const form = useServerForm({
    21→ *   serverData: queryData,
    22→ *   isLoading,
    23→ *   toLocal: (server) => transformToFormState(server),
    24→ *   save: async (local) => saveMutation(local),
    25→ *   autoSaveMs: 500,
    26→ *   contextKey: itemId, // Reset when switching items
    27→ * });
    28→ *
    29→ * return (
    30→ *   <input
    31→ *     value={form.data.name}
    32→ *     onChange={(e) => form.update({ name: e.target.value })}
    33→ *   />
    34→ * );
    35→ * ```
    36→ */
    37→
    38→import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
    39→
    40→interface UseServerFormOptions<TServer, TLocal> {
    41→  /** Server data (from React Query or other source) */
    42→  serverData: TServer | undefined;
    43→  /** Whether server data is still loading */
    44→  isLoading: boolean;
    45→  /** Transform server data to local form state */
    46→  toLocal: (server: TServer) => TLocal;
    47→  /** Save local state back to server. Returns true on success. */
    48→  save: (local: TLocal) => Promise<boolean>;
    49→  /** Auto-save debounce delay (ms). 0 = no auto-save. Default: 0 */
    50→  autoSaveMs?: number;
    51→  /** Key that triggers reset when changed (e.g., item ID). */
    52→  contextKey?: string | null;
    53→  /** Validate/transform updates before applying */
    54→  validate?: (updates: Partial<TLocal>, current: TLocal) => Partial<TLocal>;
    55→  /** Called when dirty state changes */
    56→  onDirtyChange?: (isDirty: boolean) => void;
    57→}
    58→
    59→interface UseServerFormReturn<TLocal> {
    60→  /** Current form data (local edits if any, otherwise transformed server data) */
    61→  data: TLocal;
    62→  /** Update local state with partial values */
    63→  update: (updates: Partial<TLocal>) => void;
    64→  /** Save current local state to server */
    65→  save: () => Promise<boolean>;
    66→  /** Save specific data to server (bypasses local state) */
    67→  saveData: (data: TLocal) => Promise<boolean>;
    68→  /** Reset to server data (discard local edits) */
    69→  reset: () => void;
    70→  /** Whether there are unsaved local edits */
    71→  isDirty: boolean;
    72→  /** Whether server data is loading */
    73→  isLoading: boolean;
    74→  /** Whether local state exists (user has edited) */
    75→  hasLocalEdits: boolean;
    76→  /** The raw local state (null if no edits) */
    77→  localData: TLocal | null;
    78→}
    79→
    80→export function useServerForm<TServer, TLocal extends Record<string, unknown>>({
    81→  serverData,
    82→  isLoading,
    83→  toLocal,
    84→  save: saveFn,
    85→  autoSaveMs = 0,
    86→  contextKey,
    87→  validate,
    88→  onDirtyChange,
    89→}: UseServerFormOptions<TServer, TLocal>): UseServerFormReturn<TLocal> {
    90→  // Local state for user edits (null = no edits, use server data)
    91→  const [localData, setLocalData] = useState<TLocal | null>(null);
    92→  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);
    93→
    94→  // Refs for auto-save and unmount handling
    95→  const saveTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
    96→  const isDirtyRef = useRef(false);
    97→  const hasUserEdited = useRef(false);
    98→  const saveFnRef = useRef(saveFn);
    99→  const localDataRef = useRef<TLocal | null>(null);
   100→  const prevContextKeyRef = useRef(contextKey);
   101→
   102→  // Keep refs in sync with state
   103→  useEffect(() => {
   104→    isDirtyRef.current = isDirty;
   105→    localDataRef.current = localData;
   106→    saveFnRef.current = saveFn;
   107→  }, [isDirty, localData, saveFn]);
   108→
   109→  // Notify parent of dirty state changes
   110→  useEffect(() => {
   111→    onDirtyChange?.(isDirty);
   112→  }, [isDirty, onDirtyChange]);
   113→
   114→  // Reset on context change (e.g., switching to different item)
   115→  useEffect(() => {
   116→    if (contextKey !== prevContextKeyRef.current) {
   117→      // Clear any pending auto-save
   118→      if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
   119→        clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
   120→        saveTimeoutRef.current = null;
   121→      }
   122→      // Reset local state
   123→      setLocalData(null);
   124→      setIsDirty(false);
   125→      hasUserEdited.current = false;
   126→      prevContextKeyRef.current = contextKey;
   127→    }
   128→  }, [contextKey]);
   129→
   130→  // Transform server data to local format (memoized)
   131→  const transformedServer = useMemo(() => {
   132→    if (serverData === undefined) return null;
   133→    return toLocal(serverData);
   134→  }, [serverData, toLocal]);
   135→
   136→  // Current data = local edits or transformed server data
   137→  const data = localData ?? transformedServer ?? ({} as TLocal);
   138→
   139→  // Update local state
   140→  const update = useCallback(
   141→    (updates: Partial<TLocal>) => {
   142→      setLocalData((prev) => {
   143→        const current = prev ?? transformedServer ?? ({} as TLocal);
   144→        const validated = validate ? validate(updates, current) : updates;
   145→        return { ...current, ...validated };
   146→      });
   147→      setIsDirty(true);
   148→      hasUserEdited.current = true;
   149→    },
   150→    [transformedServer, validate]
   151→  );
   152→
   153→  // Save to server
   154→  const save = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
   155→    const dataToSave = localDataRef.current;
   156→    if (!dataToSave) return true; // Nothing to save
   157→
   158→    const result = await saveFnRef.current(dataToSave);
   159→    if (result) {
   160→      setIsDirty(false);
   161→    }
   162→    return result;
   163→  }, []);
   164→
   165→  // Save specific data (bypasses local state - useful for reset operations)
   166→  const saveData = useCallback(async (dataToSave: TLocal): Promise<boolean> => {
   167→    const result = await saveFnRef.current(dataToSave);
   168→    return result;
   169→  }, []);
   170→
   171→  // Reset to server data
   172→  const reset = useCallback(() => {
   173→    if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
   174→      clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
   175→      saveTimeoutRef.current = null;
   176→    }
   177→    setLocalData(null);
   178→    setIsDirty(false);
   179→    hasUserEdited.current = false;
   180→  }, []);
   181→
   182→  // Auto-save on changes (debounced)
   183→  useEffect(() => {
   184→    if (!autoSaveMs || !hasUserEdited.current || !isDirty || !localData) {
   185→      return;
   186→    }
   187→
   188→    if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
   189→      clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
   190→    }
   191→
   192→    saveTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
   193→      await save();
   194→    }, autoSaveMs);
   195→
   196→    return () => {
   197→      if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
   198→        clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
   199→      }
   200→    };
   201→  }, [localData, isDirty, autoSaveMs, save]);
   202→
   203→  // Flush on unmount
   204→  useEffect(() => {
   205→    return () => {
   206→      if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
   207→        clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
   208→        saveTimeoutRef.current = null;
   209→      }
   210→      // Save if there are unsaved changes
   211→      if (isDirtyRef.current && hasUserEdited.current && localDataRef.current) {
   212→        saveFnRef.current(localDataRef.current);
   213→      }
   214→    };
   215→  }, []); // Only run on mount/unmount
   216→
   217→  return {
   218→    data,
   219→    update,
   220→    save,
   221→    saveData,
   222→    reset,
   223→    isDirty,
   224→    isLoading,
   225→    hasLocalEdits: localData !== null,
   226→    localData,
   227→  };
   228→}
   229→

    28→    | 'uploading-samples'

    35→

    44→  error?: string;
    45→}
    46→
    47→/**
    48→ * Hook to handle uploading LoRA files to HuggingFace via our Edge Function
    49→ */
    50→export function useHuggingFaceUpload() {
    51→  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState<UploadProgress>({
    52→    stage: 'idle',
    53→    message: '',
    54→  });
    55→
    56→  /**
    57→   * Upload a file to the temporary storage bucket
    58→   */
    59→  const uploadToTempStorage = async (file: File, userId: string): Promise<string> => {
    60→    const fileName = `${uuidv4()}-${file.name}`;
    61→    const filePath = `${userId}/${fileName}`;
    62→
    63→    const { error } = await supabase.storage
    64→      .from('temporary')
    65→      .upload(filePath, file, {
    66→        cacheControl: '3600',
    67→        upsert: false,
    68→      });
    69→
    70→    if (error) {
    71→      throw new Error(`Failed to upload file: ${error.message}`);
    72→    }
    73→
    74→    return filePath;
    75→  };
    76→
    77→  /**
    78→   * Upload LoRA file(s) and optionally sample videos to HuggingFace
    79→   * Supports both single-stage (one file) and multi-stage (high_noise + low_noise) LoRAs
    80→   */
    81→  const uploadToHuggingFace = async (
    82→    loraFiles: LoraFiles,
    83→    loraDetails: LoraDetails,
    84→    sampleVideos: File[] = [],
    85→    options: {
    86→      isPrivate?: boolean;
    87→      repoName?: string;
    88→    } = {}
    89→  ): Promise<UploadResult> => {
    90→    try {
    91→      // Get current user
    92→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    93→      if (!user) {
    94→        return { success: false, error: 'Not authenticated' };
    95→      }
    96→
    97→      // Determine if this is a multi-stage upload
    98→      const isMultiStage = !!(loraFiles.highNoise || loraFiles.lowNoise);
    99→      const storagePaths: { single?: string; highNoise?: string; lowNoise?: string } = {};
   100→
   101→      // 1. Upload LoRA file(s) to temporary storage
   102→      if (isMultiStage) {
   103→        // Multi-stage: upload high noise and/or low noise files
   104→        if (loraFiles.highNoise) {
   105→          setUploadProgress({
   106→            stage: 'uploading-high-noise',
   107→            message: 'Uploading high noise LoRA file...',
   108→            progress: 10,
   109→          });
   110→          storagePaths.highNoise = await uploadToTempStorage(loraFiles.highNoise, user.id);
   111→        }
   112→
   113→        if (loraFiles.lowNoise) {
   114→          setUploadProgress({
   115→            stage: 'uploading-low-noise',
   116→            message: 'Uploading low noise LoRA file...',
   117→            progress: loraFiles.highNoise ? 20 : 10,
   118→          });
   119→          storagePaths.lowNoise = await uploadToTempStorage(loraFiles.lowNoise, user.id);
   120→        }
   121→      } else if (loraFiles.single) {
   122→        // Single-stage: upload single file
   123→        setUploadProgress({
   124→          stage: 'uploading-lora',
   125→          message: 'Uploading LoRA file...',
   126→          progress: 10,
   127→        });
   128→        storagePaths.single = await uploadToTempStorage(loraFiles.single, user.id);
   129→      } else {
   130→        return { success: false, error: 'No LoRA file provided' };
   131→      }
   132→
   133→      // 2. Upload sample videos to temporary storage
   134→      const sampleVideoMeta: { storagePath: string; originalFileName: string }[] = [];
   135→
   136→      if (sampleVideos.length > 0) {
   137→        setUploadProgress({
   138→          stage: 'uploading-samples',
   139→          message: `Uploading sample videos (0/${sampleVideos.length})...`,
   140→          progress: 30,
   141→        });
   142→
   143→        for (let i = 0; i < sampleVideos.length; i++) {
   144→          const video = sampleVideos[i];
   145→          setUploadProgress({
   146→            stage: 'uploading-samples',
   147→            message: `Uploading sample videos (${i + 1}/${sampleVideos.length})...`,
   148→            progress: 30 + (i / sampleVideos.length) * 20,
   149→          });
   150→
   151→          const videoPath = await uploadToTempStorage(video, user.id);
   152→          sampleVideoMeta.push({
   153→            storagePath: videoPath,
   154→            originalFileName: video.name,
   155→          });
   156→        }
   157→      }
   158→
   159→      // 3. Call Edge Function to upload to HuggingFace
   160→      setUploadProgress({
   161→        stage: 'processing',
   162→        message: 'Uploading to HuggingFace...',
   163→        progress: 60,
   164→      });
   165→
   166→      const formData = new FormData();
   167→      // Use new multi-file format
   168→      formData.append('loraStoragePaths', JSON.stringify(storagePaths));
   169→      formData.append('loraDetails', JSON.stringify(loraDetails));
   170→      formData.append('sampleVideos', JSON.stringify(sampleVideoMeta));
   171→      if (options.isPrivate !== undefined) {
   172→        formData.append('isPrivate', String(options.isPrivate));
   173→      }
   174→      if (options.repoName) {
   175→        formData.append('repoName', options.repoName);
   176→      }
   177→
   178→      const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('huggingface-upload', {
   179→        body: formData,
   180→      });
   181→
   182→      if (error) {
   183→        throw new Error(error.message || 'Edge function error');
   184→      }
   185→
   186→      if (!data.success) {
   187→        throw new Error(data.error || 'Upload failed');
   188→      }
   189→
   190→      setUploadProgress({
   191→        stage: 'complete',
   192→        message: 'Upload complete!',
   193→        progress: 100,
   194→      });
   195→
   196→      return {
   197→        success: true,
   198→        repoId: data.repoId,
   199→        repoUrl: data.repoUrl,
   200→        loraUrl: data.loraUrl,
   201→        highNoiseUrl: data.highNoiseUrl,
   202→        lowNoiseUrl: data.lowNoiseUrl,
   203→        videoUrls: data.videoUrls,
   204→      };
   205→
   206→    } catch (err) {
   207→      const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error';
   208→      setUploadProgress({
   209→        stage: 'error',
   210→        message: errorMessage,
   211→      });
   212→      return { success: false, error: errorMessage };
   213→    }
   214→  };
   215→

   217→    setUploadProgress({ stage: 'idle', message: '' });
   218→  };
   219→
   220→  return {

   227→      'uploading-low-noise',
   228→      'uploading-samples',
   229→      'processing'
   230→    ].includes(uploadProgress.stage),
   231→  };
   232→}

    12→/**
    13→ * Project-wide generation modes cache
    14→ * Fetches all shot generation modes for a project in a single query
    15→ */
    16→class ProjectGenerationModesCache {
    17→  private cache = new Map<string, Map<string, GenerationModeNormalized>>(); // projectId -> shotId -> generationMode
    18→  
    19→  getProjectModes(projectId: string): Map<string, GenerationModeNormalized> | null {
    20→    return this.cache.get(projectId) || null;
    21→  }
    22→  
    23→  getShotMode(projectId: string, shotId: string): GenerationModeNormalized | null {
    24→    const projectModes = this.cache.get(projectId);
    25→    if (!projectModes) return null;
    26→    const value = projectModes.get(shotId);
    27→    return value !== undefined ? value : null;
    28→  }

    53→// Global cache instance that persists across component remounts
    54→const globalProjectGenerationModesCache = new ProjectGenerationModesCache();
    55→
    56→/**
    57→ * Fetch all shot generation modes for a project
    58→ */
    59→async function fetchProjectGenerationModesFromDB(projectId: string): Promise<Map<string, GenerationModeNormalized>> {
    60→  
    61→  // IMPORTANT:
    62→  // This cache must match the effective settings resolution used by `useToolSettings`:
    63→  // defaults → user → project → shot.
    64→  //
    65→  // If we only look at shots.settings, we will be wrong for shots that inherit
    66→  // generationMode from user/project defaults.
    67→  const { data: sessionData } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    68→  const userId = sessionData?.session?.user?.id ?? null;
    69→
    70→  // Skip queries if user is not authenticated (e.g., on public share pages)
    71→  // RLS will block these queries anyway, causing 406 errors
    72→  if (!userId) {
    73→    return new Map<string, GenerationModeNormalized>();
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const [userResult, projectResult, shotsResult] = await Promise.all([
    77→    supabase.from('users').select('settings').eq('id', userId).maybeSingle(),
    78→    supabase.from('projects').select('settings').eq('id', projectId).maybeSingle(),
    79→    supabase.from('shots').select('id, settings').eq('project_id', projectId),
    80→  ]);
    81→
    82→  if (shotsResult.error) {
    83→    console.error('[ProjectGenerationModesCache] Error fetching shot settings:', shotsResult.error);
    84→    throw shotsResult.error;
    85→  }
    86→
    87→  const toolId = TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES;
    88→  const userToolSettings = extractToolSettings(userResult.data?.settings, toolId);
    89→  const projectToolSettings = extractToolSettings(projectResult.data?.settings, toolId);
    90→
    91→  const modes = new Map<string, GenerationModeNormalized>();
    92→  (shotsResult.data || []).forEach((shot) => {
    93→    const shotToolSettings = extractToolSettings(shot.settings, toolId);
    94→
    95→    // Use shared resolution logic (priority: shot → project → user → defaults)
    96→    // defaults to 'timeline' via normalizeGenerationMode
    97→    const effectiveMode = resolveGenerationMode({
    98→      shot: shotToolSettings,
    99→      project: projectToolSettings,
   100→      user: userToolSettings,
   101→      // defaults not needed - normalizeGenerationMode handles undefined → 'timeline'
   102→    });
   103→    modes.set(shot.id, effectiveMode);
   104→  });
   105→  
   106→  return modes;
   107→}

   109→/**
   110→ * Hook to fetch and cache all shot generation modes for a project
   111→ * Provides instant access to any shot's generation mode within the project
   112→ *
   113→ * @param projectId - The project ID to fetch modes for
   114→ * @param options.enabled - Additional condition to enable the query (default: true)
   115→ */
   116→export function useProjectGenerationModesCache(projectId: string | null, options?: { enabled?: boolean }) {
   117→  const { enabled = true } = options ?? {};
   118→  const cacheRef = useRef(globalProjectGenerationModesCache);
   119→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   120→  
   121→  // 🎯 SMART POLLING: Use DataFreshnessManager for intelligent polling decisions
   122→  const smartPollingConfig = useSmartPollingConfig(['project-generation-modes', projectId]);
   123→  
   124→  // Query to fetch all shot generation modes for the project
   125→  const { data: projectModes, isLoading, error, refetch } = useQuery<Map<string, GenerationModeNormalized>>({
   126→    queryKey: ['project-generation-modes', projectId],
   127→    queryFn: () => fetchProjectGenerationModesFromDB(projectId!),
   128→    enabled: !!projectId && enabled,
   129→    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
   130→    placeholderData: (previousData) => previousData, // Keep showing previous data while refetching
   131→    // 🎯 SMART POLLING: Intelligent polling based on realtime health
   132→    ...smartPollingConfig,
   133→    refetchIntervalInBackground: true, // Enable background polling
   134→  });
   135→  
   136→  // Update cache when data changes
   137→  React.useEffect(() => {
   138→    if (projectModes && projectId) {
   139→      cacheRef.current.setProjectModes(projectId, projectModes);
   140→    }
   141→  }, [projectModes, projectId]);
   142→  
   143→  const getShotGenerationMode = useCallback((shotId: string | null, isMobile: boolean = false): GenerationModeNormalized | null => {
   144→    // Mobile always uses batch mode
   145→    if (isMobile) {
   146→      return 'batch';
   147→    }
   148→    
   149→    if (!projectId || !shotId) return null;
   150→    
   151→    // First try cache
   152→    const cachedMode = cacheRef.current.getShotMode(projectId, shotId);
   153→    if (cachedMode !== null) {
   154→      return cachedMode;
   155→    }
   156→    
   157→    // Then try current query data
   158→    if (projectModes) {
   159→      const value = projectModes.get(shotId);
   160→      return value !== undefined ? value : null;
   161→    }
   162→    
   163→    return null;
   164→  }, [projectId, projectModes]);
   165→  
   166→  const getAllShotModes = useCallback((): Map<string, GenerationModeNormalized> | null => {
   167→    if (!projectId) return null;
   168→    
   169→    // First try cache
   170→    const cachedModes = cacheRef.current.getProjectModes(projectId);
   171→    if (cachedModes) {
   172→      return cachedModes;
   173→    }
   174→    
   175→    // Then try current query data
   176→    return projectModes || null;
   177→  }, [projectId, projectModes]);
   178→  
   179→  const clearCache = useCallback((): void => {
   180→    cacheRef.current.clear();
   181→  }, []);
   182→  
   183→  const deleteProjectCache = useCallback((projectId: string | null): void => {
   184→    if (!projectId) return;
   185→    cacheRef.current.deleteProject(projectId);
   186→  }, []);
   187→  
   188→  // Debug function to log cache state
   189→  const logCacheState = useCallback((): void => {
   190→  }, [projectId, getAllShotModes]);
   191→  
   192→  // Optimistically update a single shot's mode in cache
   193→  const updateShotMode = useCallback((shotId: string | null, mode: GenerationModeNormalized) => {
   194→    if (!projectId || !shotId) return;
   195→    
   196→    // Update in-memory cache immediately
   197→    const currentModes = cacheRef.current.getProjectModes(projectId);
   198→    if (currentModes) {
   199→      currentModes.set(shotId, mode);
   200→      cacheRef.current.setProjectModes(projectId, currentModes);
   201→    }
   202→    
   203→    // CRITICAL: Also update React Query cache so it persists across re-renders
   204→    // The previous code created updatedModes but never saved it!
   205→    queryClient.setQueryData<Map<string, GenerationModeNormalized>>(
   206→      ['project-generation-modes', projectId],
   207→      (oldData) => {
   208→        if (!oldData) return oldData;
   209→        const newData = new Map(oldData);
   210→        newData.set(shotId, mode);
   211→        return newData;
   212→      }
   213→    );
   214→  }, [projectId, queryClient]);
   215→  
   216→  // Invalidate cache when mode changes (for manual refresh if needed)
   217→  const invalidateOnModeChange = useCallback(() => {
   218→    if (projectId) {
   219→      cacheRef.current.deleteProject(projectId);
   220→      refetch();
   221→    }
   222→  }, [projectId, refetch]);
   223→
   224→  return {
   225→    getShotGenerationMode,
   226→    getAllShotModes,
   227→    updateShotMode,
   228→    isLoading,
   229→    error,
   230→    refetch,
   231→    clearCache,
   232→    deleteProjectCache,
   233→    invalidateOnModeChange,
   234→    logCacheState
   235→  };
   236→}

1→import { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
     2→import { supabase } from "@/integrations/supabase/client";
     3→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
     4→import { getErrorMessage, isError } from '@/shared/lib/errorUtils';
     5→
     6→type VoiceRecordingState = "idle" | "recording" | "processing";
     7→
     8→interface UseVoiceRecordingOptions {
     9→  onResult?: (result: { transcription: string; prompt?: string }) => void;
    10→  onError?: (error: string) => void;
    11→  task?: "transcribe_only" | "transcribe_and_write";
    12→  context?: string;
    13→  example?: string;
    14→  existingValue?: string;
    15→}
    16→
    17→const MAX_RECORDING_SECONDS = 15;
    18→
    19→export function useVoiceRecording(options: UseVoiceRecordingOptions = {}) {
    20→  const { onResult, onError, task = "transcribe_and_write", context = "", example = "", existingValue = "" } = options;
    21→  
    22→  const [state, setState] = useState<VoiceRecordingState>("idle");
    23→  const [audioLevel, setAudioLevel] = useState<number>(0);
    24→  const [remainingSeconds, setRemainingSeconds] = useState<number>(MAX_RECORDING_SECONDS);
    25→  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
    26→  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);
    27→  const audioContextRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
    28→  const analyserRef = useRef<AnalyserNode | null>(null);
    29→  const animationFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
    30→  const countdownIntervalRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    31→  const autoStopTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    32→
    33→  // Cleanup audio analysis and timers on unmount or when recording stops
    34→  const cleanupAudioAnalysis = useCallback(() => {
    35→    if (animationFrameRef.current) {
    36→      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameRef.current);
    37→      animationFrameRef.current = null;
    38→    }
    39→    if (audioContextRef.current && audioContextRef.current.state !== 'closed') {
    40→      audioContextRef.current.close().catch(() => {});
    41→      audioContextRef.current = null;
    42→    }
    43→    if (countdownIntervalRef.current) {
    44→      clearInterval(countdownIntervalRef.current);
    45→      countdownIntervalRef.current = null;
    46→    }
    47→    if (autoStopTimeoutRef.current) {
    48→      clearTimeout(autoStopTimeoutRef.current);
    49→      autoStopTimeoutRef.current = null;
    50→    }
    51→    analyserRef.current = null;
    52→    setAudioLevel(0);
    53→    setRemainingSeconds(MAX_RECORDING_SECONDS);
    54→  }, []);
    55→
    56→  const startRecording = useCallback(async () => {
    57→    try {
    58→      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    59→      
    60→      // Set up audio analysis for visual feedback
    61→      try {
    62→        const audioContext = new AudioContext();
    63→        const analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
    64→        analyser.fftSize = 256;
    65→        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;
    66→        
    67→        const source = audioContext.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    68→        source.connect(analyser);
    69→        
    70→        audioContextRef.current = audioContext;
    71→        analyserRef.current = analyser;
    72→        
    73→        // Start monitoring audio levels

    75→        const updateLevel = () => {
    76→          if (analyserRef.current) {
    77→            analyserRef.current.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
    78→            // Calculate average level from frequency data
    79→            const sum = dataArray.reduce((accumulator, frequency) => accumulator + frequency, 0);
    80→            const avg = sum / dataArray.length;
    81→            // Normalize to 0-1 range with some amplification for better visual feedback
    82→            const normalized = Math.min(1, (avg / 128) * 1.5);
    83→            setAudioLevel(normalized);
    84→            animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(updateLevel);
    85→          }
    86→        };
    87→        updateLevel();
    88→      } catch (audioAnalysisError) {
    89→        // Continue without audio level monitoring
    90→      }
    91→      
    92→      // Determine the best supported MIME type
    93→      const mimeType = MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported("audio/webm;codecs=opus")
    94→        ? "audio/webm;codecs=opus"
    95→        : MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported("audio/webm")
    96→        ? "audio/webm"
    97→        : MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported("audio/mp4")
    98→        ? "audio/mp4"
    99→        : "audio/wav";
   100→

   102→      mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;

    10→/**
    11→ * Smart thumbnail preloader for video gallery performance optimization
    12→ *
    13→ * Preloads thumbnail images for:
    14→ * 1. First page of shots in ShotsPane (likely to be clicked)
    15→ * 2. When viewing a shot: ensures page 1 is preloaded, then preloads page 2
    16→ * 3. Newest shots (for quick browsing)
    17→ *
    18→ * Only preloads placeholder images, not videos. Uses network-aware strategies.
    19→ *
    20→ * Uses the shared PreloadingService for actual image loading and tracking.
    21→ * Keeps shot/page-specific tracking locally.
    22→ */
    23→export const useVideoGalleryPreloader = (options?: {
    24→  selectedShot?: Shot | null;
    25→  shouldShowShotEditor?: boolean;
    26→}) => {
    27→  const { selectedShot, shouldShowShotEditor } = options || {};
    28→
    29→  // Track previous project ID to detect actual project switches

    31→

    33→  const SHOTS_PANE_PAGE_SIZE = 5; // Match ShotsPane's pageSize
    34→
    35→  // Reduce target cache size on mobile to prevent performance issues
    36→  const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth <= 768;
    37→  const TARGET_CACHED_IMAGES = isMobile ? 12 : 48; // 2 shots × 6 images on mobile, 8 shots × 6 images on desktop
    38→
    39→  // Get project and shots data from contexts
    40→  const { selectedProjectId } = useProject();

    45→  const preloadedPagesByShot = useRef<Record<string, Set<number>>>({});
    46→  const hasStartedPreloadForProject = useRef<Record<string, boolean>>({});
    47→  const preloadedUrlCount = useRef<Record<string, number>>({});
    48→
    49→  // Get shots pane sort order settings to match ShotsPane behavior
    50→  const { settings: shotsPaneSettings } = useToolSettings<{
    51→    sortOrder?: 'oldest' | 'newest';
    52→  }>('shots-pane-ui-state', {
    53→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
    54→    enabled: !!selectedProjectId
    55→  });
    56→
    57→  const sortOrder = shotsPaneSettings?.sortOrder || 'newest';
    58→
    59→  // Network condition checks
    60→  const shouldSkipPreload = useMemo(() => {
    61→    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return false;
    62→
    63→    // Check for data saver mode
    64→    if ((navigator as { connection?: { saveData?: boolean } }).connection?.saveData) {
    65→      return true;
    66→    }
    67→
    68→    // Check for slow connection
    69→    const effectiveType = (navigator as { connection?: { effectiveType?: string } }).connection?.effectiveType;
    70→    if (effectiveType === '2g' || effectiveType === 'slow-2g') {

    74→    return false;

    77→  // Helper to build thumbnail URLs for a shot's video gallery page
    78→  const buildThumbnailUrlsForPage = useCallback(async (shotId: string, pageIndex: number): Promise<string[]> => {
    79→    if (!selectedProjectId) return [];

    82→    const endIndex = startIndex + GALLERY_PAGE_SIZE - 1;

    86→      const { data, error } = await supabase

    97→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    98→        .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true })
    99→        .range(startIndex, endIndex);
   100→
   101→      if (error) {
   102→        return [];
   103→      }
   104→
   105→      const urls = (data || [])
   106→        .filter(sg => sg.generation)

   122→
   123→  // Queue preload tasks for a shot's specific page
   124→  const queuePreloadForShotPage = useCallback(async (shotId: string, pageIndex: number) => {
   125→    if (shouldSkipPreload) return;
   126→    if (!selectedProjectId) return;
   127→

   130→    if (shotCache.has(pageIndex)) {

   133→

   150→    await preloadingService.preloadImages(images, PRIORITY.low);
   151→
   152→    // Update local URL count for debugging
   153→    preloadedUrlCount.current[selectedProjectId] =
   154→      (preloadedUrlCount.current[selectedProjectId] || 0) + newUrls.length;
   155→
   156→    // Notify listeners of cache update (for useThumbnailLoader)
   157→    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('videogallery-cache-updated', {
   158→      detail: {
   159→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
   160→        updatedUrls: newUrls
   161→      }
   162→    }));
   163→
   164→    // Mark page as preloaded
   165→    if (!preloadedPagesByShot.current[shotId]) {
   166→      preloadedPagesByShot.current[shotId] = new Set();
   167→    }
   168→    preloadedPagesByShot.current[shotId].add(pageIndex);
   169→
   170→  }, [shouldSkipPreload, selectedProjectId, buildThumbnailUrlsForPage]);
   171→
   172→  // Effect: Preload images until target cache size is reached
   173→  useEffect(() => {
   174→    if (!selectedProjectId || !shots || shouldSkipPreload) return;
   175→
   176→    // Reduce preloading when shot editor is open on mobile to prevent performance issues
   177→    if (shouldShowShotEditor && isMobile) {
   178→      return;
   179→    }
   180→
   181→    // Check if we've already started preloading for this project
   182→    if (hasStartedPreloadForProject.current[selectedProjectId]) {
   183→      return;
   184→    }
   185→
   186→    // Check current cache size (approximate)
   187→    const currentCacheSize = preloadedUrlCount.current[selectedProjectId] || 0;
   188→
   189→    if (currentCacheSize >= TARGET_CACHED_IMAGES) {
   190→      hasStartedPreloadForProject.current[selectedProjectId] = true;
   191→      return;
   192→    }
   193→
   194→    // Mark that we've started preloading for this project
   195→    hasStartedPreloadForProject.current[selectedProjectId] = true;
   196→
   197→    // Sort shots by priority: ShotsPane order first, then newest
   198→    const sortedShots = [...shots].sort((a, b) => {
   199→      const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime();
   200→      const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime();
   201→
   202→      if (sortOrder === 'oldest') {
   203→        return dateA - dateB;
   204→      } else {
   205→        return dateB - dateA;
   206→      }
   207→    });
   208→
   209→    // Create priority-ordered shot list
   210→    const shotsPaneFirstPage = sortedShots.slice(0, SHOTS_PANE_PAGE_SIZE);
   211→    const remainingShots = sortedShots.slice(SHOTS_PANE_PAGE_SIZE);
   212→
   213→    // Prioritize: ShotsPane first page, then newest shots
   214→    const priorityOrderedShots = [
   215→      ...shotsPaneFirstPage,
   216→      ...remainingShots.sort((a, b) => {
   217→        const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime();
   218→        const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime();
   219→        return dateB - dateA; // Always newest first for remaining shots
   220→      })
   221→    ];
   222→
   223→    // Queue preload for shots until we estimate reaching target
   224→    let estimatedCacheSize = currentCacheSize;
   225→    for (const shot of priorityOrderedShots) {
   226→      if (estimatedCacheSize >= TARGET_CACHED_IMAGES) break;
   227→
   228→      // Estimate how many images this shot will add (page 1 only for now)
   229→      const estimatedImagesInShot = Math.min(GALLERY_PAGE_SIZE, getShotVideoCount?.(shot.id) || GALLERY_PAGE_SIZE);
   230→
   231→      // Only queue if this shot's page 1 hasn't been preloaded yet
   232→      const shotCache = preloadedPagesByShot.current[shot.id] || new Set();
   233→      if (!shotCache.has(0)) {
   234→        queuePreloadForShotPage(shot.id, 0);
   235→        estimatedCacheSize += estimatedImagesInShot;
   236→      }
   237→    }
   238→
   239→  }, [selectedProjectId, shots]); // Simplified dependencies to prevent re-runs
   240→
   241→  // Effect: When viewing a shot, ensure page 1 is preloaded and preload page 2
   242→  useEffect(() => {
   243→    if (!shouldShowShotEditor || !selectedShot || shouldSkipPreload) return;
   244→
   245→    // Ensure page 1 is preloaded
   246→    queuePreloadForShotPage(selectedShot.id, 0);
   247→
   248→    // Preload page 2 if shot has enough videos
   249→    if (getShotVideoCount) {
   250→      const videoCount = getShotVideoCount(selectedShot.id);
   251→      if (videoCount && videoCount > GALLERY_PAGE_SIZE) {
   252→        queuePreloadForShotPage(selectedShot.id, 1); // Page 2 = index 1
   253→      }
   254→    }
   255→  }, [shouldShowShotEditor, selectedShot, shouldSkipPreload, queuePreloadForShotPage, getShotVideoCount]);
   256→
   257→  // Cleanup on project change - Clear local tracking
   258→  useEffect(() => {
   259→    const prevProjectId = prevProjectIdRef.current;
   260→
   261→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
   262→      prevProjectIdRef.current = null;
   263→    } else if (prevProjectId && prevProjectId !== selectedProjectId) {
   264→      // Clear local tracking for the old project
   265→
   266→      delete hasStartedPreloadForProject.current[prevProjectId];
   267→      delete preloadedUrlCount.current[prevProjectId];
   268→
   269→      // Clear shot-specific tracking
   270→      preloadedPagesByShot.current = {};
   271→
   272→      prevProjectIdRef.current = selectedProjectId;
   273→    } else if (!prevProjectId && selectedProjectId) {
   274→      // First time setting a project ID
   275→      prevProjectIdRef.current = selectedProjectId;
   276→    }
   277→  }, [selectedProjectId]);
   278→
   279→  return {
   280→    // Expose some state for debugging if needed
   281→    preloadedProjectUrls: preloadedUrlCount.current[selectedProjectId || ''] || 0,
   282→    targetCacheSize: TARGET_CACHED_IMAGES,
   283→    cacheUtilization: selectedProjectId
   284→      ? Math.round(((preloadedUrlCount.current[selectedProjectId] || 0) / TARGET_CACHED_IMAGES) * 100)
   285→      : 0,
   286→  };
   287→};
   288→

    75→export type ResourceType = 'lora' | 'phase-config' | 'style-reference' | 'structure-video';
    76→export type ResourceMetadata = LoraModel | PhaseConfigMetadata | StyleReferenceMetadata | StructureVideoMetadata;
    77→
    78→export interface Resource {
    79→    id: string;
    80→    userId: string;
    81→    type: ResourceType;
    82→    metadata: ResourceMetadata;
    83→    isPublic: boolean;
    84→    createdAt: string;
