    86→
    87→// List public resources (available to all users)
    88→export const useListPublicResources = (type: ResourceType) => {
    89→    return useQuery<Resource[], Error>({
    90→        queryKey: [...queryKeys.resources.public(type), 'v2'],
    91→        queryFn: async () => {
    92→            
    93→            // Manual pagination to bypass 1000 limit
    94→            let allData: Resource[] = [];
    95→            let page = 0;
    96→            const pageSize = 1000;
    97→            let hasMore = true;
    98→
    99→            while (hasMore) {
   100→                const { data, error } = await supabase
   101→                    .from('resources')
   102→                    .select('*')
   103→                    .eq('type', type)
   104→                    .eq('is_public', true)
   105→                    .range(page * pageSize, (page + 1) * pageSize - 1);
   106→                
   107→                if (error) {
   108→                    handleError(error, { context: 'useListPublicResources', showToast: false, logData: { type } });
   109→                    throw error;
   110→                }
   111→                
   112→                if (data) {
   113→                    allData = [...allData, ...data];
   114→                    if (data.length < pageSize) {
   115→                        hasMore = false;
   116→                    } else {
   117→                        page++;
   118→                    }
   119→                } else {
   120→                    hasMore = false;
   121→                }
   122→                
   123→                // Safety limit to prevent infinite loops
   124→                if (allData.length >= 20000) {
   125→                    hasMore = false;
   126→                }
   127→            }
   128→            
   129→            return allData;
   130→        },
   131→        // Use static preset - public resources change infrequently
   132→        ...QUERY_PRESETS.static,
   133→        staleTime: 15 * 60 * 1000, // Override: 15 minutes (public resources are very stable)
   134→        gcTime: 30 * 60 * 1000, // Keep in cache longer
   135→    });
   136→};
   137→
   138→// List resources
   139→export const useListResources = (type: ResourceType) => {
   140→    return useQuery<Resource[], Error>({
   141→        // Note: Using ['resources', type] pattern for user resources (no projectId needed)
   142→        queryKey: [...queryKeys.resources.all, type, 'v2'],
   143→        queryFn: async () => {
   144→            const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   145→            if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   146→            
   147→            // Manual pagination to bypass 1000 limit
   148→            let allData: Resource[] = [];
   149→            let page = 0;
   150→            const pageSize = 1000;
   151→            let hasMore = true;
   152→
   153→            while (hasMore) {
   154→                const { data, error } = await supabase
   155→                    .from('resources')
   156→                    .select('*')
   157→                    .eq('user_id', user.id)
   158→                    .eq('type', type)
   159→                    .range(page * pageSize, (page + 1) * pageSize - 1);
   160→                
   161→                if (error) throw error;
   162→
   163→                if (data) {
   164→                    allData = [...allData, ...data];
   165→                    if (data.length < pageSize) {
   166→                        hasMore = false;
   167→                    } else {
   168→                        page++;
   169→                    }
   170→                } else {
   171→                    hasMore = false;
   172→                }
   173→                
   174→                 // Safety limit
   175→                 if (allData.length >= 20000) break;
   176→            }
   177→
   178→            return allData;
   179→        },
   180→        // Use static preset - user resources change only via mutations (which invalidate)
   181→        ...QUERY_PRESETS.static,
   182→    });
   183→};
   184→
   185→// Create a new resource
   186→export interface CreateResourceArgs {
   187→    type: ResourceType;
   188→    metadata: ResourceMetadata;
   189→}
   190→
   191→export const useCreateResource = () => {
   192→    const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   193→    return useMutation<Resource, Error, CreateResourceArgs>({
   194→        mutationFn: async ({ type, metadata }) => {
   195→            const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   196→            if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   197→            
   198→            // Extract is_public from metadata for the column
   199→            const isPublic = 'is_public' in metadata ? Boolean((metadata as Record<string, unknown>).is_public) : false;
   200→            
   201→            const { data, error } = await supabase
   202→                .from('resources')
   203→                .insert({
   204→                    type,
   205→                    metadata,
   206→                    user_id: user.id,
   207→                    is_public: isPublic
   208→                })
   209→                .select()
   210→                .single();
   211→            
   212→            if (error) throw error;
   213→            return data;
   214→        },
   215→        onSuccess: (data) => {
   216→            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [...queryKeys.resources.all, data.type] });
   217→            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.type) });
   218→        },
   219→        onError: (error) => {
   220→            handleError(error, { context: 'useCreateResource', toastTitle: 'Failed to create resource' });
   221→        },
   222→    });
   223→};
   224→
   225→// Update a resource
   226→export interface UpdateResourceArgs {
   227→    id: string;
   228→    type: ResourceType;
   229→    metadata: ResourceMetadata;
   230→}
   231→
   232→export const useUpdateResource = () => {
   233→    const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   234→    return useMutation<Resource, Error, UpdateResourceArgs>({
   235→        mutationFn: async ({ id, metadata }) => {
   236→
   237→            const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   238→            if (!user) {
   239→                const err = new Error('Not authenticated');
   240→                handleError(err, { context: 'useUpdateResource', showToast: false });
   241→                throw err;
   242→            }
   243→
   244→            // First, let's check if the resource exists at all (without user_id filter)
   245→            const { data: resourceCheck } = await supabase
   246→                .from('resources')
   247→                .select('id, user_id, type')
   248→                .eq('id', id)
   249→                .maybeSingle();
   250→            
   251→            // Now verify the resource exists and belongs to the user
   252→            const { data: existingResource, error: checkError } = await supabase
   253→                .from('resources')
   254→                .select('id, user_id, type')
   255→                .eq('id', id)
   256→                .eq('user_id', user.id)
   257→                .maybeSingle();
   258→            
   259→            if (checkError) {
   260→                handleError(checkError, { context: 'useUpdateResource', showToast: false });
   261→                throw new Error(`Failed to verify resource: ${checkError.message}`);
   262→            }
   263→            
   264→            if (!existingResource) {
   265→                handleError(new Error('Resource not found or access denied'), { context: 'useUpdateResource', showToast: false, logData: {
   266→                    id,
   267→                    userId: user.id,
   268→                    resourceExists: !!resourceCheck,
   269→                    resourceOwner: resourceCheck?.user_id
   270→                }});
   271→
   272→                // Provide a more specific error message
   273→                if (resourceCheck && resourceCheck.user_id !== user.id) {
   274→                    throw new Error('This resource belongs to another user');
   275→                }
   276→                throw new Error('Resource not found or you do not have permission to update it');
   277→            }
   278→            
   279→            // Extract is_public from metadata for the column
   280→            const isPublic = 'is_public' in metadata ? Boolean((metadata as Record<string, unknown>).is_public) : false;
   281→            
   282→            // Now perform the update
   283→            const { data, error } = await supabase
   284→                .from('resources')
   285→                .update({ metadata, is_public: isPublic })
   286→                .eq('id', id)
   287→                .eq('user_id', user.id)
   288→                .select()
   289→                .maybeSingle();
   290→            
   291→            if (error) {
   292→                handleError(error, { context: 'useUpdateResource', showToast: false, logData: {
   293→                    code: error.code,
   294→                    details: error.details,
   295→                    hint: error.hint
   296→                }});
   297→                throw error;
   298→            }
   299→            
   300→            if (!data) {
   301→                handleError(new Error('Update succeeded but no data returned'), { context: 'useUpdateResource', showToast: false });
   302→                // If update succeeded but no data returned, fetch it separately
   303→                const { data: fetchedData, error: fetchError } = await supabase
   304→                    .from('resources')
   305→                    .select('*')
   306→                    .eq('id', id)
   307→                    .maybeSingle();
   308→                
   309→                if (fetchError || !fetchedData) {
   310→                    handleError(fetchError || new Error('No data returned'), { context: 'useUpdateResource', showToast: false });
   311→                    throw new Error('Update may have succeeded but failed to fetch updated resource');
   312→                }
   313→                
   314→                return fetchedData;
   315→            }
   316→            
   317→            return data;
   318→        },
   319→        onSuccess: (data) => {
   320→            // Invalidate both v2 query keys to ensure fresh data
   321→            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [...queryKeys.resources.all, data.type, 'v2'] });
   322→            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [...queryKeys.resources.public(data.type), 'v2'] });
   323→            // Also invalidate without v2 for backwards compatibility
   324→            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [...queryKeys.resources.all, data.type] });
   325→            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.type) });
   326→            // Invalidate specific-resources queries that include this resource ID
   327→            // Using predicate to find any query that contains this resource ID
   328→            queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   329→                predicate: (query) => {
   330→                    const key = query.queryKey;
   331→                    if (key[0] === 'specific-resources' && typeof key[1] === 'string') {
   332→                        return key[1].includes(data.id);
   333→                    }
   334→                    return false;
   335→                }
   336→            });
   337→        },
   338→        onError: (error) => {
   339→            handleError(error, { context: 'useUpdateResource', toastTitle: 'Failed to update resource' });
   340→        },
   341→    });
   342→};
   343→
   344→// Delete a resource
   345→export const useDeleteResource = () => {
   346→    const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   347→    return useMutation<void, Error, { id: string, type: ResourceType }>({
   348→        mutationFn: async ({ id }) => {
   349→            const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
   350→            if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
   351→
   352→            const { error } = await supabase
   353→                .from('resources')
   354→                .delete()
   355→                .eq('id', id)
   356→                .eq('user_id', user.id);
   357→
   358→            if (error) throw error;
   359→        },
   360→        onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
   361→            // Remove the individual resource cache entry
   362→            queryClient.removeQueries({ [REDACTED](variables.id) });
   363→            // Also invalidate the list queries
   364→            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [...queryKeys.resources.all, variables.type] });
   365→            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](variables.type) });
   366→        },
   367→        onError: (error) => {
   368→            handleError(error, { context: 'useDeleteResource', toastTitle: 'Failed to delete resource' });
   369→        },
   370→    });
   371→};

   236→            try {
   237→              if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) return file;
   238→
   239→              const result = await cropImageToProjectAspectRatio(file, targetAspectRatio as number);
   240→              if (result) {
   241→                return result.croppedFile;
   242→              }
   243→              return file;
   244→            } catch (e) {
   245→              console.warn(`Failed to crop image ${file.name}:`, e);
   246→              return file;
   247→            }
   248→          });
   249→
   250→          processedFiles = await Promise.all(cropPromises);
   251→        } catch (e) {
   252→          handleError(e, { context: 'useShotCreation:batchCrop', showToast: false });
   253→          processedFiles = imageFiles;
   254→        }
   255→      }
   256→
   257→      // --- PROCESS FILES ---
   258→
   259→      try {
   260→        // Create a new shot if needed
   261→        if (!shotId) {
   262→          const newShotName = `Shot ${currentShotCount + 1}`;
   263→          const result = await createShotMutation.mutateAsync({
   264→            name: newShotName,
   265→            projectId: projectIdForOperation,
   266→            shouldSelectAfterCreation: true,
   267→          });
   268→          if (result?.shot?.id) {
   269→            shotId = result.shot.id;
   270→          } else {
   271→            toast.error('Failed to create new shot.');
   272→            return null;
   273→          }
   274→        }
   275→
   276→        if (!shotId) {
   277→          toast.error('Cannot add images to an unknown shot.');
   278→          return null;
   279→        }
   280→
   281→        // Process each file
   282→        for (let fileIndex = 0; fileIndex < processedFiles.length; fileIndex++) {
   283→          const imageFile = processedFiles[fileIndex];
   284→          let newGeneration: Database['public']['Tables']['generations']['Row'] | null = null;
   285→
   286→          try {
   287→            // Generate thumbnail and upload
   288→            console.log(
   289→              `[ThumbnailGenDebug] Starting client-side thumbnail generation for ${imageFile.name}`
   290→            );
   291→            let imageUrl = '';
   292→            let thumbnailUrl = '';
   293→
   294→            try {
   295→              const {
   296→                data: { session },
   297→              } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
   298→              if (!session?.user?.id) {
   299→                throw new Error('User not authenticated');
   300→              }
   301→              const userId = session.user.id;
   302→
   303→              const thumbnailResult = await generateClientThumbnail(imageFile, 300, 0.8);
   304→
   305→              const uploadResult = await uploadImageWithThumbnail(
   306→                imageFile,
   307→                thumbnailResult.thumbnailBlob,
   308→                userId,
   309→                onProgress
   310→                  ? progress => {
   311→                      const overallProgress = Math.round(
   312→                        ((fileIndex + progress / 100) / processedFiles.length) * 100
   313→                      );
   314→                      onProgress(fileIndex, progress, overallProgress);
   315→                    }
   316→                  : undefined
   317→              );
   318→              imageUrl = uploadResult.imageUrl;
   319→              thumbnailUrl = uploadResult.thumbnailUrl;
   320→            } catch (thumbnailError) {
   321→              console.warn(
   322→                `[ThumbnailGenDebug] Client-side thumbnail generation failed for ${imageFile.name}:`,
   323→                thumbnailError
   324→              );
   325→              // Fallback to original upload
   326→              imageUrl = await uploadImageToStorage(
   327→                imageFile,
   328→                3,
   329→                onProgress
   330→                  ? progress => {
   331→                      const overallProgress = Math.round(
   332→                        ((fileIndex + progress / 100) / processedFiles.length) * 100
   333→                      );
   334→                      onProgress(fileIndex, progress, overallProgress);
   335→                    }
   336→                  : undefined
   337→              );
   338→              thumbnailUrl = imageUrl;
   339→            }
   340→
   341→            if (!imageUrl) {
   342→              toast.error(`Failed to upload image ${imageFile.name} to storage.`);
   343→              continue;
   344→            }
   345→
   346→            // Create generation record
   347→            try {
   348→              newGeneration = await createGenerationForUploadedImage(
   349→                imageUrl,
   350→                imageFile.name,
   351→                imageFile.type,
   352→                imageFile.size,
   353→                projectIdForOperation,
   354→                thumbnailUrl
   355→              );
   356→            } catch (generationError) {
   357→              toast.error(
   358→                `Failed to create generation data for ${imageFile.name}: ${(generationError as Error).message}`
   359→              );
   360→              continue;
   361→            }
   362→
   363→            if (!newGeneration?.id) {
   364→              toast.error(`Failed to create generation record for ${imageFile.name}.`);
   365→              continue;
   366→            }
   367→
   368→            // Add generation to shot
   369→            const explicitPosition =
   370→              positions && positions.length > fileIndex ? positions[fileIndex] : undefined;
   371→
   372→            if (explicitPosition !== undefined) {
   373→              await addImageToShotMutation.mutateAsync({
   374→                shot_id: shotId,
   375→                generation_id: newGeneration.id as string,
   376→                project_id: projectIdForOperation,
   377→                imageUrl: newGeneration.location || undefined,
   378→                thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl || newGeneration.location || undefined,
   379→                timelineFrame: explicitPosition,
   380→                skipOptimistic,
   381→              });
   382→            } else if (skipAutoPosition) {
   383→              await addImageToShotWithoutPositionMutation.mutateAsync({
   384→                shot_id: shotId,
   385→                generation_id: newGeneration.id as string,
   386→                project_id: projectIdForOperation,
   387→                imageUrl: newGeneration.location || undefined,
   388→                thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl || newGeneration.location || undefined,
   389→              });
   390→            } else {
   391→              await addImageToShotMutation.mutateAsync({
   392→                shot_id: shotId,
   393→                generation_id: newGeneration.id as string,
   394→                project_id: projectIdForOperation,
   395→                imageUrl: newGeneration.location || undefined,
   396→                thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl || newGeneration.location || undefined,
   397→                skipOptimistic,
   398→              });
   399→            }
   400→
   401→            generationIds.push(newGeneration.id as string);
   402→          } catch (fileError) {
   403→            handleError(fileError, { context: 'useShotCreation', toastTitle: `Failed to process file ${imageFile.name}` });
   404→          }
   405→        }
   406→
   407→        if (generationIds.length > 0) {
   408→          return { shotId, generationIds };
   409→        } else {
   410→          return null;
   411→        }
   412→      } catch (error) {
   413→        handleError(error, { context: 'useShotCreation', toastTitle: 'Failed to process dropped image(s)' });
   414→        return null;
   415→      }
   416→    },
   417→  });
   418→
   419→  return mutation;
   420→};

   384→    autoLoadStateRef.current = stateKey;
   385→  }, [enableProjectPersistence, hasSavedLoras, selectedLoras.length, handleLoadProjectLoras, userHasManuallyInteracted, disableAutoLoad]);
   386→
   387→  // Render header actions for ActiveLoRAsDisplay
   388→  // Uses extracted LoraHeaderActions component to keep JSX out of hooks
   389→  const renderHeaderActions = useCallback((customLoadHandler?: () => Promise<void>) => {
   390→    if (!enableProjectPersistence) return null;
   391→
   392→    // Format saved LoRAs for tooltip (multi-line) - use lastSavedLoras for immediate updates
   393→    const currentSavedLoras = lastSavedLoras || projectLoraSettings?.loras;
   394→    const savedLorasContent = currentSavedLoras && currentSavedLoras.length > 0
   395→      ? `Saved LoRAs (${currentSavedLoras.length}):\n` +
   396→        currentSavedLoras.map(lora => `• ${lora.id} (strength: ${lora.strength})`).join('\n')
   397→      : 'No saved LoRAs available';
   398→
   399→    return (
   400→      <LoraHeaderActions
   401→        hasSavedLoras={!!hasSavedLoras}
   402→        selectedLorasCount={selectedLoras.length}
   403→        isSaving={!!isSavingLoras}
   404→        saveSuccess={saveSuccess}
   405→        saveFlash={saveFlash}
   406→        savedLorasContent={savedLorasContent}
   407→        onSave={handleSaveProjectLoras}
   408→        onLoad={customLoadHandler || handleLoadProjectLoras}
   409→      />
   410→    );
   411→  }, [
   412→    enableProjectPersistence,
   413→    hasSavedLoras,
   414→    handleLoadProjectLoras,
   415→    handleSaveProjectLoras,
   416→    selectedLoras.length,
   417→    isSavingLoras,
   418→    saveSuccess,
   419→    saveFlash,
   420→    projectLoraSettings?.loras,
   421→    lastSavedLoras
   422→  ]);
   423→
   424→  return {
   425→    // Core state
   426→    selectedLoras,
   427→    setSelectedLoras,
   428→    
   429→    // Modal state
   430→    isLoraModalOpen,
   431→    setIsLoraModalOpen,
   432→    
   433→    // Core handlers
   434→    handleAddLora,
   435→    handleRemoveLora,
   436→    handleLoraStrengthChange,
   437→    
   438→    // Universal user preference tracking
   439→    hasEverSetLoras,
   440→    shouldApplyDefaults,
   441→    markAsUserSet,
   442→    
   443→    // Conditional functionality
   444→    ...(enableTriggerWords && { handleAddTriggerWord }),
   445→    ...(enableProjectPersistence && {
   446→      handleSaveProjectLoras,
   447→      handleLoadProjectLoras,
   448→      hasSavedLoras,
   449→      isSavingLoras,
   450→      saveSuccess,
   451→      saveFlash,
   452→      renderHeaderActions,
   453→    }),
   454→  };
   455→};

  "content": "import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';\n\nvi.mock('@/shared/utils/timelinePositionCalculator', () => ({\n  calculateFrameForIndex: vi.fn((index: number, frames: number[], spacing?: number) => {\n    if (frames.length === 0) return 0;\n    if (index >= frames.length) return frames[frames.length - 1] + (spacing ?? 50);\n    return index * 10;\n  }),\n  extractExistingFrames: vi.fn((items: Array<{ timeline_frame?: number | null; type?: string }>) => {\n    return items\n      .filter(item => item.type !== 'video' && item.timeline_frame != null && item.timeline_frame !== -1)\n      .map(item => item.timeline_frame as number);\n  }),\n}));\n\nimport { getFramePositionForIndex, getImageRange, getAspectRatioStyle } from '../image-utils';\nimport type { GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';\n\ndescribe('getFramePositionForIndex', () => {\n  it('returns a frame position for given index', () => {\n    const images = [\n      { id: '1', timeline_frame: 0 },\n      { id: '2', timeline_frame: 50 },\n      { id: '3', timeline_frame: 100 },\n    ] as GenerationRow[];\n\n    const result = getFramePositionForIndex(3, images, 50);\n    expect(typeof result).toBe('number');\n  });\n\n  it('returns 0 for empty image list', () => {\n    const result = getFramePositionForIndex(0, [], 50);\n    expect(result).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('calls through to calculateFrameForIndex with extracted frames', () => {\n    const images = [\n      { id: '1', timeline_frame: 10 },\n      { id: '2', timeline_frame: 20 },\n    ] as GenerationRow[];\n\n    const result = getFramePositionForIndex(2, images, 50);\n    expect(typeof result).toBe('number');\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('getImageRange', () => {\n  const images = [\n    { id: 'a' },\n    { id: 'b' },\n    { id: 'c' },\n    { id: 'd' },\n    { id: 'e' },\n  ] as GenerationRow[];\n\n  it('returns range of IDs between start and end (inclusive)', () => {\n    expect(getImageRange(1, 3, images)).toEqual(['b', 'c', 'd']);\n  });\n\n  it('handles reversed start/end (end < start)', () => {\n    expect(getImageRange(3, 1, images)).toEqual(['b', 'c', 'd']);\n  });\n\n  it('returns single item when start equals end', () => {\n    expect(getImageRange(2, 2, images)).toEqual(['c']);\n  });\n\n  it('handles indices at boundaries', () => {\n    expect(getImageRange(0, 4, images)).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e']);\n  });\n\n  it('skips out-of-bounds indices', () => {\n    expect(getImageRange(3, 10, images)).toEqual(['d', 'e']);\n  });\n\n  it('returns empty array when all indices are out of bounds', () => {\n    expect(getImageRange(10, 15, images)).toEqual([]);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('getAspectRatioStyle', () => {\n  it('returns correct aspect ratio for 16:9', () => {\n    const style = getAspectRatioStyle('16:9');\n    expect(style.aspectRatio).toBe(`${16 / 9}`);\n  });\n\n  it('returns correct aspect ratio for 9:16', () => {\n    const style = getAspectRatioStyle('9:16');\n    expect(style.aspectRatio).toBe(`${9 / 16}`);\n  });\n\n  it('returns correct aspect ratio for 1:1', () => {\n    const style = getAspectRatioStyle('1:1');\n    expect(style.aspectRatio).toBe('1');\n  });\n\n  it('returns default square for undefined', () => {\n    const style = getAspectRatioStyle(undefined);\n    expect(style.aspectRatio).toBe('1');\n  });\n\n  it('returns default square for invalid format', () => {\n    const style = getAspectRatioStyle('invalid');\n    expect(style.aspectRatio).toBe('1');\n  });\n\n  it('returns default square for NaN values', () => {\n    const style = getAspectRatioStyle('abc:def');\n    expect(style.aspectRatio).toBe('1');\n  });\n});\n"
}

originalInnerWidth = window.innerWidth;\n  const originalNavigator = { ...navigator };\n\n  afterEach(() => {\n    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', { value: originalInnerWidth, writable: true });\n    // Clean up navigator mocks\n    vi.restoreAllMocks();\n  });\n\n  it('returns desktop config for wide screens', () => {\n    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', { value: 1920, writable: true });\n\n    const config = getPreloadConfig();\n    expect(config.maxConcurrent).toBe(3);\n    expect(config.debounceMs).toBe(150);\n    expect(config.maxImagesPerPage).toBe(10);\n    expect(config.preloadThumbnailsOnly).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('returns mobile config for narrow screens', () => {\n    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', { value: 375, writable: true });\n\n    const config = getPreloadConfig();\n    expect(config.maxConcurrent).toBe(2);\n    expect(config.debounceMs).toBe(200);\n    expect(config.maxImagesPerPage).toBe(6);\n    expect(config.preloadThumbnailsOnly).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('returns mobile config at boundary (768px)', () => {\n    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', { value: 768, writable: true });\n\n    const config = getPreloadConfig();\n    expect(config.maxConcurrent).toBe(2);\n    expect(config.preloadThumbnailsOnly).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('returns slow connection config when effectiveType is 2g', () => {\n    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', { value: 1920, writable: true });\n    Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'connection', {\n      value: { effectiveType: expect(config.maxImagesPerPage).toBe(3);\n    expect(config.preloadThumbnailsOnly).toBe(true);\n\n    // Cleanup\n    Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'connection', {\n      value: undefined,\n      configurable: true,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('returns low memory config when deviceMemory is low', () => {\n    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', { value: 1920, writable: true });\n expect(config.preloadThumbnailsOnly).toBe(true);\n\n    // Cleanup\n    Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'deviceMemory', {\n      value: undefined,\n      configurable: true,\n    });\n  });\n});\n"

  "content": "import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';\n\n// Mock the env module to avoid import.meta.env errors\nvi.mock('@/integrations/supabase/config/env', () => ({\n  __CORRUPTION_TRACE_ENABLED__: true,\n}));\n\nimport { addCorruptionEvent, __CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__ } from '../timeline';\n\ndescribe('addCorruptionEvent', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    // Clear the timeline before each test\n    __CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__.length = 0;\n  });\n\n  it('adds an event to the timeline', () => {\n    addCorruptionEvent('test_event', { key: 'value' });\n\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__[0].event).toBe('test_event');\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__[0].data).toEqual({ key: 'value' });\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__[0].timestamp).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n  });\n\n  it('adds event with empty data by default', () => {\n    addCorruptionEvent('simple_event');\n\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__[0].data).toEqual({});\n  });\n\n  it('includes a stack trace', () => {\n    addCorruptionEvent('stack_event');\n\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__[0].stack).toBeDefined();\n    expect(typeof __CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__[0].stack).toBe('string');\n  });\n\n  it('maintains ring buffer of max 100 entries', () => {\n    // Fill with 100 entries\n    for (let i = 0; i < 105; i++) {\n      addCorruptionEvent(`event_${i}`);\n    }\n\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__).toHaveLength(100);\n    // First entries should have been evicted\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__[0].event).toBe('event_5');\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__[99].event).toBe('event_104');\n  });\n\n  it('records timestamp for each event', () => {\n    const before = Date.now();\n    addCorruptionEvent('timed_event');\n    const after = Date.now();\n\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__[0].timestamp).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(before);\n    expect(__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__[0].timestamp).toBeLessThanOrEqual(after);\n  });\n});\n"
}

expect(result.imageUrl).toBe('https://example.com/image.png');\n    expect(result.thumbUrl).toBe('https://example.com/thumb.png');\n    expect(result.location).toBe('https://example.com/image.png');\n {\n    const shotGens = [{ shot_id: 'shot-1', timeline_frame: null }];\n    const result = transformExternalGeneration(baseData, shotGens);\n    expect(result.timeline_frame).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('defaults starred to false when null', () => {\n    const data = { ...baseData, starred: null };\n    const result = transformExternalGeneration(data, []);\n    expect(result.starred).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('handles null params by setting empty objects', () => {\n    const data = { ...baseData, params: null };\n    const result = transformExternalGeneration(data, []);\n    expect(result.metadata).toEqual({});\n    expect(result.params).toEqual({});\n  });\n\n  it('sets metadata from params when params is a valid object', () => {\n    const result = transformExternalGeneration(baseData, []);\n    expect(result.metadata).toEqual({ prompt: 'a cat' });\n  });\n\n  it('handles array params gracefully (sets metadata to empty object)', () => {\n    const data = { ...baseData, params: ['not', 'an', 'object'] as unknown as Record<string, unknown> };\n    const result = transformExternalGeneration(data, []);\n    expect(result.metadata).toEqual({});\n  });\n\n  it('does not include shot_id and position when no shot_generations', () => {\n    const result = transformExternalGeneration(baseData, []);\n    // These keys should not be spread onto the result\n    expect(result).not.toHaveProperty('shot_id');\n    expect(result).not.toHaveProperty('position');\n  });\n});\n"

  "content": "import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';\nimport { captureRealtimeSnapshot } from '../snapshot';\n\ndescribe('captureRealtimeSnapshot', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    // Reset window.supabase before each test\n    delete (window as any).supabase;\n    delete (window as any).__SUPABASE_WEBSOCKET_INSTANCES__;\n  });\n\n  it('returns error when no realtime client exists', () => {\n    const result = captureRealtimeSnapshot();\n    expect('error' in result).toBe(true);\n    if ('error' in result) {\n      expect(result.error).toBe('NO_REALTIME_CLIENT');\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('returns error when supabase exists but no realtime', () => {\n    (window as any).supabase = {};\n    const result = captureRealtimeSnapshot();\n    expect('error' in result).toBe(true);\n    if ('error' in result) {\n      expect(result.error).toBe('NO_REALTIME_CLIENT');\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('returns snapshot with channel information', () => {\n    (window as any).supabase = {\n      realtime: {\n        channels: {\n          'test-topic': { state: 'joined', joinRef: '1', ref: '2' },\n        },\n        isConnected: () => true,\n      },\n    };\n\n    const result = captureRealtimeSnapshot();\n    expect('error' in result).toBe(false);\n    if (!('error' in result)) {\n      expect(result.isConnected).toBe(true);\n      expect(result.channelCount).toBe(1);\n      expect(result.channelDetails).toHaveLength(1);\n      expect(result.channelDetails[0].topic).toBe('test-topic');\n      expect(result.channelDetails[0].state).toBe('joined');\n      expect(result.timestamp).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('handles socket info when available', () => {\n    const mockSocket = { readyState: 1, url: 'wss://test.supabase.co/realtime', protocol: 'wss' };\n    (window as any).supabase = {\n      realtime: {\n        socket: mockSocket,\n        channels: {},\n        isConnected: () => true,\n      },\n    };\n\n    const result = captureRealtimeSnapshot();\n    if (!('error' in result)) {\n      expect(result.socket).toEqual({\n        readyState: 1,\n        url: 'wss://test.supabase.co/realtime',\n        protocol: 'wss',\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('handles conn transport info', () => {\n    const mockTransport = { readyState: 1, url: 'wss://test.supabase.co/realtime' };\n    (window as any).supabase = {\n      realtime: {\n        conn: { transport: mockTransport, connectionState: 'open' },\n        channels: {},\n        isConnected: () => false,\n      },\n    };\n\n    const result = captureRealtimeSnapshot();\n    if (!('error' in result)) {\n      expect(result.conn?.connectionState).toBe('open');\n      expect(result.conn?.transport?.readyState).toBe(1);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('returns null socket when no socket present', () => {\n    (window as any).supabase = {\n      realtime: {\n        channels: {},\n        isConnected: () => false,\n      },\n    };\n\n    const result = captureRealtimeSnapshot();\n    if (!('error' in result)) {\n      expect(result.socket).toBeNull();\n      expect(result.conn).toBeNull();\n    }\n  });\n});\n"
}

  "content": "import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';\nimport { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';\n\nconst mockUpdate = vi.fn();\nvi.mock('@/shared/hooks/useUserUIState', () => ({\n  useUserUIState: vi.fn((_key: string, fallback: unknown) => ({\n    value: fallback,\n    update: mockUpdate,\n    isLoading: false,\n  })),\n}));\n\nimport { useProductTour } from '../useProductTour';\n\ndescribe('useProductTour', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    vi.clearAllMocks();\n  });\n\n  it('returns initial state with isRunning false', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProductTour());\n    expect(result.current.isRunning).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('startTour sets isRunning to true when not completed or skipped', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProductTour());\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.startTour();\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isRunning).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('completeTour stops running and saves completed state', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProductTour());\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.startTour();\n    });\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.completeTour();\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isRunning).toBe(false);\n    expect(mockUpdate).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ completed: true, skipped: false });\n  });\n\n  it('skipTour stops running and saves skipped state', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProductTour());\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.startTour();\n    });\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.skipTour();\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isRunning).toBe(false);\n    expect(mockUpdate).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ completed: false, skipped: true });\n  });\n\n  it('restartTour resets state and starts running', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProductTour());\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.restartTour();\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isRunning).toBe(true);\n    expect(mockUpdate).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ completed: false, skipped: false });\n  });\n});\n"
}

  "content": "import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';\nimport { getFilterCategory, getDefaultSubFilter, getSubFilterOptions, matchesFilters } from '../filter-utils';\n\ndescribe('getFilterCategory', () => {\n  it('returns \"all\" for undefined loraType', () => {\n    expect(getFilterCategory(undefined)).toBe('all');\n  });\n\n  it('returns \"qwen\" for qwen-containing types', () => {\n    expect(getFilterCategory('Qwen Image')).toBe('qwen');\n    expect(getFilterCategory('Qwen Edit')).toBe('qwen');\n    expect(getFilterCategory('qwen_something')).toBe('qwen');\n  });\n\n  it('returns \"wan\" for wan-containing types', () => {\n    expect(getFilterCategory('Wan 2.1 T2V 14B')).toBe('wan');\n    expect(getFilterCategory('Wan 2.2 I2V')).toBe('wan');\n  });\n\n  it('returns \"z-image\" for z-image types', () => {\n    expect(getFilterCategory('Z-Image')).toBe('z-image');\n    expect(getFilterCategory('z-image')).toBe('z-image');\n  });\n\n  it('returns \"all\" for unrecognized types', () => {\n    expect(getFilterCategory('SomeOtherModel')).toBe('all');\n    expect(getFilterCategory('')).toBe('all');\n  });\n\n  it('is case insensitive', () => {\n    expect(getFilterCategory('QWEN IMAGE')).toBe('qwen');\n    expect(getFilterCategory('WAN 2.1')).toBe('wan');\n    expect(getFilterCategory('Z-IMAGE')).toBe('z-image');\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('getSubFilterOptions', () => {\n  it('returns qwen options for \"qwen\" category', () => {\n    const options = getSubFilterOptions('qwen');\n    expect(options.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n    expect(options[0]).toEqual({ value: 'all', label: 'All' });\n    expect(options.some(o => o.value === 'Qwen Image')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('returns wan options for \"wan\" category', () => {\n    const options = getSubFilterOptions('wan');\n    expect(options.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n    expect(options[0]).toEqual({ value: 'all', label: 'All' });\n    expect(options.some(o => o.value === 'Wan 2.1 T2V 14B')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('returns z-image options for \"z-image\" category', () => {\n    const options = getSubFilterOptions('z-image');\n    expect(options.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n    expect(options.some(o => o.value === 'Z-Image')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('returns empty array for \"all\" category', () => {\n    expect(getSubFilterOptions('all')).toEqual([]);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('getDefaultSubFilter', () => {\n  it('returns \"all\" for undefined loraType', () => {\n    expect(getDefaultSubFilter(undefined)).toBe('all');\n  });\n\n  it('returns the loraType if it matches a sub-filter option', () => {\n    expect(getDefaultSubFilter('Qwen Image')).toBe('Qwen Image');\n    expect(getDefaultSubFilter('Wan 2.1 T2V 14B')).toBe('Wan 2.1 T2V 14B');\n    expect(getDefaultSubFilter('Z-Image')).toBe('Z-Image');\n  });\n\n  it('returns \"all\" for types that do not match any sub-filter option', () => {\n    expect(getDefaultSubFilter('SomeUnknownModel')).toBe('all');\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('matchesFilters', () => {\n  it('matches everything when category is \"all\"', () => {\n    expect(matchesFilters('Qwen Image', 'all', 'all')).toBe(true);\n    expect(matchesFilters(undefined, 'all', 'all')).toBe(true);\n    expect(matchesFilters('anything', 'all', 'all')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('matches qwen types against qwen category', () => {\n    expect(matchesFilters('Qwen Image', 'qwen', 'all')).toBe(true);\n    expect(matchesFilters('Wan 2.1', 'qwen', 'all')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('filters by sub-filter when not \"all\"', () => {\n    expect(matchesFilters('Qwen Image', 'qwen', 'Qwen Image')).toBe(true);\n    expect(matchesFilters('Qwen Edit', 'qwen', 'Qwen Image')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('rejects undefined loraType for non-all categories', () => {\n    expect(matchesFilters(undefined, 'qwen', 'all')).toBe(false);\n    expect(matchesFilters(undefined, 'wan', 'all')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('matches wan types correctly', () => {\n    expect(matchesFilters('Wan 2.1 T2V 14B', 'wan', 'all')).toBe(true);\n    expect(matchesFilters('Wan 2.1 T2V 14B', 'wan', 'Wan 2.1 T2V 14B')).toBe(true);\n    expect(matchesFilters('Wan 2.1 T2V 14B', 'wan', 'Wan 2.2 T2V')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('matches z-image types correctly', () => {\n    expect(matchesFilters('Z-Image', 'z-image', 'all')).toBe(true);\n    expect(matchesFilters('Z-Image', 'z-image', 'Z-Image')).toBe(true);\n  });\n});\n"
}

'../useTouchDragDetection';\n\ndescribe('useTouchDragDetection', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    vi.useFakeTimers();\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => {\n    vi.useRealTimers();\n  });\n\n  it('returns isDragging ref and handleTouchStart', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useTouchDragDetection());\n    expect(result.current.isDragging).toHaveProperty('current', false);\n    expect(typeof result.current.handleTouchStart).toBe('function');\n  });\n\n  it('sets isDragging to false on touch start', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useTouchDragDetection());\n    const event = {\n      touches: [{ clientX: 100, clientY: 100 }],\n    } as unknown as React.TouchEvent;\n\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.handleTouchStart(event);\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isDragging.current).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('detects drag when touch moves beyond threshold', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useTouchDragDetection(5));\n\n    // Simulate touch start\n    const startEvent = {\n      touches: [{ clientX: 100, clientY: 100 }],\n    } as unknown as React.TouchEvent;\n\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.handleTouchStart(startEvent);\n    });\n\n    // Simulate touch move beyond threshold\n    const moveEvent = new TouchEvent('touchmove', {\n      touches: [new Touch({ identifier: 0, target: document.body, clientX: 110, clientY: 100 })],\n    });\n    act(() => {\n      document.dispatchEvent(moveEvent);\n    });\n\n    expect(result.current.isDragging.current).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('does not detect drag when touch moves within threshold', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useTouchDragDetection(10));\n\n    const startEvent = {\n      touches: [{ });\n\n    expect(result.current.isDragging.current).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('resets isDragging after touch end with delay', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useTouchDragDetection(5));\n\n    const startEvent = {\n      touches: [{ clientX: 100, clientY: 100 }],\n    } as unknown as React.TouchEvent;\n\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.handleTouchStart(startEvent);\n    });\n\n    // Move beyond threshold\n    const moveEvent = new TouchEvent('touchmove', {\n      touches: [new Touch({ identifier: 0, target: document.body, clientX: 120, clientY: 100 })],\n    });\n    act(() => {\n      document.dispatchEvent(moveEvent);\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isDragging.current).toBe(true);\n\n    // Trigger touch end\n    act(() => {\n      document.dispatchEvent(new TouchEvent('touchend'));\n    });\n\n    // After 50ms delay, should reset\n    act(() => {\n      vi.advanceTimersByTime(50);\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isDragging.current).toBe(false);\n  });\n});\n"

  "content": "import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';\nimport { calculateMultiDragOrder } from '../reorder-utils';\nimport type { GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';\n\nconst makeImage = (id: string): GenerationRow => ({ id } as GenerationRow);\n\ndescribe('calculateMultiDragOrder', () => {\n  const images = [\n    makeImage('a'), // 0\n    makeImage('b'), // 1\n    makeImage('c'), // 2\n    makeImage('d'), // 3\n    makeImage('e'), // 4\n  ];\n\n  describe('dropping on non-selected item', () => {\n    it('moves selected items before target when dragging up', () => {\n      // Select 'c' (index 2), drag to index 0 (drop on 'a')\n      const result = calculateMultiDragOrder(images, ['c'], 2, 0, 'c', 'a');\n      const ids = result.map(img => img.id);\n      expect(ids).toEqual(['c', 'a', 'b', 'd', 'e']);\n    });\n\n    it('moves selected items after target when dragging down', () => {\n      // Select 'a' (index 0), drag to index 3 (drop on 'd')\n      const result = calculateMultiDragOrder(images, ['a'], 0, 3, 'a', 'd');\n      const ids = result.map(img => img.id);\n      expect(ids).toEqual(['b', 'c', 'd', 'a', 'e']);\n    });\n\n    it('moves multiple selected items together', () => {\n      // Select 'a' and 'b' (indices 0, 1), drag to index 4 (drop on 'e')\n      const result = calculateMultiDragOrder(images, ['a', 'b'], 0, 4, 'a', 'e');\n      const ids = result.map(img => img.id);\n      expect(ids).toEqual(['c', 'd', 'e', 'a', 'b']);\n    });\n\n    it('preserves order of non-selected items', () => {\n      // Select 'c' (index 2), drag to index 1 (drop on 'b')\n      const result = calculateMultiDragOrder(images, ['c'], 2, 1, 'c', 'b');\n      const ids = result.map(img => img.id);\n      expect(ids).toEqual(['a', 'c', 'b', 'd', 'e']);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('dropping on selected item', () => {\n    it('handles dropping onto a selected item', () => {\n      // Select 'b' and 'c', drop on 'c' (a selected item)\n      const result = calculateMultiDragOrder(images, ['b', 'c'], 1, 2, 'b', 'c');\n      const ids = result.map(img => img.id);\n      // Should maintain selected items as a group\n      expect(ids).toContain('b');\n      expect(ids).toContain('c');\n      // b and c should be adjacent\n      const bIdx = ids.indexOf('b');\n      const cIdx = ids.indexOf('c');\n      expect(Math.abs(bIdx - cIdx)).toBe(1);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('edge cases', () => {\n    it('handles single item list', () => {\n      const single = [makeImage('a')];\n      const result = calculateMultiDragOrder(single, ['a'], 0, 0, 'a', 'a');\n      expect(result).toHaveLength(1);\n      expect(result[0].id).toBe('a');\n    });\n\n    it('handles selecting all items', () => {\n      const result = calculateMultiDragOrder(\n        images,\n        ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'],\n        0,\n        4,\n        'a',\n        'e'\n      );\n      expect(result).toHaveLength(5);\n    });\n\n    it('preserves total number of items', () => {\n      const result = calculateMultiDragOrder(images, ['b', 'd'], 1, 0, 'b', 'a');\n      expect(result).toHaveLength(5);\n      // All original items should be present\n      const ids = result.map(img => img.id).sort();\n      expect(ids).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e']);\n    });\n  });\n});\n"
}

  "content": "import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';\nimport { PreloadQueue } from '../queue';\n\n// Mock Image constructor\nclass MockImage {\n  onload: (() => void) | null = null;\n  onerror: (() => void) | null = null;\n  private _src = '';\n\n  get src() { return this._src; }\n  set src(value: string) {\n    this._src = value;\n    // Auto-resolve on next tick\n    if (value.includes('fail')) {\n      setTimeout(() => this.onerror?.(), 0);\n    } else {\n      setTimeout(() => this.onload?.(), 0);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// @ts-ignore\nglobalThis.Image = MockImage;\n\ndescribe('PreloadQueue', () => {\n  it('creates a queue with default maxConcurrent of 3', () => {\n    const queue = new PreloadQueue();\n    expect(queue.size).toBe(0);\n    expect(queue.activeCount).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('creates a queue with custom maxConcurrent', () => {\n    const queue = new PreloadQueue(5);\n    expect(queue.size).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('loads an image and returns HTMLImageElement', async () => {\n    const queue = new PreloadQueue(3);\n    const result = await queue.add('https://example.com/image.jpg');\n    expect(result).toBeDefined();\n    expect(result.src).toBe('https://example.com/image.jpg');\n  });\n\n  it('rejects when image fails to load', async () => {\n    const queue = new PreloadQueue(3);\n    await expect(queue.add('https://example.com/fail.jpg')).rejects.toThrow('Failed to load image');\n  });\n\n  it('respects priority ordering (higher priority first)', async () => {\n    const queue = new PreloadQueue(1); // Only 1 concurrent to see ordering\n    const order: string[] = [];\n\n    // Add low priority first, then high priority\n    const p1 = queue.add('https://example.com/low.jpg', 0).then(() => order.push('low'));\n    const p2 = queue.add('https://example.com/high.jpg', 100).then(() => order.push('high'));\n\n    await Promise.all([p1, p2]);\n\n    // First one starts immediately regardless, but high priority should be processed before others in queue\n    expect(order).toHaveLength(2);\n  });\n\n  it('clears pending items from the queue', async () => {\n    const queue = new PreloadQueue(1);\n\n    // Add items\n    const p1 = queue.add('https://example.com/a.jpg');\n    queue.add('https://example.com/b.jpg');\n    queue.add('https://example.com/c.jpg');\n\n    queue.clear();\n    expect(queue.size).toBe(0);\n\n    // First item should still resolve since it's already active\n    await p1;\n  });\n\n  it('reports correct size', () => {\n    const queue = new PreloadQueue(1);\n\n    queue.add('https://example.com/a.jpg');\n    queue.add('https://example.com/b.jpg');\n    queue.add('https://example.com/c.jpg');\n\n    // First item is active (not in queue), so 2 pending\n    expect(queue.size).toBe(2);\n  });\n\n  it('processes multiple items concurrently up to the limit', async () => {\n    const queue = new PreloadQueue(2);\n\n    const p1 = queue.add('https://example.com/a.jpg');\n    const p2 = queue.add('https://example.com/b.jpg');\n    const p3 = queue.add('https://example.com/c.jpg');\n\n    await Promise.all([p1, p2, p3]);\n    expect(queue.activeCount).toBe(0);\n    expect(queue.size).toBe(0);\n  });\n});\n"
}

  "content": "import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';\nimport { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';\nimport { useClickRipple } from '../useClickRipple';\n\ndescribe('useClickRipple', () => {\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    vi.useFakeTimers();\n    vi.spyOn(window, 'requestAnimationFrame').mockImplementation((cb) => {\n      cb(0);\n      return 0;\n    });\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => {\n    vi.useRealTimers();\n    vi.restoreAllMocks();\n  });\n\n  it('returns initial inactive state', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useClickRipple());\n    expect(result.current.isRippleActive).toBe(false);\n    expect(result.current.rippleState.position).toEqual({ x: 0, y: 0 });\n  });\n\n  it('triggerRippleAtCenter sets position to center', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useClickRipple());\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.triggerRippleAtCenter();\n    });\n    expect(result.current.rippleState.isActive).toBe(true);\n    expect(result.current.rippleState.position).toEqual({ x: 0, y: 0 });\n  });\n\n  it('deactivates ripple after duration', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useClickRipple({ duration: 500 }));\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.triggerRippleAtCenter();\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isRippleActive).toBe(true);\n    act(() => {\n      vi.advanceTimersByTime(500);\n    });\n    expect(result.current.isRippleActive).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('returns ripple styles with CSS custom properties', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useClickRipple());\n    expect(result.current.rippleStyles).toEqual({\n      '--ripple-x': '0px',\n      '--ripple-y': '0px',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('triggerRipple calculates offset from center', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useClickRipple());\n\n    const mockElement = {\n      getBoundingClientRect: () => ({\n        left: 0,\n        top: 0,\n        width: 100,\n        height: 100,\n      }),\n    };\n\n    const event = {\n      stopPropagation: vi.fn(),\n      currentTarget: mockElement,\n      clientX: 75,\n      clientY: 25,\n    } as unknown as React.PointerEvent;\n\n    act(() => {\n      result.current.triggerRipple(event);\n    });\n\n    expect(event.stopPropagation).toHaveBeenCalled();\n    // x offset = 75 - 50 = 25, y offset = 25 - 50 = -25\n    expect(result.current.rippleState.position).toEqual({ x: 25, y: -25 });\n  });\n});\n"
}

{\n      expect(isQuotaOrServerError(new Error('Server error 500'))).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('detects 502 errors', () => {\n      expect(isQuotaOrServerError(new Error('Bad gateway 502'))).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('detects 503 errors', () => {\n      expect(isQuotaOrServerError(new Error('Service unavailable 503'))).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('detects 504 errors', () it('does not remove from non-no-shot filter views', () => {\n      const queryKey = ['unified-generations', 'project', 'proj-1', 1, 20, { shotId: 'shot-1' }];\n      queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, expect(hasLoadedImage(image)).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('marks an image as not loaded', () => {\n      const image = { id: 'img-1' };\n      setImageLoadStatus(image, true);\n      setImageLoadStatus(image, false);\n      expect(hasLoadedImage(image)).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('sets __memoryCached on the image object', () => {\n      const image = { id: 'img-1' } as any;\n      setImageLoadStatus(image, true);\n      expect(image.__memoryCached).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('does nothing for images without id', () => {\n      const image = { id: '' } as any;\n      setImageLoadStatus(image, true);\n      expect(hasLoadedImage(image)).toBe(false);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('hasLoadedImage', () => {\n    it('returns false for unknown image object', () => {\n      expect(hasLoadedImage({ id: 'unknown' })).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('returns true for loaded image object', () => {\n      const image = { id: 'img-1' };\n      setImageLoadStatus(image, true);\n      expect(hasLoadedImage(image)).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('checks by URL string', () => {\n      markImageLoaded('https://example.com/img.jpg');\n      expect(hasLoadedImage('https://example.com/img.jpg')).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('returns false for unknown URL', () => {\n      expect(hasLoadedImage('https://example.com/unknown.jpg')).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('returns false for image with no id', () => {\n      expect(hasLoadedImage({ id: '' })).toBe(false);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('markImageLoaded', () => {\n    it('marks a URL as loaded', () => {\n      markImageLoaded('https://example.com/img.jpg');\n      expect(hasLoadedImage('https://example.com/img.jpg')).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('marks an image object as loaded', () => {\n      const image = { id: 'img-1' };\n      markImageLoaded(image);\n      expect(hasLoadedImage(image)).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('stores metadata with URL', () => {\n      const element = {} as HTMLImageElement;\n      markImageLoaded('https://example.com/img.jpg', { width: 100, height: 200, element });\n      expect(getImageElement('https://example.com/img.jpg')).toBe(element);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('clearLoadedImages', () => {\n    it('removes specified images from tracker', () => {\n      const img1 = { id: 'img-1' };\n      const img2 = { id: 'img-2' };\n      setImageLoadStatus(img1, true);\n      setImageLoadStatus(img2, true);\n\n      const removed = clearLoadedImages([{ id: 'img-1' }]);\n      expect(removed).toBe(1);\n      expect(hasLoadedImage(img1)).toBe(false);\n      expect(hasLoadedImage(img2)).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('returns 0 when no matching images found', () => {\n      const removed = clearLoadedImages([{ id: 'nonexistent' }]);\n      expect(removed).toBe(0);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('clearAllLoadedImages', () => {\n    it('clears all tracked images', () => {\n      setImageLoadStatus({ id: 'img-1' }, true);\n      setImageLoadStatus({ id: 'img-2' }, true);\n })).toBe(false);\n      expect(hasLoadedImage('https://example.com/img.jpg')).toBe(false);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('getLoadTrackerStats', () => {\n    it('returns current counts', () => {\n      setImageLoadStatus({ id: 'img-1' }, true);\n      markImageLoaded('https://example.com/img.jpg');\n\n      const stats = getLoadTrackerStats();\n      expect(stats.byId).toBe(1);\n      expect(stats.byUrl).toBe(1);\n      expect(stats.limits).toBeDefined();\n      expect(stats.limits.maxImages).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n      expect(stats.limits.maxUrls).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('getImageElement', () => {\n    it('returns undefined for unknown URL', () => {\n      expect(getImageElement('https://unknown.com/img.jpg')).toBeUndefined();\n    });\n\n    it('returns element when stored', () => {\n      const element = {} as HTMLImageElement;\n      markImageLoaded('https://example.com/img.jpg', { element });\n      expect(getImageElement('https://example.com/img.jpg')).toBe(element);\n    });\n  });\n});\n"

({\n          single: () => mockSingle(),\n        })),\n      })),\n    })),\n  },\n}));\n\nvi.mock('@/shared/constants/supabaseErrors', () => ({\n  isNotFoundError: vi.fn((err: { code?: string }) => });\n\n  it('returns empty data for empty resource IDs', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHookWithProviders(() => useSpecificResources([]));\n    expect(result.current.data).toEqual([]);\n   "content": "import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';\nimport { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';\nimport { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';\n\n// Since the functions are not exported (marked @internal), we test them indirectly\n// by verifying the query key structure and invalidation behavior\n\ndescribe('useShotInvalidation', () => {\n  let queryClient: QueryClient;\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    queryClient = new QueryClient({\n      defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } },\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('queryKeys used for invalidation', () => {\n    it('has correct shots list key', () => {\n      expect(queryKeys.shots.list('proj-1')).toEqual(['shots', 'proj-1', undefined]);\n    });\n\n    it('has correct shots detail key', () => {\n      expect(queryKeys.shots.detail('shot-1')).toEqual(['shot', 'shot-1']);\n    });\n\n    it('has correct generations byShot key', () => {\n      expect(queryKeys.generations.byShot('shot-1')).toEqual(['all-shot-generations', 'shot-1']);\n    });\n\n    it('has correct generations meta key', () => {\n      expect(queryKeys.generations.meta('shot-1')).toEqual(['shot-generations-meta', 'shot-1']);\n    });\n\n    it('has correct segment liveTimeline key', () => {\n      expect(queryKeys.segments.liveTimeline('shot-1')).toEqual(['segment-live-timeline', 'shot-1']);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('invalidation scopes', () => {\n    it('can invalidate list scope queries', () => {\n      const spy = vi.spyOn(queryClient, 'invalidateQueries');\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED]('proj-1') });\n      expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ [REDACTED]('proj-1') });\n    });\n\n    it('can invalidate detail scope queries', () => {\n      const spy = vi.spyOn(queryClient, 'invalidateQueries');\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED]('shot-1') });\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED]('shot-1') });\n      expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);\n    });\n  });\n});\n"
}

// 30 seconds ago\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useUpdatingTimestamp({ date }));\n    expect(result.current).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(result.current).not.toBe('Unknown');\n  });\n\n  it('abbreviates \"less than a minute\" to \"<1 min ago\"', () => {\n    const date = new Date(Date.now() - 5 * 1000).toISOString(); // 5 seconds ago\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useUpdatingTimestamp({ date }));\n    expect(result.current).toBe('<1 min ago');\n  });\n\n  it('uses custom abbreviation function', () => {\n    const date = new Date(Date.now() - 5 * 1000).toISOString();\n    const customAbbreviate = (str: string) => `custom: ${str}`;\n    const { result } = renderHook(() =>\n      useUpdatingTimestamp({ date, abbreviate: customAbbreviate })\n    );\n    expect(result.current).toContain('custom:');\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('useTaskTimestamp', () => {\n  it('returns formatted string for valid date', () => {\n    const date = new Date(Date.now() - 5 * 1000).toISOString();\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useTaskTimestamp(date));\n    expect(result.current).toBeTruthy();\n  });\n\n  it('returns \"Unknown\" for null date', () => {\n    const { result } = renderHook(() => useTaskTimestamp(null));\n    expect(result.current).toBe('Unknown');\n  });\n});\n"
}

   139→
   140→  const prefetch = useCallback(async (taskId: string) => {
   141→    if (!taskId) return;
   142→
   143→    // Check if already cached
   144→    const cached = queryClient.getQueryData(queryKeys.tasks.single(taskId));
   145→    if (cached) {
   146→      return;
   147→    }
   148→
   149→    try {
   150→      await queryClient.fetchQuery({
   151→        [REDACTED](taskId),
   152→        queryFn: async () => {
   153→          const { data, error } = await supabase
   154→            .from('tasks')
   155→            .select('*')
   156→            .eq('id', taskId)
   157→            .single();
   158→
   159→          if (error) throw error;
   160→          return mapDbTaskToTask(data);
   161→        },
   162→        staleTime: Infinity,
   163→      });
   164→    } catch {
   165→      // Silently fail - prefetch is best-effort
   166→    }
   167→  }, [queryClient]);
   168→
   169→  return prefetch;
   170→}

1→import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Smart timestamp updater hook that provides live-updating relative timestamps
     5→ * with performance optimizations for galleries and task lists.
     6→ * 
     7→ * Features:
     8→ * - Automatic updates with smart intervals (30s for recent, 60s for older)
     9→ * - Only updates when component is visible (IntersectionObserver)
    10→ * - Batched updates to prevent excessive re-renders
    11→ * - Efficient memory management with cleanup
    12→ */
    13→
    14→interface TimestampUpdateOptions {
    15→  /** Date to track */
    16→  date: Date | string | null;
    17→  /** Update interval in seconds (default: smart intervals based on age) */
    18→  updateInterval?: number;
    19→  /** Whether this timestamp is currently visible (default: true) */
    20→  isVisible?: boolean;
    21→  /** Disable automatic updates (default: false) */
    22→  disabled?: boolean;
    23→}
    24→
    25→// Global timestamp manager to coordinate updates across all components
    26→class TimestampManager {
    27→  private intervals = new Map<number, Set<() => void>>();
    28→  private timers = new Map<number, NodeJS.Timeout>();
    29→  
    30→  // Smart interval selection based on timestamp age
    31→  private getUpdateInterval(date: Date): number {
    32→    const now = Date.now();
    33→    const age = now - date.getTime();
    34→    
    35→    // Less than 5 minutes old: update every 10 seconds (more responsive for fresh content)
    36→    if (age < 5 * 60 * 1000) return 10;
    37→    
    38→    // Less than 1 hour old: update every 60 seconds  
    39→    if (age < 60 * 60 * 1000) return 60;
    40→    
    41→    // Less than 1 day old: update every 5 minutes
    42→    if (age < 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) return 300;
    43→    
    44→    // Older: update every 30 minutes
    45→    return 1800;
    46→  }
    47→  
    48→  subscribe(date: Date, callback: () => void, isVisible: boolean = true): () => void {
    49→    if (!isVisible) {
    50→      // Return no-op unsubscribe for invisible timestamps
    51→      return () => {};
    52→    }
    53→    
    54→    const interval = this.getUpdateInterval(date);
    55→    
    56→    // Get or create interval group
    57→    if (!this.intervals.has(interval)) {
    58→      this.intervals.set(interval, new Set());
    59→    }
    60→    
    61→    const callbacks = this.intervals.get(interval)!;
    62→    callbacks.add(callback);
    63→    
    64→    // Start timer if this is the first callback for this interval
    65→    if (callbacks.size === 1) {
    66→      const timer = setInterval(() => {
    67→        // Batch all callbacks for this interval
    68→        callbacks.forEach(cb => cb());
    69→      }, interval * 1000);
    70→      
    71→      this.timers.set(interval, timer);
    72→    }
    73→    
    74→    // Return unsubscribe function
    75→    return () => {
    76→      callbacks.delete(callback);
    77→      
    78→      // Clean up timer if no more callbacks
    79→      if (callbacks.size === 0) {
    80→        const timer = this.timers.get(interval);
    81→        if (timer) {
    82→          clearInterval(timer);
    83→          this.timers.delete(interval);
    84→        }
    85→        this.intervals.delete(interval);
    86→      }
    87→    };
    88→  }
    89→  
    90→  // Get current update interval for a date (for debugging)
    91→  getIntervalForDate(date: Date): number {
    92→    return this.getUpdateInterval(date);
    93→  }
    94→}
    95→
    96→// Global singleton
    97→const timestampManager = new TimestampManager();
    98→
    99→/**
   100→ * Hook that provides a timestamp that automatically updates at smart intervals
   101→ */
   102→export function useTimestampUpdater({ 
   103→  date, 
   104→  isVisible = true, 
   105→  disabled = false 
   106→}: TimestampUpdateOptions) {
   107→  const [updateTrigger, setUpdateTrigger] = useState(0);
   108→  const dateRef = useRef<Date | null>(null);
   109→  
   110→  // Parse and validate date
   111→  if (date && dateRef.current?.getTime() !== (typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date)?.getTime()) {
   112→    dateRef.current = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date;
   113→  }
   114→  
   115→  useEffect(() => {
   116→    if (!dateRef.current || disabled || !isVisible) {
   117→      return;
   118→    }
   119→    
   120→    // Subscribe to timestamp updates
   121→    const unsubscribe = timestampManager.subscribe(
   122→      dateRef.current,
   123→      () => setUpdateTrigger(prev => prev + 1),
   124→      isVisible
   125→    );
   126→    
   127→    return unsubscribe;
   128→  }, [dateRef.current?.getTime(), isVisible, disabled]);
   129→  
   130→  return {
   131→    /** Current update trigger - changes when timestamp should be recalculated */
   132→    updateTrigger,
   133→    /** The date being tracked */
   134→    date: dateRef.current,
   135→    /** Current update interval for this timestamp (for debugging) */
   136→    currentInterval: dateRef.current ? timestampManager.getIntervalForDate(dateRef.current) : null,
   137→  };
   138→}
   139→
   140→/**
   141→ * Hook for components that need to track visibility for performance
   142→ * Uses IntersectionObserver to detect when timestamps are visible
   143→ */
   144→export function useTimestampVisibility(ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>) {
   145→  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(true); // Default to visible
   146→  
   147→  useEffect(() => {
   148→    const element = ref.current;
   149→    if (!element) {
   150→      // If element not mounted yet, stay visible
   151→      return;
   152→    }
   153→    
   154→    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
   155→      // If IntersectionObserver not supported, always consider visible
   156→      setIsVisible(true);
   157→      return;
   158→    }
   159→    
   160→    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
   161→      ([entry]) => {
   162→        const newVisibility = entry.isIntersecting;
   163→        setIsVisible(newVisibility);
   164→      },
   165→      {
   166→        // Consider visible when 10% is showing
   167→        threshold: 0.1,
   168→        // Add some margin to start updating before fully visible
   169→        rootMargin: '50px'
   170→      }
   171→    );
   172→    
   173→    observer.observe(element);
   174→    
   175→    return () => {
   176→      observer.disconnect();
   177→    };
   178→  }, [ref]);
   179→  
   180→  return isVisible;
   181→}
   182→

    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * List all shots for a specific project with configurable image loading.
    18→ * @param projectId - The project to fetch shots for
    19→ * @param options.maxImagesPerShot - Limit images per shot (0 = unlimited, default)
    20→ */
    21→export const useListShots = (
    22→  projectId?: string | null,
    23→  options: { maxImagesPerShot?: number } = {}
    24→) => {
    25→  const { maxImagesPerShot = 0 } = options;
    26→
    27→  return useQuery({
    28→    queryKey: projectId ? queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, maxImagesPerShot) : ['shots', projectId, maxImagesPerShot],
    29→    queryFn: async () => {
    30→      if (!projectId) {
    31→        return [];
    32→      }
    33→
    34→      // Get shots ordered by position
    35→      const { data: shots, error: shotsError } = await supabase
    36→        .from('shots')
    37→        .select('*')
    38→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
    39→        .order('position', { ascending: true });
    40→
    41→      if (shotsError) {
    42→        throw shotsError;
    43→      }
    44→
    45→      if (!shots || shots.length === 0) {
    46→        return [];
    47→      }
    48→
    49→      // Fetch images for each shot in batches
    50→      const BATCH_SIZE = 10;
    51→      const imagesPerShot: { shotId: string; images: GenerationRow[] }[] = [];
    52→
    53→      for (let i = 0; i < shots.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    54→        const batch = shots.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
    55→        const batchResults = await Promise.all(
    56→          batch.map(async (shot) => {
    57→            let query = supabase
    58→              .from('shot_generations')
    59→              .select(`
    60→                id,
    61→                shot_id,
    62→                timeline_frame,
    63→                generation_id,
    64→                generation:generations!shot_generations_generation_id_generations_id_fk (
    65→                  id,
    66→                  location,

    68→                  type,
    69→                  created_at,
    70→                  starred,
    71→                  name,
    72→                  based_on,
    73→                  params,
    74→                  primary_variant_id,
    75→                  primary_variant:generation_variants!generations_primary_variant_id_fkey (
    76→                    location,
    77→                    thumbnail_url
    78→                  )
    79→                )
    80→              `)
    81→              .eq('shot_id', shot.id)
    82→              .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true, nullsFirst: false });
    83→
    84→            if (maxImagesPerShot > 0) {
    85→              query = query.limit(maxImagesPerShot);
    86→            }
    87→
    88→            const { data: shotGenerations, error: sgError } = await query;
    89→
    90→            if (sgError) {

    92→              return { shotId: shot.id, images: [] };
    93→            }
    94→
    95→            const images: GenerationRow[] = (shotGenerations || [])
    96→              .map(mapShotGenerationToRow)
    97→              .filter(Boolean) as GenerationRow[];
    98→
    99→            return { shotId: shot.id, images };
   100→          })
   101→        );
   102→        imagesPerShot.push(...batchResults);
   103→      }
   104→
   105→      // Build lookup map
   106→      const imagesByShot: Record<string, GenerationRow[]> = {};
   107→      imagesPerShot.forEach(({ shotId, images }) => {
   108→        imagesByShot[shotId] = images;

   110→

   112→      return shots.map(shot => {

   114→

   117→        const unpositionedGenIds = new Set<string>();
   118→        const positionedGenIds = new Set<string>();
   119→
   120→        images.forEach(img => {

   122→          uniqueGenIds.add(genId);

   127→          }
   128→        });
   129→
   130→        const unpositionedCount = unpositionedGenIds.size;
   131→
   132→        return {
   133→          ...shot,

   135→          imageCount: uniqueGenIds.size,
   136→          positionedImageCount: positionedGenIds.size,
   137→          unpositionedImageCount: unpositionedCount,
   138→          hasUnpositionedImages: unpositionedCount > 0,
   139→        };
   140→      });
   141→    },
   142→    enabled: !!projectId,
   143→    staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 5, // 5 minutes
   144→    placeholderData: (previousData) => previousData,
   145→  });
   146→};

   155→export const useProjectImageStats = (projectId?: string | null) => {
