1→/**
     2→ * usePendingSegmentTasks Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Tracks travel segment tasks that are "Queued" or "In Progress" for a given shot.
     5→ * Returns a function to check if a specific pair_shot_generation_id has a pending task.
     6→ * Supports optimistic updates for immediate UI feedback when generate is clicked.
     7→ */
     8→
     9→import { useMemo, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
    10→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    11→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    12→import { TASK_STATUS } from '@/types/tasks';
    13→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    14→
    15→interface PendingSegmentTask {
    16→  id: string;
    17→  status: string;
    18→  pair_shot_generation_id: string | null;
    19→}
    20→
    21→interface UsePendingSegmentTasksReturn {
    22→  /** Check if a pair_shot_generation_id has a pending task (real or optimistic) */
    23→  hasPendingTask: (pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined) => boolean;
    24→  /** Get the task status for a pair_shot_generation_id */
    25→  getTaskStatus: (pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined) => string | null;
    26→  /** Set of all pair_shot_generation_ids with pending tasks */
    27→  pendingPairIds: Set<string>;
    28→  /** Loading state */
    29→  isLoading: boolean;
    30→  /** Add an optimistic pending ID (for immediate UI feedback when generate is clicked) */
    31→  addOptimisticPending: (pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined) => void;
    32→}
    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Extract pair_shot_generation_id from task params
    36→ */
    37→function extractPairShotGenId(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
    38→  if (!params) return null;
    39→
    40→  // Direct param (individual_travel_segment)
    41→  if (params.pair_shot_generation_id) {
    42→    return params.pair_shot_generation_id as string;
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  // From orchestrator_details with segment_index (travel_segment from orchestrator)
    46→  const orchDetails = params.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    47→  if (orchDetails?.pair_shot_generation_ids && typeof params.segment_index === 'number') {
    48→    const ids = orchDetails.pair_shot_generation_ids;
    49→    if (Array.isArray(ids) && ids[params.segment_index]) {
    50→      return ids[params.segment_index] as string;
    51→    }
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  return null;
    55→}
    56→
    57→export function usePendingSegmentTasks(
    58→  shotId: string | null,
    59→  projectId: string | null
    60→): UsePendingSegmentTasksReturn {
    61→  // Track optimistic pending IDs with timestamps (for immediate UI feedback before task is detected)
    62→  // Map of pairShotGenerationId -> timestamp when added
    63→  const [optimisticPending, setOptimisticPending] = useState<Map<string, number>>(new Map());
    64→
    65→  // How long to wait for a task to appear in real pending before clearing optimistic
    66→  const OPTIMISTIC_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000; // 8 seconds (covers ~2-3 query cycles)
    67→
    68→  // Query pending segment tasks for this shot
    69→  const { data: pendingTasks, isLoading } = useQuery({
    70→    queryKey: [...queryKeys.tasks.pendingSegment(shotId!), projectId],
    71→    queryFn: async () => {
    72→      if (!shotId || !projectId) return [];
    73→
    74→      // Query tasks that are Queued or In Progress
    75→      // Filter for travel segment task types
    76→      const { data, error } = await supabase
    77→        .from('tasks')
    78→        .select('id, status, params')
    79→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
    80→        .in('status', [TASK_STATUS.QUEUED, TASK_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS])
    81→        .in('task_type', ['travel_segment', 'individual_travel_segment']);
    82→
    83→      if (error) {
    84→        // Don't log here - React Query will retry automatically.
    85→        // Errors are only surfaced via the query's error state after retries exhausted.
    86→        throw error;
    87→      }
    88→
    89→      // Extract pair_shot_generation_id from each task
    90→      const tasks: PendingSegmentTask[] = (data || []).map(task => ({
    91→        id: task.id,
    92→        status: task.status,
    93→        pair_shot_generation_id: extractPairShotGenId(task.params as Record<string, unknown> | null),
    94→      }));
    95→
    96→      // Filter to only tasks for this shot (by checking if pair_shot_generation_id exists)
    97→      // Note: We can't directly filter by shot_id in the query since it's in params
    98→      // The pair_shot_generation_id links to a shot_generations record for this shot
    99→
   100→      return tasks;
   101→    },
   102→    enabled: !!shotId && !!projectId,
   103→    // Poll frequently to catch status changes
   104→    refetchInterval: 3000,
   105→    // Mark as stale immediately so invalidations trigger refetch
   106→    staleTime: 0,
   107→    // Short cache time - don't keep stale data around
   108→    gcTime: 10000,
   109→    // Always refetch when window regains focus
   110→    refetchOnWindowFocus: 'always',
   111→  });
   112→
   113→  // Build a map of pair_shot_generation_id -> status
   114→  const { pendingPairIds, statusMap } = useMemo(() => {
   115→    const ids = new Set<string>();
   116→    const map = new Map<string, string>();
   117→
   118→    (pendingTasks || []).forEach(task => {
   119→      if (task.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   120→        ids.add(task.pair_shot_generation_id);
   121→        map.set(task.pair_shot_generation_id, task.status);
   122→      }
   123→    });
   124→
   125→    return { pendingPairIds: ids, statusMap: map };
   126→  }, [pendingTasks]);
   127→
   128→  // Clear optimistic IDs that are either:
   129→  // 1. Confirmed (appear in real pending tasks)
   130→  // 2. Expired (older than timeout and not in real pending - task was cancelled/failed)
   131→  useEffect(() => {
   132→    if (optimisticPending.size === 0 || isLoading) return;
   133→
   134→    const now = Date.now();
   135→
   136→    setOptimisticPending(prev => {
   137→      const next = new Map<string, number>();
   138→      let changed = false;
   139→
   140→      prev.forEach((addedAt, id) => {
   141→        const isInRealPending = pendingPairIds.has(id);
   142→        const isExpired = now - addedAt > OPTIMISTIC_TIMEOUT_MS;
   143→
   144→        if (isInRealPending) {
   145→          // Confirmed by real query - clear from optimistic (real will show it)
   146→          changed = true;
   147→        } else if (isExpired) {
   148→          // Not in real pending after timeout - was cancelled or failed
   149→          changed = true;
   150→        } else {
   151→          // Keep it - still within timeout window
   152→          next.set(id, addedAt);
   153→        }
   154→      });
   155→
   156→      return changed ? next : prev;
   157→    });
   158→  }, [pendingPairIds, optimisticPending.size, isLoading, OPTIMISTIC_TIMEOUT_MS]);
   159→
   160→  // Add an optimistic pending ID for immediate UI feedback
   161→  const addOptimisticPending = useCallback((pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined) => {
   162→    if (pairShotGenerationId) {
   163→      setOptimisticPending(prev => new Map(prev).set(pairShotGenerationId, Date.now()));
   164→    }
   165→  }, []);
   166→
   167→  // Helper to check if a pair has a pending task (real or optimistic)
   168→  const hasPendingTask = useCallback((pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined): boolean => {
   169→    if (!pairShotGenerationId) return false;
   170→    return pendingPairIds.has(pairShotGenerationId) || optimisticPending.has(pairShotGenerationId);
   171→  }, [pendingPairIds, optimisticPending]);
   172→
   173→  // Helper to get task status for a pair
   174→  const getTaskStatus = useCallback((pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined): string | null => {
   175→    if (!pairShotGenerationId) return null;
   176→    return statusMap.get(pairShotGenerationId) || null;
   177→  }, [statusMap]);
   178→
   179→  return {
   180→    hasPendingTask,
   181→    getTaskStatus,
   182→    pendingPairIds,
   183→    isLoading,
   184→    addOptimisticPending,
   185→  };
   186→}
   187→
   188→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { usePendingSegmentTasks } instead
   189→

     7→
     8→import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     9→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    10→import { GenerationRow } from '@/types/shots';
    11→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    12→import { generateAndUploadThumbnail } from '@/shared/utils/videoThumbnailGenerator';
    13→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    14→
    15→interface UseBackgroundThumbnailGeneratorOptions {
    16→  videos: GenerationRow[];
    17→  projectId: string | null;
    18→  enabled?: boolean;
    19→}
    20→
    21→interface GenerationStatus {
    22→  generationId: string;
    23→  status: 'pending' | 'processing' | 'success' | 'error';
    24→  error?: string;
    25→}
    26→
    27→export function useBackgroundThumbnailGenerator({
    28→  videos,
    29→  projectId,
    30→  enabled = true,
    31→}: UseBackgroundThumbnailGeneratorOptions) {
    32→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    33→  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<Record<string, GenerationStatus>>({});
    34→  const processingRef = useRef(false);
    35→  const queueRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
    36→
    37→  // Identify videos without thumbnails
    38→  useEffect(() => {
    39→
    40→    if (!enabled || !projectId) {
    41→      return;
    42→    }
    43→
    44→    const videosWithoutThumbnails = videos.filter(video => {
    45→      // Debug each video
    46→      const videoUrl = video.location || video.url;
    47→      const hasUrl = !!videoUrl;
    48→      
    49→      // Check if it's a video by looking at the URL extension or isVideo property
    50→      const urlLooksLikeVideo = videoUrl && /\.(mp4|mov|avi|webm|mkv)$/i.test(videoUrl);
    51→      const isDefinitelyVideo = video.isVideo === true || urlLooksLikeVideo;
    52→      
    53→      // A "real thumbnail" is an image file (jpg/png/webp), not another video file
    54→      const thumbIsImageFile = video.thumbUrl && /\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|gif)$/i.test(video.thumbUrl);
    55→      const thumbIsDifferentFromVideo = video.thumbUrl && video.thumbUrl !== video.location && video.thumbUrl !== video.url;
    56→      const hasRealThumbnail = thumbIsImageFile && thumbIsDifferentFromVideo;
    57→      
    58→      const currentStatus = statuses[video.id]?.status;
    59→      
    60→      // Must be a video (check isVideo property or URL extension)
    61→      if (!isDefinitelyVideo) return false;
    62→      
    63→      // Must have a video URL
    64→      if (!hasUrl) return false;
    65→      
    66→      // Must NOT have a real image thumbnail (if thumbUrl is .mp4, it's not a real thumbnail!)
    67→      if (hasRealThumbnail) return false;
    68→      
    69→      // Must not already be processed, processing, or errored (avoid retry loops)
    70→      if (currentStatus === 'processing' || currentStatus === 'success' || currentStatus === 'error') return false;
    71→      
    72→      return true;
    73→    });
    74→
    75→    if (videosWithoutThumbnails.length > 0) {
    76→
    77→      // Add to queue (avoid duplicates)
    78→      const newVideoIds = videosWithoutThumbnails
    79→        .map(v => v.id)
    80→        .filter(id => !queueRef.current.includes(id));
    81→      
    82→      if (newVideoIds.length > 0) {
    83→        queueRef.current = [...queueRef.current, ...newVideoIds];
    84→        
    85→        // Mark as pending
    86→        const newStatuses: Record<string, GenerationStatus> = {};
    87→        newVideoIds.forEach(id => {
    88→          newStatuses[id] = { generationId: id, status: 'pending' };
    89→        });
    90→        setStatuses(prev => ({ ...prev, ...newStatuses }));
    91→      }
    92→    }
    93→  }, [videos, projectId, enabled, statuses]);
    94→
    95→  // Process queue
    96→  useEffect(() => {
    97→    if (!enabled || !projectId || processingRef.current || queueRef.current.length === 0) {
    98→      return;
    99→    }
   100→
   101→    const processNextVideo = async () => {
   102→      processingRef.current = true;
   103→      
   104→      const generationId = queueRef.current[0];
   105→      const video = videos.find(v => v.id === generationId);
   106→      
   107→      if (!video) {
   108→        queueRef.current.shift();
   109→        processingRef.current = false;
   110→        return;
   111→      }
   112→
   113→      const videoUrl = video.location || video.url;
   114→      if (!videoUrl) {
   115→        queueRef.current.shift();
   116→        processingRef.current = false;
   117→        return;
   118→      }
   119→
   120→      // Update status to processing
   121→      setStatuses(prev => ({
   122→        ...prev,
   123→        [generationId]: { generationId, status: 'processing' }
   124→      }));
   125→
   126→      // Generate and upload thumbnail
   127→      const result = await generateAndUploadThumbnail(videoUrl, generationId, projectId);
   128→
   129→      if (result.success && result.thumbnailUrl) {
   130→
   131→        // Update status
   132→        setStatuses(prev => ({
   133→          ...prev,
   134→          [generationId]: { generationId, status: 'success' }
   135→        }));
   136→
   137→        // Invalidate React Query cache to refresh the UI
   138→        // This will trigger a refetch and show the new thumbnail
   139→        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   140→
   141→        // Also update the cache directly for immediate UI update
   142→        queryClient.setQueriesData(
   143→          { [REDACTED] },
   144→          (oldData: { items: Array<{ id: string; [key: string]: unknown }> } | undefined) => {
   145→            if (!oldData?.items) return oldData;
   146→
   147→            return {
   148→              ...oldData,
   149→              items: oldData.items.map((item) =>
   150→                item.id === generationId 
   151→                  ? { ...item, thumbUrl: result.thumbnailUrl }
   152→                  : item
   153→              )
   154→            };
   155→          }
   156→        );
   157→      } else {
   158→        handleError(new Error(result.error || 'Thumbnail generation failed'), { context: 'useBackgroundThumbnailGenerator', showToast: false, logData: { generationId: generationId.substring(0, 8) } });
   159→
   160→        // Update status to error
   161→        setStatuses(prev => ({
   162→          ...prev,
   163→          [generationId]: { 
   164→            generationId, 
   165→            status: 'error',
   166→            error: result.error 
   167→          }
   168→        }));
   169→      }
   170→
   171→      // Remove from queue
   172→      queueRef.current.shift();
   173→      processingRef.current = false;
   174→
   175→      // Wait a bit before processing next (to avoid overwhelming the system)
   176→      setTimeout(() => {
   177→        if (queueRef.current.length > 0) {
   178→          processNextVideo();
   179→        }
   180→      }, 2000); // 2 second delay between generations
   181→    };
   182→
   183→    processNextVideo();
   184→  }, [enabled, projectId, videos, queryClient, queueRef.current.length]);
   185→
   186→  return {
   187→    statuses,
   188→    queueLength: queueRef.current.length,
   189→    isProcessing: processingRef.current,
   190→  };
   191→}
   192→
   193→

    54→  userHasSetPrompt: boolean;
    55→
    56→  /** Whether user has made an edit that diverges from the base (after enhancement) */
    57→  userHasEditedAfterEnhancement: boolean;
    58→
    59→  /**
    60→   * Handle typing in the textarea.
    61→   * Saves to settings.prompt. If this differs from basePromptForEnhancement,
    62→   * the user's edit will take priority over the enhanced prompt.
    63→   */
    64→  handleChange: (value: string) => void;
    65→
    66→  /**
    67→   * Handle clear button or "Use Default" action.
    68→   * Clears BOTH user edit AND enhanced prompt → falls back to shot defaults.
    69→   */
    70→  handleClearAll: () => void;
    71→
    72→  /**
    73→   * Handle clearing just the enhanced prompt (from Enhanced badge hover).
    74→   * Clears enhanced → reveals the base prompt (settings.prompt or shot default).
    75→   */
    76→  handleClearEnhanced: () => void;
    77→
    78→  /**
    79→   * Handle voice input result.
    80→   * Saves to settings.prompt (same as typing).
    81→   */
    82→  handleVoiceResult: (result: { prompt?: string; transcription?: string }) => void;
    83→}
    84→
    85→/**
    86→ * Hook to manage prompt field state with smart priority logic.
    87→ *
    88→ * The key insight is using basePromptForEnhancement to distinguish:
    89→ * - "settings.prompt is the original base" → show enhanced prompt
    90→ * - "settings.prompt is a user edit" → show user's edit
    91→ *
    92→ * @example
    93→ * ```tsx
    94→ * const prompt = usePromptFieldState({
    95→ *   settingsPrompt: settings.prompt,
    96→ *   enhancedPrompt,
    97→ *   basePromptForEnhancement,
    98→ *   defaultPrompt: shotDefaults?.prompt,
    99→ *   onSettingsChange: (value) => onChange({ prompt: value }),
   100→ *   onClearEnhancedPrompt,
   101→ * });
   102→ *
   103→ * return (
   104→ *   <>
   105→ *     {prompt.badgeType === 'enhanced' && <EnhancedBadge onClear={prompt.handleClearEnhanced} />}
   106→ *     <Textarea
   107→ *       value={prompt.displayValue}
   108→ *       onChange={(e) => prompt.handleChange(e.target.value)}
   109→ *       onClear={prompt.handleClearAll}
   110→ *     />
   111→ *   </>
   112→ * );
   113→ * ```
   114→ */
   115→export function usePromptFieldState({
   116→  settingsPrompt,
   117→  enhancedPrompt,
   118→  basePromptForEnhancement,
   119→  defaultPrompt,
   120→  onSettingsChange,
   121→  onClearEnhancedPrompt,
   122→}: UsePromptFieldStateOptions): PromptFieldState {
   123→  // Derived state
   124→  const hasEnhancedPrompt = !!enhancedPrompt?.trim();
   125→  const hasSettingsPrompt = settingsPrompt !== undefined;
   126→  const hasDefaultPrompt = defaultPrompt !== undefined;
   127→
   128→  // Check if user has edited AFTER enhancement was created
   129→  // This is true if:
   130→  // 1. settings.prompt exists
   131→  // 2. AND it's different from the base that was used for enhancement
   132→  const userHasEditedAfterEnhancement = useMemo(() => {
   133→    if (settingsPrompt === undefined) return false;
   134→    if (!hasEnhancedPrompt) return false; // No enhancement to compare against
   135→
   136→    // If we have the base that was used for enhancement, compare against it
   137→    if (basePromptForEnhancement !== undefined) {
   138→      return settingsPrompt.trim() !== basePromptForEnhancement.trim();
   139→    }
   140→
   141→    // Fallback: if no base stored (older data), compare against enhanced prompt itself
   142→    // User has edited if their prompt differs from the displayed enhanced value
   143→    return enhancedPrompt ? settingsPrompt.trim() !== enhancedPrompt.trim() : false;
   144→  }, [hasSettingsPrompt, hasEnhancedPrompt, settingsPrompt, basePromptForEnhancement, enhancedPrompt]);
   145→
   146→  // Calculate display value and badge type
   147→  const { displayValue, badgeType } = useMemo(() => {
   148→    // Priority 1: User edited after enhancement → show their edit
   149→    if (userHasEditedAfterEnhancement && settingsPrompt !== undefined) {
   150→      return { displayValue: settingsPrompt, badgeType: null as PromptBadgeType };
   151→    }
   152→
   153→    // Priority 2: Enhanced prompt exists → show it
   154→    if (enhancedPrompt?.trim()) {
   155→      return { displayValue: enhancedPrompt, badgeType: 'enhanced' as PromptBadgeType };
   156→    }
   157→
   158→    // Priority 3: settings.prompt exists (no enhancement, or same as base)
   159→    if (settingsPrompt !== undefined) {
   160→      return { displayValue: settingsPrompt, badgeType: null as PromptBadgeType };
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    // Priority 4: Fall back to shot defaults
   164→    if (defaultPrompt !== undefined) {
   165→      return { displayValue: defaultPrompt, badgeType: 'default' as PromptBadgeType };
   166→    }
   167→
   168→    // Nothing set
   169→    return { displayValue: '', badgeType: null as PromptBadgeType };
   170→  }, [
   171→    userHasEditedAfterEnhancement,
   172→    settingsPrompt,
   173→    enhancedPrompt,
   174→    defaultPrompt,
   175→    hasEnhancedPrompt,
   176→    hasSettingsPrompt,
   177→    hasDefaultPrompt,
   178→  ]);
   179→
   180→  // Handlers
   181→  const handleChange = useCallback((value: string) => {
   182→    onSettingsChange(value);
   183→  }, [onSettingsChange]);
   184→
   185→  const handleClearAll = useCallback(() => {
   186→    // Clear user edit (undefined = use defaults)
   187→    onSettingsChange(undefined);
   188→    // Also clear enhanced prompt
   189→    onClearEnhancedPrompt?.();
   190→  }, [onSettingsChange, onClearEnhancedPrompt]);
   191→
   192→  const handleClearEnhanced = useCallback(() => {
   193→    // Only clear enhanced prompt
   194→    // This reveals the base prompt (settings.prompt or shot default)
   195→    onClearEnhancedPrompt?.();
   196→  }, [onClearEnhancedPrompt]);
   197→
   198→  const handleVoiceResult = useCallback((result: { prompt?: string; transcription?: string }) => {
   199→    onSettingsChange(result.prompt || result.transcription || '');
   200→  }, [onSettingsChange]);
   201→
   202→  return {
   203→    displayValue,
   204→    badgeType,
   205→    hasEnhancedPrompt,
   206→    userHasSetPrompt: hasSettingsPrompt,
   207→    userHasEditedAfterEnhancement,
   208→    handleChange,
   209→    handleClearAll,
   210→    handleClearEnhanced,
   211→    handleVoiceResult,
   212→  };
   213→}
   214→

1→/**
     2→ * CRITICAL RACE CONDITION FIXES IMPLEMENTED:
     3→ * 
     4→ * 1. Session Management: Each loading session has a unique ID and AbortController
     5→ * 2. Proper Cancellation: All timeouts and operations are properly canceled when superseded
     6→ * 3. Reconciliation Tracking: Uses reconciliation IDs to prevent stale state updates
     7→ * 4. Safe State Updates: All setState calls check if the session is still active
     8→ * 5. Memory Leak Prevention: Comprehensive cleanup on unmount and session changes
     9→ * 
    10→ * This addresses the mobile stalling issues caused by competing progressive loading sessions.
    11→ */
    12→
    13→import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
    14→import { hasLoadedImage } from '@/shared/lib/preloading';
    15→
    16→interface ImageWithId {

    33→
    34→// Session management for proper cleanup and race condition prevention
    35→interface LoadingSession {
    36→  id: string;

    38→  timeouts: (NodeJS.Timeout | number)[];
    39→  rafIds: number[]; // requestAnimationFrame handles
    40→  isActive: boolean;
    41→  startTime: number;

    43→
    44→export const useProgressiveImageLoading = ({ 
    45→  images, 
    46→  page, 
    47→  enabled = true,
    48→  onImagesReady,
    49→  isMobile,
    50→  useIntersectionObserver = true, // Enable by default for better mobile performance
    51→  isLightboxOpen = false, // Pause loading when lightbox is open
    52→}: UseProgressiveImageLoadingProps) => {
    53→  const [showImageIndices, setShowImageIndices] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
    54→  const currentPageRef = useRef(page);
    55→  const lastTriggerTimeRef = useRef<number>(0);
    56→  const activeSessionRef = useRef<LoadingSession | null>(null);
    57→  const reconciliationIdRef = useRef<number>(0);
    58→  
    59→  // Create a stable identifier for the image set to detect changes
    60→  // This prevents the bug where server pagination with same-length pages wouldn't trigger
    61→  // Include page number to ensure uniqueness across pages, and use first/last images for better coverage
    62→  const imageSetId = React.useMemo(() => {
    63→    if (images.length === 0) return `empty-${page}`;
    64→    // Use first 2 and last 1 image IDs plus page number for better uniqueness
    65→    // This ensures different pages are detected even if they share some images
    66→    const firstIds = images.slice(0, 2).map(img => img?.id).join(',');
    67→    const lastId = images.length > 2 ? images[images.length - 1]?.id : '';
    68→    return `${page}-${firstIds}-${lastId}`;
    69→  }, [images, page]);
    70→  
    71→  // Helper function to safely cancel a loading session
    72→  const cancelActiveSession = (_reason: string) => {
    73→    if (activeSessionRef.current?.isActive) {
    74→      // Abort any ongoing operations
    75→      activeSessionRef.current.abortController.abort();
    76→
    77→      // Clear all timeouts
    78→      activeSessionRef.current.timeouts.forEach(timeout => clearTimeout(timeout));

   124→    const abortController = new AbortController();

   153→      }
   154→      return false;
   155→    };

   183→    if (stableOnImagesReady.current && isSessionActive()) {

   185→      const rafId1 = requestAnimationFrame(() => {

1→/**
     2→ * useLoadVariantImages Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Loads a variant's source images onto the timeline by switching primary variants.
     5→ * For each image position (start, end) where the image differs:
     6→ * - Same generation, different variant → find and set as primary
     7→ * - Same generation, match by URL → find and set as primary
     8→ * - Different generation entirely → create new variant with source URL, set as primary
     9→ */
    10→
    11→import { useCallback, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
    12→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    13→import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    14→import { invalidateVariantChange } from '@/shared/hooks/useGenerationInvalidation';
    15→import { handleError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandler';
    16→import type { GenerationVariant } from '@/shared/hooks/useVariants';
    17→import type { CurrentSegmentImagesData } from '@/shared/components/VariantSelector/utils';
    18→
    19→interface UseLoadVariantImagesProps {
    20→  currentSegmentImages?: CurrentSegmentImagesData & {
    21→    startShotGenerationId?: string;
    22→    endShotGenerationId?: string;
    23→  };
    24→}
    25→
    26→/**
    27→ * Extract the storage path from a full URL or relative path for matching.
    28→ */
    29→function extractStoragePath(url: string | undefined | null): string | null {
    30→  if (!url) return null;
    31→  const storageMatch = url.match(/\/storage\/v1\/object\/(?:public|sign)\/(.+?)(?:\?|$)/);
    32→  if (storageMatch) return storageMatch[1];
    33→  if (url.startsWith('generations/') || url.startsWith('/generations/')) {
    34→    return url.replace(/^\//, '');
    35→  }
    36→  return url;
    37→}
    38→
    39→function pathsMatch(url1: string | undefined | null, url2: string | undefined | null): boolean {
    40→  if (!url1 || !url2) return false;
    41→  if (url1 === url2) return true;
    42→  const p1 = extractStoragePath(url1);
    43→  const p2 = extractStoragePath(url2);
    44→  return !!p1 && !!p2 && p1 === p2;
    45→}
    46→
    47→export function useLoadVariantImages({ currentSegmentImages }: UseLoadVariantImagesProps) {
    48→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    49→  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
    50→
    51→  // Clean up on unmount
    52→  useEffect(() => {
    53→    return () => {
    54→      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    55→    };
    56→  }, []);
    57→
    58→  const loadVariantImages = useCallback(async (variant: GenerationVariant) => {
    59→    // Abort any previous in-flight request
    60→    abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    61→    abortControllerRef.current = new AbortController();
    62→    const signal = abortControllerRef.current.signal;
    63→
    64→    if (!currentSegmentImages) return;
    65→
    66→    const params = variant.params;
    67→    if (!params) return;
    68→
    69→    // Extract source image data from variant params
    70→    const indivParams = (params.individual_segment_params || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    71→    const resolvedPaths = (indivParams.input_image_paths_resolved || params.input_image_paths_resolved) as string[] | undefined;
    72→
    73→    const variantStartGenId = (indivParams.start_image_generation_id || params.start_image_generation_id) as string | undefined;
    74→    const variantEndGenId = (indivParams.end_image_generation_id || params.end_image_generation_id) as string | undefined;
    75→    const variantStartVariantId = (indivParams.start_image_variant_id || params.start_image_variant_id) as string | undefined;
    76→    const variantEndVariantId = (indivParams.end_image_variant_id || params.end_image_variant_id) as string | undefined;
    77→    const variantStartUrl = resolvedPaths?.[0] || (indivParams.start_image_url || params.start_image_url) as string | undefined;
    78→    const variantEndUrl = resolvedPaths && resolvedPaths.length > 1
    79→      ? resolvedPaths[resolvedPaths.length - 1]
    80→      : (indivParams.end_image_url || params.end_image_url) as string | undefined;
    81→
    82→    // Process each image position
    83→    const positions = [
    84→      {
    85→        variantGenId: variantStartGenId,
    86→        variantVariantId: variantStartVariantId,
    87→        variantUrl: variantStartUrl,
    88→        currentGenId: currentSegmentImages.startGenerationId,
    89→        currentVariantId: currentSegmentImages.startVariantId,
    90→        currentUrl: currentSegmentImages.startUrl,
    91→      },
    92→      {
    93→        variantGenId: variantEndGenId,
    94→        variantVariantId: variantEndVariantId,
    95→        variantUrl: variantEndUrl,
    96→        currentGenId: currentSegmentImages.endGenerationId,
    97→        currentVariantId: currentSegmentImages.endVariantId,
    98→        currentUrl: currentSegmentImages.endUrl,
    99→      },
   100→    ];
   101→
   102→    for (const pos of positions) {
   103→      // Skip if no source data or no current data
   104→      if (!pos.variantGenId && !pos.variantUrl) continue;
   105→      if (!pos.currentGenId) continue;
   106→
   107→      // Check if this request was superseded before each async operation
   108→      if (signal.aborted) return;
   109→
   110→      try {
   111→        await loadSingleImage({
   112→          variantGenId: pos.variantGenId,
   113→          variantVariantId: pos.variantVariantId,
   114→          variantUrl: pos.variantUrl,
   115→          currentGenId: pos.currentGenId,
   116→          currentVariantId: pos.currentVariantId,
   117→          currentUrl: pos.currentUrl,
   118→        });
   119→
   120→        if (signal.aborted) return;
   121→
   122→        // Invalidate caches for this generation
   123→        await invalidateVariantChange(queryClient, {
   124→          generationId: pos.currentGenId,
   125→          reason: 'load-variant-images',
   126→        });
   127→
   128→        if (signal.aborted) return;
   129→      } catch (error) {
   130→        if (signal.aborted) return;
   131→        handleError(error, { context: 'LoadVariantImages', showToast: false });
   132→      }
   133→    }
   134→  }, [currentSegmentImages, queryClient]);
   135→
   136→  return { loadVariantImages };
   137→}
   138→
   139→/**
   140→ * Load a single image position: find or create the variant and make it primary.
   141→ */
   142→async function loadSingleImage(pos: {
   143→  variantGenId: string | undefined;
   144→  variantVariantId: string | undefined;
   145→  variantUrl: string | undefined;
   146→  currentGenId: string;
   147→  currentVariantId: string | undefined;
   148→  currentUrl: string | undefined;
   149→}) {
   150→  // Check if images actually differ
   151→  if (pos.variantGenId === pos.currentGenId) {
   152→    if (pos.variantVariantId && pos.currentVariantId && pos.variantVariantId === pos.currentVariantId) {
   153→      return; // Same variant, nothing to do
   154→    }
   155→    if (!pos.variantVariantId && !pos.currentVariantId) {
   156→      if (pathsMatch(pos.variantUrl, pos.currentUrl)) return;
   157→    }
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  const targetGenerationId = pos.currentGenId;
   161→
   162→  // Strategy 1: Same generation - find variant by ID
   163→  if (pos.variantGenId === pos.currentGenId && pos.variantVariantId) {
   164→    await setPrimaryById(pos.variantVariantId);
   165→    return;
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  // Strategy 2: Find variant by URL match on the current generation
   169→  if (pos.variantUrl) {
   170→    const { data: existingVariants } = await supabase
   171→      .from('generation_variants')
   172→      .select('id, location')
   173→      .eq('generation_id', targetGenerationId);
   174→
   175→    if (existingVariants) {
   176→      const match = existingVariants.find(v => pathsMatch(v.location, pos.variantUrl));
   177→      if (match) {
   178→        await setPrimaryById(match.id);
   179→        return;
   180→      }
   181→    }
   182→
   183→    // Strategy 3: Create new variant with the source URL
   184→    const { error } = await supabase
   185→      .from('generation_variants')
   186→      .insert({
   187→        generation_id: targetGenerationId,
   188→        location: pos.variantUrl,
   189→        thumbnail_url: pos.variantUrl,
   190→        is_primary: true, // DB trigger handles unsetting old primary
   191→        variant_type: 'loaded',
   192→        params: {
   193→          source_generation_id: pos.variantGenId,
   194→          loaded_from_variant: pos.variantVariantId,
   195→          source_url: pos.variantUrl,
   196→        },
   197→      })
   198→      .select('id')
   199→      .single();
   200→
   201→    if (error) {
   202→      throw new Error(`Failed to create variant: ${error.message}`);
   203→    }
   204→  }
   205→}
   206→
   207→/**
   208→ * Set a variant as primary by ID. DB trigger handles unsetting the old primary.
   209→ */
   210→async function setPrimaryById(variantId: string) {
   211→  const { error } = await supabase
   212→    .from('generation_variants')
   213→    .update({ is_primary: true })
   214→    .eq('id', variantId);
   215→
   216→  if (error) {
   217→    throw new Error(`Failed to set primary variant: ${error.message}`);
   218→  }
   219→}
   220→

1→/**
     2→ * useAdjacentPagePreloader
     3→ *
     4→ * Unified hook for preloading adjacent gallery pages.
     5→ * Handles React Query prefetching + image preloading + cache cleanup in one place.
     6→ *
     7→ * This replaces the previous scattered approach where:
     8→ * - Page components had handlePrefetchAdjacentPages callbacks
     9→ * - Those callbacks manually called queryClient.prefetchQuery + smartPreloadImages
    10→ * - ImagePreloadManager separately ran useImagePreloading + useCacheCleanup
    11→ *
    12→ * Now: Just use this hook in MediaGallery. Pages don't need to know about preloading.
    13→ */
    14→
    15→import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
    16→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    17→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    18→import { fetchGenerations } from '@/shared/hooks/useProjectGenerations';
    19→import {
    20→  preloadingService,
    21→  clearLoadedImages,
    22→  PRIORITY_VALUES,
    23→} from '@/shared/lib/preloading';
    24→
    25→interface UseAdjacentPagePreloaderProps {
    26→  /** Project ID to scope queries */
    27→  projectId: string | null;
    28→  /** Current page (1-indexed, as used by the API) */
    29→  currentPage: number;
    30→  /** Items per page */
    31→  itemsPerPage: number;
    32→  /** Filters object (will be stringified for cache key) */
    33→  filters?: Record<string, unknown>;
    34→  /** Total items (for calculating total pages) */
    35→  totalItems?: number;
    36→  /** Whether preloading is enabled */
    37→  enabled?: boolean;
    38→  /** Pause preloading (e.g., when lightbox is open) */
    39→  paused?: boolean;
    40→}
    41→
    42→interface PaginatedResponse {
    43→  items?: Array<{ id?: string; url?: string; thumbUrl?: string }>;
    44→  total?: number;
    45→}
    46→
    47→/**
    48→ * Clean up distant page queries from React Query cache.
    49→ * Keeps pages within ±keepRange of current page.
    50→ */
    51→function cleanupDistantPages(
    52→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    53→  projectId: string,
    54→  currentPage: number,
    55→  keepRange: number = 2
    56→): void {
    57→  const allQueries = queryClient.getQueryCache().getAll();
    58→
    59→  allQueries.forEach((query) => {
    60→    const key = query.queryKey as unknown[];
    61→    if (!Array.isArray(key)) return;
    62→
    63→    // Match unified format: ['unified-generations', 'project', projectId, page, ...]
    64→    if (
    65→      key[0] === 'unified-generations' &&
    66→      key[1] === 'project' &&
    67→      key[2] === projectId
    68→    ) {
    69→      const page = key[3];
    70→      if (typeof page === 'number' && Math.abs(page - currentPage) > keepRange) {
    71→        // Clear load tracker for removed pages
    72→        const data = query.state?.data as PaginatedResponse | undefined;
    73→        if (data?.items) {
    74→          clearLoadedImages(data.items.filter((item): item is { id: string } => !!item.id));
    75→        }
    76→        // Remove the query
    77→        queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: query.queryKey });
    78→      }
    79→    }
    80→  });
    81→}
    82→
    83→/**
    84→ * Unified hook for preloading adjacent gallery pages.
    85→ */
    86→export function useAdjacentPagePreloader({
    87→  projectId,
    88→  currentPage,
    89→  itemsPerPage,
    90→  filters,
    91→  totalItems,
    92→  enabled = true,
    93→  paused = false,
    94→}: UseAdjacentPagePreloaderProps): void {
    95→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    96→
    97→  // Use shared service for config
    98→  const config = preloadingService.getConfig();
    99→
   100→  // Stable filters string for dependency array (to detect when filters change)
   101→  // We stringify for the dependency array but pass the object to query keys
   102→  const filtersString = useMemo(
   103→    () => (filters ? JSON.stringify(filters) : null),
   104→    [filters]
   105→  );
   106→
   107→  // Calculate total pages
   108→  const totalPages = useMemo(() => {
   109→    if (totalItems !== undefined && totalItems > 0) {
   110→      return Math.ceil(totalItems / itemsPerPage);
   111→    }
   112→    return Infinity; // Unknown, assume there's always more
   113→  }, [totalItems, itemsPerPage]);
   114→
   115→  useEffect(() => {
   116→    // Skip if disabled, paused, or no project
   117→    if (!enabled || paused || !projectId) {
   118→      return;
   119→    }
   120→
   121→    // Clear pending preloads from previous page
   122→    preloadingService.clearQueue();
   123→
   124→    // Debounce: wait for user to settle on a page
   125→    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
   126→      const hasPrevPage = currentPage > 1;
   127→      const hasNextPage = currentPage < totalPages;
   128→
   129→      // IMPORTANT: Pass the filters object directly to query keys (not stringified)
   130→      // This must match how useProjectGenerations creates its query keys
   131→      // The filtersString is only used for the effect dependency array
   132→
   133→      // Prefetch next page (higher priority)
   134→      if (hasNextPage) {
   135→        const nextPage = currentPage + 1;
   136→        try {
   137→          await queryClient.prefetchQuery({
   138→            [REDACTED](
   139→              projectId,
   140→              nextPage,
   141→              itemsPerPage,
   142→              filters // Pass object, not string
   143→            ),
   144→            queryFn: () =>
   145→              fetchGenerations(
   146→                projectId,
   147→                itemsPerPage,
   148→                (nextPage - 1) * itemsPerPage,
   149→                filters
   150→              ),
   151→            staleTime: 30_000,
   152→          });
   153→
   154→          // Preload images from prefetched data
   155→          const cached = queryClient.getQueryData<PaginatedResponse>(
   156→            queryKeys.unified.byProject(projectId, nextPage, itemsPerPage, filters)
   157→          );
   158→          if (cached?.items) {
   159→            preloadingService.preloadImages(cached.items, PRIORITY_VALUES.high);
   160→          }
   161→        } catch (err) {
   162→          // Prefetch failures are non-critical, just log
   163→        }
   164→      }
   165→
   166→      // Prefetch previous page (lower priority)
   167→      if (hasPrevPage) {
   168→        const prevPage = currentPage - 1;
   169→        try {
   170→          await queryClient.prefetchQuery({
   171→            [REDACTED](
   172→              projectId,
   173→              prevPage,
   174→              itemsPerPage,
   175→              filters // Pass object, not string
   176→            ),
   177→            queryFn: () =>
   178→              fetchGenerations(
   179→                projectId,
   180→                itemsPerPage,
   181→                (prevPage - 1) * itemsPerPage,
   182→                filters
   183→              ),
   184→            staleTime: 30_000,
   185→          });
   186→
   187→          const cached = queryClient.getQueryData<PaginatedResponse>(
   188→            queryKeys.unified.byProject(projectId, prevPage, itemsPerPage, filters)
   189→          );
   190→          if (cached?.items) {
   191→            preloadingService.preloadImages(cached.items, PRIORITY_VALUES.normal);
   192→          }
   193→        } catch (err) {
   194→        }
   195→      }
   196→
   197→      // Clean up distant pages
   198→      cleanupDistantPages(queryClient, projectId, currentPage, 2);
   199→    }, config.debounceMs);
   200→
   201→    return () => {
   202→      clearTimeout(timer);
   203→      // Clear queue on page change to prioritize new adjacent pages
   204→      preloadingService.clearQueue();
   205→    };
   206→  }, [
   207→    enabled,
   208→    paused,
   209→    projectId,
   210→    currentPage,
   211→    itemsPerPage,
   212→    filters, // Include filters object for reference equality checks
   213→    filtersString, // Include string for content change detection
   214→    totalPages,
   215→    queryClient,
   216→    config,
   217→  ]);
   218→
   219→  // Note: We don't clear queue on unmount because other components may be using it
   220→  // The service handles cleanup on project change
   221→}
   222→

1→/**
     2→ * useServerForm - Generic "form over server state" pattern.
     3→ *
     4→ * This is NOT a settings hook. It provides local editing state on top of any
     5→ * server data source (React Query, custom fetch, etc.). Use it for editing
     6→ * arbitrary server records, not for tool/UI settings persistence.
     7→ *
     8→ * For persisting tool settings, use `useAutoSaveSettings` instead.
     9→ *
    10→ * Features:
    11→ * - Local state management with dirty tracking
    12→ * - Optional auto-save with configurable debounce
    13→ * - Unmount flush (best-effort save of unsaved changes)
    14→ * - Context switching (reset on key change)
    15→ *
    16→ * @see docs/structure_detail/settings_system.md for the settings hook decision tree
    17→ *
    18→ * @example
    19→ * ```tsx
    20→ * const form = useServerForm({
    21→ *   serverData: queryData,
    22→ *   isLoading,
    23→ *   toLocal: (server) => transformToFormState(server),
    24→ *   save: async (local) => saveMutation(local),
    25→ *   autoSaveMs: 500,
    26→ *   contextKey: itemId, // Reset when switching items
    27→ * });
    28→ *
    29→ * return (
    30→ *   <input
    31→ *     value={form.data.name}
    32→ *     onChange={(e) => form.update({ name: e.target.value })}
    33→ *   />
    34→ * );
    35→ * ```
    36→ */
    37→
    38→import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
    39→
    40→interface UseServerFormOptions<TServer, TLocal> {
    41→  /** Server data (from React Query or other source) */
    42→  serverData: TServer | undefined;
    43→  /** Whether server data is still loading */
    44→  isLoading: boolean;
    45→  /** Transform server data to local form state */
    46→  toLocal: (server: TServer) => TLocal;
    47→  /** Save local state back to server. Returns true on success. */
    48→  save: (local: TLocal) => Promise<boolean>;
    49→  /** Auto-save debounce delay (ms). 0 = no auto-save. Default: 0 */
    50→  autoSaveMs?: number;
    51→  /** Key that triggers reset when changed (e.g., item ID). */
    52→  contextKey?: string | null;
    53→  /** Validate/transform updates before applying */
    54→  validate?: (updates: Partial<TLocal>, current: TLocal) => Partial<TLocal>;
    55→  /** Called when dirty state changes */
    56→  onDirtyChange?: (isDirty: boolean) => void;
    57→}
    58→
    59→interface UseServerFormReturn<TLocal> {
    60→  /** Current form data (local edits if any, otherwise transformed server data) */
    61→  data: TLocal;
    62→  /** Update local state with partial values */
    63→  update: (updates: Partial<TLocal>) => void;
    64→  /** Save current local state to server */
    65→  save: () => Promise<boolean>;
    66→  /** Save specific data to server (bypasses local state) */
    67→  saveData: (data: TLocal) => Promise<boolean>;
    68→  /** Reset to server data (discard local edits) */
    69→  reset: () => void;
    70→  /** Whether there are unsaved local edits */
    71→  isDirty: boolean;
    72→  /** Whether server data is loading */
    73→  isLoading: boolean;
    74→  /** Whether local state exists (user has edited) */
    75→  hasLocalEdits: boolean;
    76→  /** The raw local state (null if no edits) */
    77→  localData: TLocal | null;
    78→}
    79→
    80→export function useServerForm<TServer, TLocal extends Record<string, unknown>>({
    81→  serverData,
    82→  isLoading,
    83→  toLocal,
    84→  save: saveFn,
    85→  autoSaveMs = 0,
    86→  contextKey,
    87→  validate,
    88→  onDirtyChange,
    89→}: UseServerFormOptions<TServer, TLocal>): UseServerFormReturn<TLocal> {
    90→  // Local state for user edits (null = no edits, use server data)
    91→  const [localData, setLocalData] = useState<TLocal | null>(null);
    92→  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);
    93→
    94→  // Refs for auto-save and unmount handling
    95→  const saveTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
    96→  const isDirtyRef = useRef(false);
    97→  const hasUserEdited = useRef(false);
    98→  const saveFnRef = useRef(saveFn);
    99→  const localDataRef = useRef<TLocal | null>(null);
   100→  const prevContextKeyRef = useRef(contextKey);
   101→
   102→  // Keep refs in sync with state
   103→  useEffect(() => {
   104→    isDirtyRef.current = isDirty;
   105→    localDataRef.current = localData;
   106→    saveFnRef.current = saveFn;
   107→  }, [isDirty, localData, saveFn]);
   108→
   109→  // Notify parent of dirty state changes
   110→  useEffect(() => {
   111→    onDirtyChange?.(isDirty);
   112→  }, [isDirty, onDirtyChange]);
   113→
   114→  // Reset on context change (e.g., switching to different item)
   115→  useEffect(() => {
   116→    if (contextKey !== prevContextKeyRef.current) {
   117→      // Clear any pending auto-save
   118→      if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
   119→        clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
   120→        saveTimeoutRef.current = null;
   121→      }
   122→      // Reset local state
   123→      setLocalData(null);
   124→      setIsDirty(false);
   125→      hasUserEdited.current = false;
   126→      prevContextKeyRef.current = contextKey;
   127→    }
   128→  }, [contextKey]);
   129→
   130→  // Transform server data to local format (memoized)
   131→  const transformedServer = useMemo(() => {
   132→    if (serverData === undefined) return null;
   133→    return toLocal(serverData);
   134→  }, [serverData, toLocal]);
   135→
   136→  // Current data = local edits or transformed server data
   137→  const data = localData ?? transformedServer ?? ({} as TLocal);
   138→
   139→  // Update local state
   140→  const update = useCallback(
   141→    (updates: Partial<TLocal>) => {
   142→      setLocalData((prev) => {
   143→        const current = prev ?? transformedServer ?? ({} as TLocal);
   144→        const validated = validate ? validate(updates, current) : updates;
   145→        return { ...current, ...validated };
   146→      });
   147→      setIsDirty(true);
   148→      hasUserEdited.current = true;
   149→    },
   150→    [transformedServer, validate]
   151→  );
   152→
   153→  // Save to server
   154→  const save = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
   155→    const dataToSave = localDataRef.current;
   156→    if (!dataToSave) return true; // Nothing to save
   157→
   158→    const result = await saveFnRef.current(dataToSave);
   159→    if (result) {
   160→      setIsDirty(false);
   161→    }
   162→    return result;
   163→  }, []);
   164→
   165→  // Save specific data (bypasses local state - useful for reset operations)
   166→  const saveData = useCallback(async (dataToSave: TLocal): Promise<boolean> => {
   167→    const result = await saveFnRef.current(dataToSave);
   168→    return result;
   169→  }, []);
   170→
   171→  // Reset to server data
   172→  const reset = useCallback(() => {
   173→    if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
   174→      clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
   175→      saveTimeoutRef.current = null;
   176→    }
   177→    setLocalData(null);
   178→    setIsDirty(false);
   179→    hasUserEdited.current = false;
   180→  }, []);
   181→
   182→  // Auto-save on changes (debounced)
   183→  useEffect(() => {
   184→    if (!autoSaveMs || !hasUserEdited.current || !isDirty || !localData) {
   185→      return;
   186→    }
   187→
   188→    if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
   189→      clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
   190→    }
   191→
   192→    saveTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
   193→      await save();
   194→    }, autoSaveMs);
   195→
   196→    return () => {
   197→      if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
   198→        clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
   199→      }
   200→    };
   201→  }, [localData, isDirty, autoSaveMs, save]);
   202→
   203→  // Flush on unmount
   204→  useEffect(() => {
   205→    return () => {
   206→      if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
   207→        clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
   208→        saveTimeoutRef.current = null;
   209→      }
   210→      // Save if there are unsaved changes
   211→      if (isDirtyRef.current && hasUserEdited.current && localDataRef.current) {
   212→        saveFnRef.current(localDataRef.current);
   213→      }
   214→    };
   215→  }, []); // Only run on mount/unmount
   216→
   217→  return {
   218→    data,
   219→    update,
   220→    save,
   221→    saveData,
   222→    reset,
   223→    isDirty,
   224→    isLoading,
   225→    hasLocalEdits: localData !== null,
   226→    localData,
   227→  };
   228→}
   229→
```

    47→/**
    48→ * Hook to handle uploading LoRA files to HuggingFace via our Edge Function
    49→ */
    50→export function useHuggingFaceUpload() {
    51→  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState<UploadProgress>({
    52→    stage: 'idle',
    53→    message: '',
    54→  });
    55→
    56→  /**
    57→   * Upload a file to the temporary storage bucket
    58→   */
    59→  const uploadToTempStorage = async (file: File, userId: string): Promise<string> => {
    60→    const fileName = `${uuidv4()}-${file.name}`;
    61→    const filePath = `${userId}/${fileName}`;
    62→
    63→    const { error } = await supabase.storage
    64→      .from('temporary')
    65→      .upload(filePath, file, {
    66→        cacheControl: '3600',
    67→        upsert: false,
    68→      });
    69→
    70→    if (error) {
    71→      throw new Error(`Failed to upload file: ${error.message}`);
    72→    }
    73→
    74→    return filePath;
    75→  };
    76→
    77→  /**
    78→   * Upload LoRA file(s) and optionally sample videos to HuggingFace
    79→   * Supports both single-stage (one file) and multi-stage (high_noise + low_noise) LoRAs
    80→   */
    81→  const uploadToHuggingFace = async (

   104→        if (loraFiles.highNoise) {

   119→          storagePaths.lowNoise = await uploadToTempStorage(loraFiles.lowNoise, user.id);

   129→      } else {

   132→

   135→
   136→      if (sampleVideos.length > 0) {

   144→          const video = sampleVideos[i];
   145→          setUploadProgress({

   147→            message: `Uploading sample videos (${i + 1}/${sampleVideos.length})...`,
   148→            progress: 30 + (i / sampleVideos.length) * 20,

    55→
    56→export function useTimelineFrameUpdates({
    57→  shotId,
    58→  projectId,
    59→  shotGenerations,
    60→  syncShotData,
    61→}: UseTimelineFrameUpdatesOptions) {
    62→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    63→
    64→  /**
    65→   * Update timeline frame for a single generation
    66→   */
    67→  const updateTimelineFrame = useCallback(async (generationId: string, frame: number) => {
    68→    if (!shotId) {
    69→      throw new Error('No shotId provided');
    70→    }
    71→
    72→    // Find the shot_generation record - try multiple lookup strategies
    73→    let shotGen = shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.generation_id === generationId);
    74→
    75→    // Fallback: maybe the passed ID is actually the shot_generation ID
    76→    if (!shotGen) {

    78→    }

    81→    if (!shotGen?.id) {

    83→      throw new Error(`Shot generation not found for generation ${generationId} - this indicates a data flow issue`);
    84→    }

    92→    if (error) {

    97→    if (shotGen.generation_id) {

    99→    }
   100→
   101→    // Refetch instead of invalidate to preserve data

   109→  const batchExchangePositions = useCallback(async (
   110→    exchanges: Array<{ id: string; newFrame: number } | { shotGenerationIdA: string; shotGenerationIdB: string }>

   121→        let sgA = shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === swap.shotGenerationIdA);
   122→        if (!sgA) {
   123→          sgA = shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.generation_id === swap.shotGenerationIdA);
   124→        }
   125→
   126→        let sgB = shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === swap.shotGenerationIdB);
   127→        if (!sgB) {
   128→          sgB = shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.generation_id === swap.shotGenerationIdB);
   129→        }
   130→
   131→        if (!sgA || !sgB) {
   132→          return;
   133→        }
   134→
   135→        const frameA = sgA.timeline_frame;
   136→        const frameB = sgB.timeline_frame;
   137→
   138→        const updateA = supabase
   139→          .from('shot_generations')
   140→          .update({ timeline_frame: frameB })
   141→          .eq('id', sgA.id)
   142→          .eq('shot_id', shotId);
   143→
   144→        const updateB = supabase
   145→          .from('shot_generations')
   146→          .update({ timeline_frame: frameA })
   147→          .eq('id', sgB.id)
   148→          .eq('shot_id', shotId);
   149→
   150→        const syncPromises: Promise<void>[] = [];
   151→        if (sgA.generation_id) syncPromises.push(syncShotData(sgA.generation_id, shotId, frameB));
   152→        if (sgB.generation_id) syncPromises.push(syncShotData(sgB.generation_id, shotId, frameA));
   153→
   154→        const [resA, resB] = await Promise.all([updateA, updateB, ...syncPromises]);
   155→
   156→        if (resA.error) throw resA.error;
   157→        if (resB.error) throw resB.error;
   158→      });
   159→
   160→      await Promise.all(swapUpdates);
   161→
   162→      refetchRelatedCaches(queryClient, shotId, projectId);

   164→    }
   165→
   166→    // Handle absolute frame updates (from timeline drag)
   167→    const absoluteUpdates = exchanges as Array<{ id: string; newFrame: number }>;
   168→    const updates = absoluteUpdates.map(async ({ id, newFrame }) => {
   169→      let shotGen = shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.generation_id === id);
   170→
   171→      if (!shotGen) {
   172→        shotGen = shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === id);
   173→      }
   174→
   175→      if (!shotGen?.id) {
   176→        console.error('[TimelinePositionUtils] Shot generation not found for batch update:', id.substring(0, 8));
   177→        return;
   178→      }
   179→
   180→      const syncPromise = shotGen.generation_id
   181→        ? syncShotData(shotGen.generation_id, shotId, newFrame)
   182→        : Promise.resolve();
   183→
   184→      const { error } = await supabase
   185→        .from('shot_generations')
   186→        .update({ timeline_frame: newFrame })
   187→        .eq('id', shotGen.id)
   188→        .eq('shot_id', shotId);
   189→
   190→      await syncPromise;
   191→
   192→      if (error) {
   193→        console.error('[TimelinePositionUtils] Error updating position:', error);
   194→        throw error;
   195→      }
   196→    });
   197→
   198→    await Promise.all(updates);
   199→
   200→    refetchRelatedCaches(queryClient, shotId, projectId);
   201→  }, [shotId, shotGenerations, queryClient, projectId, syncShotData]);
   202→
   203→  /**
   204→   * Move items to distributed positions between neighbors (for batch mode drag).
   205→   * Supports both single and multi-item moves.
   206→   */
   207→  const moveItemsToMidpoint = useCallback(async (
   208→    draggedItemIds: string[],
   209→    newStartIndex: number,

   230→      allItems,
   231→      shotGenerations,

   234→    // Deduplicate

   237→    // Normalize (start at 0, compress gaps)
   238→    uniqueUpdates = buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(uniqueUpdates, shotGenerations);
   239→

   241→    const updatePromises = Array.from(uniqueUpdates.entries()).map(async ([id, payload]) => {

   260→  }, [shotId, shotGenerations, queryClient, projectId]);
   261→
   262→  return {
   263→    updateTimelineFrame,
   264→    batchExchangePositions,
   265→    moveItemsToMidpoint,
   266→  };
   267→}

     4→import { PANE_CONFIG } from '@/shared/config/panes';
     5→
     6→interface UseSlidingPaneOptions {
     7→  side: 'left' | 'right' | 'bottom';
     8→  isLocked: boolean;
     9→  onToggleLock: () => void;
    10→  additionalRefs?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>[];
    11→  /** External programmatic open state - when true, pane opens even if not locked */
    12→  programmaticOpen?: boolean;
    13→  /** Callback when pane open state changes (e.g., from hover timeout) */
    14→  onOpenChange?: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
    15→}
    16→
    17→export const useSlidingPane = ({ side, isLocked, onToggleLock, additionalRefs, programmaticOpen, onOpenChange }: UseSlidingPaneOptions) => {
    18→  const [isOpen, setIsOpenInternal] = useState(isLocked || programmaticOpen);
    19→
    20→  // Wrapper that also notifies parent of state changes
    21→  const setIsOpen = useCallback((open: boolean) => {
    22→    setIsOpenInternal(open);
    23→    onOpenChange?.(open);
    24→  }, [onOpenChange]);
    25→  const leaveTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    26→  const paneRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
    27→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
    28→  const isTablet = useIsTablet();
    29→  // On tablets, use desktop-like behavior with pane locking
    30→  // On phones (small mobile), use simplified mobile behavior without locking
    31→  const isSmallMobile = isMobile && !isTablet;
    32→  const location = useLocation();
    33→
    34→  const setOpen = useCallback((open: boolean) => {
    35→    // On small phones (not tablets), don't use locks at all - just manage open state
    36→    if (isSmallMobile) {
    37→      setIsOpen(open);
    38→      return;
    39→    }
    40→
    41→    // Desktop and tablet behavior (original)
    42→    if (isLocked && !open) {
    43→      // If locked, don't allow programmatic close via hover
    44→      return;
    45→    }
    46→
    47→    setIsOpen(open);
    48→  }, [isLocked, isSmallMobile, setIsOpen]);
    49→
    50→  // Sync open state with lock state AND programmatic open state
    51→  // Using useLayoutEffect to ensure state updates synchronously before paint
    52→  // This prevents visual glitches when state changes from external sources (like MediaLightbox)
    53→  // NOTE: Use setIsOpenInternal here (not setIsOpen) to avoid notifying parent of changes
    54→  // that originated from parent - that would create a feedback loop
    55→  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    56→    // Open if locked OR programmatically opened
    57→    if (isLocked || programmaticOpen) {
    58→      setIsOpenInternal(true);
    59→    } else {
    60→      setIsOpenInternal(false);
    61→    }
    62→  }, [isLocked, programmaticOpen]);
    63→
    64→  // Close pane on route change (small phones only)
    65→  useEffect(() => {
    66→    if (isSmallMobile) {
    67→      setIsOpen(false);
    68→    }
    69→    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    70→  }, [location.pathname]);
    71→
    72→  // Lock body scroll when pane is open on small phones (both temporary and locked states)
    73→  // When locked, Layout.tsx handles creating a scrollable main content area instead
    74→  useEffect(() => {
    75→    if (!isSmallMobile) return;
    76→    
    77→    if (isOpen) {
    78→      // Store original overflow style
    79→      const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    80→      const originalTouchAction = document.body.style.touchAction;
    81→      
    82→      // Lock body scroll - Layout.tsx creates separate scroll containers for split view
    83→      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    84→      document.body.style.touchAction = 'none';
    85→      
    86→      return () => {
    87→        // Restore original styles
    88→        document.body.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
    89→        document.body.style.touchAction = originalTouchAction;
    90→      };
    91→    }
    92→  }, [isSmallMobile, isOpen]);
    93→
    94→  // Click outside handler for small phones (only when not locked)
    95→  // We now use BOTH touchstart and pointerdown to ensure we capture
    96→  // all touch events BEFORE they can reach underlying elements
    97→  useEffect(() => {
    98→    // Don't close on click outside if pane is locked
    99→    if (!isSmallMobile || !isOpen || isLocked) return;
   100→
   101→    const handleClickOutside = (event: TouchEvent | MouseEvent | PointerEvent) => {
   102→      const targetEl = event.target as HTMLElement;
   103→
   104→      // Ignore if click is on any pane-control opener/closer
   105→      if (targetEl.closest('[data-pane-control]')) {
   106→        return; // allow event to proceed
   107→      }
   108→
   109→      // Ignore clicks on floating UI portal elements (Select, Popover, Dialog, etc.)
   110→      // These are rendered outside the pane but should be considered "inside" for interaction purposes
   111→      if (
   112→        targetEl.closest('[role="listbox"]') ||
   113→        targetEl.closest('[data-popup]') ||
   114→        targetEl.closest('[data-dialog-content]')
   115→      ) {
   116→        return; // allow event to proceed, don't close pane
   117→      }
   118→
   119→      if (paneRef.current && !paneRef.current.contains(targetEl) && !additionalRefs?.some(ref => ref.current?.contains(targetEl))) {
   120→        // Prevent the click from triggering underlying UI actions
   121→        event.preventDefault();
   122→        event.stopPropagation();
   123→        setIsOpen(false);
   124→      }
   125→    };
   126→
   127→    // Delay subscribing to click-outside events to prevent catching stray events from open tap
   128→    const subscribeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
   129→      document.addEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside, { capture: true, passive: false });
   130→      document.addEventListener('pointerdown', handleClickOutside, true);
   131→    }, 100);
   132→
   133→    return () => {
   134→      clearTimeout(subscribeTimeout);
   135→      document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside, true);
   136→      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', handleClickOutside, true);
   137→    };
   138→  }, [isSmallMobile, isOpen, isLocked, additionalRefs]);
   139→
   140→  // Close on dragstart anywhere (small phones)
   141→  useEffect(() => {
   142→    if (!isSmallMobile) return;
   143→
   144→    const handleDragStart = () => {
   145→      if (isOpen) {
   146→        setIsOpen(false);
   147→      }
   148→    };
   149→
   150→    document.addEventListener('dragstart', handleDragStart);
   151→    return () => document.removeEventListener('dragstart', handleDragStart);
   152→  }, [isSmallMobile, isOpen]);
   153→
   154→  // Exclusive pane coordination on small phones
   155→  // When another pane opens, this one should close (locking the other will handle unlocking this via PanesContext)
   156→  useEffect(() => {
   157→    if (!isSmallMobile) return;
   158→
   159→    const handleMobilePaneOpen = (evt: Event) => {
   160→      const customEvt = evt as CustomEvent<{ side: string | null }>;
   161→      const openedSide = customEvt.detail?.side ?? null;
   162→      if (openedSide !== side && !isLocked) {
   163→        // Another pane (or null) requested and we're not locked – close this one
   164→        setIsOpen(false);
   165→      }
   166→      // Note: If this pane IS locked, PanesContext will handle unlocking it
   167→      // when the other pane gets locked (only one can be locked at a time on mobile)
   168→    };
   169→
   170→    window.addEventListener('mobilePaneOpen', handleMobilePaneOpen as EventListener);
   171→    return () => window.removeEventListener('mobilePaneOpen', handleMobilePaneOpen as EventListener);
   172→  }, [isSmallMobile, side, isLocked]);
   173→
   174→  const openPane = () => {
   175→    if (leaveTimeoutRef.current) {
   176→        clearTimeout(leaveTimeoutRef.current);
   177→        leaveTimeoutRef.current = null;
   178→    }
   179→
   180→    if (isSmallMobile) {
   181→      // Dispatch global event so other panes close immediately
   182→      const evt = new CustomEvent('mobilePaneOpen', { detail: { side } });
   183→      window.dispatchEvent(evt);
   184→    }
   185→    setOpen(true);
   186→  }
   187→
   188→  const handlePaneLeave = () => {
   189→    // No hover behavior on small phones
   190→    if (isSmallMobile) return;
   191→
   192→    if (isLocked) return;
   193→    leaveTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   194→      setOpen(false);
   195→    }, PANE_CONFIG.timing.HOVER_DELAY);
   196→  };
   197→
   198→  const handlePaneEnter = () => {
   199→    // No hover behavior on small phones
   200→    if (isSmallMobile) return;
   201→
   202→    if (isLocked) return;
   203→    if (leaveTimeoutRef.current) {
   204→      clearTimeout(leaveTimeoutRef.current);
   205→      leaveTimeoutRef.current = null;
   206→    }
   207→  };
   208→
   209→  const toggleLock = (force?: boolean) => {
   210→    // Allow locking on all devices including mobile
   211→    if (force !== undefined) {
   212→      // Force to specific state - used by UI buttons
   213→      if (force !== isLocked) {
   214→        onToggleLock();
   215→      }
   216→    } else {
   217→      // Toggle current state
   218→      onToggleLock();
   219→    }
   220→  };
   221→  
   222→  useEffect(() => {
   223→    // Cleanup timeout on unmount
   224→    return () => {
   225→      if (leaveTimeoutRef.current) {
   226→        clearTimeout(leaveTimeoutRef.current);
   227→      }
   228→    };
   229→  }, []);
   230→
   231→  const getTransformClass = () => {
   232→    // Pane is visible if open OR locked (all devices)
   233→    const isVisible = isOpen || isLocked;
   234→
   235→    const transformClass = (() => {
   236→      switch (side) {
   237→        case 'left':
   238→          return isVisible ? 'translate-x-0' : '-translate-x-full';
   239→        case 'right':
   240→          return isVisible ? 'translate-x-0' : 'translate-x-full';
   241→        case 'bottom':
   242→          return isVisible ? 'translate-y-0' : 'translate-y-full';
   243→        default:
   244→          return '';
   245→      }
   246→    })();
   247→
   248→    return transformClass;
   249→  };
   250→
   251→  const paneProps = {
   252→    ref: paneRef,
   253→    onMouseEnter: handlePaneEnter,
   254→    onMouseLeave: handlePaneLeave,
   255→  };
   256→
   257→  // Should show a backdrop overlay that captures all touches
   258→  // Only on small phones when pane is open but NOT locked
   259→  const showBackdrop = isSmallMobile && isOpen && !isLocked;
   260→
   261→  return {
   262→    isLocked, // Return actual lock state on all devices
   263→    isOpen,
   264→    toggleLock,
   265→    openPane,
   266→    paneProps,
   267→    transformClass: getTransformClass(),
   268→    handlePaneEnter,
   269→    handlePaneLeave,
   270→    isMobile, // Still return isMobile for backward compatibility
   271→    showBackdrop, // Whether to show backdrop overlay for tap-outside-to-close
   272→    closePane: () => setIsOpen(false), // Function to close the pane (for backdrop onClick)
   273→  };
   274→};

    32→    inCloud: boolean;
    33→  };
    34→  aiInputMode: {

    36→  };
    37→  privacyDefaults: {

    39→    generationsPublic: boolean;
    40→  };
    41→  theme: {
